english: Eala won with a score of 6(1)-7, 7-6(4), 6-1 which was the last tune-up game of the Filipino tennis star before Wimbledon.

english: Eala previously defeated Zeynep Sonmez, 6-1, 6-3 of Turkey on Saturday.

english: The victory is a big boost for Eala for her first match at Wimbledon.

text: MAY ambisyon man gali sa pagdalagan sa pagka-Presidente si boxing-legend kag Senador Manny Pacquiao.
english: BOXING-legend and Senator Manny Pacquiao also has ambitions to run for president.

text: In fact, sadto pa ginsugid ining iya ambisyon sang iya coach nga si Freddie Roach, kag bisan sang boxing promoter nga si Bob Arum sa pagdaug sini sa pagka-senador sadtong May 2016 election.
english: In fact, his coach Freddie Roach, and even boxing promoter Bob Arum, have already expressed his ambition to win the senatorial seat in the May 2016 election.

text: Biib kita sa suporta sang mga pumuluyo kay Pacquiao.
english: We are amazed at the support of the people for Pacquiao.

text: Todo suporta gid kita sa mga kadalag-an sini sa boksing.
english: We fully support his victories in boxing.

text: Halos tanan nga Filipino mga fans niya.
english: Almost all Filipinos are his fans.

text: Bag-o sini, nangin representative man siya sang Saranggani sa sulod sang duha ka termino sa idalom sang UNA Party ni anay Vice Presidente Jejomar Binay kag indi sang LDP-Laban, kon diin nagsaylo siya kag ginsaligan nga makabulig sa partido.
english: Before that, he was also the representative of Saranggani for two terms under the UNA Party of former Vice President Jejomar Binay and not the LDP-Laban, where he moved and was trusted to help the party.

text: Ginhimo pa gani ini nga Acting Party President.
english: It was even made Acting Party President.

text:
***

Ugaling, amat-amat na ini nangin “obstacle” para sa kay President Duterte samtang nagahilapit ang presidential election sa 2022.
english:
***

However, it has gradually become an obstacle for President Duterte as the 2022 presidential election approaches.

text: Sang sini lang gani, ginpakanubo sini ang “soft stance” kag  “defeatist attitude” ni Presidente Duterte sa “bullying” sang China batok sa aton legal claim sa 200-nautical mile nga Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ).
english: Recently, it downplayed President Duterte's “soft stance” and “defeatist attitude” on China's bullying against our legal claim to the 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ).

text: May sovereign rights kita diri nga may lubos nga kinamatarong sa pag-okupar kag pag-benepisyo sa ano man nga kaayuhan nga makuha naton diri.
english: We have sovereign rights here with full right to occupy and benefit from whatever good we get here.

text: Gintugyan ining EEZ sang UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) sa aton kag sa iban pa nga pungsod nga katapo sang United Nations, nga nagalakip man gani sang Filipinas kag China.
english: This EEZ is entrusted by the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) to us and other member countries of the United Nations, which even includes the Philippines and China.

text: Nanindugan si Pacquao nga dapat ipangisug naton ang aton kinamatarong sa EEZ, nga ginhangop ni Presidente Duterte nga nagaugyon siya sa position sang political opposition nga ginapanguluhan ni Vice President Leni Robredo sang ISambayan coalition.
english: Pacquao insisted that we must assert our rights to the EEZ, which President Duterte interpreted as agreeing with the position of the political opposition led by Vice President Leni Robredo of the ISambayan coalition.

text: Amat-amat man nga nabaton sang mga kapartido ni Presidente Duterte ang mensahe sang Presidente sa sining taliwas nga tindug ni Pacquiao.
english: President Duterte's party members have also gradually accepted the President's message on Pacquiao's opposite position.

text: Gani, nagpagwa sing sentimiento na ang pila ka nagapanguna nga myembro sang LDP-Laban Party ni Presidente Duterte agud sawayon na siya.
english: Some leading members of President Duterte's LDP-Laban Party have already expressed their sentiments to criticize him.

text: Sa isa gani ka asembliya sang partido, nakibut siya nga wala man lang siya naimbitahan diri.
english: At one party assembly, he was surprised that he was not invited.

text: Gali kay nag-entra na ang Presidente, nga tsirman sang LDP-Laban, kag gintugyan ang paghiwat sang asembliya sa bise presidente sang partido.
english: The President, who is the chairman of the LDP-Laban, has already stepped in and entrusted the holding of the assembly to the party's vice president.

text: Kon matuod ang ulihi nga balita nga nabaton naton, indi na acting party president si Pacquiao kag gin-islan na sang iban.
english: If the latest news we received is true, Pacquiao is no longer acting party president and has been replaced by someone else.

text: Bati ta si House Speaker Velasco.
english: Let’s beat House Speaker Velasco.

text: Sa isa ka survey, nga suspetso sang iban gin-lutong macao sang partido, naggwa nga samtang si Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte ang nagapanguna, si Pacquiao pang-apat lang.
english: In a survey, which some suspect was cooked by the party, it turned out that while Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte was leading, Pacquiao was only fourth.

text:
***

Tungod sini, bati ta nga may nagatulod sa iya agud mag-upod sa ISambayan sang political opposition.
english:
***

Because of this, we hear that someone is pushing him to join the ISambayan of the political opposition.

text: Katulad ini seguro sang ginhimo sang mautak nga anay Diktador Ferdinand Marcos nga sang napierde sa nominasyon sang Liberal Party, nagtipyok sa Nacionalista Party kon diin eventually nagdaug siya sa pagka-Presidente.
english: This is probably similar to what the brainy former Dictator Ferdinand Marcos did when he lost the Liberal Party nomination, joined the Nacionalista Party where he eventually won the presidency.

text: Pero sori gid, Mr. Pac-Man, wala man gana sa imo ang ISambayan.
english: But I'm sorry, Mr. Pac-Man, ISambayan doesn't like you either.

text: “We are a coalition of democratic forces.
english: “We are a coalition of democratic forces.

text: We reject those who are identified with authoritarianism.
english: We reject those who are identified with authoritarianism.

text: We reject those who are responsible for extrajudicial killings or who abet extrajudicial killings,” siling ni retired Supreme Court Senior Justice Antonio Carpio sadto sa suhestyon nga basi pwede masuportahan nila ang kandidatura ni Davao City Sara Duterte sa pagka-Presidente.
english: We reject those who are responsible for extrajudicial killings or who abet extrajudicial killings,” retired Supreme Court Senior Justice Antonio Carpio said then on the suggestion that they might support Davao City Sara Duterte’s candidacy for President.

text: Subong man sina ang siling ni Carpio, nga lead convenor san ISambayan, kon bala mabaton nila si Pacquiao sa ila grupo.
english: Carpio, the lead convenor of ISambayan, also said that they will accept Pacquiao in their group.

text: “There are many of us who do not agree with his position on extrajudicial killings.
english: “There are many of us who do not agree with his position on extrajudicial killings.

text: He’s also for the death penalty although he quotes the Bible,” siling ni retired SC Senior Justice Carpio.
english: He’s also for the death penalty although he quotes the Bible,” retired SC Senior Justice Carpio said.

text: So, quo vadis na, Mr. Pac-Man!/PN
english: So, quo vadis na, Mr. Pac-Man!/PN

text: Apisar sang kaakig sang China kasunod sang kontrobersyal nga pagbisita ni US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi sa Taiwan sang nagligad nga semana, nagpadala pa gid ang Estados Unidos sang five-member congressional delegation agud magpakigkita kay President Tsai Ing-wen.
english: Despite China's anger following US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi's controversial visit to Taiwan last week, the United States still sent a five-member congressional delegation to meet with President Tsai Ing-wen.

text: Ang nasambit nga bipartisan group ang ginpangunahan ni Senator Ed Markey, Democrat of Massachusetts.
english: The bipartisan group was led by Senator Ed Markey, Democrat of Massachusetts.

text: Subong nga adlaw, Agusto 15, natalana nga magsapol ang US lawmakers sa presidente sang Taiwan.
english: Today, August 15, US lawmakers are scheduled to meet with the president of Taiwan.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang panibag-o nga sabat ang China sa panibag-o nga tikang sang Estados Unidos.
english: So far, China has not yet responded to the new US move.

text: Ginalantaw sang analysts nga posible may “sharp reaction” ang Beijing kaangay sang pagdugang sang military exercises sa palibot sang Taiwan.
english: Analysts expect Beijing to have a "sharp reaction" such as increasing military exercises around Taiwan.

text: Bangud gina-claim sang China nga teritoryo pa sini ang Taiwan, ginpatigayon nila sang nagligad nga semana ang military drills sa palibot sang isla agud ipakita ang kaakig sa pag-abot ni Pelosi.
english: Because China still claims Taiwan as its territory, it conducted military drills around the island last week to show its anger over Pelosi's arrival.

text: Sa latest report sang Defence Ministry sang Taiwan, ginapahayag nga may 22 pa ka Chinese aircraft kag anum ka naval ships sa sulod kag sa palibot sang Taiwan Strait.
english: According to the latest report by Taiwan's Defense Ministry, there are still 22 Chinese aircraft and six naval ships in and around the Taiwan Strait.

text: Ginkakas sang Malacañang ang duha ka Department of Health (DOH) officials sa ila mga posisyon.
english: Malacañang has removed two Department of Health (DOH) officials from their positions.

text: Ginkumpirma ini sang separado nga memoranda halin sa Office of the Executive Secretary.
english: This was confirmed by a separate memorandum from the Office of the Executive Secretary.

text: Ini ang epektibo gilayon.
english: It is effective immediately.

text: Sa sulat nga napetsahan Abril 15 nga naka-address kay DOH Secretary Teodoro J. Herbosa, gin-anunsyo ni Executive Secretary Lucas P. Bersamin ang gilayon nga pagkakas kay Ariel I. Valencia bilang Assistant Secretary of Health.
english: In a letter dated April 15 addressed to DOH Secretary Teodoro J. Herbosa, Executive Secretary Lucas P. Bersamin announced the immediate dismissal of Ariel I. Valencia as Assistant Secretary of Health.

text: Ang ikaduha nga sulat ang nagakumpirma man sa termination ni Jaime S. Bernadas bilang Director IV sang DOH.
english: The second letter also confirms the termination of Jaime S. Bernadas as Director IV of the DOH.

text: Wala gintuad sa dokumento ang kabangdanan sang pagsipa sa ila sa posisyon.
english: The document did not disclose the reason for their dismissal.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Nagasaulog subong nga 2025 ang Girl Scout of the Philippines Iloilo sang Diamond Jubilee.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Girl Scout of the Philippines Iloilo is celebrating its Diamond Jubilee in 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Merrily Jane Pedroso, Program Commissioner sa Girl Scout of the Philippines Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga yearlong ang ila selebrasyon sa diin kada bulan kay nagkalain-lain sila nga aktibidad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Merrily Jane Pedroso, Program Commissioner of the Girl Scout of the Philippines Iloilo, said their celebration is yearlong where every month they have different activities.

text: Suno kay Pedroso, subong nga Pebrero may yara sila sang Diamond Jubilee Queen.
english: According to Pedroso, this February they will have a Diamond Jubilee Queen.

text: Lima sa ila ang halin sa probinsya sang Iloilo nga may tag-isa halin sa kada district, isa ang halin sa Iloilo City, kag may isa nga naghalin sa Guimaras.
english: Five of them are from Iloilo province with one from each district, one from Iloilo City, and one from Guimaras.

text: Sa subong, ang Queen amo si Junior Girl Scout Ma.
english: Right now, the Queen is Junior Girl Scout Ma.

text: Erika Jenielle Mendoza sang San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: Erika Jenielle Mendoza of San Enrique, Iloilo.

text: Ini nga aktibidad antg kabahin sang ila fundraising event para nga makaayo ang pasilidad sa Camp Pasica sa Dingle, Iloilo.
english: This activity is part of their fundraising event to improve the facility at Camp Pasica in Dingle, Iloilo.

text: Patigayunon ang koronasyon sa Jubilee Queen sa Pebrero 22 sa Camp Pasica.
english: The coronation of the Jubilee Queen will be held on February 22 at Camp Pasica.

text: Gin-athag sang World Health Organization nga wala naangot sa mga amo ang monkeypox outbreaks.
english: The World Health Organization has clarified that monkeypox outbreaks are not linked to employers.

text: Kasunod ini sang reports nga ginapang-atake kag ginapang-hiluan ang amo nga mga sapat sa Brazil.
english: This follows reports of such animals being attacked and poisoned in Brazil.

text: Suno kay WHO spokeswoman Margaret Harris, nagakatabo ang transmission sa mga tawo kag indi dapat pagbasulon ang mga amo.
english: WHO spokeswoman Margaret Harris said human-to-human transmission occurs and employers are not to blame.

text: Sa report sang local media, ginapahayag nga ginabato ang mga amo sa Brazilian cities.
english: According to local media reports, employers are reportedly being stoned in Brazilian cities.

text: Sa natural reserve sa Rio do Preto, Sao Paulo state, 10 ka amo ang daw ginpanghiluan kag hungod nga gin-injure sa sulod lang sang halos isa ka semana.
english: In a natural reserve in Rio do Preto, Sao Paulo state, 10 employees were apparently poisoned and deliberately injured in just over a week.

text: Ginadudahan sang rescuers kag activists nga ginpang-atake sila matapos nga nakumpirma nga may tatlo ka monkeypox cases sa amo nga area.
english: Rescuers and activists suspect they were attacked after three monkeypox cases were confirmed in the area.

text: Sa bilog nga kalibutan, masobra na sa 28,100 cases ang nakumpirma kag 12 ang napatay.
english: Worldwide, more than 28,100 cases have been confirmed and 12 have died.

text: Ginpahayag ni Harris nga bisan monkeypox ang pangalan sini, wala ini nagakahulugan nga mga amo ang main transmitters sang balatian kag rason sang current outbreak.
english: Harris said that although it is called monkeypox, it does not mean that they are the main transmitters of the disease and the cause of the current outbreak.

text: Ginpangalanan ini nga monkeypox bangud una nga na-identify ang virus sa mga amo nga gina-tun-an sa ukon ginatatap para sa research sa Denmark.
english: It was named monkeypox because the virus was first identified in monkeys being studied or treated for research in Denmark.

text: Wala sang katupong nga pagpasalamat sa Diyos ang ginhimo sang mga alumni sang Central Philippine University (CPU) matapos nalakip sa mga topnotchers sa February 2025 Respiratory Therapists Licensure Examination.
english: The alumni of the Central Philippine University (CPU) expressed their gratitude to God after being among the topnotchers in the February 2025 Respiratory Therapists Licensure Examination.

text: Patas sa Rank 5 sanday Jose Miguel Santisteban Dumat-ol sang Miagao, Iloilo kag Jywelle Nae Leonero Nacional sang Sultan Kudarat nga may 91.75 percent.
english: Jose Miguel Santisteban Dumat-ol of Miagao, Iloilo and Jywelle Nae Leonero Nacional of Sultan Kudarat are tied for Rank 5 with 91.75 percent.

text: Samtang, pareho naman nga Rank 6 sanday Di-Anne-Mei Quiñones Evangelista sang Mandurriao, Iloilo City kag Charisse Joy Ponte Rubino sang Kalibo, Aklan nga nakakuha sang 91.50 percent.
english: Meanwhile, Di-Anne-Mei Quiñones Evangelista of Mandurriao, Iloilo City and Charisse Joy Ponte Rubino of Kalibo, Aklan were both Rank 6 with 91.50 percent.

text: Nalab-ot naman sang CPU ang 97.30% nga passing rate matapos 36 sa 37 ka examinees halin sa unibersidad ang nakapasar sa pasinawan.
english: The CPU achieved a 97.30% passing rate after 36 out of 37 examinees from the university passed the examination.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa 1,097 examinees 853 ang nakapasar ang pasinawan.
english: Out of 1,097 examinees, 853 passed the examination.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Santisteban, iya ginpahayag nga sang Senior High School ini, nagdesisyon ini nga magkuha sang nasambit nga kurso matapos ang ila immersion.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Santisteban said that when he was in Senior High School, he decided to take the course after their immersion.

text: Apisar indi ini ang iya una nga napilian nga kurso, apang natun-an naman niya ini nga palanggaon sa diin nagbunga sang matam-is ang iya pagtuon.
english: Although this was not his first choice of course, he learned to love it and his studies bore fruit.

text: Samtang suno naman kay Nacional, nangin dako man nga pagpahangkat sa ila pagtuon ang pandemya.
english: Meanwhile, Nacional said the pandemic has also been a big challenge for their studies.

text: Apang sa pihak sini, nagtutok ini sa iya handom nga mangin Respiratory Therapist.
english: But despite this, she focused on her dream of becoming a Respiratory Therapist.

text: Para naman kay Evangelista, makabig man nga survival of the fittest ang ila kurso sa diin sang 1st year masobra sila sa 40, apang masobra na lang sa 30 sa ila ang naka-graduate.
english: For Evangelista, their course is also considered survival of the fittest where in the 1st year they were more than 40, but only more than 30 of them graduated.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga indi mahapos ang ila kurso bangud nakasandig sa ila ang kabuhi sang tawo ilabi na nga nakatutok sila sa Respiratory.
english: He said their course is not easy because people's lives depend on them especially since they are focused on respiratory.

text: Ginpakigbahin naman ni Rubino nga ang iya inspirasyon sa iya pagtuon amo ang iya hinuptanan nga ido.
english: Rubino shared that his inspiration for his studies was his pet dog.

text: Suno kay Rubino, nangin dako man nga bulig sa ila pag-review amo nga isa lang sila ka section sa diin nangin mahapos ang ila pagbuligay sa pagtuon.
english: According to Rubino, it was also a big help in their review that they were in one section which made it easier for them to work together to learn.

text: Wala na nakasaka sa stage sa graduation ceremony ang estudyante nga si Khentjoy Balsomo Beatisula, 20,  residente sang Brgy.
english: Student Khentjoy Balsomo Beatisula, 20, resident of Brgy.

text: Fatima, General Santos City, South Cotabato matapos ginbawian sang kabuhi.
english: Fatima, General Santos City, South Cotabato after he died.

text: Suno kay Alyas Panny, iloy sang biktima, nauna na nga nagkadto ang anak sa Banisil National High School sang alas-3 sang hapon para sa graduation rites.
english: According to Panny, the victim's mother, her son had already gone to Banisil National High School at 3 pm for the graduation rites.

text: Makaligad ang pila ka minuto, nakibot nalang ini sang nakit-an nga nagahigda sa salog kag may pilas sa tuhod kag kilay ang iya anak.
english: A few minutes later, she was shocked to find her son lying on the floor with injuries to his knee and eyebrow.

text: Sa imbestigasyon sang Fatima Police Station, naggwa nga nakadasma kag nag-igo ang estudyante sa semento.
english: According to the investigation of the Fatima Police Station, the student slipped and hit the cement.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang PNP nga wala sang foul play sa kamatayon sang estudyante.
english: The PNP also confirmed that there was no foul play in the death of the student.

text: Nadala pa ini  sa ospital apang gindeklarar nga dead on arrival.
english: He was rushed to the hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Isa ka tawo ang patay matapos nga nagkulob ang isa ka Chinese vessel sa Rizal sa Occidental Mindoro kahapon sang hapon.
english: One person was killed after a Chinese vessel capsized off Rizal in Occidental Mindoro yesterday afternoon.

text: Ang biktima isa Chinese citizen nga gindeklarar nga dead on arrival sa ospital.
english: The victim was a Chinese citizen who was declared dead on arrival at the hospital.

text: Suno sa otoridad, ang barko ang nagapreparar nga maglarga nga may karga nga balas sang hinali lang ini nagtakilid kag naglugdang.
english: According to authorities, the ship was preparing to leave with a load of sand when it suddenly tilted and sank.

text: May yara sang crew sang 23 ka Filipinos kag Chinese seafarers ang barko.
english: The ship had a crew of 23 Filipino and Chinese seafarers.

text: Anom ka mga Pinoy kag pito ka Chinese ang natigayon nga ma-rescue.
english: Six Filipinos and seven Chinese were rescued.

text: Padayon pa ang Search and rescue operations para sa iban nga crewmen.
english: Search and rescue operations are still ongoing for the other crewmen.

text: Wala pa matumod ang kabangdanan sang paglugdang sang barko.
english: The cause of the sinking has not yet been determined.

text: May mga report nga naga-guwa nga nagsugtanay na ang Israel kag Palestinian militants nga magpatuman sang ceasefire sa Gaza matapos nga nagpatunga ang Egypt.
english: There are reports that Israel and Palestinian militants have agreed to implement a ceasefire in Gaza after Egypt intervened.

text: May Egyptian security source nga nagpahayag nga nagpasugot ang Israel sa proposal, apang wala naman ini ginkumpirma sang spokespeople para sa Israel kag Islamic Jihad.
english: An Egyptian security source said Israel had agreed to the proposal, but the spokesperson for Israel and Islamic Jihad did not confirm this.

text: Ang ginpahayag lang amo nga padayon ang pag-contact subong sa Cairo.
english: All that was said was that contact is currently ongoing in Cairo.

text: Suno sa Gaza officials, 31 na ka Palestinians ang napatay lakip na ang anum ka kabataan kag mga Palestinian Islamic Jihad group fighters lakip na ang duha ka mataas nga lider nga sanday Khaled Mansour kag Tayseer Jabari.
english: According to Gaza officials, 31 Palestinians have been killed including six children and Palestinian Islamic Jihad group fighters including two senior leaders Khaled Mansour and Tayseer Jabari.

text: Halos 600 ka Palestinian rockets kag mortars ang ginpalupad pa-Israel halin sang Byernes suno sa isa ka Israeli official.
english: Nearly 600 Palestinian rockets and mortars have been flown into Israel since Friday, an Israeli official said.

text: Sabat pa sang Israel, gin-launch sang pungsod ang amo nga mga operasyon bangud nakabatyag ini sang pamahog halin sa Palestinian Islamic Jihad.
english: Israel said the country launched the operations because it felt threatened by the Palestinian Islamic Jihad.

text: Ini nga bayluhanay-pwersa amo ang pinakaulihi nga natabo sa tunga sang Israel kag Gaza umpisa sang natabo ang onse ka adlaw nga away sang Mayo 2021 kun sa diin masobra 200 ka Palestinians kag madamo man nga Israelis ang nagkalamatay.
english: The exchange of force is the latest between Israel and Gaza since the 11-day fighting in May 2021 that killed more than 200 Palestinians and many Israelis.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag ang Israeli military nga ang ila latest operation nga may codename nga “Breaking Dawn” ang mahimo maglawig sang isa ka semana.
english: Earlier, the Israeli military said its latest operation, codenamed “Breaking Dawn,” could last a week.

text: Sini lang nga Domingo, ang Palestinian rockets halin sa Gaza Strip ang nakadangat na sa Jerusalem — labing-una nga natabo halin sang kumplikto sang 2021.##
english: Just this Sunday, Palestinian rockets from the Gaza Strip reached Jerusalem — the first time since the conflict in 2021.##

text: Indi lang record high temperatures kag mala nga duta ang dala sang heatwaves sa mga pungsod sa Europa subong nga summer.
english: Heatwaves are not just bringing record high temperatures and dry soil to European countries this summer.

text: Sa dalayon nga paghubas sang tubig sa mga suba kaangay sang natabo sa River Po sa Italya, nakit-an ang nag-submerge anay nga bomba sang panahon pa sang World War II.
english: In constant flooding of rivers such as the River Po in Italy, a former submersible bomb from World War II has been found.

text: Mga manugpangisda ang nakatukib sini nga bomba (ginabanta nagabug-at sang 450 kg) sa northern village sang Borgo Virgilio, malapit sa syudad sang Mantua.
english: Fishermen discovered the bomb (estimated to weigh 450 kg) in the northern village of Borgo Virgilio, near Mantua City.

text: Sunod man nga gin-defuse sang military experts ang bomba kag ginpatigayon ang controlled explosion.
english: Military experts subsequently defused the bomb and conducted a controlled explosion.

text: Sa pagpatigayon sang disposal operation, gin-evacuate ang ginabanta 3,000 ka mga tawo.
english: In conducting the disposal operation, an estimated 3,000 people were evacuated.

text: Gin-shut down ang airspace kag ginpauntat ang navigation sa waterway amo man ang traffic sa railway line malapit sa amo nga lugar kun diin ginpalupok ang bomba.
english: The airspace was shut down and navigation on the waterway was stopped as well as traffic on the railway line near the area where the bomb was detonated.

text: Ang River Po amo ang longest river sa Italya.
english: The River Po is the longest river in Italy.

text: Ini ang ginakuhaan sang one-third sang agricultural production sang Italya kag subong naga-suprer sang worst drought sa sulod sang 70 ka tuig.
english: It accounts for one-third of Italy's agricultural production and is currently suffering the worst drought in 70 years.

text: Hindi na pipigilan ni Pangulong Marcos ang pagpasa ng kontrobersyal na “Konektadong Pinoy” bill, na inaasahang kusa nang magiging batas pagdating ng Agosto 24, ayon sa Department of Information and Communications Technology.
english: President Marcos will no longer prevent the passage of the controversial “Connected Filipino” bill, which is expected to become law on August 24, according to the Department of Information and Communications Technology.

text: Kinumpirma ni DICT Secretary Henry Aguda na walang indikasyong i-ve-veto ng Pangulo ang panukala, na layong pabilisin ang licensing process, itaguyod ang infrastructure sharing, at payagan ang mas maliliit na kumpanya na mag-invest sa data transmission kahit walang legislative franchise.
english: DICT Secretary Henry Aguda confirmed that there is no indication that the President will veto the proposal, which aims to speed up the licensing process, promote infrastructure sharing, and allow smaller companies to invest in data transmission even without legislative franchise.

text: Bagamat suportado ng gobyerno, umani ito ng batikos mula sa malalaking telco companies na nag-aalalang maapektuhan ang kanilang operasyon at seguridad.
english: Although supported by the government, it has drawn criticism from large telco companies who are concerned that their operations and security will be affected.

text: Gayunman, tiniyak ng DICT na lalahok ang mga telco sa pagbalangkas ng implementing rules and regulations o IRR.
english: However, DICT assured that telcos will be involved in the formulation of implementing rules and regulations or IRR.

text: ILOILO CITY- Kilalahon ta ang pinaka-sensitive nga tawo sa kalibutan.
english: ILOILO CITY- Let's get to know the most sensitive person in the world.

text: Sensitibo ini, indi bangud nga mahapos ini nga magsunggod kag maghibi kundi, mahapos nga magbatyag ang lawas sini kun may makaon ini nga pagkaon nga indi masahuan sang iya lawas.
english: It is sensitive, not because it is easy to start and cry but, it is easy for its body to feel when it eats food that its body cannot digest.

text: Siya si Jenna Gestetner, 21-anyos sang Los Angeles, California, nga na-diagnose nga may Mast Cell Activation Syndrome (MCAS) sa bata nga edad.
english: She is Jenna Gestetner, 21-year-old of Los Angeles, California, who was diagnosed with Mast Cell Activation Syndrome (MCAS) at a young age.

text: Ang MCAS kilala bilang kondisyon sa diin ang pasyente naga- eksperyensiya sang sulit-sulit nga episodes sang symptoms sang anaphylaxis — allergic symptoms kaangay sang paghabok-habok, low blood pressure, nabudlayan sa pagginhawa kag iban pa.
english: MCAS is known as a condition in which the patient experiences repeated episodes of symptoms of anaphylaxis — allergic symptoms such as hives, low blood pressure, difficulty breathing and others.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, may yara ini sang 100 tanan ka allergies kag ginalimitahan lamang nga magkaon sang 13 ka pagkaon.
english: In fact, it has 100 total allergies and is only restricted to eating 13 foods.

text: Suno kay Jenna, humalin sang 12-anyos siya, sa kada tion nga may ginakaon ini, masami siya makabatyag sang paglingin sang ulo, pagpalanakit sang lawas, kakapoy kag iban pa tubtob nga naglala ini.
english: According to Jenna, since she was 12 years old, every time she ate something, she often felt dizzy, body aches, fatigue and others until it got worse.

text: Kag sang ulihi, didto na ini na-diagnose nga may yara siya sang amo nga kondisyon.
english: And later, that's when he was diagnosed with the condition.

text: Sa subong, ang 13 ka mga pagkaon nga mahimo niya i-enjoy ang ginalakipan sang white fish, turkey, green beans, zucchini, cucumber, lime, dates, grapes, raspberries, pears, chia seeds, water lily seeds kag olive oil.
english: Right now, the 13 foods she can enjoy include white fish, turkey, green beans, zucchini, cucumber, lime, dates, grapes, raspberries, pears, chia seeds, water lily seeds and olive oil.

text: NGAA madamo gihapon ang wala luyag magpabakuna kontra COVID-19?
english: WHY are so many people still reluctant to get vaccinated against COVID-19?

text: Para sa iban, ina tungod ining bakuna sa karon experimento pa lang, kag indi sila luyag magpa-abenturar nga itugyan ang ila ikaayong lawas sa wala pa sing kaseguruhan nga experimento.
english: For some, that's because this vaccine is currently an experiment, and they don't want to venture out and entrust their health to an uncertain experiment.

text: Plano nila ang maghulat lang anay tubtub masaligan na gid ini sa experyensya sang kadam-an nga mauna, ukon tubtub ma-commercialize na ang vaccine.
english: They plan to wait until it is reliable in the experience of the majority of people who will be first, or until the vaccine is commercialized.

text: Isa pa, malaka man lang kuno ang maigu sing “severe” sang COVID-19 kag mapa-abenturahan ini kasubong sang trangkaso (flu) nga indi kinahanglan magpa-bakuna, although available man ang bakuna para sa flu.
english: In addition, it is said that few people are severely affected by COVID-19 and can be treated like the flu without the need for vaccination, although the flu vaccine is also available.

text: Ang record sang kalibutan nagasiling nga ang nagakapatay sa COVID-19 nagalab-ut na, on average, sa indi magsobra sa 5% kag ang laban sini mga tigulang kag ang may balatian nga may mataas sing risgo.
english: World records say that the death toll from COVID-19 is already reaching, on average, no more than 5% and most of them are the elderly and those with high-risk diseases.

text: Tungod sini, sunu sa ila nga indi pa man tigulang kag wala man sing ginadala-dala nga balatian, wala gid man kuno sing daku nga kabalak-an kon nagaamlig ka man samtang nagapangita sing palangabuhian sa gwa.
english: Therefore, according to those who are not old and do not have any diseases, there is nothing to worry about if you are protected while earning a living outside.

text: Sori, ugaling nga indi ini mapasugtan sang aton gobyerno tungod sa experyensya man sang pila ka pungsod kon diin mataas ang death rate tungod sa halog nga pagpatigayon sang mga health protocols, katulad sang Sweden, kon diin ang death toll sining ulihi naglab-ut na sobra sa 10% ang excess mortality.
english: Sorry, but our government cannot allow this because of the experience of some countries where the death rate is high due to the slow implementation of health protocols, such as Sweden, where the death toll recently reached more than 10% excess mortality.

text: Pangayuon ta lang nga mabalanse sang gobyerno ang health measures kag ang livelihood sang mga pumuluyo para indi kita tanan matam-an tubtub magtalikud ang ngit-ngit sang COVID-19.
english: Let's just ask the government to balance the health measures and the livelihood of the people so that we are not all affected until the darkness of COVID-19 passes.

text: Kag magpabakuna!
english: And get vaccinated!

text: Agud bisan maigu sining virus indi man “severe” kag indi ka magtupa sa ICU.
english: So that even if you get this virus, it's not severe and you don't end up in the ICU.

text: In other words, maayo gid man nga magpaniguro paagi sa bakuna agud malikaw kita sa malala nga sintoma kag masid-angan pa ni Kamatayan kon matabo, luas lang kon nakapanakga ka na nga itugyan na gid lang ang imo kapalaran sa binubuot sang Diyos.
english: In other words, it is good to be vaccinated to avoid severe symptoms and even death if it happens, unless you have decided to leave your destiny to the will of God.

text:
***

Na-alarma ang bug-os nga kalibutan sa pag-ulhot sang United Kingdom variant kag iban pa nga variant sang Covid-19 virus sa South Africa, Brazil, India kag iban pa nga lugar.
english:
***

The whole world is alarmed by the emergence of the United Kingdom variant and other variants of the Covid-19 virus in South Africa, Brazil, India and elsewhere.

text: May report na gani sang kasubong nga variant diri sa Filipinas.
english: There are even reports of such a variant here in the Philippines.

text: Bunga ining mga virus variant, sunu sa mga scientist, sang “mutation” ukon pagbaylo-baylo sang forma (structure) kag gawi (functionality) sang orihinal nga virus.
english: These virus variants, according to scientists, are the result of mutations or changes in the structure and functionality of the original virus.

text: Kabahin ini sang natural selection process sang mga species, pabor man ukon indi sa maapektuhan sini, katulad sang mga tawo.
english: This is part of the natural selection process of species, whether in favor or against those affected, such as humans.

text: Ang pamangkot: Maapektuhan bala sining COVID-19 variants ang karon nga mga health kag vaccination program?
english: The question is: Will these COVID-19 variants affect current health and vaccination programs?

text: Nadiskubrihan sa United Kingdom nga ining UK variant mas madasig manglaton sangsa orihinal nga COVID-19 virus.
english: It has been discovered in the United Kingdom that this UK variant is more transmissible than the original COVID-19 virus.

text: Mas madasig sing mga 70%, sunu sa mga health authorities.
english: About 70% faster, according to health authorities.

text: Kasubong man sini ang ugali sang iban nga variant.
english: The behavior of other variants is similar.

text: Although indi man mas mapintas sangsa orihinal nga COVID-19 virus, nangin daku nga problema ining  mga variant sa healthcare progam.
english: Although not more virulent than the original COVID-19 virus, these variants have become a major problem in the healthcare program.

text: Ginbangdan ini sang madasig nga pagdamo sang infection cases kag madasig man nga pagginutok sang aton mga ospital.
english: This is due to the rapid increase in infection cases and the rapid overcrowding of our hospitals.

text: Yara man gani ang kahangawa sang pila ka mga scientist nga basi maapektuhan  sini ang vaccination program tungod virus-specific ang COVID-19 vaccine kag ang ining variants basi indi ma-identify sang antibodies kag pabay-an lang sa ila pagpamintas.
english: Some scientists are even concerned that this may affect the vaccination program because the COVID-19 vaccine is virus-specific and these variants may not be identified by antibodies and left to their own devices.

text: Kon indi man, basi kuno low-level lang nga immunity ang mahatag sang bakuna kag, tungod sini, pabalik-balik lang ang aton pag-antos sa COVID-19.
english: Otherwise, the vaccine may provide only low-level immunity and, as a result, we will suffer from COVID-19 again and again.

text: Kon matuod ini, daku ini nga problema, labi na gid sa ginsiling sang DOH nga community infection na ang dala man sang mga variant.
english: If this is true, it is a big problem, especially since the DOH said that the variants are also causing community infection.

text: Sunu ugaling sa padayon nga pagtuon sang mga scientist, ma-identify man gali sang antibodies ang presensysa sining mga COVID-19 variant.
english: However, according to the ongoing study of scientists, antibodies can also identify the presence of these COVID-19 variants.

text: “There’s a lot of different arms of the immune system recognizing the virus.
english: “There’s a lot of different arms of the immune system recognizing the virus.

text: So if you have a mutation, it wouldn’t evade all these different arms,” pasalig ni Daniela Weiskopf, nga co-author sa pagtuon angot diri kag researcher sa La Jolla Institute for Immunology.
english: So if you have a mutation, it wouldn’t evade all these different arms,” assures Daniela Weiskopf, co-author of the study and researcher at the La Jolla Institute for Immunology.

text: Siling niya pwede ma-identify gihapon ang variant sang antibodies sa pila ka bahin (pieces) sini nga napanubli sa orihinal nga COVID-19 virus nga gina-introduce sang traditional vaccine sa lawas sang tawo.
english: He said the variant of antibodies can still be identified in some pieces of it inherited from the original COVID-19 virus that is introduced by the traditional vaccine into the human body.

text: Sa kaso sang Messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccine, nga wala nagagamit sang COVID-19 virus, ma-identify ining variant halin sa viral protein sini nga mismo ang lawas ang naga-develop sa pagtudlo sang mRNA vaccine nga gamiton man sini sa pag-trigger sang immune system nga maga-produce sang antibodies./PN
english: In the case of the Messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccine, which does not use the COVID-19 virus, this variant can be identified from its viral protein that the body itself is developing to teach the mRNA vaccine that it will also use to trigger the immune system to produce antibodies.

text: ILOILO – Bata pa lang, huyog na ni Miss Eco International 2025 Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks nga magpasakop sa mga pageant.
english: ILOILO – Miss Eco International 2025 Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks has been interested in participating in pageants since she was a child.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jennifer Caimoso Cadion, tiya ni Alexie kag tumandok sang Barangay Buga, Leon, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga sang yara sa sekondarya ang Ilongga beauty queen, nagpasakop na ini sa pageant.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jennifer Caimoso Cadion, Alexie's aunt and a native of Barangay Buga, Leon, Iloilo, said that when the Ilongga beauty queen was in secondary school, she participated in the pageant.

text: Suno kay Cadion, tuig 2023 sang nakuha ni Alexie ang titulo nga Miss Buga 2013.
english: According to Cadion, Alexie won the title of Miss Buga 2013 in 2023.

text: Matapos sini, nagpasakop na si Alexie sa Miss Iloilo 2024.
english: After that, Alexie has already participated in Miss Iloilo 2024.

text: Ini man ang nangin lyabe agud makapasakop ini sa Miss Universe Philippines 2014 sa diin gintiglawas sini ang Iloilo City.
english: This was also the key to her participation in Miss Universe Philippines 2014 where she represented Iloilo City.

text: Ginkoranahan naman ini bilang Miss Eco International Philippines 2025.
english: She was crowned Miss Eco International Philippines 2025.

text: Subong nga adlaw, naghatag ini sang dungog indi lang sa ila pamilya kundi sa bug-os nga Pilipinas matapos ginkoronahan bilang Miss Eco International 2025.
english: Today, she brought honor not only to her family but to the entire Philippines after being crowned Miss Eco International 2025.

text: Naghibi naman ang pamilya ni Alexie bangud wala sila nagalaom nga makapasakop ini sa international pageant kag makakuha sang korona.
english: Alexie's family cried because they did not expect her to participate in the international pageant and win the crown.

text: Wala sang ginhatag nga anuman nga excuse ang Oklahoma City Thunder sa ila pigado nga performance sa Game 6 sang NBA Finals batok sa Indiana Pacers.
english: The Oklahoma City Thunder offered no excuses for their poor performance in Game 6 of the NBA Finals against the Indiana Pacers.

text: Sa hampang kahapon, madamo ang naglaum nga madala na pauli sang Thunder ang kampyonato ilabi na bangud sa injury nga naangkon ni Tyrese Haliburton sa Game 5.
english: With yesterday's game, many expected the Thunder to take home the championship especially with the injury Tyrese Haliburton suffered in Game 5.

text: Apang nagtakop ang sambuwa sa 108-91 pabor sa Indiana nga amo man ang nagpatas sa serye sa 3-3.
english: But the game ended 108-91 in favor of Indiana which also tied the series at 3-3.

text: Suno kay Thunder superstar Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, kinahanglan nila nga matun-an ang leksyon sa amo nga hampang.
english: According to Thunder superstar Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, they need to learn the lesson from that game.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga wala gid siya naghalong kag nakulangan sang focus rason nga siya ang nakahimo sang walo sa 21 turnovers sang Oklahoma.
english: He also admitted that he was not careful and lacked focus, which led to eight of Oklahoma's 21 turnovers.

text: “The way I see it is we sucked tonight,” suno sa Thunder MVP.
english: “The way I see it is we sucked tonight,” according to the Thunder MVP.

text: “We need to learn the lessons, and we have one game for everything we worked for, and so do they.
english: “We need to learn the lessons, and we have one game for everything we worked for, and so do they.

text:
The better team Sunday will win.”

Suno naman sa forward nga si Jalen Williams, indi maayo ang ila depensa.
english:
The better team Sunday will win.”

According to forward Jalen Williams, their defense was not good.

text: Daw nagguwa suno sa iya nga wala sila sang salig sa isa kag isa — indi kaangay sang ila maayo nga hampang sa nagligad nga game.
english: He said it appeared that they did not trust each other — unlike their good play in the previous game.

text: “Our defense wasn’t very good.
english: “Our defense wasn’t very good.

text: When you’re constantly taking the ball out and you’re playing against a set defense over and over again, that’s part of it.
english: When you’re constantly taking the ball out and you’re playing against a set defense over and over again, that’s part of it.

text: Other part, we didn’t do a good job trusting each other to make the next play like we did Game 5,” pahayag sini.
english: Other part, we didn’t do a good job trusting each other to make the next play like we did Game 5,” stated sini.

text: Mangin si Thunder coach Mark Daigneault ang nag-ako man nga dismayado sila apang nakahibalo nga madamo sang kinahanglan i-adjust para sa Game 7.
english: Even Thunder coach Mark Daigneault also admitted they were disappointed but knew there was a lot to adjust for Game 7.

text: Kahapon sa fourth quarter, sang may 30-puntos nga abanse ang Pacers, ginpapahuway na si Gilgeous-Alexander kag ang iban pa nga Thunder starters bilang preparasyon na sa final game.
english: Yesterday in the fourth quarter, when the Pacers had a 30-point lead, Gilgeous-Alexander and the other Thunder starters were rested in preparation for the final game.

text: Matabo ang winner-takes-all Game 7 sa Lunes, 8:00 sang aga oras sa Pilipinas.
english: The winner-takes-all Game 7 will take place on Monday, 8:00 am Philippine time.

text: Patigayunon ini sa home court sang Thunder sa Paycom Center.
english: It will be held on the Thunder’s home court at the Paycom Center.

text: Ini man ang una nga NBA Finals halin sang 2016 nga nakalab-ot sa Game 7 ang duha ka magkasumpong nga teams.
english: This is also the first NBA Finals since 2016 that two opposing teams have reached Game 7.

text: Kun magbakal ka sang imo paborito nga beverage kaangay sang kape ukon shake, masami mo man bala ginapadugangan sang heavy whipped cream ang imo nga drinks bilang topping?
english: When you buy your favorite beverage like coffee or shake, do you often add heavy whipped cream to your drinks as a topping?

text: Suno kay SaVanna Shoemaker, registered dietician sa Estados Unidos, sa mga indibidwal nga paborito ang whipped cream kag nanamitan nga i-partner ini sa ila nga pagkaon ukon drinks, wala sang dapat kabalak-an bangud madamo ini sang minerals kag health-boosting vitamins kaangay sang vitamins A, D, E, kag K ang nasambit nga dairy product.
english: According to SaVanna Shoemaker, registered dietician in the United States, for individuals who love whipped cream and enjoy partnering it with their food or drinks, there is nothing to worry about because it is rich in minerals and health-boosting vitamins such as vitamins A, D, E, and K.

text: Pahayag niya, mas maka-absorb ang lawas sang isa ka indibidwal sang fat-soluble vitamins kun magconsume sang healthy fat kaangay sang fat nga yara sa heavy whipping cream.
english: He said that an individual's body can absorb more fat-soluble vitamins if he consumes healthy fat such as the fat in heavy whipping cream.

text: Natukiban man sa pila ka mga pagtuon suno kay Shoemaker nga ang full-fat dairy products ang nagapanubo sang risgo sa pag-angkon sang obesity, type 2 diabetes, kag heart disease.
english: It has also been found in some studies, Shoemaker said, that full-fat dairy products reduce the risk of developing obesity, type 2 diabetes, and heart disease.

text: Apang paandam sang dietician, nagakadapat nga in moderation man ang pagkaon sang whipped cream agud maangkon ang nagakaigo nga benepisyo sa ikaayong lawas.
english: However, the dietician warns that whipped cream should be eaten in moderation to get the proper health benefits.

text: Nagapadayon na subong ang pagboto sang mga Pilipino sa luwas sang pungsod para sa ila napili nga mga kandidato sa May 2025 midterm elections.
english: Filipinos abroad are now voting for their chosen candidates in the May 2025 midterm elections.

text: Nag-umpisa ang overseas voting kahapon, Abril 13, kag magalawig tubtub sa katapusan nga voting hours sa Pilipinas sa Mayo 12.
english: Overseas voting began yesterday, April 13, and will last until the last voting hours in the Philippines on May 12.

text: Suno kay Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chairman George Garcia, magluwas sa pagboto sa mga embahada kag consulates, ang rehistrado ng mga overseas Filipino voters ang mahimo man makaboto online.
english: According to Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chairman George Garcia, besides voting at embassies and consulates, registered overseas Filipino voters can also vote online.

text: Bukas ang internet voting sa abroad sa bilog nga 24 oras.
english: Internet voting abroad is open for 24 hours.

text: Matandaan nga may ginpatigayon nga test online voting para nga ma-familiarize sang mga Pinoy ang features sang system nga gin-adoptar sang komisyon sa labing-una nga tion.
english: It can be recalled that a test online voting was conducted to familiarize Filipinos with the features of the system adopted by the commission for the first time.

text: Sa record sang Comelec, may 1.231-million nga mga Filipino voters sa luwas sang pungsod; apang sa sini nga numero, 48,000 lamang ang nag-enroll para sa online voting.
english: According to Comelec records, there are 1.231-million Filipino voters abroad; but of this number, only 48,000 registered for online voting.

text: CROATIA – Ginmando sang justice minister sang Poland sa Warsaw Prosecutor’s Office ang pag-imbestigar sa natabo nga aksidente sang bus sa dalanon sa Croatia sa diin napatay ang 12 ka mga Polish pilgrims.
english: CROATIA – Poland’s justice minister has ordered the Warsaw Prosecutor’s Office to investigate a roadside bus crash in Croatia that killed 12 Polish pilgrims.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Neva Intrepido, tanan nga 32 ka mga nakaluwas nga pasahero ang pilason sa diin 19 sa mga ini ang kritikal.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Neva Intrepido, all 32 surviving passengers were injured, 19 of whom were critical.

text: Ang trip nga gin-organized sang Brotherhood of St Joseph Catholic group ang ginalakipan sang tatlo ka mga pari kag anom ka mga madre.
english: The trip, organized by the Brotherhood of St Joseph Catholic group, included three priests and six nuns.

text: Ang mga ini ang padulong kuntani sa Medjugorje, isa ka Catholic shrine sa Bosnia.
english: They were on their way to Medjugorje, a Catholic shrine in Bosnia.

text: Nagbiya ang bus halin sa Czestochowa City matapos ang prayer service.
english: The bus left Czestochowa City after the prayer service.

text: Naghalin naman ang mga pasahero sa nagkalain-lain nga rehiyon sa Poland.
english: The passengers came from different regions of Poland.

text: Natabo ang aksidente samtang naga-travel ang mga ini sa tunga sang dalanon sang Jarek Bisaski kag Podvorec, ukon sa north-east sang Zagreb.
english: The accident occurred while they were traveling between Jarek Bisaski and Podvorec roads, or north-east of Zagreb.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman sang pag-unong kag kasubo si Croatian Prime Minister Andrej Plenković sa pamilya sang mga napatay nga biktima.
english: Croatian Prime Minister Andrej Plenković expressed his condolences to the families of the victims.

text: Nahibaluan nga pilgrimages sa banwa sang Medjugorje ang bantog sa Poland kasunod sang report nga nakita sang mga kabataan si Virgin Mary sa lugar sang 1980’s.
english: Pilgrimages to the town of Medjugorje are famous in Poland following reports that children saw the Virgin Mary in the area in the 1980’s.

text: Nagpadala ang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) sang psychological first aid (PFA) team sa Myanmar kasunod sang 7.7 magnitude nga linog nga natabo sang Marso 28 nga nagbilin sang linibo ka mga patay.
english: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) sent a psychological first aid (PFA) team to Myanmar following the 7.7 magnitude earthquake that struck on March 28 and left thousands dead.

text: Suno sa ahensya, may walo ka mga myembro ang team nga nag-abot sa Yangon sang Abril 11 bilang parte sang coordinated humanitarian response sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas.
english: According to the agency, the eight-member team arrived in Yangon on April 11 as part of the Philippine government's coordinated humanitarian response.

text: Nagapanguna sa mission ang Disaster Response Management Group (DRMG) sang DSWD.
english: The DSWD's Disaster Response Management Group (DRMG) is leading the mission.

text: Tuyo sini nga makabulig indi lamang sa mga Pinoy nga apektado sang linog kundi sa iban pa nga survivors nga nagakinahanglan sang bulig.
english: It aims to help not only the Filipinos affected by the earthquake but also other survivors who need help.

text: Sa pag-abot gid sang team, nag-upod sila sa Philippine Embassy officials sa mga pamilya kadungan sang solemn reception sang abo sang duha ka Filipino teachers nga kumpirmado na nga napatay bangud sa pag-collapse sang building nga ila ginatiniran.
english: Upon arrival, the team joined Philippine Embassy officials in the families during the solemn reception of the ashes of two Filipino teachers who were confirmed dead due to the collapse of the building where they were staying.

text: Diri sa Pilipinas, nagahatag man ang ahensya sang psychosocial support kag counseling sessions sa mga pamilya sang apektado nga overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) nga kadam-an na-deploy bilang educators sa Myanmar.
english: Here in the Philippines, the agency is also providing psychosocial support and counseling sessions to the families of affected overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) who are mostly deployed as educators in Myanmar.

text: Naghatag man ang ahensya sang P10,000 nga cash assistance sa kada apektado nga pamilya.
english: The agency also provided P10,000 cash assistance to each affected family.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa subong, may duha pa ka nabilin nga missing nga mga Pinoy sa Mandalay bangud sa amo man nga linog.
english: It is known that there are still two missing Filipinos in Mandalay due to the same earthquake.

text: JAPAN – Nagapabilin subong sa gihapon nga dako nga palaligban ang istorya sang isa ka monyeka sa Japan nga ginpangalanan kay Okiku sa diin nagalaba ang iya buhok.
english: JAPAN – The story of a doll in Japan named Okiku where her hair grows long remains a big concern.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma, nag-umpisa ang istorya sang tuig 1918 sang ginbakal siya sang bata nga lalaki sa isla sang Hokkaido agud iregalo sa iya mangod.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma, the story began in 1918 when a boy bought her on the island of Hokkaido to give as a gift to his brother.

text: Tuman ang kalipay sang bata nga babaye sa diin ginhatagan niya ini sang pangalan nga kaangay man sang iya nga pangalan nga Okiku.
english: The girl was so happy that he gave her a name that was similar to his name Okiku.

text: Ang bata nga babaye kag ang monyeka ang literal nga indi mabulag.
english: The little girl and the doll are literally inseparable.

text: Sa ulihi, nagmasakit ang bata sa diin gintrangkaso ini bangud sa mga komplikasyon tubtub napatay.
english: Later, the child became ill and contracted the flu due to complications until he died.

text: Bilang memorya sang ila pinalangga nga anak nga babaye, ginbutang sang iya mga ginikanan ang monyeka sa altar sang pamilya.
english: In memory of their beloved daughter, her parents placed the doll on the family altar.

text: Wala nagdugay, namutikan nila nga amat-amat nga nagalaba ang buhok sang monyeka kaangay sang isa ka buhi nga babaye.
english: Soon, they noticed that the doll's hair was slowly growing like a living woman's.

text: Gin-umpisahan nila nga guntingan ang buhok sang monyeka kag sa tion nga maglaba ang buhok, naga-untat ini sa iya tuhod nga amo ang eksakto nga kalabaon sang buhok sang napatay nga si Okiku.
english: They start cutting the doll’s hair and once the hair gets long enough, it stops at her knee which is the exact length of the deceased Okiku’s hair.

text: Sang 1938, nagsaylo ang pamilya sa Sakhalin, apang nahadlok sila nga updon ang monyeka.
english: In 1938, the family moved to Sakhalin, but they were afraid to take the doll with them.

text: Sa baylo, gindala nila ini sa Mannenji Temple sa Iwamizawa, Hokkaido, sa diin ginsulod ini sa espesyal nga kahon nga himo sa kahoy.
english: Instead, they took it to the Mannenji Temple in Iwamizawa, Hokkaido, where it was placed in a special wooden box.

text: Sa subong, ang monyeka ang yara sa gihapon sa templo kag regular nga ginaguntingan ang iya buhok.
english: Today, the doll is still at the temple and gets regular haircuts.

text: Nalakip ang apat ka mga produkto sang Central Philippine University (CPU) sa lista sang topnotchers sa February 2025 Respiratory Therapists Licensure Examination.
english: Included are four Central Philippine University (CPU) products in the list of topnotchers in the February 2025 Respiratory Therapists Licensure Examination.

text: Patas sa Rank 5 sanday Jose Miguel Santisteban Dumat-ol kag Jywelle Nae Leonero Nacional nga may 91.75 percent; samtang pareho naman nga Rank 6 sanday Di-Anne-Mei Quiñones Evangelista kag Charisse Joy Ponte Rubino nga nakakuha sang 91.50 percent.
english: Tied in Rank 5 are Jose Miguel Santisteban Dumat-ol and Jywelle Nae Leonero Nacional with 91.75 percent; while Di-Anne-Mei Quiñones Evangelista and Charisse Joy Ponte Rubino were both Rank 6 with 91.50 percent.

text: Nalab-ot naman sang CPU ang 97.30% nga passing rate matapos 36 sa 37 ka examinees halin sa unibersidad ang nakapasar sa pasinawan.
english: The CPU achieved a 97.30% passing rate after 36 out of 37 examinees from the university passed the examination.

text: Base sa gin-release sang Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) subong nga gab-i, kabug-usan nga 1,097 examinees ang nagkuha sang exam kag 853 ang nakapasar.
english: Based on the release of the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) tonight, a total of 1,097 examinees took the exam and 853 passed.

text: Nanguna sa topnotchers si Erma Mae Yongco Sanchez sang Cebu Doctors’ University (CDU) nga may percentage rating nga 94%.
english: Erma Mae Yongco Sanchez of Cebu Doctors’ University (CDU) led the topnotchers with a percentage rating of 94%.

text:
Natalana pa nga i-anunsyo ang petsa kag venue sang oath-taking ceremony sang madinalag-on nga examinees.#

Photo: CPU page/FB
english:
The date and venue of the oath-taking ceremony of the successful examinees is yet to be announced.

Photo: CPU page/FB

text: Ginhatagan pagtamod ni House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez nga ang simbolo sang Holy Week ukon Semana Santa ang isa ka pahanumdom sa tanan nga Katoliko, partikular sa mga empleyado sang gobyerno, nga magserbisyo nga may tampad, integridad kag kaluoy, kag magtutok sa mga nagakinahanglan sang bulig.
english: House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez noted that the symbol of Holy Week is a reminder to all Catholics, particularly government employees, to serve with honesty, integrity and compassion, and to focus on those in need.

text: Gin-engganyo man ni Speaker Romualdez ang mga Pilipino nga magpamalandong sa kabuhi ni Hesukristo.
english: Speaker Romualdez also encouraged Filipinos to reflect on the life of Jesus Christ.

text: Ginhatagan pagtamod ni Speaker Romualdez nga ang pagpanglakaton ni Jesukristo nagapahanumdom sa aton nga ang matuod nga kusog makita sa pagsakripisyo, ang pag-ayo natawo sa pagpatawad, kag ang pagtuo nagahatag sang paglaum bisan sa aton pinakamadulom nga mga tinion.
english: Speaker Romualdez noted that the journey of Jesus Christ reminds us that true strength is found in sacrifice, healing is born in forgiveness, and faith offers hope even in our darkest moments.

text: Suno sa Speaker, ang espiritu sang mga Pilipino masami nagasaka sa ibabaw sang kabudlayan nga may mahipos nga kaisog, madalom nga pagtuo, kag kaluoy sa isigkatawo.
english: According to the Speaker, the Filipino spirit often rises above adversity with quiet courage, deep faith, and compassion for others.

text: Ginpabutyag ni Speaker Romualdez ang handum nga ang sagrado nga tion magadala sang paghidait, kusog sa mga wala sang kapat-uran, kag kasulhayan sa mga nagakinahanglan.
english: Speaker Romualdez expressed the desire that the sacred moment will bring peace, strength to those who are uncertain, and comfort to those in need.

text: Sa sini nga Semana Santa, ang Speaker nagapangamuyo para sa isa ka makahulugan, malinong, kag puno sang grasya nga Semana Santa.
english: This Easter, the Speaker prays for a meaningful, peaceful, and grace-filled Easter.

text: Ginpangabay man sini nga ang gugma ni Kristo magpuyo sa tagsa ka puluy-an sang mga Pilipino, kag padayon nga pakamaayuhon kag tuytuyan sang Dios ang pinalangga nga pungsod, ang Pilipinas.
english: He also asked that the love of Christ dwell in every Filipino home, and that God continue to bless and guide the beloved nation, the Philippines.

text: Gin-ako ni Miagao, Iloilo Vice Mayor Macario Napulan nga iya ginkakibot nga gina-demolish na ang pila ka parte sang Municipal Stage kag Basketball Court sang Miagao.
english: Miagao, Iloilo Vice Mayor Macario Napulan admitted that he was surprised that some parts of the Municipal Stage and Basketball Court of Miagao are being demolished.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Vice Mayor Napulan, iya ginpahayag nga ang tikang ang isa ka demolisyon sa historical kag cultural identity sang banwa sang Miagao.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Vice Mayor Napulan said the move is a demolition of the historical and cultural identity of Miagao.

text: Suno kay Napulan, sang ginpadulongan sini ang lugar, gina-jack hammer na ang mga bleachers sini.
english: According to Napulan, when he visited the area, the bleachers were already being jack hammered.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang entablado nangin hipos nga saksi sang pinakaimportante nga mga hilikuton nga nagpadalom sang paghiusa kag pag-abyanay sang mga tawo gikan sa nagkalainlain nga relihiyoso nga pagpati kag politikal nga mga ideolohiya.
english: He also stated that the stage has been a silent witness of the most important activities that have deepened the unity and friendship of people from different religious beliefs and political ideologies.

text: Gintuad man sang natungdan nga wala siya nakahibalo lakip na ang municipal council sa amo nga tikang nga ginaduso sang administrasyon ni Mayor Engr.
english: He also admitted that he was not aware of the move proposed by the administration of Mayor Engr.

text: Richard Garin.
english: Richard Garin.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sini nga wala sang public hearing nga ginpatuman ang munisipyo antes ginduso ang demolition job.
english: He also revealed that there was no public hearing implemented by the municipality before the demolition job was proposed.

text: Gintuad man ni Napulan nga sang nagligad nga tuig nag-request si Mayor Garin nga i-redesign ang plaza lakip na ang munisipyo nga nagabalor P3 million kada area.
english: Napulan also admitted that last year Mayor Garin requested to redesign the plaza including the municipality worth P3 million per area.

text: Para kay Napulan, pabor siya sa development apang, indi lang paggub-on ang kabilogan sang structure agud mapabilin ang cultural identity sang tagsa ka Miagawanons.
english: For Napulan, he is in favor of development but, not just demolish the entire structure to preserve the cultural identity of each Miagawanons.

text: Nagapanindugan naman si Miagao, Iloilo Mayor Richard Garin nga wala sang ginalapas ang munisipyo sang Miagao sa patag sang cultural heritage kaangot sa pagpatukod sang Municipal Stage kag Basketball Court sa amo nga banwa.
english: Miagao, Iloilo Mayor Richard Garin insists that the municipality of Miagao is not violating anything in the field of cultural heritage in connection with the construction of the Municipal Stage and Basketball Court in the town.

text: Ini kasunod man sang pagpabutyag sang pagkadismaya ni Vice Mayor Macario Napulan sa amo nga proyekto.
english: This follows the expression of disappointment of Vice Mayor Macario Napulan over the project.

text: Suno Mayor Garin, kinahanglan anay mahibaluan ni Napulan ang insakto nga cultural heritage.
english: According to Mayor Garin, Napulan must first know the right cultural heritage.

text: Suno kay Garin, atop lang ang gindugang kag wala ini nalakip sa cultural landmark sang banwa.
english: According to Garin, only the roof was added and it is not included in the cultural landmark of the town.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga wala gintandog ang stage sang munisipyo kag kon maigo ini sang roofing sang basketball court, mahimo nga i-transfer ini.
english: He also explained that the municipal stage was not touched and if it is hit by the roofing of the basketball court, it can be transferred.

text: Ginpatpat man ni Garin nga ang cultural property sang banwa ang ginalakipan sang duha ka Spanish Era canyon, ang Rizal monument, ang Britanico Cultural Hall, Historical books, mga hablon sang banwa kag lakip na ang Municipal plaza.
english: Garin also explained that the cultural property of the town includes two Spanish Era canyons, the Rizal monument, the British Cultural Hall, historical books, textiles of the town and including the Municipal plaza.

text: Indi man magpati ang natungdan nga wala nakahibalo si Vice Mayor Napulan sa ila proyekto bangud sang tinalikdan pa nga tuig ini gina-istoryahan.
english: He also does not believe that Vice Mayor Napulan is not aware of their project because it has been discussed since last year.

text: Ginklaro man ni Garin nga wala sang pagpangguba nga himuon sa mga istruktura kag lunsay isaylo lamang.
english: Garin also clarified that no demolition will be done to the structures and all will be relocated.

text: Pabor man ang alkalde sa nangin pahayag ni Napulan nga indi pagtugutan ang isa ka tawo nga wala makahangop sang existence sang mga Miagawanon nga panason ang mismo identity nga ginbilin sang mga katigulangan.
english: The mayor also supported Napulan's statement that a person who does not understand the existence of the Miagawanon should not be allowed to erase the very identity left by the ancestors.

text: Ginkustodiya na ang pito ka mga pulis nga gin-tag bilang mga “persons of interest” sa pagluthang sa kontrobersyal nga mayoral candidate sa Albuera, Leyte kag self-confessed drug lord nga si Kerwin Espinosa.
english: Seven policemen tagged as “persons of interest” in the shooting of controversial mayoral candidate in Albuera, Leyte and self-confessed drug lord Kerwin Espinosa have been taken into custody.

text: Suno kay Philippine National Police (PNP) spokesperson Police Brigadier General Jean Fajardo, gina-imbestigaran subong kun may kahilabtanan sila ukon wala sang shooting incident.
english: According to Philippine National Police (PNP) spokesperson Police Brigadier General Jean Fajardo, they are now investigating whether they were involved or not in the shooting incident.

text: Na-tag sila bilang persons of interest bangud nakit-an sila sa compound kun sa diin nagkadto ang suspected getaway vehicle samtang nagapatigayon ang mga awtoridad sang hot pursuit operation.
english: They were tagged as persons of interest because they were found in the compound where the suspected getaway vehicle went while the authorities were conducting a hot pursuit operation.

text: “Nagsagawa po tayo ng pursuit operation dahil may isa po tayong motor vehicle in interest, isa pong Montero, na diumano umalis po kaagad doon sa site noong mangyari po yung insidente,” suno kay Fajardo.
english: “We conducted a pursuit operation because we have a motor vehicle in interest, a Montero, who allegedly left the site immediately after the incident,” Fajardo said.

text: “Nasundan po ito kaagad.
english: “It was followed up immediately.

text:
Pagpasok po ng compound may naabutan po doon na mga pulis po.”

Ang pito ka mga pulis nga naka-assign sa Ormoc City Police Station ang nakasuksok sang pangsibilyan nga panapton suno kay Fajardo.
english:
When we entered the compound, we found some policemen there.”

The seven policemen assigned to the Ormoc City Police Station are wearing civilian clothes, Fajardo said.

text: Duha sa ila ang mga opisyal pa, kag lima naman ang non-commissioned officers.
english: Two of them are still officers, and five are non-commissioned officers.

text: Duha ka mga salakyan ang nakit-an sa compound kag may mga pusil man nga nakit-an sa sulod sang amo nga mga salakyan.
english: Two vehicles were found in the compound and firearms were also found inside those vehicles.

text: Matandaan nga pasado alas kuwatro sang hapon sang Huwebes sang natiruhan si Espinosa samtang nagahulat ini sang iya turno nga maghambal kadungan sang campaign event sa Albuera.
english: Espinosa was stabbed around 4 pm on Thursday while waiting for his turn to speak during a campaign event in Albuera.

text: Bantog ang pangalan ni Espinosa bangud gin-ako sini sa Senado sang 2016 nga involved siya sa illegal drug trade.
english: Espinosa's name is famous because he admitted to the Senate in 2016 that he was involved in illegal drug trade.

text: Sang 2018, nagpahayag naman ini sa counter-affidavit sa state prosecutors nga ang iya mga statement sa Senate ang indi makapamatuod nga isa siya ka drug lord kun wala man sang drug evidence.
english: In 2018, he said in a counter-affidavit to state prosecutors that his statements in the Senate would not prove that he was a drug lord without drug evidence.

text: Sang Hunyo 2024, ginbasura sang korte sa Baybay, Leyte ang drug case batok sa iya.
english: In June 2024, the court in Baybay, Leyte dismissed the drug case against him.

text: May kaso pa siya nga money laundering sa korte sa Pasay, kag may duha pa ka kaso sang illegal possession of dangerous drugs kag illegal possession of firearms nga ginpabuksan liwat sang Court of Appeals.
english: He still has a money laundering case in the Pasay court, and two other cases of illegal possession of dangerous drugs and illegal possession of firearms that were reopened by the Court of Appeals.

text:
STATEMENT NI KERWIN ESPINOSA

Sa iya naman press conference matapos natiruhan sa Albuera, Leyte, ginpahayag ni Espinosa nga natingala siya kun ngaa ginauna pa sang mga awtoridad ang persons of interest sa baylo nga kadtuan siya sa ospital kag imbestigaran ang natabo.
english:
STATEMENT BY KERWIN ESPINOSA

In his press conference after being stabbed in Albuera, Leyte, Espinosa said he wondered why the authorities were giving priority to persons of interest instead of going to the hospital and investigating the incident.

text: Pahayag sini, gindala pa sa police regional office ang persons of interest sa baylo nga sa police station sa Albuera.
english: He said the persons of interest were taken to the police regional office instead of the police station in Albuera.

text: Apisar ginklaro sini nga wala siya nahadlok sa pagpangampanya kasunod sang shooting incident, naghingyo ini sa Commission on Elections nga hatagan siya sang security detail.
english: Although he clarified that he was not afraid to campaign following the shooting incident, he asked the Commission on Elections to give him a security detail.

text: Mas maayo man suno sa natungdan kun mapaidalom ang Albuera sa Comelec control subong nga eleksyon.
english: He said it would be better if Albuera was placed under Comelec control this election.

text: Ginpalayas sang Democratic Republic of the Congo ang spokesman sang United Nations peacekeeping mission nga MONUSCO kag ginbasol bangud sa tensyon nga amo ang nagtuga sang makamamatay nga protesta sang nagligad nga semana.
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has expelled the spokesman of the United Nations peacekeeping mission MONUSCO and blamed it for the tensions that sparked last week's deadly protests.

text: Gin-anunsyo sang foreign affairs ini nga desisyon sa katapusan sang bulan sang Hulyo.
english: The foreign affairs announced this decision at the end of July.

text: Matandaan nga 36 ka mga tawo lakip na ang apat ka UN peacekeepers ang napatay sang gin-vandalise kag ginsunog sang ginatos ka protesters ang buildings sang peacekeeping mission sa amo nga pungsod.
english: It can be recalled that 36 people including four UN peacekeepers were killed when hundreds of protesters vandalized and burned the buildings of the peacekeeping mission in the country.

text: Masobra 10 ka tuig na nga aktibo ang amo nga mission apang ginpahayag sang mga sibilyan nga napaslawan ini nga protektahan ang publiko gikan sa armed gang violence sa amo nga rehiyon.
english: The mission has been active for more than 10 years but civilians said it has failed to protect the public from armed gang violence in the region.

text: Ginpahayag naman sang Congolese government nga ang spokesman nga si Mathias Gillmann nga naghimo sang “indelicate and inappropriate” statements nga amo pa ang nagpasaka sa tensyon sa tunga sang mga tawo kag sa MONUSCO.
english: The Congolese government said spokesman Mathias Gillmann made "indelicate and inappropriate" statements that raised tensions between the people and MONUSCO.

text: Nasamaran ang 23 ka mga tawo matapos magluntad ang 7.5 magnitude nga linog sa Pacific Coast sa Japan.
english: Twenty-three people were injured after a 7.5 magnitude earthquake struck the Pacific Coast of Japan.

text: Nakarecord ang Japan Meteorological Agency sang 70cm nga tsunami sa Kuji port sa Iwate prefecture.
english: The Japan Meteorological Agency recorded a 70cm tsunami at Kuji port in Iwate prefecture.

text: Natabo ang linog kagab-i Disyembre 8 pasado 11:15 sa Pacific Ocean, mga 50 ka milya halin sa baybayon sang Aomori sa bahin sang Honshu island.
english: The quake occurred last night December 8 around 11:15 in the Pacific Ocean, about 50 miles off the coast of Aomori on the island of Honshu.

text: Padayon nga ginahimo sang gobyerno sang Japan ang assessment sa halit nga ginbilin sang linog kag tsunami samtang ginpaandaman naman ang publiko angot sa dugang nga mga aftershocks.
english: The Japanese government is continuing to assess the damage caused by the earthquake and tsunami while warning the public of more aftershocks.

text: Dakop sa akto sang tag-iya sang kanding ang isa ka lalaki nga ginahimuslan ang amo nga sapat sa El Nido, Palawan.
english: A man was caught in the act of raping a goat in El Nido, Palawan.

text: Ang suspek amo si alyas “JR”.
english: The suspect was identified as alias “JR”.

text: Suno sa tag-iya sang sapat, nakita gid niya ang ginahimo sang suspek kag sang iya ini gintawag, madasig nga nalagyo ang suspek nga wala sang bayo.
english: According to the owner of the animal, he saw what the suspect was doing and when he called him, the suspect quickly fled without clothes.

text: Kaupod niya nga nalagyo ang ginapahayag nga lookout sini nga si Dodong.
english: He was accompanied by his alleged lookout, Dodong.

text: Nadakpan si Dodong sa operasyon sang otoridad kag ginsaysay nga ginlagas ni JR ang kanding kag sang nadakpan niya, nag-uba ini sang bayo kag ginhimuslan ang kanding.
english: Dodong was arrested in the operation and explained that JR chased the goat and when he caught him, he took off his clothes and raped the goat.

text: Padayon pa nga ginapangita sang otoridad ang suspek kag mangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act No.
english: The suspect is still being sought and will face charges of violating Republic Act No.

text: 8485 ukon Animal Welfare Act of 1998.
english: 8485 or Animal Welfare Act of 1998.

text: ILOILO – Proud ang pamilya sang Ilongga beauty queen nga si Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks sa Barangay Buga, Leon, Iloilo matapos ginkoronahan ini bilang Miss Eco International 2025.
english: ILOILO – The family of Ilongga beauty queen Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks in Barangay Buga, Leon, Iloilo is proud after she was crowned Miss Eco International 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rose Caimoso Calasabsab, pamilya ni Alexie, iya ginpahayag nga tuman ang iya kalipay matapos nakadala ini sang bugal sa Pilipinas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rose Caimoso Calasabsab, Alexie's family, said she is very happy after he brought pride to the Philippines.

text: Suno kay Calasabsab, bata pa lang si Alexie, nagatinguha gid ini sa tanan nga mga kompetisyon nga iya ginapasakupan.
english: According to Calasabsab, Alexie is very young, he works hard in all the competitions he participates in.

text: Sang una suno sa natungdan, luyag sang Ilongga beauty queen nga mangin atleta, kag sa ulihi, ginsulod naman sini ang patag sang pageantry.
english: At first, he said, the Ilongga beauty queen wanted to become an athlete, and later, she entered the field of pageantry.

text: Apang wala man nangin mahapos ang paglab-ot ni Alexie sa iya handom bangud nabiktima man ini sang bullying sa diin ginasunlog ini sang mga kabataan nga ‘Ati’ bangud sa color sang iya panit.
english: However, it was not easy for Alexie to achieve his dream because he was also a victim of bullying where he was beaten by children who called him 'Ati' because of the color of his skin.

text: Sa baylo nga mangakig suno sa natungdan, ginapili ni Alexie nga magpa-umod.
english: Instead of getting angry, he said, Alexie chooses to be humble.

text: Ini nga pagbinatasan suno sa iya pamilya ang nadala ini Alexie sang nagdako na ini sa diin ang mga naga-bully sa iya sadto ang naga-idolo naman sa iya sa subong.
english: According to his family, Alexie brought this behavior when he grew up where those who bullied him before are now idolizing him.

text: Nangin dalangpan man sini ang iya ‘Lola Basing’ nga amo ang nagpadako sa iya sa diin naapektuhan gid ini sang tuman matapos nagtaliwan ini.
english: He also took refuge in his 'Lola Basing' who raised him where he was deeply affected after she passed away.

text: Handa na liwat magpasakop sa ring ang four-division boxing champion nga si Nonito “The Filipino Flash” Donaire sa iya pag-atubang kay Andres Campos sang Chile para sa interim WBA bantamweight title.
english: Four-division boxing champion Nonito “The Filipino Flash” Donaire is ready to enter the ring again as he faces Andres Campos of Chile for the interim WBA bantamweight title.

text: Ang hampang magatalana sa Hunyo 14 sa Argentina, kun sa diin luyag ni Donaire nga mabalik ang iya kadungganan matapos ang duha ka sunod-sunod nga kapyerdihan.
english: The fight is scheduled for June 14 in Argentina, where Donaire wants to regain his honor after two straight losses.

text: Sa tuig 2022, natalana siya sa ikaduha nga round pa lang sang rematch nila ni Naoya Inoue, ang undisputed junior featherweight champion.
english: In 2022, he is scheduled for just the second round of a rematch with Naoya Inoue, the undisputed junior featherweight champion.

text: Sunod sini, natalana man siya sang 2023 paagi sa unanimous decision ni Alexandro Santiago para sa bakante nga WBO bantamweight belt.
english: Subsequently, he is also scheduled for 2023 via Alexandro Santiago’s unanimous decision for the vacant WBO bantamweight belt.

text: Ang iya pinakaulihi nga kadalag-an amo sang Disyembre 11, 2021, sang ginpyerde niya si Reynaldo Gaballo sa ikaapat nga round kag na-depensahan niya ang iya WBC bantamweight title.
english: His most recent win came on December 11, 2021, when he defeated Reynaldo Gaballo in the fourth round to defend his WBC bantamweight title.

text: May yara na sang 42 ka kadalag-an, 8 ka pyerde, kag 28 ka knockouts si Donaire, samtang si Campos naman may record nga 17 ka kadalag-an, 2 ka ka pyerde, isa ka draw kag 6 ka knockouts.
english: Donaire now has 42 wins, 8 losses, and 28 knockouts, while Campos has a record of 17 wins, 2 losses, one draw and 6 knockouts.

text: MADASIG ang pagsaka sa poder sa national scene sang mga Marcos.
english: THE Marcoses are rising rapidly to power on the national scene.

text: In fact, nangin senador na si Bongbong kag senador man sa karon si Imee.
english: In fact, Bongbong has become a senator and Imee is now a senator.

text: Nagplano na gani si Bongbong agud mangin Vice President ugaling lang kay nalugaw-an ini batok sa balo sang maki-Aquino nga anay DILG Secretary Jess Robredo.
english: Bongbong even planned to become Vice President but lost against the widow of pro-Aquino former DILG Secretary Jess Robredo.

text: Apang handom gihapon ni Bongbong mag-Presidente sa masunod nga eleksyon, kag daku ang tsansa sini nga matuman ini kon suportahan siya ni Presidente Duterte, nga may impluwensya gihapon bisan wala na ini sa poder, kon indi mapunggan sang mabakud nga kasumpong.
english: But Bongbong still wants to be president in the next election, and he has a good chance of doing so if he is supported by President Duterte, who still has influence even though he is no longer in power, if not stopped by a strong opponent.

text: Indi ayhan ining ambisyon sang mga Marcos amo gid ang dulaon ang legasiya sang mga Aquino kon Presidente na si Bongbong?
english: Isn't this ambition of the Marcoses to erase the legacy of the Aquinos when Bongbong becomes President?
