text: Kon presidente na si Bongbong, no doubt, lubos na nga madula ang ngalan sang mga Aquino sa madamo nga landmark, katulad sang Ninoy Aquino International Airport, ang matahum nga handumanan sang martyrdom ni Ninoy batok sa martial law regime ni anay Diktador Marcos,  kag, labaw sa tanan, ang matahum nga ngalan sini sa mga libro sang kasaysayan sang pungsod nga maligwat pabor sa naulihi kon presidente na si Bongbong.
english: If Bongbong becomes president, no doubt, the name of the Aquinos will be completely lost in many landmarks, such as the Ninoy Aquino International Airport, the beautiful memory of Ninoy's martyrdom against the martial law regime of former Dictator Marcos, and, above all, its beautiful name in the country's history books. that Bongbong.

text: In fact, amat-amat na nila ini natuman, katulad sang pagpalubong kay Diktador Marcos sa Libingan ng mga Bayani kag ang mga lihok nga dulaon ang ngalan ni Ninoy sa NAIA.
english: In fact, they have gradually accomplished this, such as the burial of Dictator Marcos in the Libingan ng mga Bayani and the moves to remove Ninoy's name from the NAIA.

text: Ginapatuman naman gani nila ang a la martial law nga panglagas sa mga kritiko paagi sa kay Presidente Duterte.
english: They are even implementing martial law to persecute critics through President Duterte.

text: Gani, indi naton mabasol ang isa ta ka abyan nga luyag nga liwat magbungguanay ang mga Marcos kag Aquino sa pulitika.
english: Therefore, we cannot blame a friend of ours who wants the Marcoses and Aquinos to clash again in politics.

text: Nagapati gani siya nga ang pagpadalagan lang ni anay Presidente Noynoy Aquino sa pagka-Presidente sa 2022 ang makaupang sining ambisyon ni Bongbong kag mapadayon ang matahum nga ngalan sang mga Aquino.
english: He even believes that only former President Noynoy Aquino's run for president in 2022 will thwart Bongbong's ambition and maintain the beautiful name of the Aquinos.

text: Ano abe sa inyo?
english: What do you think?

text:
***

Ngaa kinahanglan ipatuman gihapon ang mga health protocol bisan nabakunahan na batok sa COVID-19?
english:
***

Why should health protocols still be implemented even after being vaccinated against COVID-19?

text: Panugyan ini sang aton mga health authorities tungod sa posibilidad nga na-infect bag-o nabakunahan, tapos sang pagbakuna samtang wala pa maka-develop ang mga antibodies; kag tungod sa posibilidad nga ma-infect liwat, ukon maka-infect gihapon sang iban.
english: This is the advice of our health authorities because of the possibility of being infected before vaccination, after vaccination while antibodies have not yet developed; and because of the possibility of being reinfected, or still infecting others.

text: Ngaa amo sina?
english: Why is that?

text: Ang ginhatag nila nga paathag amo nga tungod indi pa lubos maseguro kon ano kalawig ang immunity nga mahatag sang antibodies nga na-develop bangod sa bakuna (vaccine) sa kada tawo nga nabakunahan.
english: The explanation they gave is that it is not yet fully certain how long the immunity will be given by the antibodies developed from the vaccine in each person who is vaccinated.

text: Lain-Lain man kuno ang longevity immunity sang kada tawo.
english: Longevity immunity is also said to vary from person to person.

text: Pwede kuno sa sulod sang pila lang ka adlaw, isa ka bulan, tatlo ka bulan, anom ka bulan, isa ka tuig, ukon sobra pa sa isa ka tuig.
english: They say it can be for just a few days, a month, three months, six months, a year, or even more than a year.

text: In other words, indi pa maseguro sang kada isa kon bala tubtub san-o ang epekto sang immunity nga maangkon nila halin sa bakuna.
english: In other words, each person cannot be sure how long the immunity they will get from the vaccine will last.

text: Gani maniguro anay kita tubtub mahusayan ining problema paagi sa blood analysis sang na-develop nga antibodies, ang T-cells nga naga-develop immediately after infection, kag ang bagay nga trabaho sang immune system signalling molecules.
english: So let's try to solve this problem by blood analysis of the developed antibodies, the T-cells that develop immediately after infection, and the proper work of the immune system signaling molecules.

text: Kinahanglan man maseguro kon bala neutralizing antibodies ining nakuha sa bakuna nga amo gid ang maaway sa COVID-19.
english: It is also necessary to ensure whether the neutralizing antibodies obtained from the vaccine are the ones that will fight COVID-19.

text: Kon neutralizing antibodies gid man, ma-categorize bala ini sila?
english: If they are neutralizing antibodies, can they be categorized?

text: Sa pagtuon sa 164 COVID-19 patients sang mga scientist sa Duke-NUS Medical School sa Singapore na-categorize nila ini sa lima ka grupo.
english: In a study of 164 COVID-19 patients by scientists at Duke-NUS Medical School in Singapore, they categorized them into five groups.

text: Ang una nga grupo gintawag nila nga “Negative Group”, nga wala gid nag-develop sang detectable neutralizing antibodies.
english: The first group they called the “Negative Group”, which never developed detectable neutralizing antibodies.

text: Mga 11.6% ini sila sang mga pasyente.
english: They were about 11.6% of the patients.

text: “Rapid Waning group”, mga 26.8% sang mga pasyente nga may varying level sang antibodies nga madasig mag-wane, ukon manghina, ang epekto.
english: “Rapid Waning group”, about 26.8% of patients with varying levels of antibodies that quickly wane, or weaken, the effect.

text: “Slow Waning Group”, 29 % nga mostly positive for antibodies sa sulod sang 6 ka bulan.
english: “Slow Waning Group”, 29 % mostly positive for antibodies within 6 months.

text: “Persistent Group, mga 31.7%.
english: “Persistent Group, about 31.7%.

text: Nagpakita ini sang diutay nga pagbaylo tubtub sa 180 ka adlaw.
english: It showed little conversion up to 180 days.

text: “Delayed Response Group”, mga 1.8% nga nagpakita sang significante nga pagsaka sang neutralizing  antibodies sa late covalescence.
english: “Delayed Response Group”, about 1.8% who showed a significant rise of neutralizing  antibodies in late covalescence.

text: Note, however, nga ining pagtuon ginhimo sa mga pasyente nga ang proteksyon amo lang ang ila natural immunity tungod wala ini sila mabakunahan.
english: Note, however, that this study was conducted in patients whose protection was limited to their natural immunity as they were not vaccinated against it.

text: Amo man bala ini nga mga longevity immunity (adaptive) ang mahatag sang antibodies sa nabakunahan?
english: Can the same longevity immunity (adaptive) be provided by the antibodies to the vaccinated?

text: Kon amo man ini, dapat gid man kita mangamlig gihapon bisan nabakunahan na kay indi pa makaseguro ang kada isa kon ano gid ka lawig nga immunity ang naangkon nila halin sa bakuna./PN
english: If this is the case, we must still protect ourselves even after being vaccinated because not everyone can be sure how long the immunity they have gained from the vaccine./PN

text: Ano ang imo nga plano kun makalab-ot na ikaw sa retirement age?
english: What are your plans when you reach retirement age?

text: Posible nga mag-enjoy ka na lang sa travels; mangin plantita kag mangin masako sa farm; ukon kun may pamilya ka na, mahimo nga mangin hobby mo na ang pag-atipan sa imo nga mga apo.
english: It’s possible to just enjoy the travels; be a plant and be busy on the farm; or if you have a family, you can make taking care of your grandchildren your hobby.

text: Apang sa Japan, pinasahi gid ang tatlo ka Lolo nga ginbansagan nga “G3S” bangud sa ila edad nga halos malapit na lang magpa-alam sa kalibutan, nasarangan pa nila nga mag-team up kag magpangawat sa mga balay!
english: But in Japan, the three grandparents nicknamed “G3S” are very special because at their age of almost saying goodbye to the world, they are still able to team up and rob houses!

text: Ini amo sanday Hideo Umino, 88, Hidemi Matsuda, 70, kag Kenichi Watanabe, 69, nga ginpahayag nga lunsay mga ex-convict.
english: They are Hideo Umino, 88, Hidemi Matsuda, 70, and Kenichi Watanabe, 69, all said to be ex-convicts.

text: Bangud nga ulupdanay sila anay sa presuhan, ginapahayag nga nagplano sila nga padayunon ang paghimo sang krimen apisar nakaguwa na sila kag apisar sang ila edad nga nagapalanakit na ang tuhod kag likod.
english: Because they were together in prison, they allegedly planned to continue committing the crime despite their release and despite their age of knee and back pain.

text: Gin-akusaran ang tatlo nga amo ang nagsulod sa isa ka balay sa Sapporo nga isa ka syudad sa Hokkaido sang Mayo kun sa diin ginkawat ang tatlo ka whiskey kag pagkasunod nga bulan, ginransak pa gid ang isa ka balay kag ginpangtaban ang mga alahas balor P374,000.
english: The three were accused of breaking into a house in Sapporo, a city in Hokkaido, in May where they stole three whiskeys and the following month, ransacking another house and stealing jewelry worth P374,000.

text: Gina-imbestigaran man sang pulis ang ila posible nga kahilabtanan sa 10 ka iban pa gid nga insidente sang pagpangawat sa Sapporo kag sa Ebetsu.
english: Police are also investigating their possible involvement in 10 other robbery incidents in Sapporo and Ebetsu.

text: Nagaguwa sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon sang otoridad nga planado man ang tanan bangud si Lolo Hideo ang assigned sa pagsulod sa balay; si Lolo Hidemi ang getaway driver; kag si Lolo Kenichi ang magabaligya sang ila kinawatan.
english: Initial investigation of the authorities revealed that everything was planned because Lolo Hideo was assigned to enter the house; Grandpa Hidemi is the getaway driver; and Grandpa Kenichi will sell their loot.

text: Base sa pag-interogar sa ila sang kapulisan, gin-ako sang mga tigulang nga ginhimo nila ang krimen agud nga may yara man sila sang palangabuhian.
english: Based on police interrogation, the elderly admitted that they committed the crime in order to earn a living.

text: Sa Estados Unidos, wala naka-saler sa isa ka Pinoy martial arts expert ang isa ka Amerikano nga nagapinagusto lang sa pagpang-kastigo sa mga tawo nga iya makit-an sa New York City.
english: In the United States, an American who enjoys beating people he meets in New York City did not get a salary from a Filipino martial arts expert.

text: Ginapahayag nga nakapangsakit na ang lalaki nga si Samuel Frazier sa anum ka mga tawo antes naagyan kag nasampolan ni Ro Malabanan, isa ka Filipino-American jiu-jitsu black belter.
english: The man, Samuel Frazier, allegedly assaulted six people before being approached and stabbed by Ro Malabanan, a Filipino-American jiu-jitsu black belter.

text: Suno kay Malabanan, nakit-an mismo niya nga gulpi lang nga nagtuhaw si Samuel kag gulpi lang nga nanumbag sa lalaki sa amo nga lugar.
english: According to Malabanan, he saw Samuel suddenly appear and suddenly punch the man in the area.

text: Bilang black-belter sa jiu jitsu, ginpahayag ni Malabanan nga nagtukar gid ang iya nga instinct bilang martial artist rason nga wala na ini nangduha-duha kag ginpalapitan ang lalaki.
english: As a black-belter in jiu jitsu, Malabanan said his instinct as a martial artist came into play and he did not hesitate to approach the man.

text: Gin-atake siya ni Malabanan sa iya nga likod.
english: Malabanan attacked him from behind.

text: Nagtinguha pa nga magbato ang lalaki apang gingamit ni Malabanan ang seatbelt position kag ginduot ang lalaki sa semento.
english: The man tried to resist but Malabanan used the seatbelt position and pushed the man to the cement.

text: Gin-check man ni Malabanan kun may dala nga armas ukon patalom ang lalaki kag ginpadayon ang pagduot sini sa semento tubtub nga makaabot ang pulis.
english: Malabanan also checked if the man had a weapon or knife and continued to press him against the cement until the police arrived.

text: Isa ka mixed-martial arts practitioner si Malabanan nga nagatudlo man sang boxing.
english: Malabanan is a mixed-martial arts practitioner who also teaches boxing.

text: Ginbun-ag siya sa Pilipinas apang nagdaku sa Estados Unidos.
english: He was born in the Philippines but grew up in the United States.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga wala niya ginatan-aw ang iya kaugalingon bilang baganihan bangud ginhimo lang niya ang iya trabaho bilang isa ka New Yorker.
english: He also said he doesn’t see himself as a hero because he just did his job as a New Yorker.

text: Nahibaluan man sang ulihi nga ang suspek ang may yara na nga daan sang kaso nga unprovoked assault.
english: It was also later learned that the suspect had a previous conviction for unprovoked assault.

text: Gingamit ni Pasig congressional candidate Atty. Ian Sia ang mga tinaga nga “freedom of speech” sa iya pagdepensa sa iya “lahog” nahanungod sa solo parents nga iya pahulidon sa iya sa isa ka bes kada tuig.
english: Pasig congressional candidate Atty. Ian Sia the words “freedom of speech” in his defense of his “joke” about solo parents that he will have sex with her once a year.

text: Nakabutang ini sa sabat ni Sia sa una nga show cause order nga ginpaguwa sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) nga nagaserbe man nga warning sa posible matabo nga disqualification.
english: This is stated in Sia's response to the first show cause order issued by the Commission on Elections (Comelec) which also serves as a warning of possible disqualification.

text: Abril 8 ginpasa ang sabat ni Sia sa Comelec, apang kahapon lang, Abril 9, ginpakita ang kopya sini sa mga katapo sang media.
english: Sia's response was submitted to the Comelec on April 8, but only yesterday, April 9, a copy was shown to members of the media.

text: Nagsabat ang abogado nga ang iya statements ang wala ginhimo agud nga mag-“discriminate, exclude, restrict, demean or harass” sa female solo parents.
english: The lawyer responded that his statements were not made to “discriminate, exclude, restrict, demean or harass” female solo parents.

text: Gin-kwestyon pa sini ang legalidad sang Comelec Resolution No.
english: He also questioned the legality of Comelec Resolution No.

english: 1116 which sets guidelines on equal campaigning and protection against discrimination.

english: 9006 provides that rules and regulations issued pursuant thereto must be for the implementation of said law, which is in relation to equal time and opportunity in relation to the posting of election propaganda,” according to Sia.

text: Nasundan pa ini sang isa pa ka hitabo sang body-shaming sa isa babaye nga former staffer, gani nga nag-isyu ang Comelec sang ikaduha nga show cause order batok sa congressional candidate.
english: This was followed by another incident of body-shaming of a female former staffer, prompting the Comelec to issue a second show cause order against the congressional candidate.

text: Sang Abril 8, nag-isyu man ang Korte Suprema kay Sia sang show cause order kaangot sa iya joke sa single mothers kasunod sang request for an examination nga gin-file sang Gabriela Women’s Party.
english: On April 8, the Supreme Court also issued a show cause order to Sia over her joke on single mothers following a request for an examination filed by the Gabriela Women’s Party.

text: ILOILO CITY – Apisar sang seryoso nga pamahog sang China, nagdayon gid si US house speaker Nancy Pelosi sa pagpadulong sa Taiwan.
english: ILOILO CITY – Despite the serious threat from China, US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi continued her visit to Taiwan.

text: Kagab-i, nag-abot sa Taiwan ang US Air Force Boeing C-40C kung sa diin sakay ang US house speaker.
english: Last night, the US Air Force Boeing C-40C arrived in Taiwan carrying the US house speaker.

text: Wala sang may ginpatigayon nga official ceremony kag ginsugata lamang siya sang foreign minister sang Taiwan.
english: There was no official ceremony and he was only met by Taiwan's foreign minister.

text: Sang naka-landing na sa Taiwan, nag-post sang isa ka short statement si Pelosi nga nagapahayag nga ang iya pagbisita sa pungsod ang maya katuyu-an nga i-highlight ang commitment sang US sa pagsuporta sa demokrasya sang amo nga pungsod.
english: Upon landing in Taiwan, Pelosi posted a short statement saying that her visit to the country was aimed at highlighting the US commitment to support the country's democracy.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga ang iya pagbisita ang wala nagakontra sa “long-standing one-China policy”.
english: He said his visit was not against the “long-standing one-China policy”.

text: Natalana nga magpakigkita para sa isa ka lunch meeting si Pelosi kay Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen subong nga adlaw.
english: Pelosi is scheduled to meet for a lunch meeting with Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen today.

text: Lakip man sa aktibidad ni Pelosi amo ang pagpakigkita sa grupo sang mga aktibista nga outspoken sa human rights record sang China.
english: Pelosi's activities also included meeting with a group of activists outspoken on China's human rights record.

text: Matapos nga nag-landing ang ginasakyan ni Pelosi sa Taiwan, gilayon nga nagpatrolya ang China sang bombers, fighter jets kag surveilance aircraft malapit kag mismo sa air defense zone sang Taiwan.
english: After Pelosi's plane landed in Taiwan, China immediately patrolled bombers, fighter jets and surveillance aircraft near and right in Taiwan's air defense zone.

text: Lakip na diri ang 21 ka Chinese military aircrafts.
english: This includes 21 Chinese military aircraft.

text: Bangud sini, gin-conclude sang U.S. Defense Department nga ang Chinese army ang nagahanda para sa isa ka contingency agud nga ma-unify ang Taiwan sa People’s Republic of China pinaagi sa paggamit sang pwersa.
english: As a result, the U.S. Defense Department concluded that the Chinese army is preparing for a contingency to unify Taiwan with the People's Republic of China through the use of force.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Chinese military ang naka-high alert kag natalana nga maglunsyar sang “targeted military operations” bilang balus sa pagbisita ni Pelosi sa Taiwan.
english: The Chinese military is on high alert and is scheduled to launch targeted military operations in response to Pelosi's visit to Taiwan.

text: Ang People’s Liberation Army’s Eastern Theatre Command ang nagpahayag nga magapatigayon sila sang joint military operations malapit sa Taiwan kag maga-test-launch sang conventional missiles sa sea east sang Taiwan.
english: The People's Liberation Army's Eastern Theater Command said it will conduct joint military operations near Taiwan and test-launch conventional missiles in the sea east of Taiwan.

text: Ang pagbisita ni Pelosi sa Taiwan ang gintawag sang foreign ministry sang China nga isa ka seriuos violation sang one-China principle kag may dako nga impact sa political foundation sang China-U.S. relations.
english: Pelosi's visit to Taiwan was called by China's foreign ministry a seriuos violation of the one-China principle and had a major impact on the political foundation of China-U.S. relations.

text: Ginpauntat na ni Manila third district councilor candidate Mocha Uson sa iya team ang paggamit sang jingle nga ginsaway sang Commission on Elections (Comelec).
english: Manila third district councilor candidate Mocha Uson has stopped her team from using the jingle that was criticized by the Commission on Elections (Comelec).

text: Ini amo ang partikular nga campaign material nga may lyrics nga “Cookie ni Mocha, ang sarap-sarap!” nga gina-sulit-sulit kag gina-sautan pa ni Uson sa videos nga nagalapta online.
english: This is specifically campaign material with the lyrics “Mocha’s cookie, the delicious!” that Uson is repeating and teasing in videos that are circulating online.

text: Suno kay Uson, ginapa-repaso na sini ang tanan nga content sang iya mga materyales sa pagpangampanya agud masiguro nga nagasanto ini sa standards sang poll body sang pagka-disente kag husto para sa public discourse kag electoral engagement.
english: Uson said he is already reviewing all content of his campaign materials to ensure that they meet the poll body's standards of decency and accuracy for public discourse and electoral engagement.

text: Sa sulat sang Comelec task force kay Uson sang nagligad nga Abril 8, ginsiling nga mahimo man magamit ang puns kag double meanings bilang literary devices sa mga kampanya, apang kuntani, indi lang ini paggamiton nga ma-distract ang tawo sa kun ano gid ang political platform.
english: In a letter to Uson last April 8, the Comelec task force said that puns and double meanings can also be used as literary devices in campaigns, but hopefully, they should not be used to distract people from what the political platform is.

text: Ginpaathag man sang poll body nga ang “sexually suggestive elements” ang mahimo makadula sang seryoso nga diskusyon nahanungod sa polisa, pang-gobyerno, kag buwasdamlag sang mga komunidad.
english: The poll body also explained that “sexually suggestive elements” can derail serious discussions about policy, governance, and the future of communities.

text: Nagpasalig naman si Uson nga gina-respeto sini ang importansya sang “respectful, inclusive, kag age-appropriate tone” sa campaign communications, kag siya kag ang iya team ang committed man sa makahulugan nga dayalogo para sa komunidad.
english: Uson assured that he respects the importance of “respectful, inclusive, and age-appropriate tone” in campaign communications, and he and his team are also committed to meaningful dialogue for the community.

text: Si Uson ang na-involve man anay sa kaangay nga kontrobersiya sang siya pa ang nagapungko nga assistant communications secretary sa idalom ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte bangud sa malaswa man nga dance video nga naga-promote sang federalism.
english: Uson was also involved in a similar controversy when he was assistant communications secretary under former President Rodrigo Duterte over an obscene dance video promoting federalism.

text: Sang 2022 elections, nagpadalagan si Uson bilang isa sa nominees sang Mothers for Change (Mocha) party-list apang nalutos.
english: In the 2022 elections, Uson ran as one of the nominees of the Mothers for Change (Mocha) party-list but lost.

text: Nagpaandam ang common-law wife ni former President Rodrigo Duterte nga mapa-“impiyerno” gid ang ang mga tawo nga yara sa likod sang pag-aresto sa anay presidente kag pagdala sa iya sa Netherlands.
english: The common-law wife of former President Rodrigo Duterte has warned that the people behind the arrest of the former president and his extradition to the Netherlands will be punished.

text: Suno kay Honeylet Avanceña, sang ginpamangkot niya si Duterte kun akig bala ini nga naka-detain ini sa The Hague, nagsabat ini nga “indi.” Pahayag pa sini, “wrong move” gid ang pag-aresto sa anay punong ehekutibo bangud nagaulikid lamang ini sa iya pungsod.
english: According to Honeylet Avanceña, when she asked Duterte if he was angry that he was detained in The Hague, he replied “no.” He said the arrest of the former chief executive was a “wrong move” because he only cared about his country.

text: “I asked him nga eh, ‘how do you feel?
english: “I asked him nga eh, ‘how do you feel?

text: Are you angry?’ He said ‘no.’ Kaya yung mga gumawa sa kaniya nito, impyerno kayo,” pahayag sini sa atubang sang vloggers kag reporters sa The Hague.
english: Are you angry?’ He said ‘no.’ So those who did this to him, you are hell,” he told vloggers and reporters in The Hague.

text: “All he cared for was about his country, alam n’yo ‘yan,” dugang pa sini.
english: “All he cared for was about his country, you know that,” he added.

text: Suno pa sa iya, indi man tarantado, kawatan, ukon bangag si Duterte.
english: He said Duterte is not a thief, a thief, or a bastard.

text: “Buti sana kung naging tarantado, magnanakaw, bangag.
english: “I wish I was a thief, a thief, a bastard.

text: ‘Di ba?
english: ‘Right?

text: Akala nila that will put him down.
english: They thought that would put him down.

text: Nagkamali sila.
english: They were wrong.

text: Wrong move,” dugang pa ni Honeylet.
english: Wrong move,” Honeylet added.

text: Matandaan nga si Honeylet kag anak sini nga si Veronica “Kitty” Duterte ang nag-abot sa Netherlands sang Marso 26, 2025 antes ang ika-80 nga kaadlawan sang former president.
english: Honeylet and her daughter Veronica “Kitty” Duterte arrived in the Netherlands on March 26, 2025 before the former president's 80th birthday.

text: Marso 11 sang gindakop si Duterte sang nag-abot ini sa Pilipinas halin sa Hong Kong kasunod sang request sang International Criminal Court (ICC) bilang kabahin sang imbestigasyon sa iya kontrobersyal kag maduguon nga “war on drugs”.
english: Duterte was arrested on March 11 when he arrived in the Philippines from Hong Kong following a request by the International Criminal Court (ICC) as part of an investigation into his controversial and bloody “war on drugs”.

text: Gin-set sang korte ang confirmation of charges sa Septyembre 23 nga amo ang maga-determina kun magapadayon sa trial sa kaso nga crimes against humanity.
english: The court set the confirmation of charges for September 23 which will determine whether to proceed with the trial in the case of crimes against humanity.

text: Natukod naman ang legal team sang presidente kun sa diin lakip sa nahingadlan amo ang veteran defense lawyer nga si Nicholas Kaufman nga amo ang lead counsel kag ang French lawyer nga si Dov Jacobs.
english: The president's legal team was formed with veteran defense lawyer Nicholas Kaufman as lead counsel and French lawyer Dov Jacobs.

text: Padayunon ni former Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lason ang iya pagbantay sa ‘kaban ng bayan’ kon siya ang mangin mapalaron sa 2025 midterm elections.
english: Former Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lason will continue to guard the ‘people’s treasury’ if he is successful in the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Ini ang iya ginpayag matapos ang grand rally sang Alyansa para sa Bagong Pilipinas sa Gaisano Iloilo City Center sa Benigno Aquino Ave., Diversion Road, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: He said this after the grand rally of the Alliance for a New Philippines at the Gaisano Iloilo City Center at Benigno Aquino Ave., Diversion Road, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lacson, iya ginpahayag nga indi sini luyag ang korapsyon partikular sa national budget.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Lacson said he does not want corruption particularly in the national budget.

text: Suno kay Lacson, iya na-obserbahan sa national budget sa nakaligad nga walo ka tuig, sugod sang 2016 tubtob 2023, ang ‘unused appropriation’ ang yara sa average nga P350 billion kada tuig.
english: Lacson said he observed in the national budget in the past eight years, from 2016 to 2023, the 'unused appropriation' is on average P350 billion per year.

text: Nakita man sini nga ang mga insertions nga nahimo sang mga legislators ang wala sang konsultasyon kaupod ang implementing agencies.
english: He also found that the insertions made by the legislators were without consultation with the implementing agencies.

text: Nagapati man ang natungdan nga madamo pa siya sang sarang nga mahimo sa Iloilo ilabi na sa pag-download sang resources sang national government sa tagsa ka local government agud mapatuman ang local development plan.
english: He also believes that he can do more in Iloilo especially in downloading the resources of the national government to each local government to implement the local development plan.

text: Napuhag ang mga estudyante sa 13 ka mga eskwelahan sa New Zealand matapos nakabaton sang bomb threats nga nag-resulta pa sa pag-lock down sa mga buluthuan kag pag-evacuate sa mga tawo.
english: Students in 13 schools in New Zealand were shocked after receiving bomb threats that resulted in schools being locked down and people evacuated.

text: Isa ka adlaw antes sini nga insidente, may yara man sang tawag nga nabaton ang apat ka mga buluthuan sa amo man nga pungsod kag nagpamahog nga may bomba sa ila eskwelahan.
english: A day before this incident, four schools in the same country received a call threatening that there was a bomb in their school.

text: Ginapatihan sang New Zealand Police nga kabahin ini sang overseas cyberattack kag wala sang aktwal nga pamahog sa seguridad sang mga tawo sa mga eskwelahan.
english: New Zealand Police believe this is part of an overseas cyberattack and does not pose an actual threat to the security of people in schools.

text: Nagapreparar ang pulis sa pagpakig-angot sa ila international partners.
english: The police are preparing to liaise with their international partners.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang report nga may yara gid man sang mga bomba sa mga target nga lugar.
english: So far, there have been no reports of any bombs in the target areas.

text: Suno kay Assistant police commissioner Bruce O’Brien, nakit-an nga may pagka-pareho ini nga mga insidente sa natabo nga global “robo-hoaxes” sa New Zealand kag Australian schools sang 2016 kag 2017.
english: Assistant police commissioner Bruce O'Brien said the incidents are similar to the global robo-hoaxes in New Zealand and Australian schools in 2016 and 2017.

text: Sang amo nga tion, sa dalayon nga imbestigasyon sang pulis, natumod nga taga-Israel ang suspek.
english: At that time, the police investigation revealed that the suspect was from Israel.

text: Sang 2018, ginpreso ang Israeli-American nga suspek bangud sa 2,000 ka hoax threats nga ginhimo sini sa North America, Britain, Australia, New Zealand, Norway kag Denmark.
english: In 2018, the Israeli-American suspect was jailed for making 2,000 hoax threats in North America, Britain, Australia, New Zealand, Norway and Denmark.

text: Ginaplano ni senatorial candidate Manny Pacquiao nga iduso ang maayo nga economic enterprise sang pungsod kon makapungko siya balik bilang senador.
english: Senatorial candidate Manny Pacquiao plans to promote the country's good economic enterprise if he is elected senator again.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay former senator Pacquiao, iya ginpahayag nga tutokan sini ang economic enterprise sang pungsod agud mapabaskog ang Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) bangud para sa iya, importante nga may palangitan-an ang mga Pilipino.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, former senator Pacquiao said he will focus on the country's economic enterprise to strengthen the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) because for him, it is important that Filipinos have a job.

text: Suno kay Pacquiao, napili sini ang amo nga plataporma bangud naagyan sini ang tuman ka pigado nga pagpangabuhi ilabi na kon wala sang palangitan-an.
english: According to Pacquiao, he chose the platform because he went through a very poor life especially when there is no sky.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga kon matigayon matuman ang plano, magaserbe ini nga source of income para sa tagsa ka pamilyang Pilipino.
english: He also said that if the plan is implemented, it will serve as a source of income for every Filipino family.

text: Nagapati man ang natungdan nga isa ka paagi ang tikang agud nga masustener ang livelihood sang mga Pinoy nga mahimo mapuslan man sang masunod pa nga henerasyon.
english: He also believes that the move is a way to sustain the livelihood of Filipinos that can also benefit the next generation.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Pacquiao ang nagpapili sa pagka-presidente sang 2022 kon sa diin, nagtapos ini sa ika-tatlo nga pwesto kag nakakuha sang 3.6 million nga boto.
english: Pacquiao ran for president in 2022, finishing third with 3.6 million votes.

text: Pilason ang masobra 20 ka myembro sang isa ka pamilya sa Cotabato matapos ginhabuyan sang granada ang ila compound samtang nagakinasadya kadungan sang bag-ong tuig.
english: More than 20 members of a family in Cotabato were injured after a grenade was thrown at their compound while they were celebrating the New Year.

text: Natabo ini s Purok Ipil-Ipil, Barangay Dalapitan,sa banwa sang Matalam.
english: This happened in Purok Ipil-Ipil, Barangay Dalapitan, in the town of Matalam.

text: Suno sa imestigasyon, nagatipon na para sa media noche ang magpamilya sang hinali lang nga may naglupok.
english: According to the investigation, the family was gathering for media noche when suddenly an explosion occurred.

text: May nakakita naman sa isa ka lalaki nga amo ang ginatudlo naghaboy sang granada sa compound sang mga biktima.
english: Someone saw a man who allegedly threw a grenade at the victims' compound.

text: Madasig naman nga ginpangdala sa ospital ang mga biktima.
english: The victims were rushed to the hospital.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon kag nagapabilin naman nga at-large ang suspek.
english: The investigation is ongoing and the suspect remains at large.

text: Malip-ot ang mga tinaga apang puno sang bugal nga gindumdom ni Alexie Brooks ang isa ka importante nga tawo sa iya kabuhi matapos nadag-an sini ang korona sa Miss Eco International 2025.
english: The words were short but filled with pride as Alexie Brooks remembered an important person in her life after she won the Miss Eco International 2025 crown.

text: “Lola!
english: “Grandma!

text: I made it,” caption sang Ilongga beauty queen sa iya Facebook post kun sa diin may laragway si ‘Lola Basing’ kag yara naman sa background si Alexie kasunod sang iya pagdaog sa Egypt.
english: I made it,” captioned the Ilongga beauty queen in her Facebook post where there is a picture of 'Lola Basing' and Alexie is in the background following her victory in Egypt.

text: Indi lipod sa ihibalo sang publiko ang istorya ni Alexie — nga si Lola Basing amo ang nagpadaku kag nagtatap sa iya tubtub nga amat-amat sini nga nalab-ot ang iya mga handum.
english: Alexie's story is not hidden from the public — that Lola Basing raised and cared for him until he gradually achieved his dreams.

text: Sa backstage interview sa Top 5 finalists, emosyonal man ang Pinay sang gin-share sini ang kabudlay sang nadula ang iya Lola nga nangin rason man suno sa iya kun ngaa nag-alang-alang siya kun magpadayon pa sa pag-intra sa kumpetisyon.
english: In a backstage interview with the Top 5 finalists, the Filipina was also emotional when she shared the difficulty of losing her grandmother which was the reason why she hesitated to continue participating in the competition.

text: Septyembre 2024 sang napatay ang iya Lola — tion man nga nag-post si Brooks kun ano ini kasakit para sa iya.
english: It was September 2024 when her Grandmother died — also a time when Brooks posted how painful it was for her.

text: “Today, I lost the person I loved more than anything, and the pain is unbearable.
english: “Today, I lost the person I loved more than anything, and the pain is unbearable.

text: I’m at a loss for words.
english: I’m at a loss for words.

text: Lola, I loved you with everything I had, and now I feel completely shattered and unable to move on.
english: Lola, I loved you with everything I had, and now I feel completely shattered and unable to move on.

text: I am heartbroken.
english: I am heartbroken.

text: God please,” pahayag sini anay.
english: God please,” he said.

text:
Sa isa ka separado nga post, ginbutyag sini anay kun ano ka daku ang pagpalangga sini sa iya Lola nga amo suno sa iya ang iya pinakasuod nga abyan kag amo ang iya “greatest love.”

“Who would have thought it would be my final letter to you?
english:
In a separate post, she previously expressed how much she loves her grandmother who she said is her best friend and is her “greatest love.”

“Who would have thought it would be my final letter to you?

text: I am hurt, grieving, and crying; I lost the only person I have ever loved so truly and wholeheartedly.
english: I am hurting, grieving, and crying; I lost the only person I have ever loved so truly and wholeheartedly.

text: You are my mother, my father, my best friend, my mentor, my master teacher, my greatest love.
english: You are my mother, my father, my best friend, my mentor, my master teacher, my greatest love.

text: God knows how much I love you and how shattered and broken I am,” pahayag sang Filipino-American queen.
english: God knows how much I love you and how shattered and broken I am,” the Filipino-American queen said.

text: Pasado alas singko kaina sang aga (oras sa Pilipinas) nakuha ni Brooks ang ikatatlo nga Miss Eco International crown sang Pilipinas kasunod kanday Cynthia Thomalla sang 2018 kag Kathleen Paton sang 2022.
english: Around 5:00 am yesterday (Philippine time), Brooks won the Philippines' third Miss Eco International crown after Cynthia Thomalla in 2018 and Kathleen Paton in 2022.

text: Nakuha man sang Ilongga ang Best in National Costume award paagi sa Philippine Eagle-inspired costume nga desinyo sang Ilonggo designer nga si Tata Pinuela.
english: The Ilongga also won the Best in National Costume award with her Philippine Eagle-inspired costume design by Ilonggo designer Tata Pinuela.

text: (Photos: Alexie Brooks and Missosology)
english: (Photos: Alexie Brooks and Missosology)

text:
Councilor Mabilog, ginkakibot nga wala ginsuporthan kag ginasura sang mayorya ang ginduso nya nga resolusyon

Ginkakibot ni Iloilo City Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog nga wala ginsuportahan kag ginbasura sang mayorya ang iya ginduso nga resolution nga naga-commend kuntani kay Iloilo City Vice Mayor Lady Julie Grace “Love-Love” Baronda matapos ini nga gin-eleher nga Chairwoman sang National Movement of Young Legislators (NMYL).
english:
Councilor Mabilog, surprised that the majority did not support and reject his proposed resolution

Iloilo City Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog was surprised that the majority did not support and rejected her proposed resolution commending Iloilo City Vice Mayor Lady Julie Grace “Love-Love” Baronda after she was elected Chairwoman of the National Movement of Young Legislators (NMYL).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mabilog, iya ginpahayag nga bugal gid sang siudad ang pagdaug ni Baronda sa amo nga posisyon sa national nga lebel.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mabilog said the city is proud of Baronda's victory in the position at the national level.

text: Si Baronda amo ang nakabatun sang 921 votes, samtang 145 votes lang ang nabatun sang representate halin sa Ilocos Norte nga iya kontra para sa chairmanship.
english: Baronda received 921 votes, while the representative from Ilocos Norte who was his opponent for the chairmanship received only 145 votes.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang bise alcalde sang Iloilo amo ang labing una nga babayi sa Visayas nga nakaangkon sang nasambit nga pwesto.
english: The vice mayor of Iloilo is the first woman in the Visayas to hold the post.

text: Wala naman ginkakibot ni Vice Mayor Love Baronda ang desisyon sang konseho nga ibasura ang resolusyon nga gin-file ni Councilor Mabilog.
english: Vice Mayor Love Baronda said he was not surprised by the council's decision to reject the resolution filed by Councilor Mabilog.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Baronda, iya ginpahayag nga wala man siya nagalagas sang recognition bangud ang pagserbe lang sang maayo sa publiko ang iya prayoridad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Baronda said he is not chasing recognition because serving the public is his priority.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini sa mga naghatag sa iya sang kahiyagunan nga magpanguna bilang chairwoman sang nasambit nga organisasyon.
english: She also thanked those who gave her the opportunity to lead as chairwoman of the said organization.

text: SALA ang pagpati ni President Duterte nga guerrahon kita sang China kon okuparon naton – sing malinong, syempre – ang legal naton nga pagpanag-iya sa kabug-usan sang 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone sa West Philippine Sea, lakip na ang Scarborough Shoal.
english: PRESIDENT Duterte is wrong to believe that China will wage war on us if we occupy – peacefully, of course – our legal ownership of the entire 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone in the West Philippine Sea, including the Scarborough Shoal.

text: Sa matuod, indi mahimo guerrahon kita sang China tungod sang aton Mutual Defense Treaty sa United States, nga may obligasyon nga depensahan kita kon atakehon  sang China.
english: In fact, China cannot go to war with us because of our Mutual Defense Treaty with the United States, which has an obligation to defend us if China attacks.

text: Kahadlok lang sina sang China nga guerrahon ang United States sa akto nga pagdampig sini sa Filipinas.
english: That's just China's fear of going to war with the United States for its act of siding with the Philippines.

text: Nag-atras gani  sadto angRusya, nga mas pwersado sa China, sang ginpilit sini itukod ang isa ka missile base sa Cuba nga nagabutang sa peligro ang United States, nga nag-deklarar gid ini sing guerra sa Rusya kon sigehon gid nila ang proyekto sini.
english: Russia, which is more powerful than China, even backed down when it insisted on building a missile base in Cuba that threatened the United States, declaring war on Russia if they continued with the project.

text:
***

Tungod aton ini ang EEZ pwede man gani tolerahon naton ang presensya kag kon ano man ang ipangabay nga lehitimo sang China sa aton EEZ kon maglisensya ini kay luyag ta man mangin abyan ang tanan.
english:
***

Because this is our EEZ, we can tolerate the presence and whatever China legitimately asks for in our EEZ if it licenses because we want everyone to be friends.

text: In fact, pwede ta man ma-tolerar ang ila presensya sa aton EEZ nga indi maka-lisensya.
english: In fact, we can tolerate their presence in our EEZ without a license.

text: Daw pareho bala sa pagtugot sang Freedom of Navigation sa mga friendly passage nga wala sing threat sa aton national interest, kon diin ang himuon lang naton amo ang ma-identify lang sila kag segurahon nga wala sila sing malain nga tuyu sa aton.
english: It's like allowing Freedom of Navigation to friendly passages that pose no threat to our national interest, where all we have to do is just identify them and make sure they don't have bad intentions towards us.

text: Kon may problema dira sa aton pag-exercise sang sovereign rights sa aton EEZ, amo na lang seguro ang mga na-okupar na nga mga isla diri bag-o gin-kumpirma sang Hague Tribunal nga aton full sovereign rights sa 200-nautical mile ta nga EEZ.
english: If there is a problem with our exercise of sovereign rights in our EEZ, it is probably the occupied islands here before the Hague Tribunal confirmed that we have full sovereign rights in our 200-nautical mile EEZ.

text: Parti dira, pwede man seguro ma-assign sa ila ining na-okupar na nila nga mga isla katulad sang pag-assign sang sovereign rights sa ila mga embassy kag consulate sa iban nga nasyon.
english: In this regard, they can probably be assigned these occupied islands just like the assignment of sovereign rights to their embassies and consulates in other countries.

text: Pwede man naton ma-share, ukon mag-upod sa joint venture sa mga proyekto of mutual interest, katulad sang joint oil drilling venture, nga, syempre, may pahanugot sang aton Kongreso nga ang poder ginahatag diri sang aton Constitution.
english: We can also share, or join a joint venture in projects of mutual interest, such as the joint oil drilling venture, which, of course, has the approval of our Congress whose power is given here by our Constitution.

text:
***

Ang winner sa isa ka international pageant, katulad sang Miss Universe, Miss World, Miss International kag Miss Earth,  indi kinahanglan nga matahum kay subjective ini kag base lang sa cultural looks.
english:
***

The winner of an international pageant, such as Miss Universe, Miss World, Miss International and Miss Earth, does not have to be beautiful because it is subjective and based on cultural looks.

text: Importante nga may kinaiya siya nga matalupangdan sang tanan, bisan ano man siya nga lahi ukon rasa, tungod makagalanyat (charming) ang iya personalidad sa kabug-usan kag may dala sing mabungahon nga mensahe sa kalibutan nga iya representahan sa kabug-usan.
english: It is important that he has a character that everyone notices, regardless of his race or ethnicity, because his personality is charming overall and carries a fruitful message to the world that he represents as a whole.

text: Ini tanan nakita naton kay Rabiya – kag bisan pa sang pila ka mga judges nga nakatugda parti sa iya padulong sa final phase sang kumpetisyon.
english: We saw all this in Rabiya – and even in some of the judges who made suggestions about her towards the final phase of the competition.

text: Madamo gani sang iya mga kaupod sa kompetisyon ang nakapahayag man sang ila pagdayaw sa iya.
english: Many of his fellow competitors have even expressed their admiration for him.

text: Unod siya sang mga pamantalaan, radyo kag TV nga nagapahayag nga nagapanguna siya sa madamo nga survey.
english: He is the content of newspapers, radio and TV stations that state he is leading in many polls.

text: Luas lang, siyempre, sa pila nga ang “bias” tagalumapaw sa ila hayag nga kahisa, ukon  tungod ginbayaran sila sing daku agud lang pakalainon si Rabiya sa indi naton mahangpan nga agenda nila.
english: Except, of course, for the few whose “bias” goes beyond their obvious jealousy, or  because they were paid a lot of money just to discredit Rabiya for their incomprehensible agenda.

text: Gani nakibut kita sa resulta sang botohay sang all-female nga judges sa pag-abot sa Top 10.
english: So we were surprised by the result of the vote of the all-female judges to reach the Top 10.

text: Si Rabiya nakaupod sa Top 21 sa botohay sang publiko.
english: Rabiya made it to the Top 21 in the public vote.

text: Apang wala siya sa Top 10 sang mga judges.
english: But he was not in the Top 10 of the judges.

text: Ngaa ayhan?
english: Why maybe?

text: Maathag ang cultural kag professional biases sang mga judges, nga ang kalabanan mga professional  models, nga si Rabiya indi, kag indi man malikom ang huyog sang iban agud botohon ang ila kasimanwa halin sa ila man pungsod.
english: The cultural and professional biases of the judges, most of whom are professional models, are clear, which Rabiya is not, and the tendency of others to vote for their fellow citizens from their own country is not hidden.

text: Well, leksyon na ini sa masunod nga mga international pageant nga magpili kita sang mga judges nga “fair” kag indi madala sang ila culture outlook kag professional interest.
english: Well, this is a lesson for the next international pageants that we should choose judges who are “fair” and not influenced by their culture outlook and professional interest.

text:
***

Importante sa mga Ilonggo ang ila kadungganan, nga indi basta pakalainon sang bisan sin-o lang, labi na gid kon kwestyonable ang iya interes.
english:
***

Ilonggos value their honor, which cannot be insulted by anyone, especially if his interests are questionable.

text: In fact, ginpahayag na ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga posible ma-deklarar nga persona non grata ang isa ka blogger sa iya pagpanglibak kay Rabiya, nga bisan pa gani sang pagkatapos sang pageant, nga daw siya ang luyag magbulos sa lugar ni Rabiya, samtang indi man siya angayan.
english: In fact, Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas has already said that a blogger may be declared persona non grata for his ridicule of Rabiya, who even after the pageant, as if he wants to take Rabiya's place, while he is not worthy.

text: Nevah!
english: Nevah!

text: Sa karon, naga-preparar na ang siyudad, ang probinsya sang Iloilo kag ang LGU sang Balasan nga iya banwa sa paghatag sing “fitting welcome” sa kay Rabiya.
english: The city, the province of Iloilo and the LGU of Balasan, her hometown, are now preparing to give Rabiya a fitting welcome.

text: Congratulations Rabiya, ikaw ang amon Miss Universe!/PN
english: Congratulations Rabiya, you are our Miss Universe!/PN

text: Ano ang imo himuon mo kun isa ka adlaw, gindeklarar sang iban nga tawo nga patay ka na pero sa pagkamatuod, you are “alive, awake, alert, and enthusiastic”?
english: What would you do if one day, some people declared you dead but in reality, you are “alive, awake, alert, and enthusiastic”?

text: Mahimo nga daw makahalam-ot man ini sa una, apang kun ikaw ang sa sitwasyon sining isa ka lalaki sa India, mahimo nga manginit ka man kun indi ka pagpatihan nga buhi ka pa matuod kag may kinamatarong pa sa imo nga mga propiedad.
english: It may seem funny at first, but if you were in the situation of this man in India, you might be angry if you were not believed that you were still alive and had rights to your property.

text: Kaso ini ni Baburam Bhil, 40-anyos nga lalaki sa Mithora village sa Rajasthan sa amo nga pungsod diri sa Asya.
english: This is the case of Baburam Bhil, a 40-year-old man from Mithora village in Rajasthan in that Asian country.

text: Tuman ang kakibot sini Sang may ginpaguwa nga death certificate kun sa diin nakasaad ang iya pangalan, gani gintilawan sini nga i-correct ang sala paagi sa pagpalapit sa ila village kag state authorities.
english: He was shocked when a death certificate was issued with his name on it, so he tried to correct the mistake by approaching his village and state authorities.

text: Pila ka beses niya ini ginhimo apang wala ginsapak ang iya apelar kag ang malain pa, ginkumpiskar sang gobyerno ang iya mga propiedad bangud sa rason nga patay na ang tag-iya.
english: He did so several times but his appeal was ignored and worse, the government confiscated his properties on the grounds that the owner was dead.

text: Diri kag napinsaran na sini nga mangin bayolente kag maghimo sang krimen.
english: It was here that he thought of becoming violent and committing a crime.

text: Bitbit ang isa ka kutsilyo, ginsulod sini ang isa ka eskwelahan, nag-eskandalo, napilasan pa sini ang duha ka manunudlo kag isa ka ginikanan kag sang ulihi, gin-hostage pa sini ang mga estudyante tubtub nga nag-abot ang mga pulis.
english: Carrying a knife, he broke into a school, caused a scandal, injured two teachers and a parent and later held students hostage until police arrived.

text: Sang gin-interogar na, ginpaathag ni Rajasthan nga pila ka beses na siya nag-hingyo nga i-annul ang iya death certificate apang wala siya ginpatihan rason nga nangin desperado siya kag naghimo na lang sang krimen.
english: When questioned, Rajasthan explained that he had requested several times to have his death certificate canceled but he was not believed.

text: Ginpinsar sini nga kun maghimo siya sang eskandalo, arestuhon siya sang otoridad kag mapilitan ang pulis nga ibutang ang iya pangalan sa record — pamatuod nga buhi siya kag indi pa patay.
english: He thought that if he made a scandal, the authorities would arrest him and the police would be forced to put his name on the record — proof that he was alive and not dead.

text: Sunod nga ginpaidalom sa detention ang amo nga lalaki, apang “big win” ini para sa iya bangud nag-gana ang iya plano sang gin-anunsyo sang otoridad nga imbestigaran kun ano ka matuod ang iya ginpaguwa nga alegasyon.
english: The man was subsequently detained, but it was a “big win” for him because his plan worked when the authorities announced that they would investigate the truth of his allegation.

text: Ginapasekyar na subong sang Department of Agriculture (DA) sa pagpanguna ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) led by Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: ang pagbag-o kag padayon nga pagbakal sang mga Pilipino sa imported rice sa merkado.
english: the change and continued purchase of imported rice by Filipinos in the market.

text: Ginmanduan sang opisyal ang Rice Industry Development Office (RIDO) agud pangunahan ang imbestigasyon sa padayon nga pagpili sang mga manugbakal sang imported nga mga bugas particular na ang mga bugas nga gina-import halin sa Vietnam.
english: The official directed the Rice Industry Development Office (RIDO) to lead the investigation into the continued selection of buyers of imported rice particularly rice imported from Vietnam.

text: Suno kay Laurel, ang mga pagbag-o nga ini ang possible senyales sang pagbag-o man sang mga prayoridad sang mga manugbakal kun sa diin mas ginapili sini ang may kalidad kaysa sa mas madamo.
english: According to Laurel, these changes are a possible sign of a change in the priorities of consumers where they prefer quality over quantity.

text: Samtang, tinutuyo man sang amo nga direktiba nga makahimo pa sang mga kongkreto nga rekomendasyon nga amo ang makapabaskog sang suporta para sa mga local nga nga mangunguma kag mangin mga rice millers sa sulod sang pungsod agud mas mapabaskog man ang kapasidad sini para sa ekportasyon.
english: Meanwhile, the directive also aims to make concrete recommendations that will strengthen support for local farmers and rice millers in the country to further strengthen its capacity for export.

text: Nagpadulong ang ang mga benepisyaryo sang Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps) sa Iloilo Sports Complex subong nga adlaw halin sa nagkalain-lain nga distrito sang Iloilo City kag mga banwa sang Iloilo.
english: The beneficiaries of the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps) arrived at the Iloilo Sports Complex today from different districts of Iloilo City and towns of Iloilo.

text: Ini kaangot sa Bagong Pilipinas Job Fair ang assistance sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) para sa 4Ps Beneficiaries.
english: This is in connection with the Bagong Pilipinas Job Fair the assistance of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) for 4Ps Beneficiaries.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Assistant Secretary Florentino Loyola Jr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Assistant Secretary Florentino Loyola Jr.

text: sang DWSD Office of the Assistant Secretary, iya ginpahayag nga ang nga aktibidad ang kabahin sang programa nga “Trabaho sa Bagong Pilipinas,” nga may katuyuan nga maghatag bulig sa mga pigado nga pamilya paagi sa iban pa nga oportunidad kag serbisyo.
english: of the DWSD Office of the Assistant Secretary, he said the activity is part of the “Trabaho sa Bagong Pilipinas” program, which aims to provide assistance to poor families through other opportunities and services.

text: Ginlauman nga makabaton sang bulig ang 3,000 ka mga benepisyaryo sang 4Ps sang P5,000 nga cash assistance.
english: 3,000 4Ps beneficiaries are expected to receive P5,000 cash assistance.

text: Ang nasambit nga programa ginpatigayon sa bulig sang DSWD kalakip na ang nagkalain-lain nga ahensya sang gobyerno.
english: The program was implemented with the assistance of the DSWD as well as various government agencies.

text: Gin-report ni Commodore Jay Tarriela, spokesperson sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) sa West Philippine Sea, nga nagpadayon ang barko sang China Coast Guard (CCG) sa agresibo nga mga aktwasyon batok sa BRP Cabra sang Pilipinas.
english: Commodore Jay Tarriela, spokesperson of the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) in the West Philippine Sea, reported that the China Coast Guard (CCG) ship continued aggressive actions against the Philippines' BRP Cabra.

text: Kahapon sang hapon suno kay Tarriela, pila ka beses nga nagtuyo ang CCG vessel 3302 nga bungguan ang PCG vessel samtang yara sa 98.31 nautical miles halin sa Palauig Point, Tumalog City, Zambales.
english: Yesterday afternoon, Tarriela said, CCG vessel 3302 tried several times to collide with the PCG vessel while it was 98.31 nautical miles from Palauig Point, Tumalog City, Zambales.

text: Bangud nakahibalo maglikaw ang barko sang Pilipinas, nag-deploy pa gid ang CCG sang mas gamay kag mas madasig nga sakayan nga amo ang CCG-21612.
english: Because the Philippine ship was able to avoid the situation, the CCG deployed a smaller and faster vessel, CCG-21612.

text: Apisar sini suno kay Tarriela, nagpangibabaw gihapon ang seamanship kag abilidad sang mga taga-PCG batok sa duha ka CCG vessels.
english: Despite this, Tarriela said, the seamanship and ability of the PCG personnel still prevailed against the two CCG vessels.

text: “Despite these aggressive actions, the professionalism, composure, and seamanship of the PCG sailors have successfully outmatched the reckless tactics employed by the two China Coast Guard vessels.
english: “Despite these aggressive actions, the professionalism, composure, and seamanship of the PCG sailors have successfully outmatched the reckless tactics employed by the two China Coast Guard vessels.

text: The BRP Cabra continues to shadow and challenge CCG-3302, demonstrating unwavering resolve in the face of intimidation,” suno sa PCG spokesperson.
english: The BRP Cabra continues to shadow and challenge CCG-3302, demonstrating unwavering resolve in the face of intimidation,” according to the PCG spokesperson.

text: Sang Domingo, ang amo man nga barko ang nag-ikog, nagbalabag, kag nagpinalapit sa BRP Cabra samtang yara sa distansya nga 170 nautical miles halin sa baybayon sang Zambales.
english: On Sunday, the same ship tailed, blocked, and approached BRP Cabra while at a distance of 170 nautical miles off the coast of Zambales.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Tatlo ka beses na nga nagreklamo sa Provincial Government Environment and Natural Resources Office (PGENRO) ang isa ka residente nga naga-claim nga tag-iya ini sang duta kun sa diin ginapatuman ang quarry sa Tigum River, Brgy.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – A resident claiming to be the owner of the land where the quarry is being implemented in Tigum River, Brgy.

text: Salacay, Cabatuan, Iloilo.
english: Salacay, Cabatuan, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Cesar Emmanuelle Buyco, Jr., pinuno sang PGENRO, iya ginpahayag nga sang tuig 2022, duha ka beses nga nagareklamo sa ila si Maria Fe Cabucos nga amo ang naga-claim nga siya ang tag-iya sang duta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Cesar Emmanuelle Buyco, Jr., head of PGENRO, said that in 2022, Maria Fe Cabucos complained to them twice who claimed to be the owner of the land.

text: Matapos sini, sang 2024, nagreklamo man ini pinaagi sa Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB).
english: After that, in 2024, it also complained through the Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB).

text: Suno kay Buyco, masami nga nagakontra si Cabucos sa mga resulta sang ila imbestigasyon sa diin gina-akusaran pa sila nga naga-apin sa alkalde.
english: According to Buyco, Cabucos often opposes the results of their investigation where they are even accused of defending the mayor.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga natukiban nila nga ang ginareklamo ni Cabucos nga iya duta ang kabahin na sang suba nga nagakahulugan nga isa ka public domain ukon ginapanag-iyahan na sang gobyerno.
english: He said they discovered that Cabucos' complaint that his land is already part of the river which means it is a public domain or owned by the government.

text: Masami man suno sa natungdan nga ginabuyayaw sila ni Cabucos nga kaangay man sang ginhimo sini sa iya Facebook live sa diin ginbuyayaw sini si Cabatuan, Iloilo Vice Mayor Ronilo Caspe.
english: He said Cabucos often ridiculed them as he did in his Facebook live where he ridiculed Cabatuan, Iloilo Vice Mayor Ronilo Caspe.

text: Magatambong na liwat ang pila ka sa Cabinet officials sa patigayunon nga Senate hearing kaangot sa pag-aresto kay former president Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Some Cabinet officials will again attend the upcoming Senate hearing on the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Apang kadungan sini, ginklaro sang Malacañang nga gamiton sang mga opisyal ang ila nga executive privilege pananglitan pamangkuton sila sang sensitibo nga mga impormasyon.
english: But at the same time, Malacañang clarified that officials will use their executive privilege if they are asked for sensitive information.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, lakip sa mahimo magtambong sa ikatatlo nga inquiry sang Senate Committee on Foreign Affairs nga pangunahan ni Sen.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, among those who may attend the third inquiry of the Senate Committee on Foreign Affairs led by Sen.

text:
Imee Marcos amo ang mga masunod:

Matandaan nga sa una nga hearing, nagtambong man ang Cabinet secretaries, apang sa ikaduha, bakante na ang mga pulungkuan sa Senado bangud ginsiling sang Malacañang nga bastante na ang nahatag nga mga impormasyon kag gamiton na nila ang ila nga executive privilege.
english:
Imee Marcos are as follows:

It can be recalled that in the first hearing, the Cabinet secretaries also attended, but in the second, the seats in the Senate were vacant because Malacañang said that enough information was provided and they will use their executive privilege.

text: Gin-abi-abi naman sang presidential sister ang pagpasugot sang Palasyo nga mag-attend na liwat ang government officials.
english: The presidential sister welcomed the Palace's approval for government officials to attend again.

text: “Mabuti at nagdalawang-isip ang administrasyon, pero sana hudyat na ang kanilang anunsyo ng pagnanais ibunyag ang katotohanan, na sa wakas, maliwanagan ang sambayanan patungkol sa totoong mga pangyayari,” kabahin sang statement ni Imee.
english: “It is good that the administration hesitated, but I hope that their announcement of their desire to reveal the truth will be quick, so that in the end, the public will be enlightened about the true events,” Imee said in a statement.

text: Marso 11 sang gin-aresto si Duterte sa gahum sang arrest warrant sang International Criminal Court bangud sa “crimes against humanity” nga nag-ugat sa drug war.
english: Duterte was arrested on March 11 under an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court for “crimes against humanity” rooted in the drug war.

text: Nagapabilin ini subong sa The Hague, Netherlands kag naka-schedule naman ang confirmation of charges sa Septyembre 23, 2025.
english: He is currently being held in The Hague, Netherlands and confirmation of charges is scheduled for September 23, 2025.

text: Ginapadalman na sang kapulisan kun paano nakaangkon sang bodyguards nga personnel sang Philippine Coast Guard si Guimaras gubernatorial candidate Margarita “Maggie” Cacho.
english: Police are investigating how Guimaras gubernatorial candidate Margarita “Maggie” Cacho acquired bodyguards who are personnel of the Philippine Coast Guard.

text: Si Cacho, nga pakaisa ni First Lady Atty. Liza Cacho Araneta Marcos, kaupod ang tatlo ka iban pa ang nadakpan sa entrapment operation sa Sibunag, Guimaras nga ginpatigayon sang Criminal Investigation Detection Group (CIDG)-Special Envoy on Transnational Crime kag Regional Intelligence Division.
english: Cacho, cousin of First Lady Atty. Liza Cacho Araneta Marcos, along with three others were arrested in an entrapment operation in Sibunag, Guimaras conducted by the Criminal Investigation Detection Group (CIDG)-Special Envoy on Transnational Crime and Regional Intelligence Division.

text: Ini amo sanday Cayetano Leal, 48, residente sang Brgy.
english: They are Cayetano Leal, 48, resident of Brgy.

text: Misi, Lambunao nga tinawo ni Cacho; kag ang duha ka Philippine Coast Guard personnel nga sanday Marwin Parpan, 31, residente sang Dipolog City kag Rico Maylan, 27, residente sang Sandulot Siaton, Negros Oriental.
english: Misi, Lambunao, Cacho's employee; and two Philippine Coast Guard personnel, Marwin Parpan, 31, resident of Dipolog City and Rico Maylan, 27, resident of Sandulot Siaton, Negros Oriental.

text: Ang duha ka mga Philippine Coast Guard personnel ang nabase sa Masbate apang nagaserbe nga personal security guard ni Cacho.
english: The two Philippine Coast Guard personnel are based in Masbate but serve as Cacho's personal security guards.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, director sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong, wala pa nila mapat-ud kun may high ranking officer ukon opisyal ang duha ka uniformed personnel agud magserbe bodyguards.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, director of the Police Regional Office 6, said they have not yet determined whether the two uniformed personnel have high ranking officers to serve as bodyguards.

text: Suno kay Wanky, nagpakig-angot man sila sa Commanding Officer sang duha apang wala ini nakahibalo kun paano sila nangin bodyguards ni Cacho..Una na ginkumpirma sang regional director nga napasakaan na sang kaso nga swindling sanday Cacho kag Leal kag paglapas naman sa Republic Act 10591 ukon Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act in relation with the COMELEC Resolution number 11067 (COMELEC Gun Ban) ang kaso sang duha ka mga uniformed personnel.
english: Wanky said they also contacted the Commanding Officer of the two but he did not know how they became Cacho's bodyguards. number 11067 (COMELEC Gun Ban) the case of two uniformed personnel.

text: Suno kay Wanky, nag-ugat ang operasyon kasunod sang reklamo sang biktima nga ginpangayuan ini sang P1 million agud mapasulod ang proyekto sini para sa Private Motor Vehicle Inspection Center- Emission Testing Center sang Department of Transportation.
english: According to Wanky, the operation stemmed from the victim's complaint that he was asked for P1 million to enter his project for the Private Motor Vehicle Inspection Center-Emission Testing Center of the Department of Transportation.

text: Ginagamit man ni Cacho ang first family bilang rason sa iya modus agud mapapati ang iya mga biktima.
english: Cacho also uses the first family as an excuse for his modus operandi to convince his victims.

text: Nakuha naman ang P400,000 nga boodle money nga gingamit sa operasyon.
english: P400,000 boodle money used in the operation was also recovered.

text: May narekober man nga mga armas kag mga bala.
english: Weapons and ammunition were also recovered.

text: Sa subong, preso ang mga ini sa Sibunag Municipal Police Station.
english: They are currently detained at the Sibunag Municipal Police Station.

text: Isa man sa ginaimbestigahan man sang otoridad kun may iban pa gid nga uniformed personnel nga nagaserbe bodyguards ni Cacho magluwas pa sa mga nadakpan.
english: Authorities are also investigating whether there are other uniformed personnel serving as Cacho's bodyguards besides those arrested.

text: Ginaproblema subong sang Commission on Elections sa banwa sang Zarraga, Iloilo nga wala sila sang budget subong nga tuig.
english: The Commission on Elections in Zarraga, Iloilo is now facing a problem that they do not have a budget this year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Henry Masna, Election Officer III sang Zarraga, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga sang 2024 pa nila naplastar ang kinahanglanon nga budget nga P383,000 para sa mga aktibidad may kaangtanan sa eleksyon subong nga tuig.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Henry Masna, Election Officer III of Zarraga, Iloilo, said that in 2024 they have set the required budget of P383,000 for activities related to this year's election.

text: Apang suno kay Masna, nakibot na lamang sila nga sa session sang Municipal Council sang nagligad nga semana, ginpahibalo lang sila nga wala naaprubahan ang ila budget.
english: However, Masna said they were surprised that during the Municipal Council session last week, they were informed that their budget was not approved.

text: Pahayag niya, tuman gid nila nga ginkadismaya ini nga development.
english: He said they are very disappointed with this development.

text: Sa subong, wala pa nila maistorya ang council kun ano ang rason nga wala ini maaprubahan.
english: So far, they have not talked to the council about the reason why it was not approved.

text: Sa pihak sini, sa iya nga bahin, tinguhaan niya nga mangita sang paagi agud nga matatapan ang ila kinahanglanon nga gasto para sa eleksyon.
english: Meanwhile, for his part, he will try to find a way to meet their necessary expenses for the election.

text: 10 na ka bangkay ang na-recover sang search and rescue officials matapos naglugdang ang barko sa eastern province sang North Maluku, Indonesia.
english: 10 bodies have been recovered by search and rescue officials after a ship sank in the eastern province of North Maluku, Indonesia.

text: 77 ka mga tawo ang sakay sang amo nga pssenger ship sang natabo ang paglugdang sang Lunes sang gab-i apang 64 lang ang una nga na-rescue nga buhi.
english: 77 people were on board the pssenger ship when it sank on Monday night but only 64 were initially rescued alive.

text: Sa padayon sang search operation, nakit-an ang bangkay sang mga missing kag tatlo subong ang padayon pa nga ginapangita.
english: During the search operation, the bodies of the missing were found and three are still being sought.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Gina Vella Cumla direkta sa Jakarta, Indonesia, ginabasol subong ang miscommunication nga natabo nga rason kun ngaa inoras pa ang ginlawig halin sang na-umpisahan ang search and recue.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Gina Vella Cumla directly in Jakarta, Indonesia, miscommunication is now being blamed for the delay in the search and rescue.

text: Suno kay Cumla, gamay lang nga barko ang ginasakyan sang mga pasahero kag madasig nga naglugdang bangud sa malain nga tyempo.
english: According to Cumla, the ship was carrying only a small passenger ship and sank quickly due to bad weather.

text: Komon ang marine accidents sa Indonesia kag nagasalig ang mga tawo sa ferries kag magagmay nga mga sakayang-pandagat agud nga magbyahe bisan pa nga may talalupangdon nga pigado nga safety standards.
english: Marine accidents are common in Indonesia and people rely on ferries and small boats to travel despite remarkably poor safety standards.

text: Naglab-ot sa 93% ukon 168 sa 180 ka mga Barangay sa siudad sang Iloilo ang wala nakapasa sang ila tagsa ka 2026 Annual Budget.
english: A total of 93% or 168 of the 180 Barangays in Iloilo City have not submitted their respective 2026 Annual Budgets.

text: Sa privilege speech ni Committee Chairman on Appropriations-Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia, iya ginpahayag nga magluwas subong nga 2026, may ara man sang 33 ka mga barangay sa siudad ang wala nakapasa sang ila annual budget sa mga nagligad nga tuig.
english: In his privilege speech, Committee Chairman on Appropriations-Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia said that besides 2026, there are also 33 barangays in the city that have not submitted their annual budget in previous years.

text: Suno pa kay Sarabia, matawag ini nga isa ka widespread budgetary crisis bangud indi lang ini nagakatabo sa mga Barangay Officials kundi amo man sa mga Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Councils.
english: Sarabia said this can be called a widespread budgetary crisis because it is not only happening to the Barangay Officials but also to the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Councils.

text: Pahayag niya nga yara lang sa duha ka mga barangay ang nakapasa sang ila annual budget humalin sa mga SK officials.
english: He said only two barangays have submitted their annual budget from the SK officials.

text: Suno pa sa iya, ini amo ang nagapahayag nga kun wala sang annual budget, wala man sang mga programa, proyekto, Capital outlay, Salary increase kag Social Services sa Barangay.
english: He said this means that if there is no annual budget, there are no programs, projects, capital outlay, salary increase and social services in the Barangay.

text: Ini man ang rason nga nagpasar sang resolution si Sarabia nga nagapanawagan sang Investigation in aid of Legislation sa tanan nga Barangay kag Sangguniang Kabataan Council sa siyudad sang Iloilo agud makahatag ang mga ini sang ila mga paathag.
english: This is also the reason why Sarabia passed a resolution calling for an investigation in aid of legislation in all Barangays and Sangguniang Kabataan Councils in Iloilo City so that they can give their explanations.

text: Kumpyansa si Manila 6th district Rep.
english: Manila 6th district Rep.

text: Bienvenido “Benny” Abante Jr.
english: Welcome “Benny” Abante Jr.

text: nga may bastante nga numero ang Kamara kag sarang nga mapasaka sa Senado ng impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: that the House has sufficient numbers and can file an impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte in the Senate.

text: Suno kay Abante, nakahibalo siya nga may yara sang iban nga kongresista nga nagapang-alang-alang na bangud malapit na lang ang eleksyon, apang wala siya ginakulbaan suno sa iya bangud positibo siya nga makalusot ang complaint.
english: Abante said he knows that there are other congressmen who are hesitant because the election is near, but he is not worried because he is positive that the complaint will pass.

text: “I have to be very, very honest with this, na merong mga may ibang may reservation sapagkat, you know, 2028, election ‘yan.
english: “I have to be very, very honest with this, that there are those who have other reservations until, you know, 2028, that election.

text: Pero sa aking papanaw, wala akong anumang kakaba-kaba na papasa ‘yan,” suno kay Abante.
english: But in my journey, I don't have any worries about passing it on,” Abante said.

text: “Out of 311 congressmen, 105 lang ang kailangan, one-third eh to be able to pass it and let it go to the Senate for the impeachment court.
english: “Out of 311 congressmen, only 105 are needed, one-third to be able to pass it and let it go to the Senate for the impeachment court.

text: So palagay ko makukuha namin ‘yun,” pahayag pa sini.
english: So I think we can get that,” he said.

text: Si Abante kag si House Deputy Speaker Francisco Paolo Ortega V ang nag-endorso sang ikaapat nga impeachment complaint batok sa vice president sang Pebrero 18.
english: Abante and House Deputy Speaker Francisco Paolo Ortega V endorsed a fourth impeachment complaint against the vice president on Feb. 18.

text: Gin-file ang amo nga complaint inoras lang matapos gindeklarar ni Duterte ang iya desisyon nga magpadalagan sa pagka-presidente sa 2028.
english: The complaint was filed just hours after Duterte declared his decision to run for president in 2028.

text: Kun makalab-ot na ang articles of impeachment sa Senado, nagalaum si Abante nga maapresyar sang mga senador ang facts, ebidensya, kag substance sang impeachment complaint.
english: When the articles of impeachment reach the Senate, Abante hopes that the senators will appreciate the facts, evidence, and substance of the impeachment complaint.

text: Matandaan nga na-impeach anay si Duterte sa Kamara sang Pebrero 5, 2025 matapos nga 215 ka mga kongresista ang nagpirma sa ikaapat man nga complaint batok sa iya.
english: Duterte was impeached by the House of Representatives on February 5, 2025 after 215 congressmen signed a fourth complaint against him.

text: Ginpasaka ang Articles of Impeachment sa Senado sang amo nga adlaw.
english: The Articles of Impeachment were filed in the Senate that day.

text: Sang Hulyo 25, gin-anunsyo naman sang Korte Suprema nga unconstitutional ang Articles of Impeachment bangud sa paglapas sa one-year bar rule sang 1987 Constitution.
english: On July 25, the Supreme Court declared the Articles of Impeachment unconstitutional for violating the one-year bar rule of the 1987 Constitution.

text: Sang Enero sini nga tuig, gin-uphold sang Supreme Court ang ila desisyon kag dalayon nga nagbasura sang motion for reconsideration nga gin-file sang Kamara.#
english: In January this year, the Supreme Court upheld its decision and immediately dismissed the motion for reconsideration filed by the House.#

text: BULATSING ang kinalye nga tawag sang mga kabataan diri sa aton sa tawo nga gahinambog lang sang sugid nga indi mapatihan.
english: BULATSING is the kind of name that the children here in our country call a person who just tells stories that are not believed.

text: Siling sadto ni Presidente  Duterte nga masakay siya sa jetski agud itanom ang aton bandera sa isa ka isla sa West Philippine Sea.
english: President Duterte said he would ride a jetski to plant our flag on an island in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Wala siya nagsiling kon ano nga isla, pero basi ang ginatumod ni Presidente Duterte nga isla amo ang Scarborough Shoal, nga papwersa nga gin-agaw sa aton sang China sadtong 2012, nga isa ka daku nga bato nga naga-ulhot sa dagat mga 120 ka milya halin sa Luzon kag Palawan nga nahamtang sa aminhan (north) nayon sang WPS.
english: He did not say which island, but maybe President Duterte is referring to the Scarborough Shoal, which was forcibly taken from us by China in 2012, which is a large rock that juts out into the sea about 120 miles from Luzon and Palawan located north of the WPS.

text: Gintunaan ini sang pag-file naton sang kaso sa Hague Tribunal sadtong 2013, nga gindaug naman naton sadtong 2016 kon diin gin-confirmar sang Hague Tribunal ang aton “full sovereign rights” sa  200-nautical mile nga Exclusive Economic Zone nga gin-assign sa aton sang UN Convention on the Law of the Sea, ukon UNCLOS.
english: This led to our filing a case with the Hague Tribunal in 2013, which we won in 2016 where the Hague Tribunal confirmed our “full sovereign rights” to the 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone assigned to us by the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea, UNCLOS.

text: Una nga ginpirmahan kag gin-ratify ining UNCLOS sang 164 ka pungsod, lakip gani diri ang Filipinas kag China.
english: UNCLOS was initially signed and ratified by 164 countries, including the Philippines and China.

text: May 14 nga dugang nagpirma, ugaling nagahulat pa sang ratification.
english: There are 14 more signatories, but they are still waiting for ratification.

text: Ang aton Constitution nagasiling man nga ang ining EEZ para lang sa “exclusive use”, kag wala na sing iban, sang mga Filipino.
english: Our Constitution also states that this EEZ is for the “exclusive use”, and nothing else, of the Filipinos.

text:
***

Wala ugaling matuman ining paisug-isog nga pabutyag ni Presidente Duterte tubtub sa karon, mga apat ka tuig na ang nagligad.
english:
***

However, this bold statement of President Duterte has not been fulfilled until now, about four years ago.

text: Gin-ungkat ugaling ini sang pila ka interesado sining ulihi lang.
english: However, some interested parties have recently picked it up.

text: Hinambog, ukon bulatsing, lang bala ini ni Presidente Duterte agud lingawon lang ang mga pumuluyo, ukon seryoso gid man ini agud ipakilala sa China nga aton ining isla kag wala sing makaupang sa aton agud kadtuan ini kag angkunon?
english: Is this just a boast, or a joke, by President Duterte to entertain the people, or is it really serious to show China that this island is ours and nothing can stop us from going and claiming it?

text: Indi kamo magpati seguro pero madamo ang nagpati sa sining paisug-isog nga pabutyag ni Presidente Duterte.
english: You may not believe it but many believed this bold statement of President Duterte.

text: Isa lang kuno ato ugaling ka campaign bravado, ukon pahambog, sa kampanya sadtong pagpadalagan niya sa pagka-Presidente.
english: But that was just a campaign bravado, or boast, in his presidential campaign.

text: Ang mapati kuno sadto mga “stupid”.
english: Those who believed it were said to be “stupid”.

text: “Paano abe ako makalab-ut dira sa kalayo sadto, mga 150 ka milya ang layo.
english: “How was I supposed to get to that fire, about 150 miles away.
