text: Sa kalayo sadto mahubsan sing gasolina ang jetski ko; kag basi mahulog ako kag malumos, nga daan indi ako kabalo maglangoy…” siling pa niya.
english: In the fire my jetski would run out of fuel; and I might fall and drown, since I don't know how to swim...” he said.

text: Sus, mga istupido gali kita sa pagpati sa sining paisug-isog nga pabutyag ni Presidente Duterte.
english: Sus, we are stupid to believe this bold statement of President Duterte.

text: Ayhan?
english: Perhaps?

text: Tungod sa ginpakita nga kaisug ni Presidente nga bisan ang Diyos gintawag niya nga “stupid” kag gin-mulay man si Pope Francis nga lider sang mga sobra isa ka bilyon nga katoliko sa bug-os nga kalibutan, sin-o man abe nga ordinaryo nga pumuluyo ang indi magpati nga mahimo ini ni President Duterte bisan pabuang-buang lang?
english: Given the President's courage to call even God “stupid” and to criticize Pope Francis, the leader of more than a billion Catholics around the world, who among the ordinary people does not believe that President Duterte can do this even if he is stupid?

text: Ako gani nagpati man nga mahimo niya ini, pero, excuse me, indi ako “stupid”, ukon kadlawan kamo sang nakakilala sa akon.
english: I even believed that he could do it, but, excuse me, I'm not “stupid”, or you'll be laughed at by those who know me.

text: Paano?
english: How?

text: Simple lang.
english: It’s simple.

text: Sakay ka anay sa coastguard boat upod ang jetski tubtub malapit na gawa sa isla, dayon ihulog ang jetski sa dagat kag sakyan ini pakadto sa isla nga may sobra pa nga gasolina.
english: You ride the coastguard boat with the jetski until you get close to the island, then drop the jetski into the sea and ride it to the island with more fuel.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text: Kon matabo ina, luyag man gani makita sang mga pumuluyo kon paano ni President Duterte ipilit nga magdungka sa isla kag himuon ang iya plano nga itanom ang aton bandera dira.
english: If that happens, the people will want to see how President Duterte will insist on landing on the island and carry out his plan to plant our flag there.

text: Masadya (nga indi masadya) seguro ang matabo.
english: Fun (which is not fun) is probably going to happen.

text: Wala man seguro nga soldado sang China ang maghalit kag magpatay kay Presidente Duterte kon ipilit niya himuon ang ginaplano niya himuon.
english: There is probably no Chinese soldier who will harm and kill President Duterte if he insists on doing what he plans to do.

text: Aba, may Mutual Defense Treaty kita sa United States, kag ang himuon nga pagpatay kay Presidente Duterte magadabuk lang sang gyera sa tunga sng China kag United States, nga segurado indi luyag matabo sang China.
english: Well, we have a Mutual Defense Treaty with the United States, and the assassination of President Duterte will only spark a war between China and the United States, which China certainly does not want to happen.

text: Ang matabo seguro amo nga ulu-uluhan lang si Presidente Duterte nga indi gid ini pagahimuon kag pabalikon lang ini sa coastguard boat agud makabalik puli.
english: What will probably happen is that President Duterte will just decide not to do it and just send it back to the coastguard boat to go home.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text: Kag, siyempre, labi pa gid ang pagdayaw sang mga pumuluyo sa iya.
english: And, of course, the admiration of the citizens for him is even greater.

text: Ugaling lang kay bulatsing lang gali ining paisug-isog nga pabutyag ni Presidente Duterte.
english: However, President Duterte's bold statement is just a joke.

text: Sus, a!/PN
english: Up, a!/PN

text: MANILA – Kon ano kabaskog ang daludo sang tubig samtang yara si Bagyong Carina, amo man ang pagtodo pamwersa sang duha ka babaye, agud nga mapaguwa ang ila nga bata!
english: MANILA – As strong as the waves of water during Typhoon Carina, so are the force of two women, in order to get their child out!

text: Duha ka kababainhan ang wala napunggan nga magbata samtang nagabaha bangud sa malain nga panahon nga dala ni Super Typhoon Carina.
english: Two women were unable to give birth during the floods due to the bad weather brought by Super Typhoon Carina.

text: Pila ka mga kababainhan ang nagbata kadungan sang height sang bagyo Habagat kag bagyo Carina sa Metro Manila kag isa sa ila, ang sa evacuation center nagbata.
english: Several women gave birth during the height of Typhoon Habagat and Typhoon Carina in Metro Manila and one of them, the one in the evacuation center gave birth.

text: Santo sa isa ka report nagsiling nga ang ginang nga si Maria Teresa Ragul nagbata sa isa ka evacuation center sa northern part sang Metro Manila.
english: According to a report, Maria Teresa Ragul gave birth at an evacuation center in the northern part of Metro Manila.

text: Matapos nga ma-rescue sa ila puluy-an, si Ragul, ang nagbun-ag sang isa ka lapsag nga babayi sini nga Miyerkules, kag nagasiling nga ila nadesisyonan nga ang lapsag pagahingalanan nga “Carina” kasunod sang bagyo.
english: After being rescued from their home, Ragul, gave birth to a baby girl this Wednesday, and says they decided the baby would be named “Carina” following the storm.

text: Samtang isa naman ka iloy ang nagbata sa sulod sang balay nga wala na madala sa ospital bangud man sa ginbaha ang ila lugar sa Barangay Talayan, Quezon City sang nagligad nga Miyerkules.
english: Meanwhile, a mother gave birth inside her house and was not taken to the hospital due to flooding in Barangay Talayan, Quezon City last Wednesday.

text: Sa separado nga report, ginpahayag nga pasado las 6:00 sang aga nag-awas ang tubig sa San Juan River nga kadungan sang pagkatawo ni Mikaela Bravo.
english: In a separate report, it was stated that around 6:00 am, water flowed into the San Juan River which coincided with the birth of Mikaela Bravo.

text: Sa istorya ni Dave, bana ni Mikaela, sang alas kwatro ginsugid niya sa iya lola nga nagasakit ang iya tiyan sang iya asawa, kon sa diin, wala sang baha sadto nga oras.
english: According to Dave, Mikaela's husband, at four o'clock he told his grandmother that his wife had a stomach ache, whereas, there was no flood at that time.

text: Apang, sang alas sais na, madasig nga nagtaas ang baha amo nga indi gilayon nga madala ang iya asawa sa ospital, rason nga didto ini nagbun-ag sa ila puluy-an.
english: However, by six o'clock, the flood rose so quickly that his wife could not be taken to the hospital immediately, so she gave birth at home.

text: Sa subong, si Mikaela, ang gindala sa ospital, yara na sa maayo nga kahimtangan, kag ang iya lapsag nga lalaki, ang ginpangalanan nga David Esther.
english: In the meantime, Mikaela, who was taken to the hospital, is in good condition, and her baby boy, who was named David Esther.

text: Pilason ang 12 ka mga tawo kalakip na diri ang duha ka mga bata matapos nahulog sa pil-as ang ginasakyan nila nga multicab sa New Carmen, Tugbok District, Davao City.
english: Twelve people, including two children, were injured after their multicab fell into a ditch in New Carmen, Tugbok District, Davao City.

text: Nagataklad sa mabudlay nga dalan ang salakyan sang hinali lang naguba ang makina sini kag nagdalus-os tubtob nahulog sa pil-as.
english: The vehicle was climbing a difficult road when its engine suddenly broke down and skidded until it fell into a ravine.

text: Kalakip sa pilaso amo ang duha ka bata nga nagaeda sang duha kag siyam ka tuig.
english: Among the injured were two children aged two and nine.

text: Gin-arkilahan lang ang multicab para gamiton sa paglagaw sang natabo ang aksidente.
english: The multicab was rented for travel purposes when the accident occurred.

text: Nagagwa sa imbestigasyon na mechanical problem ang rason sang disgrasya.
english: Investigation revealed that a mechanical problem was the cause of the accident.

text: Kun may yara man sang pagkaon nga pwede lutuon sa masobra 100 ka recipe ukon pamaagi, ini amo ang itlog.
english: If there is any food that can be cooked in more than 100 recipes or methods, it is eggs.

text: Apang suno sa eksperto, kun luyag mo nga makaangkon sang instant protein boost kag enerhiya, indi mo na kinahanglan lutuon ang itlog bangud mas madamo ini sang health benefits kun kan-on nga hilaw ukon raw.
english: However, according to experts, if you want to get an instant protein boost and energy, you do not need to cook eggs because they have more health benefits if eaten raw or raw.

text: Suno kay Katherine Marengo, isa ka clinical registered dietitian sa New Orleans, sa mga indibidwal nga mahilig magkaon sang hilaw nga itlog, wala sang dapat kabalak-an bangud tuman kataas ang levels sang vitamin A kag vitamin B-12 nga yara sa raw eggs.
english: According to Katherine Marengo, a clinical registered dietitian in New Orleans, for individuals who like to eat raw eggs, there is nothing to worry about because the levels of vitamin A and vitamin B-12 in raw eggs are very high.

text: Manggaranon man suno sa iya sa important antioxidants nga lutein kag zeaxanthin ang itlog nga amo ang nagapalikaw sa eye-related diseases.
english: He said eggs are also rich in important antioxidants lutein and zeaxanthin which prevent eye-related diseases.

text: Pabor man suno sa dietitian sa mga magakuha sang exam ang pagkaon sang raw egg bangud mataas ang choline sang itlog nga wala pa naluto sa diin importante ini nga factor para sa masangkad nga brain function.
english: The dietitian also favors those who will take the exam to eat raw eggs because the choline of uncooked eggs is high which is an important factor for good brain function.

text: Ginkaakig sang mga pumuluyo sang Catbalogan, Samar ang pag-demolish sang Pieta Statue sa Pieta Park sang syudad.
english: Residents of Catbalogan, Samar are angry over the demolition of the Pieta Statue in the city's Pieta Park.

text: Gin-inagurahan sang 1995, ang Pieta Statue gintukod bilang memorial sa mga biktima sang Doña Paz tragedy sang 1987.
english: Inaugurated in 1995, the Pieta Statue was built as a memorial to the victims of the 1987 Doña Paz tragedy.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, gin-demolish ang park nga wala sang permit halin sa city government.
english: According to reports, the park was demolished without a permit from the city government.

text: Ginpahayag nga may tukuron nga isa ka pizza chain sa lugar.
english: A pizza chain will reportedly be built in the area.

text: Ginapangita pa sa gihapon ang siyam ka tawo nga na-missing matapos naglugdang ang barko sa eastern province sang North Maluku, Indonesia.
english: Nine people are still being searched for after a ship sank in the eastern province of North Maluku, Indonesia.

text: 77 ka mga tawo ang sakay sang amo nga passenger ship apang 64 lang ang una nga na-rescue.
english: 77 people were on board the passenger ship but only 64 were initially rescued.

text: May nagdugang nga apat kahapon nga adlaw apang lunsay na mga patay.
english: Four more were added yesterday but all died.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Gina Vella Cumla direkta sa Jakarta, Indonesia, nagaupod ang local disaster management agency, soldiers, policemen kag volunteers sa search and rescue operation.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Gina Vella Cumla directly in Jakarta, Indonesia, the local disaster management agency, soldiers, policemen and volunteers are joining the search and rescue operation.

text: May mga local villagers man nga nagbulig agud nga mapadasig ang operation.
english: Local villagers also helped to speed up the operation.

text: Suno kay Cumla, gamay lang nga barko ang ginasakyan sang mga pasahero kag madasig nga naglugdang bangud sa malain nga tyempo.
english: According to Cumla, the ship was carrying only a small passenger ship and sank quickly due to bad weather.

text: Komon ang marine accidents sa Indonesia kag nagasalig ang mga tawo sa ferries kag magagmay nga baroto agud nga magbyahe bisan pa nga may talalupangdon nga pigado nga safety standards.
english: Marine accidents are common in Indonesia and people rely on ferries and small boats to get around despite remarkably poor safety standards.

text: Makatilingala ang istorya sang isa ka piso bangud sa kapin 35,000 ka mga manok nga nagkalamatay sang nasunog ang isa ka poultry farm sa Bugallon, Pangasinan, isahanon lang ini nga nakaluwas.
english: The story of one chick is amazing because of the more than 35,000 chickens that died when a poultry farm in Bugallon, Pangasinan burned down, it was the only one that survived.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa Barangay Gueset kun sa diin ginabanta nga kapin sa P40 milyon ang balor sang halit.
english: The incident occurred in Barangay Gueset where the damage was estimated at more than P40 million.

text: Nagsugod ang kalayo sa isa ka building sa farm kag madasig nga naglapta.
english: The fire started in a building on the farm and spread quickly.

text: Sang napalong na ang kalayo, ginkakibot sang mga tawo sa poultry farm nga may isa ka piso nga buhi kag wala nasunog.
english: When the fire was extinguished, people at the poultry farm were surprised to find one chick alive and unburned.

text: Wala naman sang pahayag ang piso kun paano ini nakaluwas bangu indi man ini makahambal.
english: The chick did not say how it survived because it could not speak.

text: Nagalaum ang Philippine National Police (PNP) nga i-konsiderar liwat sang mga mamalidha sa Estados Unidos ang amendment nga ginduso agud nga limitahan ang bulig sang US sa mga pulis sa Pilipinas.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) hopes that US lawmakers will reconsider the amendment proposed to limit US assistance to the Philippine police.

text: Suno kay PNP Spokesperson Police Colonel Jean Fajardo, magahulag ang PNP kag i-address ini nga isyu paagi sa diplomatic channels.
english: PNP Spokesperson Police Colonel Jean Fajardo said the PNP will act and address the issue through diplomatic channels.

text: Madumduman nga sang Hulyo 14, naghisugot ang mga mamalidha sa US nga ilakip sa amendment sa National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023 nga untaton ang US assistance sa PNP tubtub nga mahitso na ang problema sa human rights violations sa pungsod kag ma-meet ang human rights requirement.
english: On July 14, US lawmakers agreed to include in the amendment to the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023 to suspend US assistance to the PNP until the problem of human rights violations in the country is addressed and the human rights requirement is met.

text: Suno pa kay Pennsylvania Congresswoman Susan Wild nga amo ang nag-introduce sang amendment, indi nagakabagay nga magkadto ang buwis sang Estados Unidos sa pagsuplay sang armas, training, kag iban pa nga bulig sa state security forces sang Pilipinas nga may yara sang ‘violent’ human rights violations.
english: According to Pennsylvania Congresswoman Susan Wild, who introduced the amendment, it is not appropriate for US taxes to go to the supply of weapons, training, and other assistance to the Philippine state security forces that have violent human rights violations.

text: Gin-cite sini nga yara sa 30,000 ka extrajudicial killings ang natabo sa Pilipinas halin sang 2016 tubtub subong bangud sang “assassinations, arbitrary arrests, torture, kag red-tagging sa labor organizers kag oppositions leaders”.
english: He cited that about 30,000 extrajudicial killings have occurred in the Philippines since 2016 due to “assassinations, arbitrary arrests, torture, and red-tagging of labor organizers and oppositions leaders”.

text:
Ginpahayag man sini nga nagpanawagan si former President Rodrigo Duterte nga patyon ang “politically engaged bishops” kag ginmuno man sini ang paghingalan sang International Trade Union Confederation sa Pilipinas bilang isa 10 ka mga pungsod sa kalibutan nga “most repressive sa labor movement and workers.”

Suno naman sa PNP spokesperson, isa ka institusyon ang PNP nga advocate kag nagadampig sa tawhanon nga kinamatarong.
english:
He also said that former President Rodrigo Duterte called for the killing of “politically engaged bishops” and he also noted the International Trade Union Confederation’s naming of the Philippines as one of the 10 countries in the world that are “most repressive to the labor movement and workers.”

According to the PNP spokesperson, the PNP is an institution that advocates and stands for human rights.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga wala nakahibalo ang PNP kun ano nga mga partikular nga kaso ang gin-konsiderar kag gintun-an sang US lawmakers sa pagpasar sang amo nga amendment.
english: He also said the PNP does not know what specific cases were considered and studied by US lawmakers in passing the amendment.

text: Nagpasalig man ini nga nagapakig-angot gid ang PNP sa Department of Justice (DOJ) sa pag-imbestigar batok sa ginapahayag nga human rights violations nga nahimo sa pila ka police operations.
english: He also assured that the PNP is working closely with the Department of Justice (DOJ) to investigate alleged human rights violations committed in some police operations.

text: Gindakop sa isa ka entrapment operation ang isa ka aspirant sa pagka-gobernador sa probinsya sang Guimaras.
english: An aspirant for governor in Guimaras province was arrested in an entrapment operation.

text: Ini amo si Margarita “Maggie” Cacho.
english: This is Margarita “Maggie” Cacho.

text: Suno kay PCapt.
english: According to PCapt.

text: Ross Obejas, hepe sang Sibunag Municipal Police Station, magluwas kay Cacho, gindakop man ang duha ka personnel sang Philippine Coast Guard kag isa ka ginapahayag nga secretary ni Cacho.
english: Ross Obejas, chief of the Sibunag Municipal Police Station, said besides Cacho, two personnel of the Philippine Coast Guard and an alleged secretary of Cacho were also arrested.

text: Suno sa otoridad, may kaangtanan sa ginaalegar donasyon para sa eleksyon ang ginhimo nga transaksyon sang involved nga mga indibidwal.
english: According to the authorities, the transaction was related to the alleged donation for the election.

text: Nakahunong subong sa Sibunag PNP ang nasambit nga mga indibidwal.
english: The suspects are currently detained at Sibunag PNP.

text: Bilog nga kalibutan ang nakahibalo kun daw ano kainit subong ang gina-suprer sang mga tawo sa pila ka mga pungsod sa Europa bangud sa heatwave.
english: The whole world knows how hot people are suffering in some European countries due to the heatwave.

text: Sa France, indi lang tawo ang naga-suprer sang tuman nga kapaang kundi pati ang mga baka sa mga kaumhan.
english: In France, it is not only humans who suffer from severe drought but also cattle in the countryside.

text: Halimbawa, nagsaka sa 34 degrees Celsius (93 Fahrenheit) ang temperatura sa uma nanday Nicolas Joannon sa eastern city of Lyon rason nga haluson paguwaon ang mga baka agud nga makalagaw-lagaw man kuntani kag makaharab.
english: For example, the temperature rose to 34 degrees Celsius (93 Fahrenheit) on the farm of Nicolas Joannon in the eastern city of Lyon, causing the cows to be almost let out so that they could roam and graze.

text: Bangud sini, may gin-install nga duha ka dalagku nga bentilador — 4.5 meters (ukon halos 15 feet) ini in diameter kag ginbutang sa sulod sang barn.
english: Because of this, two large fans were installed — they were 4.5 meters (or almost 15 feet) in diameter and placed inside the barn.

text: Bangud sini maka-relax na ang mga baka — udto man ukon hapon.
english: Because of this, the cows can relax — whether it is noon or afternoon.

text: Paathag ni Joannon, kun magsaka gani ang temperatura, nagaka-heat stress ang mga sapat rason nga nagagamay man ang ila nga kaon kag gamay man ang gatas nga ila ma-produce.
english: Joannon explained that when the temperature rises, the animals get heat stress, which causes them to eat less and produce less milk.

text: Apang kun maayo ang kondisyon suno kay Joannon, nagakabatak man ang ila nga production level kag nagapaguwa sang quality milk para sa ila nga consumers.
english: However, if the conditions are good, Joannon said, their production level also increases and produces quality milk for their consumers.

text: Automatic ang fan blades nga gin-install sa barn — kun nagainit, mas nagadasig ang libot sini.
english: The fan blades installed in the barn are automatic — when it gets hot, they spin faster.

text: Daku gid ini nga bulig suno kay Joannon bangud sensitive ang dairy cows sa temperatura.
english: Joannon said this is a big help because dairy cows are sensitive to temperature.

text: Halin 22C (71F) kag 50 percent humidity, nagatipon na ang init sa lawas kag nagakabuhinan ang milk production.
english: From 22C (71F) and 50 percent humidity, body heat builds up and milk production decreases.

text: Maka-produce ang baka sang 28 to 38 liters sang milk kada adlaw apang kun ma-stress bangud sa init, posible ini nga mabuhinan sang tag-duha ka litro.
english: A cow can produce 28 to 38 liters of milk per day but if stressed due to heat, it is possible to reduce this by two liters each.

text: Na-eleher bilang presidente sang Sri-Lanka ang six-time prime minister nga si Ranil Wickremesinghe, ang suod nga kaalyado sang ginpahalin nga presidente sang pungsod.
english: Six-time prime minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, a close ally of the ousted president, has been elected president of Sri-Lanka.

text: Nakakuha si Wickremesinghe sang 134 votes sa parliament, mas mataas sa 82 nga nakuha sang iya kasumpong.
english: Wickremesinghe secured 134 votes in parliament, higher than the 82 secured by his opponent.

text: Ginpatigayon ang pagbinotohay kasunod sang pagtal-as ni anay president Gotabaya Rajapaksa gikan sa pungsod matapos nga ginsulod sang mga naga-protesta ang presidential residences kag iban pa nga government buildings bangud sa tuman nga kaakig sa iya mismanagement sa nagakatabo nga krisis sa ekonomiya.
english: The vote was held following the withdrawal of former President Gotabaya Rajapaksa from the country after protesters stormed presidential residences and other government buildings in anger over his mismanagement of the ongoing economic crisis.

text: May mga protesta man sang nagliligad nga nagapanawagan nga pahalinon si Wickremesinghe bilang prime minister, apang nagpakatig-a ini kag ginbaton pa ang tanyag nga mangin acting president sang naghalin na ang anay presidente.
english: There have also been protests in the past calling for Wickremesinghe to be removed as prime minister, but he stubbornly accepted the offer to become acting president when the former president left.

text: Ang kadalag-an sini sa parliament ang kasunod man sang pagsuporta sang kadam-an sang mga opisyal halin sa main party, ang Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) nga dominado sang Rajapaksa family.
english: Its victory in parliament also follows the support of a majority of officials from the main party, the Rajapaksa family-dominated Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP).

text: Mabudlay ang atubangon ni Wickremesinghe sa iya termino bangud naga-eksperyensya ang pungsod sang tuman kalala nga krisis — kulang ang pagkaon kag gatong, kag nadulaan pa sang salig ang publiko sa parliament.
english: Wickremesinghe will face a difficult term in office as the country is experiencing a very serious crisis — there is a shortage of food and fuel, and the public has lost confidence in parliament.

text: ILOILO CITY-Nagtapos sa trahedya ang masadya kuntani nga kasal sa pungsod Iran matapos nga aksidente nga naigo sang bala ang bride nga gintunaan sang iya kamatayon sang isa ka bisita ang nagpalupok sang pusil.
english: ILOILO CITY – A happy wedding in Iran ended in tragedy after the bride was accidentally hit by a bullet that caused her death when a guest fired a gun.

text: Isa ka ‘celebratory gunfire’ ang ginpatigayon kun sa diin isa sa mga guests ang naghimo sini sa kasal nga ginpatigayon sa Firuzabad City.
english: A celebratory gunfire was held where one of the guests did so at the wedding held in Firuzabad City.

text: Ang celebratory gunfire amo ang pagpalupok sang pusil sa okasyon bilang para pagpakita sang kalipay apisar nga ginadumilian ini.
english: A celebratory gunfire is the firing of a firearm on occasion as a show of joy despite the fact that it is prohibited.

text: Base sa report, nangin matawhay man ang una nga round sang pagpaulan sang bala,apang sa ikaduha nga round, didto na naigo sa ulo ang biktima nga si Mahvash Leghaei, 24-anyos kag pilason man ang duha pa ka bisita.
english: According to the report, the first round of gunfire was peaceful, but in the second round, the victim, Mahvash Leghaei, 24, was hit in the head and two other guests were also injured.

text: Pakaisa sang groom ang suspek nga naaresto man gilayon sang mga otoridad kag nakumpirma man nga wala sang lisensya ang iya pusil.
english: The suspect was the groom's cousin who was immediately arrested by the authorities and confirmed that his gun was not licensed.

text: Ginaplano sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sang Iloilo nga ipahibalo sa Senado nga may naga-eksister na nga daan nga provincial ordinance nga nakapangalan sa General Martin Delgado Avenue ang Bangga Dama, Sta., Barbara to San Jose, San Miguel.
english: The Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Iloilo plans to inform the Senate that there is an existing provincial ordinance named General Martin Delgado Avenue from Bangga Dama, Sta., Barbara to San Jose, San Miguel.

text: Ini kasunod man sang pagduso ni Iloilo 2nd District Representative Mike Gorriceta nga ipangalan sa iya amay ang nasambit nga dalan.
english: This follows the proposal of Iloilo 2nd District Representative Mike Gorriceta to name the road after his father.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Larry Pestaño, Representative sang office of the Congressman Michael Gorriceta, iya ginpahayag nga ang tikang ang sa idalom sang House Bill 10891 nga nagapangalan sa mga nasambit nga dalan bilang Arcadio H. Gorriceta Avenue.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Larry Pestaño, Representative of the office of Congressman Michael Gorriceta, he said the move is under House Bill 10891 which names the said roads as Arcadio H. Gorriceta Avenue.

text: Suno kay Pestaño, may yara na sang naga-eksister nga Provincial Ordinance No.
english: According to Pestaño, there is already an existing Provincial Ordinance No.

text: 2016-126 ukon “An Ordinance Naming the Provincial Road From Junction Senator Benigno S. Aquino Jr.
english: 2016-126 or “An Ordinance Naming the Provincial Road From Junction Senator Benigno S. Aquino Jr.

text: Avenue at Bangga Dama, Población, Santa Barbara to Junction National Road in Brgy.
english: Avenue at Bangga Dama, Población, Santa Barbara to Junction National Road in Brgy.

text: San Jose, San Miguel as the General Martin T. Delgado Avenue.
english: San Jose, San Miguel as the General Martin T. Delgado Avenue.

text: Luyag man sang natungdan nga maathagan sa mangin proseso samtang yara ang hagna sa Senate Committee level.
english: He also wanted clarification on the process while the bill is at the Senate Committee level.

text: Nagalaum man si Pestaño nga mahatagan igtalupangod sang senado ang tikang nga ginaduso nga mangin kahigayonan man agud hatagan sang pagkilala ang nangin kontribusyon ang nangin serbisyo ni Former Rep.
english: Pestaño also hopes that the Senate will pay attention to the proposed measure as an opportunity to recognize the contribution of Former Rep.

text: Arcadio H. Gorriceta.
english: Arcadio H. Gorriceta.

text: Wala na nagalaum si Vice President Sara Duterte nga makabaton sang hustisya ang kaso sang iya amay nga si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa idalom sang subong nga administrasyon.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte no longer hopes that the case of her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, will receive justice under the current administration.

text: Sa isa ka interview, ginsuhestyon sang Bise Presidente nga indi na niya makita nga makabaton sang nagakaigo nga hustisya kag due process ang kaso sang iya amay gikan sa gobyerno sang Pilipinas bangud sa ginaalegar extraordinary rendition sang administrasyon ni Pres.
english: In an interview, the Vice President suggested that he no longer sees his father's case receiving proper justice and due process from the Philippine government because of the alleged extraordinary rendition of the administration of Pres.

text: Ferdinand Marcos Jr sa anay presidente.
english: Ferdinand Marcos Jr to the former president.

text: Kasunod sini, naghingyo ang Bise Presidente nga kontani indi na ini matabo sa iban nga mga Pilipino, nga suno sa iya amo ang rason kon ngaa ginapatigayon ang Senate hearings angut sa proseso sang pagdakop kay FPRRD.
english: Subsequently, the Vice President urged that this should not happen to other Filipinos, which he said is the reason why the Senate hearings are being conducted regarding the process of arresting FPRRD.

text: Suno sa iya, paagi sa sini nga mga hearing, ang Senado makaangkon sang bastante nga mga pagsulundan kag makahimo sang mga kasuguan agud mapunggan ang mga amo nga sahi sang mga sitwasyon nga masulit.
english: He said that through these hearings, the Senate will have sufficient guidelines and enact laws to prevent such types of situations from repeating.

text: Samtang luyag karon ni FPRRD nga mapadasig ang kaso bangud luyag sini nga makapauli sa Pilipinas.
english: Meanwhile, FPRRD now wants to expedite the case because it wants to return to the Philippines.

text: Suno kay VP Sara, ginpahayag sang anay presidente nga tigulang na siya kag mahimo nga kuhaon sa bisan ano nga oras, kag ginhatagan pagtamod nga kun matabo ini, luyag niya nga mapatay sa iya kaugalingon nga pungsod.
english: According to VP Sara, the former president said that he is old and could be removed at any time, noting that if this happens, he wants to die in his own country.

text: Wala pa nabaton sang mga Pinoy sa Sri Lanka ang 300 US dollars ukon malapit P17,000 nga ginpromisa sang Philippine government nga ihatag sa tunga sang nagalala nga krisis sa ekonomiya.
english: Filipinos in Sri Lanka have not yet received the 300 US dollars or nearly P17,000 that the Philippine government promised to provide amid the worsening economic crisis.

text: Mayo sini nga tuig sang nagpasalig ang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) nga ihatag ang assistance bangud sang pagtimbuok sa presyo sang mga balaklon sa amo nga pungsod.
english: In May this year, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) promised to provide assistance due to the rise in commodity prices in the country.

text: Kulang ang foreign currency reserves sa Sri Lanka; wala sang inugbayad sa utang rason nga ginakulang man sang suplay sang bulong, pagkaon, gatong, kag iban pa nga kinahanglanon.
english: Sri Lanka lacks foreign currency reserves; there is no money to pay the debt so there is also a shortage of supplies of medicine, food, fuel, and other necessities.

text: May yara man anay sang gintanyag nga repatriation assistance ang gobyerno sang Pilipinas para sa ginabanta 700 ka mga Pinoy sa amo nga pungsod apang wala pa sang ginmandu nga evacuation.
english: The Philippine government has also offered repatriation assistance for an estimated 700 Filipinos in the country but no evacuation has been ordered.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Priscilla Rollo Wijesooriya direkta sa Kandy, isa ka daku nga syudad sa central Sri Lanka, daku gid nga bulig sa mga Pilipino kun mabaton na ang cash assistance bangud tuman ang pagpamigado subong sa ila nga lugar.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Priscilla Rollo Wijesooriya directly from Kandy, a large city in central Sri Lanka, it will be a big help to Filipinos if they receive the cash assistance because of the extreme poverty in their area.

text: Sa subong, ginsulit sang DFA ang pahayag nga maga-coordinate ini sa Philippine Honorary Consul General sa Colombo (capital sang Sri Lanka) agud nga ma-provide ang anuman nga assistance sa mga Pinoy nga pinaka-apektado sang economic crisis.
english: Meanwhile, the DFA reiterated its statement that it will coordinate with the Philippine Honorary Consul General in Colombo (capital of Sri Lanka) to provide any assistance to the Filipinos most affected by the economic crisis.

text: Kadungan sini, ginpasaka man sang DFA ang crisis alert level sa Alert Level 2; buot silingon, wala sang overseas Filipino worker nga i-deploy sa amo nga South Asian country magluwas lang sa may yara sang existing contracts.
english: Meanwhile, the DFA also raised the crisis alert level to Alert Level 2; that is, no overseas Filipino worker will be deployed in that South Asian country except for those with existing contracts.

text: Madumduman nga nagtal-as ang anay presidente nga si Gotabaya Rajapaksa kag kun madumduman, sa kaakig sang mga residente sa iya kag sa iya administrasyon, ginpangsulod nila ang presidential palace.
english: It can be recalled that former President Gotabaya Rajapaksa rose up and if you recall, in anger of the residents against him and his administration, they entered the presidential palace.

text: Madumduman man nga ginsunog man sang Sri Lankan protesters ang puluy-an sang ila nga prime minister.
english: Sri Lankan protesters also set fire to the residence of their prime minister.

text: Daw ano ka lawig ang imo nga masarangan kun saot ang pagahambalan?
english: How long can you go when it comes to dancing?

text: Basi pa lang kag mapierde mo ining nalab-ot sang isa ka lalaki sa Nigeria nga nakahimo gid sang world record bangud sa kalawigon sang iya nga pag-twerk.
english: Maybe you can beat this achievement of a man in Nigeria who actually set a world record for the length of time he twerked.

text: Ini amo si Babajide Israel Adebanjo nga nagpaathag nga indi lamang saot ang iya gusto himuon kundi isa ka misyon agud nga matib-ong ang iya kawsa nga mag-raise sang awareness kaangot sa depression kag kun ano bala ka-importante ang mental health.
english: This is Babajide Israel Adebanjo who explained that he wants to do more than dance but a mission to fulfill his cause of raising awareness about depression and the importance of mental health.

text: “No record is too crazy, too big, too great or too little to achieve.
english: “No record is too crazy, too big, too great or too little to achieve.

text: There is always space for everyone and their unique attributes,” paathag sini kun ngaa gusto sini makuha ang world record.
english: There is always space for everyone and their unique attributes,” he explained why he wanted to get the world record.

text: Wala-untat nga nag-twerk si Babajide sa sulod sang tatlo ka oras kag 30 minutos.
english: Babajide twerked non-stop for three hours and 30 minutes.

text: Malipayon man sini nga gin-share ang acceptance email halin sa Guinness World Records nga nagakahulugan nga opisyal nga ginkilala sang organisasyon ang iya record-breaking achievement.
english: He also happily shared the acceptance email from Guinness World Records which means the organization has officially recognized his record-breaking achievement.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini sa tanan nga nag-suporta sa iya agud nga matapos ang amo nga journey nga puno sang enerhiya kag positibo nga panan-awan.
english: He also thanked everyone who supported him to complete the journey full of energy and positive outlook.

text: Para sa Nigerian dancer, indi lamang world record ang iya nahimo kundi isa ka selebrasyon sang determinasyon kag isa man ka panawagan para sa mental health awareness.
english: For the Nigerian dancer, the accomplishment is not only a world record but also a celebration of determination and also a call for mental health awareness.

text: NAHAM-UT ang madamo sa aton mga pumuluyo sa hinali sang paglisu sang pensar ni Presidente Duterte sa pagbakig-debate sa kay anay Supreme Court associate Justice Antonio Carpio.
english: MANY of our citizens are shocked by President Duterte's sudden change of heart in the debate with former Supreme Court associate Justice Antonio Carpio.

text: Sa nahibal-an na sang publiko ginhangkat ni Presidente Duterte sang sining ulihi lang si SC Justice Carpio sa isa ka debate.
english: As the public knows, President Duterte recently challenged SC Justice Carpio in a debate.

text: Angot ini sa akusasyon sang naulihi nga ginapabay-an lang ni Presidente Duterte ang pang-abuso sang China sa sulod sang aton 200-nautical mile nga Exclusive Economic Zone.
english: This is in response to the latter's accusation that President Duterte is tolerating China's abuses within our 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone.

text: Kon indi ang ila padayon nga pagpangisda diri (nga ginabaligya pa ining mga isda sa aton), samtang nagasiling ang aton Constitution nga sa aton lang “exclusive use” ang aton EEZ, ginapang-agaw pa gani sang China ang pila naton ka isla sa sulod sini.
english: If not for their continued fishing here (which still sells these fish to us), while our Constitution says that our EEZ is for our “exclusive use”, China is even seizing some of our islands within it.

text: Sa iya pag-atras sa debate, ginsiling ugaling ni Presidente Duterte nga nalipat gali siya nga indi siya bagay makig-debate sa isa nga manubo ang tindug sa Presidente.
english: In his withdrawal from the debate, however, President Duterte said he had forgotten that he was not suitable to debate with someone who is inferior to the President.

text: Manubo gali ang iya pagtan-aw sa anay SC Justice Carpio, nga pila ka beses nga nag-acting SC chief justice.
english: He actually had a low opinion of former SC Justice Carpio, who served as acting SC chief justice several times.

text: Sus a!
english: On to!

text: “Kahalam-ut!” siling gani sang pila nga nasugilanon naton.
english: “How delicious!” even some of those we spoke to said.

text: Ang matuod seguro amo nga na-realize niya sang ulihi nga ang makaatubang niya sa debate ang isa ka mas mangin-alamon pa sa iya sa kasuguan.
english: The truth is probably that he later realized that the one who would face him in the debate was someone who was wiser than he was in the law.

text: Diri man sa sini nga debate maathagan pa gid ang isyu sang aton claim sa West Philippine Sea batok sa China, upod ang bagay nga pagduso sang aton kinamatarong sa aton EEZ “short of war” paagi sa malinong nga pag-okupar lang sini.
english: This debate will also clarify the issue of our claim to the West Philippine Sea against China, as well as the issue of pushing our rights to our EEZ “short of war” by peacefully occupying it.

text: Kon may pakusog gid man nga matabo indi halin sa aton kundi sa China, kon diin gapati kita indi kita pabay-an sang United States tungod sang aton Mutual Defense Treaty.
english: If there is a reinforcement not from us but from China, where we believe the United States will not abandon us because of our Mutual Defense Treaty.

text: In fact, gapati kita nga indi magpa-abenturar ang China sa pagpakig-encuentro sa United States sa ina nga sitwasyon.
english: In fact, we believe that China will not venture into an encounter with the United States in that situation.

text: Nadaug na naton ini nga isyu sa Hague Tribunal sadtong 2016 pa.
english: We have already won this issue in the Hague Tribunal back in 2016.

text: Kag yara man ang United States sa pagpangapin sa aton.
english: And the United States is there to defend us.

text: Ti, ano pa ang tulod-butong nga position ni President Duterte angot diri?
english: Well, what else is President Duterte's position on this?

text: Basi maki-China gid man ugaling si Presidente.
english: Maybe the President will be pro-China.

text: In fact, masakit sa aton mga pumuluyo nga sa isa ka public address ni Presidente Duterte gintawag niya nga “papel” ukon basura lang ang gindaug naton nga kaso sa Hague  Tribunal sadtong 2016.
english: In fact, it is painful for our people that in a public address of President Duterte he called “paper” or garbage the case we won in the Hague Tribunal in 2016.

text: Na-shock ang madamo.
english: Many were shocked.

text: “Impeachable crime”, ukon daku nga kasal-anan ini nga makatabug sa kay Presidente Duterte sa iya pwesto.
english: It is an “impeachable crime”, or a serious crime that can remove President Duterte from office.

text: Kag naghalin ina nga panugdaon sa isa ka naka-intiende gid sang kasuguan.
english: And that suggestion came from someone who really understood the law.

text: Ano abe sa inyo nga mga myembro sang Kongreso, nga sa kamot ninyo ginahusgaran ang isa ka impeachment case batok sa Presidente?
english: What about you members of Congress, who are judging an impeachment case against the President?

text:
***

Sunu sa aton mole sa mga mall sa siyudad, may matahum nga areglo sa tunga sang mall kag sang mga magagmay nga mga tindahan agud pareho sila maka-benepisyo.
english:
***

According to our mole in the malls in the city, there is a beautiful arrangement between the mall and the small shops so that they can both benefit.

text: Sa ini nga areglo, indi na kinahanglan nga manira ang magagmay nga mga tindahan nga naga-arkila diri kag makapadayon man sa pagganar ang mall.
english: With this arrangement, the small shops that rent here will not have to close and the mall will also be able to continue making a profit.

text: Sa sining hingyo, ginadula anay sining mall ang pagpanukot sang arkila sang mga magagmay nga mga tindahan diri.
english: With this request, the mall is temporarily eliminating the rent collection of small shops here.

text: Sa bahin sang mall, maga-share lang ini sang 10 ka porsyento sa income sining mga tindahan.
english: As for the mall, it will only share 10 percent in the income of these stores.

text: Mapadayon ining areglo tubtub magpuas ang panghalit sang COVID-19.
english: This arrangement will continue until the end of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Daku ini nga bulig matuod sa mga ginatos nga magagmay nga mga tindahan, nga nagaarkila sang indi magkubos sang P10,000 kada bulan diri.
english: This is a big help indeed to the hundreds of small shops, which rent at least P10,000 per month here.

text: Magamit pa nila ining indi mahatag nga arkila sa mall para sa ipuhunan sa mga produkto nga ginabaligya nila.
english: They can still use this unaffordable mall rent to invest in the products they sell.

text: Makabulig man ini sa pagpabilin sa trabaho sang pila nila ka empleyado.
english: It will also help keep some of their employees in their jobs.

text: Ang makuha nga 10 ka porsyento sa income sining magagmay nga mga tindahan sang mall, on the other hand, magamit man sang mall ini agud itabon sa ila ginabayaran nga buhis kag mga permit sa ila pag-operar, kag ayhan makahatag man sing bisan diutay lang nga kita nga magamit sini sa mga galastuhan sa pag-maintain sang mall.
english: The 10 percent of the income of these small mall stores, on the other hand, can also be used by the mall to cover the taxes and permits they pay for their operation, and perhaps also provide at least a small amount of revenue that it can use for the maintenance costs of the mall.

text: Indeed, matahum ini nga areglo, nga pwede sundon sang pila ka mga establecimiento para sa mutal benefit sang management kag mga empleyado./PN
english: Indeed, this is a beautiful arrangement, which can be followed by some establishments for the mutual benefit of management and employees./PN

text: Nagdaug ang Indiana Pacers sa Game 3 sang 2025 NBA Finals kag naangkon ang 2-1 nga abanse sa serye batok sa Oklahoma City Thunder.
english: The Indiana Pacers won Game 3 of the 2025 NBA Finals to take a 2-1 series lead over the Oklahoma City Thunder.

text: Nagpakita sang ikasangkol ang Pacers sa second half, kun sa diin si Tyrese Haliburton ang nagbawi kag naghatag sang clutch plays para sa iya team.
english: The Pacers showed the ability to contribute in the second half, where Tyrese Haliburton recovered and provided clutch plays for his team.

text: Bangud sa kadalag-an nga ini, duha ka daog na lang ang kinahanglan sang Indiana Pacers bag-o makuha ang kampeonato sa pinakauna nga kahigayunan.
english: With this victory, the Indiana Pacers need only two wins to win the championship for the first time.

text: Nakaandan mo man bala magbutang sang tawas sa imo mga tiil agud mangin mahamot ini kag fresh?
english: Do you also use to put tawas on your feet to keep them fragrant and fresh?

text: Suno sa mga eksperto, dako ang bentaha sa ikaayong lawas kun banyusan man ang mga tiil sang essential oils ilabi na kun antes magtulog.
english: According to experts, there are many health benefits to bathing the feet with essential oils especially before going to bed.

text: Suno kay Dr. Debra Rose Wilson, health psychologist, sa Estados Unidos, ang essential oils ang manggaranon sa medicinal kag therapeutic properties.
english: According to Dr. Debra Rose Wilson, health psychologist, in the United States, essential oils are rich in medicinal and therapeutic properties.

text: Naga-promote ini suno sa doktor sang healthy sleep, nagabulong sang sakit sang ulo, kag common cold.
english: According to the doctor, it promotes healthy sleep, treats headaches, and the common cold.

text: Pahayag ni Wilson, kada nerve sang lawas sang isa ka indibidwal ang naga-end sa mga tiil rason nga kun pahidan sang essential oils, mas ma-absorb sang lawas ang health benefits.
english: Wilson said every nerve in an individual's body ends in the feet so if you apply essential oils, the body will absorb the health benefits.

text: Dugang pa niya, agud maangkon ang kalidad nga tulog, bentaha ang pagpahid sang lavender oil sa mga tiil bangud nagabulig ini buhin sang anxiety kag nagapalikaw sa insomnia.
english: He added that to get quality sleep, it is advantageous to apply lavender oil to the feet because it helps reduce anxiety and prevent insomnia.

text: Para naman sa mga may nausea kag luyag nga magsangkad ang ila brain function, pabor man ang pagbanyos sang peppermint oil sa mga till antes magtulog.
english: For those who have nausea and want to expand their brain function, it is also recommended to apply peppermint oil to the tills before going to bed.

text: Liwat nag-init ang tension sa tunga sang Thailand kag Cambodia matapos maglunsyar ang Thailand sang air strikes sa may disputed border sini sa Cambodia.
english: Tensions between Thailand and Cambodia have flared again after Thailand launched air strikes along its disputed border with Cambodia.

text: Ini suno sa Thai military subong nga Lunes, Disyembre 8.
english: This is according to the Thai military on Monday, December 8.

text: Ini man matapos maghabuyanay sang basol ang pareho nga pungsod sang paglapas sa ceasefire agreement nga gin-areglo ni US President Donald Trump.
english: This is after the same countries blamed each other for violating the ceasefire agreement arranged by US President Donald Trump.

text: Sa isa ka statement, ginkumpirmar sang Thailand military nga napatay ang isa ka suldado nga Thai kag pilason ang apat pa ka mga indibidwal sa pag-atake sang Cambodia sa duha ka lugar sa easternmost province sang Ubon Ratchathani.
english: In a statement, the Thai military confirmed that a Thai soldier was killed and four other individuals wounded in Cambodian attacks on two areas in the easternmost province of Ubon Ratchathani.

text: Kaangot diri, gin-umpisahan na sang kampo sang Thai ang paggamit sang aircraft para maigo ang target sini nga military sang Camboadia sa nagkalain-lain nga lugar.
english: In this regard, the Thai camp has already started using aircraft to hit its Cambodian military targets in various areas.

text: Sa kampo naman sang Cambodia, ginsiling sang defense ministry nga ang Thai military ang naglunsyar sang pag-atake sa kaagahon sa ila pwersa sa duha ka lokasyon kasunod sang ila adlaw nga mga probokasyon kag wala nagbalos ang ila mga tropa.
english: In the Cambodian camp, the defense ministry said the Thai military launched morning attacks on its forces in two locations following their daily provocations and their troops did not retaliate.

text: Matandaan nga nauna nga nag-init ang tension sa border dispute sang Hulyo nga nagpatay sa 48 ka tawo kag nagpa-displaced sa 300,000 ka mga indibidwal.
english: Tensions earlier escalated over the border dispute in July that killed 48 people and displaced 300,000 individuals.

text: Nag-untat ang away sang matapos mangin epektibo ang ceasefire deal nga gin-areglo nanday Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim kag Trump, na lunsay nasaksihan ang pagpirma sa expanded peace agreement sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod sa Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia sang Oktubre.
english: The fighting stopped after the ceasefire deal brokered by Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and Trump came into effect, both of whom witnessed the signing of an expanded peace agreement between the two countries in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia in October.

text:
”Glad I could help.”

Ini ang sabat ni President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.
english:
”Glad I could help.”

This was the response of President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos, Jr.

text: sa statement nga ginbuy-an ni Vice President Sara Duterte sang nagligad nga adlaw nga nagapasalamat ini sa chief executive bangud paagi sa ginhimo ni Marcos suno sa iya, nagpatawaray na sila sang iya amay kun ano man ang natabo sa ila kabuhi.
english: in a statement released by Vice President Sara Duterte yesterday that she is grateful to the chief executive because through what Marcos did, she said, she and her father have forgiven each other for whatever happened in their lives.

text: Ang ginatumod ni Sara amo ang pagpadakop sa iya amay nga si former President Rodrigo Duterte, kag samtang yara ini sa detention facility sa The Hague, Netherlands, nag-ayo suno sa iya ang ila nga relasyon bilang mag-amay.
english: Sara is referring to the arrest of her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, and while he was in the detention facility in The Hague, Netherlands, she said their relationship as fathers improved.

text: “This really is ironic, but I have to thank Bongbong Marcos because there was forgiveness between me and [former President Duterte] for all that has happened in our lives,” suno sa vice president.
english: “This really is ironic, but I have to thank Bongbong Marcos because there was forgiveness between me and [former President Duterte] for all that has happened in our lives,” according to the vice president.

text:
Diri sini gindugang nga nag-ayo na ang ila “father-daughter relationship.”

Ang malip-ot nga sabat ni Marcos ang ginbasa naman ni Palace Press Officer Usec.
english:
It added that their “father-daughter relationship” has improved.

Marcos' brief reply was read out by Palace Press Officer Usec.

text: Claire Castro, Abril 3.
english: Claire Castro, April 3.

text: Antes ginbasa ang mensahe sang presidente, nagsabat anay si Castro kay Sara nga ang una sini pasalamatan amo mismo ang amay nga Duterte, bangud siya man ang responsable sa iya ginpanghimo rason kun ngaa didto siya subong sa Netherlands.
english: Before reading the president's message, Castro replied to Sara that the first person to thank is his father Duterte, because he is also responsible for what he did that is why he is now in the Netherlands.

text: ”Mas maganda po siguro kung magpasalamat muna si VP Sara sa kanyang ama mismo, kay dating Pangulong Duterte, dahil kung siya man po ay nagkaroon ng pagkakataon at nagkaroon ng oras kasama ang kanyang ama ay dahil po ito sa kasong EJK,” suno kay Castro.
english: "It would be better if VP Sara thanked his father himself, former President Duterte, because if he had the opportunity and had time with his father, it was because of the EJK case," Castro said.

text:
‘Kung hindi po naganap at nagawa ang sinasabing mga aksyon patungkol sa war on drugs at walang nag-complaint, hindi naman din sila magkakaroon ng pagkakataon na makapunta sa The Hague, so mas maganda pasalamatan niya muna po, dahil sa ginawa ng kanyang ama, sa mga inerereklamo sa kanya, iyon po ang naging cause kung bakit sila nasa The Hague.”

Nahibaluan nga si Marcos ang ginabasol sang mga Duterte kag ila mga kaalyado kun ngaa didto sa The Hague ang former chief executive agud atubangon ang kaso nga crimes against humanity sa International Criminal Court (ICC) bangud sa iya drug war.#
english:
"If the said actions regarding the war on drugs had not taken place and no one had complained, they would not have had the opportunity to go to The Hague, so it is better for him to thank them first, because of what his father did, to those who complained to him, that is why they are in The Hague.

Marcos is being blamed by the Dutertes and their allies for the fact that the former chief executive is in The Hague to face charges of crimes against humanity at the International Criminal Court (ICC) over his drug war.

text: Gin-umpisahan ang Oplan Baklas sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Iloilo City ang pagpangbaklas sang mga campaign paraphernalia kadungan sang pagsugod sang national campaign period.
english: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) Iloilo City launched Oplan Baklas to dismantle campaign paraphernalia as the national campaign period begins.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jonathan Sayno, Election Assistant II sang Iloilo City COMELEC, iya ginpahayag nga nagsugod sila pangbaklas sa atubang sang Iloilo Provincial Capitol kag nagderetso sa bahin sang Jaro Plaza.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jonathan Sayno, Election Assistant II of the Iloilo City COMELEC, said they started their campaign in front of the Iloilo Provincial Capitol and went straight to the Jaro Plaza.

text: Suno kay Sayno, lunsay national nga tarpaulins ang nakuha amo kanday Camille Villar, Sen.
english: According to Sayno, all national tarpaulins were obtained from Camille Villar, Sen.

text: Imee Marcos, Uswag Ilonggo Partylist, kag iban pa nga national candidates.
english: Imee Marcos, Uswag Ilonggo Partylist, and other national candidates.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga kalabanan sa nakuha nga tarpaulins ang wala sang ‘paid for by’ nga pangalan nga isa ka bayolasyon sa pagsulundan sang COMELEC.
english: He also said that most of the tarpaulins seized did not have the name 'paid for by' which is a violation of COMELEC rules.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga nakuha nga campaign materials ang mangin inventory kag i-report national nga COMELEC agud makuha ukon maturn-over.
english: He also explained that the campaign materials obtained will be inventoried and reported nationally to the COMELEC for retrieval or turn-over.

text: Ginklaro man sang natungdan nga ang paglapas sa guidelines sang mga tarpaulins ang mahimo man mangin grounds for disqualification sa pagpadalagan sa public office.
english: He also clarified that violation of the guidelines of tarpaulins can also be grounds for disqualification from running for public office.

text: Nagaplano si Senator Ronald ‘Bato’ Dela Rosa nga magkadto sa The Hague, Netherlands agud nga bisitahon si former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Senator Ronald ‘Bato’ Dela Rosa is planning to go to The Hague, Netherlands to visit former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Pahayag sini, iya tinguhaan nga mag-apply sang visa antes ang May 2025 midterm elections.
english: He said he will try to apply for a visa before the May 2025 midterm elections.

text: “Mag-try ako mag-apply ng Schengen visa kung issuehan ako.
english: “I will try to apply for a Schengen visa if I am issued one.

text: Pag may pagkakataon, before elections, sana makabisita muna ako sa kanya,” suno kay Bato.
english: If I have the opportunity, before elections, I hope I can visit him first,” Bato said.

text: Sang ulihi, gindugang niya nga mahimo man siya maka-apply sang visa bisan pagkatapos na sang eleksyon — bisan magdaog man siya ukon indi.
english: Later, he added that he could also apply for a visa even after the election — whether he wins or not.

text: Ginpamangkot man ang senador kun nahangawa man siya sa posibilidad nga i-detain siya kaupod kay Duterte.
english: The senator was also asked if he was concerned about the possibility of being detained along with Duterte.

text: Apang sabat sini, kun magkadto siya didto, magasuksok na lang siya sang wig agud indi siya makilal-an.
english: But he replied that if he went there, he would wear a wig so that he would not be recognized.

text: Naglahog man ini nga madamo siya sang klase sang masuksok lakip na ang afro wig.
english: She also joked that she wears many kinds of hair including an afro wig.

text: “Sige lang.
english: “It’s okay.

text: I-detain lang ako.
english: Just detain me.

text: Pero pagpunta ako doon sa The Hague, mag-wig ako.
english: But when I go to The Hague, I'll wear a wig.

text: Mag-wig ako para hindi nila ako makilala doon,” kabahin sang iya sabat.
english: I'll wear a wig so they won't recognize me there,” she replied.

text: Sini nga Huwebes, Abril 3, nagtambong si Bato sa hearing sang Senate Committee on Foreign relations kaangot sa pag-aresto kay Duterte sang Marso 11 bangud sa kaso nga crimes against humanity sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: This Thursday, April 3, Bato attended the hearing of the Senate Committee on Foreign Relations regarding Duterte's arrest on March 11 for crimes against humanity at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Si Bato amo anay ang chief sang Philippine National Police sang gin-implementar ni Duterte ang drug war gani nga ginapanan-aw ang posibilidad nga siya ang masunod nga dagdagan sang arrest warrant halin sa international tribunal.#
english: Bato was the chief of the Philippine National Police when Duterte implemented the drug war and is expected to be the next to be issued an arrest warrant by the international tribunal.

text: Nagapati ang complainant sang criminal cases batok kay Zarraga Vice Mayor Remia M. Sularan nga may mabug-at sila nga ebidensya agud nga mapasabat ang bise-alkalde sa gin-alegar nga falsification sang mga public documents agud mag-claim sang travel expenses.
english: The complainant of the criminal cases against Zarraga Vice Mayor Remia M. Sularan believes that they have strong evidence to hold the vice-mayor accountable for the alleged falsification of public documents to claim travel expenses.

text: Ang reklamo ang ginpasaka ni Joel A. Sularan, isa ka job hire employee sang Zarraga Municipal Hall pinaagi sa iya counsel nga si Atty. Theodore P. Banderado.
english: The complaint was filed by Joel A. Sularan, a job hire employee of Zarraga Municipal Hall through his counsel Atty. Theodore P. Banderado.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joel Sularan, iya ginpahayag nga confident siya sa tikang nga iya ginahimo ilabi na sa pagsumiter niya sang liquidation reports nga nagasiling nga nagtambong ang bise-alcalde sa 1st Luzon Wide Cooperative Development Officers Conference sa Venus Parkview Hotel sa Baguio City halin sang Septyembre 17-20, 2024.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joel Sularan said he is confident in the steps he is taking especially in his submission of liquidation reports that say the vice-mayor attended the 1st Luzon Wide Cooperative Development Officers Conference at the Venus Parkview Hotel in Baguio City from September 17-2024.

text: Suno kay Sularan, nakabaton si Vice Mayor Remia Sularan sang P6,143.00 para sa ticket sa eroplano sang Setyembre 3 kag dugang nga P10,380.00 para sa travel expenses sang Setyembre 5.
english: According to Sularan, Vice Mayor Remia Sularan received P6,143.00 for a plane ticket on September 3 and an additional P10,380.00 for travel expenses on September 5.

text: Apang, nagapakita sa opisyal nga rekord nga si Sularan yara sa Zarraga sang Setyembre 18, 2024, sa diin nagpanguna siya sa isa ka Regular Session sang Sangguniang Bayan.
english: However, official records show that Sularan was in Zarraga on September 18, 2024, where he presided over a Regular Session of the Sangguniang Bayan.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga ang ebidensya nga ginpresentar sa pagsuporta sa akusasyon nagalakip sang pila ka mga key pieces sang documentation.
english: He also said the evidence presented in support of the charge included several key pieces of documentation.

text: Ini ang mga Obligation Requests para sang mga cash advance, may kaangtanan sa mga gasto sa pagbiyahe para sa conference.
english: These are Obligation Requests for cash advances, related to travel expenses for the conference.

text: Dugang pa, ang mga Liquidation Reports nga may mga ‘falsified’ nga supporting documents, pareho sang mga ticket sa eroplano, mga boarding pass, certificate of appearance, travel orders, kag mga iteneraries, ang ginsumiter.
english: In addition, Liquidation Reports with ‘falsified’ supporting documents, such as air tickets, boarding passes, certificate of appearance, travel orders, and iteneraries, were submitted.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang kaso ginpasaka sa idalom sang Article 217 in relation to Article 171 kag 48 sang Revised Penal Code, nga nagasakop sang malversation public funds paagi sa falsification sang mga public documents.
english: It is learned that the case was filed under Article 217 in relation to Articles 171 and 48 of the Revised Penal Code, which covers malversation of public funds through falsification of public documents.

text: Nagpaandam si Senator Ronald ‘Bato’ dela Rosa nga mahimo manabat kay United States President Donald Trump ang mga nagbulig nga madakop si former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte kag madala sa The Hague.
english: Senator Ronald 'Bato' dela Rosa has warned that those who helped arrest former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte and bring him to The Hague could be held accountable by United States President Donald Trump.

text: Nabuy-an ini nga statement kadungan sang una nga pagpakita ni Bato sa Senate hearing nga naangot sa Duterte arrest.
english: The statement was released during Bato's first appearance at a Senate hearing related to the Duterte arrest.

text: Ang ginatumod ni Bato amo ang executive order nga napirmahan ni Trump sang Pebrero 2025.
english: Bato was referring to the executive order Trump signed in February 2025.

text:
Nakasaad diri nga may sanctions sa “non-American individual or organization” nga direkta nga naga-kooperar sa International Criminal Court (ICC) sa pag-detain sa isa ka “protected person.” ng ginatumod nga “protected persons” sa idalom sang amo nga order amo ang US nationals, US military personnel, kag citizens sang US NATO allies kag “major non-NATO allies.”

Ang mga pungsod naman nga nalakip sa major non-NATO allies amo ang Israel, Pilipinas, kag iban pa.
english:
It provides for sanctions against a “non-American individual or organization” that directly cooperates with the International Criminal Court (ICC) in the detention of a “protected person.” The protected persons under the order are US nationals, US military personnel, and citizens of US NATO allies and “major non-NATO allies.”

The countries that are included in the major non-NATO allies are Israel, the Philippines, and others.

text: Suno kay Bato, isa ka “moral obligation” sang committee nga ipakigbahin ang findings kay Trump para nga manabat ang tag-iya sang Gulfstream nga eroplano nga ginsakyan ni Duterte sang ginlupad ini sa The Netherlands.
english: Bato said it is a “moral obligation” of the committee to share the findings with Trump so that the owner of the Gulfstream plane that Duterte was on when he flew to The Netherlands will be held accountable.

text: “It is a moral obligation of the committee to share our findings…to President Donald Trump para kung sino mang may-ari ng Gulfstream na ito na eroplano, kung may ari-arian siya sa Amerika eh covered siya sa executive order na pinirmahan ni President Trump,” pahayag sang senador kag former PNP chief.
english: “It is a moral obligation of the committee to share our findings...to President Donald Trump so that whoever owns this Gulfstream plane, if he has property in America, he is covered by the executive order signed by President Trump,” said the senator and former PNP chief.

text: Kun balikan ang mga hitabo, ginalantaw nga gusto anay ni Trump nga protektahan ang kaalyado sini nga si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga gindagdagan man anay sang ICC arrest warrant bangud sa gyera sa Gaza.
english: Looking back, Trump is believed to have wanted to protect his ally, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who was also issued an ICC arrest warrant for the war in Gaza.

text: Bangud sadto, nagpaguwa sang executive order si Trump nga amo ang ginatumod ni Bato nga magahatag sang sanctions sa mga tawo nga magabulig sa ICC.
english: As a result, Trump issued an executive order that Bato referred to as imposing sanctions on people who help the ICC.

text: Yari ang kabahin sang order ni Trump: “The United States unequivocally opposes and expects our allies to oppose any ICC actions against the United States, Israel, or any other ally of the United States that has not consented to ICC jurisdiction.” Ang ginakahangaw-an nga epekto sini amo ang travel prohibitions, funding cuts halin sa US, ukon freezing sang US assets.
english: Here is part of Trump’s order: “The United States unequivocally opposes and expects our allies to oppose any ICC actions against the United States, Israel, or any other ally of the United States that has not consented to ICC jurisdiction.” The feared impact of this is travel bans, funding cuts from the US, or freezing of US assets.

text: Ini ang gusto matabo ni Bato kag particular sini nga gintumod kun sin-o man ang tag-iya sang chartered plane nga nagdala kay Duterte sa The Hague.
english: This is what Bato wants to happen and he particularly pointed out whoever is the owner of the chartered plane that brought Duterte to The Hague.

text: “Sigurado ako kung may-ari ka ng eroplano, mayroon kang ari-arian sa Amerika, kaya prepare for the repercussions of your actions, dahil very clear ‘yan sa executive order na in-issue ni President Trump,” suno kay Dela Rosa.
english: "I'm sure if you own an airplane, you have property in America, so prepare for the repercussions of your actions, because that's very clear in the executive order issued by President Trump," Dela Rosa said.

text: Pero naka-istorya na bala si Bato sa sin-o man nga US official para maduso ang sanctions?
english: But has Bato talked to any US official to push for sanctions?

text:
Ang sabat niya: “Secret.”

Nahibaluan nga Marso 11 sang gindakop si Duterte bangud sa ginaalegar nga crimes against humanity.
english:
His answer: “Secret.”

Duterte was arrested on March 11 for alleged crimes against humanity.

text: Gin-set ang confirmation of charges sa Septyembre 23.
english: Confirmation of charges was set for September 23.

text: Samtang wala pa ini, didto ang former president sa detention facility sa The Hague.
english: In the meantime, the former president is in a detention facility in The Hague.

text: Madamo ang nagapati nga bangud sa papel ni Bato sa PNP sang tion sang drug war, siya ang posible i-sunod nga dagdagan sang arrest warrant.#
english: Many believe that because of Bato's role in the PNP during the drug war, he is likely to be the next to be issued an arrest warrant.

text: Nagapati si Mayor Jerry Treñas nga may bug-at nga balasehan ang House of Representatives kag Senado agud nga i-impeach si Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Mayor Jerry Treñas believes that the House of Representatives and Senate have a strong basis to impeach Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga bilang isa ka abogado, kon may nakita nga grounds ang Senado kag Kamara, mangin palaagyan ini agud matigayon ang impeachment complaint.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Treñas said that as a lawyer, if the Senate and House of Representatives find grounds, it will be a way to file an impeachment complaint.

text: Suno kay Treñas, kon hinali nga magapatawag sang mando si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., base sa mandate man sang konstituyson, mahimo nga sundon gid ini sang Kamara kag Senado.
english: According to Treñas, if President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. suddenly issues a decree, based on the mandate of the constitution, the House and Senate may follow it.

text: Para sa alkalde, kinahanglan nga makalatag sang mga ebidensya si VP Duterte agud nga madepensa sini ang iya kaugalingon kon wala gidman siya sang kapaltahan sa akusasyon nga ginabato sa iya.
english: For the mayor, VP Duterte needs to lay evidence so that he can defend himself if he is innocent of the accusations against him.

text: Ginalantaw man sini nga kon magpatawag si Marcos sang special session agud mag-aprubar sang isa ka bill nga nagatumod sa impeachment ni Duterte, mahimo nga matigayon gid ang amo nga tikang.
english: He also believes that if Marcos calls a special session to approve a bill that refers to the impeachment of Duterte, such a step may be taken.

text: Gintawag ni Former Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava nga ‘animal kag iskandaluso nga kontrata’ ang ginpirmahan nga joint venture agreement ni Former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog sa tunga sang syudad kag Double Dragon Properties Corporation kaangot sa Guimaras-Iloilo Ferry Terminal (GIFT) Project.
english: Former Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava called the joint venture agreement signed by Former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog between the city and Double Dragon Properties Corporation regarding the Guimaras-Iloilo Ferry Terminal (GIFT) Project an 'animal and scandalous contract'.

text: Ang issue nagtuhaw kasunod sang renegotiation nga ginaduso ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas kag sa nasambit nga korporasyon.
english: The issue arose following the renegotiation proposed by Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas and the said corporation.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Former Councilor Nava, iya ginpahayag nga sa ila pagdihon sa amo nga agreement, wala sila nahatagan sang kopya sini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Former Councilor Nava said that when they signed the agreement, they were not given a copy of it.

text: 2012 sang ginpirmahan ni Mabilog ang agreement nga nagahatag sa Double Dragon Properties sang eksklusibo nga 25 ka tuig nga kinamatarong sa pagdevelop kag pag-operate sang 13,000-square-meter terminal complex.
english: 2012 when Mabilog signed the agreement giving Double Dragon Properties an exclusive 25-year right to develop and operate the 13,000-square-meter terminal complex.

text: Suno kay Nava, ang tikang ang isa ka ‘shocking to human senses’ rason nga nag-apelar siya sa konseho nga i-review ini, kon sa diin, nag-file siya sang resolusyon sang Hunyo 2013 agud bawion ang otoridad ni Mabilog nga magpirma sa joint venture agreement.
english: Nava said the move was shocking to human senses and he appealed to the council to review it, where he filed a resolution in June 2013 to revoke Mabilog's authority to sign the joint venture agreement.

text: Natigayon naman nga napasar ang resolusyon apang liwat nga nabalik ang otoridad kay Mabilog kasunod sang iya nga pagpahingyo sa konseho.
english: The resolution was passed but the authority was returned to Mabilog following his request to the council.

text: Gindala naman sini sa ombudsman ang agreement bangud wala ini nag-agi sa insakto nga bidding nga mahimo paglapas sa graft and corruption.
english: He took the agreement to the ombudsman because it did not go through proper bidding which could be a violation of graft and corruption.

text: Nagapati ang natungdan nga ang agreement ang wala nagtuga sang development sa Parola Wharf bangud naka-focus lamang sa business kon sa diin, mas dako pa ang shopping mall kon ikumpara sa wharf.
english: He believes that the agreement did not create development in Parola Wharf because it focused only on business where the shopping mall is bigger than the wharf.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga indi pagpamulitika ang tikang nga ginaduso subong ni Mayor Jerry Treñas bangud parte ini sang ‘public interest’.
english: He also explained that the move proposed by Mayor Jerry Treñas is not political because it is part of the public interest.

text: Nahibaluan, nga sang si Nava ang councilor, nagboto ini pabor sa amo nga agreement bangud sa amo nga tion, gahingyo siya sang anay alkalde nga buligan.
english: It is known that when Nava was a councilor, he voted in favor of the agreement because at that time, he was asking the former mayor to help him.

text: Apang subong, para sa iya, unfair kag tuman ka lugi ang syudad sa amo nga agreement.
english: But now, for him, the city is unfair and losing too much in the agreement.

text: Kon balikan, nakasaad sa anay agreement ang 25 year exclusive rights sa pagkolekta sang terminal, berthing and cargo fees, kag ang pagparenta sang mga commercial spaces sa terminal complex.
english: Looking back, the former agreement provided for 25 year exclusive rights to collect terminal, berthing and cargo fees, and the lease of commercial spaces in the terminal complex.

text: Sa idalom sang JVA, ang bahin sang syudad naglakip sang 1-5% sang kita sa gross terminal fee, 1% sang gross berthing fee revenues, 1% sang gross cargo fee revenues, kag 1% sang gross rental revenue (wala labot ang VAT).
english: Under the JVA, the city’s share included 1-5% of gross terminal fee revenue, 1% of gross berthing fee revenues, 1% of gross cargo fee revenues, and 1% of gross rental revenue (excluding VAT).

text: Indi maghalin ang Sri Lankan protesters sa sulod sang puluy-an sang ila nga presidente kag prime minister tubtub wala sang opisyal nga kumpirmasyon nga naka-resign na sa pwesto ang duha ka mataas nga opisyal sang pungsod.
english: Sri Lankan protesters will not leave the residence of their president and prime minister until there is official confirmation that the two senior officials have resigned.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag si President Gotabaya Rajapaksa nga manaog ini sa puwesto sa Hulyo 13, sandig sa anunsyo sang speaker sang parliament.
english: Earlier, President Gotabaya Rajapaksa announced that he would step down on July 13, based on the announcement of the speaker of parliament.

text: Wala sang public statement nagikan sa presidente apang may military sources nga nagsiling nga yara siya subong sa Navy vessel sa kalalawran nga sakop pa sang Sri Lanka.
english: There was no public statement from the president but military sources said he was currently on a Navy vessel in Sri Lankan waters.

text: Ang iya utod nga si former Prime Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa ang yara man sa naval base sa amo nga pungsod.
english: His brother, former Prime Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, is also at the naval base in that country.

text: Matandaan nga linibo ka mga residente ang nagsulong sa official residences sang duha agud piliton nga manaog sila sa puwesto.
english: Thousands of residents stormed the official residences of the two to force them to step down.

text: Ang presidente ang ginabasol sa economic mismanagement sa pungsod ang amo ang rason kun ngaa ginakulang ang pagkaon, gatong, kag bulong sa pila na ka bulan.
english: The president is blamed for economic mismanagement in the country that is the reason why food, fuel, and medicine have been in short supply for months.

text: Ang current Prime Minister nga si Ranil Wickremesinghe ang nagpahayag man nga maga-resign ini matapos nga ginsunog sang mga tawo ang iya private residence.
english: Current Prime Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe also announced his resignation after the mob set fire to his private residence.

text: Sa subong, okupado sang protesters ang balay sang presidente.
english: Protesters are currently occupying the president's house.

text: Pila sa mga video kag laragway ang nagapakita nga naga-enjoy ang mga tawo sa swimming pool, nagahigda sa kama, nagahigda-higda sa well-manicured gardens, naga-work out sa gym, kag nagalantaw sang telebisyon kun sa diin ginapaguwa man ang footage sang kaangay nila nga mga protesters.
english: Some of the videos and pictures show people enjoying the swimming pool, lying in bed, lounging in well-manicured gardens, working out in the gym, and watching television where footage of fellow protesters is also broadcast.

text: May yara man sang local reports nga nagapahayag nga nakakita ang anti-government protesters sang millions of rupees sa sulod sang mansion sang presidente.
english: There are also local reports that anti-government protesters found millions of rupees inside the president's mansion.

text: Sa bahin sang Vatican, nagpanawagan na si Pope Francis para sa kalinong sa Sri Lanka sa tunga sang nagalala nga economic crisis.
english: On the Vatican side, Pope Francis has called for peace in Sri Lanka amid the worsening economic crisis.

text: Ginhangkat ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas si Former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog nga mag-debate sa joint venture agreement (JVA) sang city government kag Double Dragon Properties Corp kaangot man sa Guimaras Iloilo Ferry Terminal (GIFT) Project.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas challenged Former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog to debate the joint venture agreement (JVA) of the city government and Double Dragon Properties Corp. also regarding the Guimaras Iloilo Ferry Terminal (GIFT) Project.

text: Ini kasunod man sang mga akusasyon ni Mabilog batok sa amo nga tikang sang city government.
english: This follows Mabilog's accusations against the city government's move.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga dapat sabton man ni Mabilog ang issue sa tion sang iya nga pagpamuno kon sa diin, ginpirmahan sini sang 2012 ang agreement nga nagahatag sa Double Dragon Properties Corp sang eksklusibo nga 25 ka tuig nga kinamatarong sa pagdevelop kag pag-operate sang 13,000-square-meter terminal complex.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said Mabilog should also address the issue during his tenure where he signed in 2012 an agreement giving Double Dragon Properties Corp an exclusive 25-year right to develop and operate the 13,000-square-meter terminal complex.

text: Ginkwestyon man ni Treñas kon ngaa tuman gid ka concern ang anay alkalde sa Double Dragon Properties Corporation.
english: Treñas also questioned why the former mayor is so concerned about the Double Dragon Properties Corporation.

text: Suno kay Treñas, baseless ang mga akusasyon ni Mabilog kon sa diin, nagbato man ini sang pamangkot kon ang agreement nga ginhimo sang administrasyon sang anay alkalde ang nagasunod sa existing laws sang syudad.
english: Treñas said Mabilog's accusations are baseless and he also questioned whether the agreement made by the former mayor's administration complies with the city's existing laws.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang renegotiation subong nga sa idalom sang Public Private Partnership (PPP) ang nagasunod sa insakto nga proseso.
english: He also clarified that the current renegotiation under Public Private Partnership (PPP) follows the proper process.

text: Ginpunto man ni Treñas nga nagabuligay sila ni Guimaras Governor JC Rahman Nava agud nga mangin madinalag-on ang renegotiation project.
english: Treñas also pointed out that they are working with Guimaras Governor JC Rahman Nava to make the renegotiation project a success.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Committee on Transportation sang City Council nga ang letter sang renegotiation ang mangin epektibo 60 days sugod mabaton sang City Legal Office kag Double Dragon Properties Corp.
