english: Earlier, the City Council's Committee on Transportation said the letter of renegotiation will be effective 60 days from receipt by the City Legal Office and Double Dragon Properties Corp.

text: Nahibaluan nga halos duha ka tuig matapos gin-umpisahan ang pagrepaso liwat sang Joint Venture Agreement para sa Guimaras-Iloilo Ferry Terminal Services sa Parola Wharf.
english: It is known that almost two years after the start of the review of the Joint Venture Agreement for the Guimaras-Iloilo Ferry Terminal Services at Parola Wharf.

text: Kon balikan, nakasaad sa anay agreement ang 25 year exclusive rights sa pagkolekta sang terminal, berthing and cargo fees, kag ang pagparenta sang mga commercial spaces sa terminal complex.
english: Looking back, the former agreement provided for 25 year exclusive rights to collect terminal, berthing and cargo fees, and the lease of commercial spaces in the terminal complex.

text: Sa idalom sang JVA, ang bahin sang syudad naglakip sang 1-5% sang kita sa gross terminal fee, 1% sang gross berthing fee revenues, 1% sang gross cargo fee revenues, kag 1% sang gross rental revenue (wala labot ang VAT).
english: Under the JVA, the city’s share included 1-5% of gross terminal fee revenue, 1% of gross berthing fee revenues, 1% of gross cargo fee revenues, and 1% of gross rental revenue (excluding VAT).

text: Yara na sa 80% ang kahandaan sang House of Representatives’ prosecution panel para sa impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The House of Representatives' prosecution panel is 80% ready for the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rep.

text: Lorenz Defensor nga myembro sang team, iya ginpahayag nga nakapatigayon na sila sang mock trials agud mabatyagan nila kun ano gid ang impeachment proceeding.
english: Lorenz Defensor, a member of the team, said they have already conducted mock trials to get a feel for the impeachment proceedings.

text: Suno kay Defensor, katuyuan man sini nga makapreparar sang isabat ang House prosecutors kun kwestyunon sang members sang defense team ang mga ebidensya kag mga testigo.
english: Defensor said the purpose of this is to prepare a response for the House prosecutors if members of the defense team question the evidence and witnesses.

text: Pahayag sang mamalidha, ginaprepar man nila ang testimonial kag documentary evidence.
english: The lawmaker said they are also preparing testimonial and documentary evidence.

text: Gin-ako ni Defensor nga wala nangin mahapos ang pagpreparar para sa impeachment trial samtang masako man sila sa kampanya sa eleksyon.
english: Defensor acknowledged that it was not easy to prepare for the impeachment trial while they were also busy with the election campaign.

text: Matandaan nga Pebrero 5 sang gin-impeach sang House si Duterte matapos nga 215 ka mga kongresista ang nag-file kag nag-verify sang fourth impeachment complaint.
english: It can be recalled that the House impeached Duterte on February 5 after 215 congressmen filed and verified the fourth impeachment complaint.

text: Kabahin sang complaint ang alleged misuse sang confidential funds; pamahog sa mga opisyal sang gobyerno kalakip na si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.; kag conduct unbecoming of a vice president.
english: Part of the complaint is the alleged misuse of confidential funds; threats to government officials including President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.; and conduct unbecoming of a vice president.

text: Ang Articles of Impeachment ang gilayon nga gin- transmit sa Senado.
english: The Articles of Impeachment were immediately transmitted to the Senate.

text: Ang Constitution naga-require nga magsugod gilayon ang trial kun at least one-third sang tanan nga House members — sa sini nga kaso, 102 gikan sa 306 — ang nagpirma kag nag-endorso sang petisyon.
english: The Constitution requires a trial to begin immediately if at least one-third of all House members — in this case, 102 out of 306 — sign and endorse the petition.

text: Sa idalom sang Constitution, ang Senado ang magaserbe nga impeachment court, samtang ang mga senador ang magapungko bilang mga huwes.
english: Under the Constitution, the Senate would serve as the impeachment court, while senators would sit as judges.

text: Kumporme si Iloilo 3rd District Rep.
english: Iloilo 3rd District Rep.

text: Lorenz Defensor nga liwat mahatagan sang atensyon ang ginaduso nga anti-political dynasty bill sa kongreso.
english: Lorenz Defensor to give attention to the proposed anti-political dynasty bill in Congress.

text: May kaangtanan ini sa petition nga gin- file sa Supreme Court (SC) nga nagapangabay sa judiciary nga indi pagtolerar ang kongreso nga pabay-an lang ang pagdumili sa political dynasties nga nasaad sa 1987 Constitution.
english: This is in connection with a petition filed in the Supreme Court (SC) asking the judiciary not to tolerate Congress to ignore the ban on political dynasties stipulated in the 1987 Constitution.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rep.

text: Lorenz Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan lang nga mangin balance ang pagdihon sang bill agud i-ban ang political dynasties sa pungsod.
english: Lorenz Defensor, he said that the bill needs to be balanced to ban political dynasties in the country.

text: Suno kay Defensor, dapat may depinisyon gid kun ano ang dynasty sa idalom sang layi nga ipasar sang kongreso kag bukas siya siya para diri ilabi na kun ang Supreme Court mismo ang mag-isyu sang mandamus.
english: Defensor said there should be a definition of dynasty under the law passed by Congress and he is open to it especially if the Supreme Court itself issues a mandamus.

text: Pahayag ni Defensor, may ginabanta nga 30 na ka mga pending bills angot sa anti-dynasty law kag tion na nga seryosohon ini.
english: Defensor said there are about 30 pending bills regarding the anti-dynasty law and it is time to take them seriously.

text: Dugang niya, samtang wala pa sang maathag nga depinisyon kun ano ang dynasty, mangin mabudlay ang pag-exercise sang democratic process ilabi na sa mga opisyal ang gobyerno nga magpamilya.
english: He added that while there is no clear definition of what a dynasty is, it will be difficult to exercise the democratic process especially for government officials who have families.

text: Suno sa iya, kinahanglan nga mangin rasonable ang depinisyon agud indi man madalukan sang kinamatarong ang indibidwal nga magsulod sa public service.
english: He said the definition should be reasonable so that the individual's right to enter the public service is not denied.

text: Padayonun ang operasyon sang cryptocurrency sa Pilipinas, suno sa Securities and Exchange Commission.
english: Cryptocurrency operations in the Philippines will continue, according to the Securities and Exchange Commission.

text: Ginpaathag sang ahensya nga wala ginadumilian ang trading basta ang mga Crypto Asset Service Providers may rehistro kag lisensya.
english: The agency explained that trading is not prohibited as long as Crypto Asset Service Providers are registered and licensed.

text: Tuyo sang regulasyon nga maprotektahan ang investors, mapabilin ang integridad sang merkado, kag masiguro ang patas nga kompetisyon.
english: Regulation aims to protect investors, maintain market integrity, and ensure fair competition.

text: Ginpahayag man sang SEC nga mahimo sila mag-imbestigar kag maghimo sang tikang batok sa mga unregistered CASPs, lakip na ang pagpugong sang access sa ila platforms.
english: The SEC also said it may investigate and take action against unregistered CASPs, including restricting access to their platforms.

text: Base sa datos, naglab-ut sa 750,000 ang crypto users sa Pilipinas sang pandemya, kag ika-walo ang pungsod sa kalibutan sa cryptocurrency adoption suno sa Chainalysis.
english: Based on data, the Philippines has reached 750,000 crypto users during the pandemic, and the country ranks eighth in the world in cryptocurrency adoption according to Chainalysis.

text: Sa subong nga panahon sang tag-ululan indi malikawan ang asod-asod nga pagbrownout sa diin may mga bes nga sa tunga sang kagab-ihon ukon kaagahon, nagapaligo kita sang balhas kun mag-ala sauna ang aton puluy-an bangud patay ang electric fan ukon ang aircon.
english: In this rainy season, brownouts are inevitable where sometimes in the middle of the night or morning, we take a bath when our house gets hot because the electric fan or the aircon is off.

text: Suno sa mga eksperto, healthy ang pag-release sang balhas sa aton nga lawas ilabi na kun naga-ehersisyo bangud naga-promote ini sang cardiovascular health.
english: According to experts, it is healthy to release sweat in our body especially when exercising because it promotes cardiovascular health.

text: Apang kun ano ka-importante ang pagpabalhas para sa ikaayong lawas, amo man ang pag-counteract sang fluid loss.
english: But as important as sweating is for health, so is counteracting fluid loss.

text: Suno kay Sarah Rautio, Consumer Horticulture Educator sa Michigan State University, pat-od nga dako ang mahatag nga benepisyo sang pagpabalhas kun naga-ehersisyo apang kun indi ma-counteract ang fluid loss, mangin tunaan ini sang nausea kag pagkalingin sang ulo tuga sang dehydration.
english: According to Sarah Rautio, Consumer Horticulture Educator at Michigan State University, sweating can certainly have many benefits during exercise but if fluid loss is not counteracted, it can lead to nausea and dizziness due to dehydration.

text: Agud mapabilin nga dehydrated ang lawas, yari ang pila ka mga panugyan sang eksperto:
english: In order to keep the body dehydrated, here are some expert tips:

text: Nakit-an nga wala na sang kabuhi ang isa ka public school teacher sa sulod sang iya boarding house sa Brgy.
english: A public school teacher was found dead inside her boarding house in Brgy.

text: Villasis, Santiago City, Isabela.
english: Villasis, Santiago City, Isabela.

text: Ang biktima amo ang 31-anyos nga si alyas “Jhanmar”.
english: The victim was identified as 31-year-old alias “Jhanmar”.

text: Nadiskubre ang bangkay sang biktima matapos nagbalik sa boarding house ang isa ka boarder agud magdul-ong sang mga bayo nga ginpalabhan sang biktima.
english: The victim's body was discovered after a boarder returned to the boarding house to deliver clothes that the victim had washed.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, madugay ang pagpanuktok sang isa ka boarder tubtob nga napilitan ini nga buksan na lang ang pwertahan kag nakit-an nga nagahigda sa salog ang biktima.
english: According to the investigation, a boarder knocked for a long time until he was forced to open the door and found the victim lying on the floor.

text: Wala naman sang nakit-an nga foul play ang otoridad apang padayon ang imbestigasyon sa kamatayon sang manunudlo.
english: Authorities did not find any foul play but the investigation into the death of the teacher is ongoing.

text: Nagalaum ang director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC) nga ma-impeach sang mas temprano sa Kamara si Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC) hopes that Vice President Sara Duterte will be impeached earlier in the House.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Msgr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, iya ginpahayag nga kun magsaka na ang articles of impeachment sa Senado, diri na kag may kahigayunan ang mga tawo nga mapamatian ang sabat ni Duterte kaangot sa sampaw-sampaw nga mga akusasyon sa iya.
english: Meliton Oso, he said that when the articles of impeachment go up in the Senate, the people will have the opportunity to hear Duterte's response to the accusations against him.

text: Lakip sa ginpang-mensyonar sini nga kontrobersiya batok sa bise-presidente amo si “Mary Grace Piattos”, ang kapangalan sang isa ka popular nga potato chip brand nga isa sa ginlista nga recipient sang confidential funds ni Duterte sa Office of the Vice President (OVP).
english: Among the controversies he mentioned against the vice president was “Mary Grace Piattos”, the name of a popular potato chip brand that is one of the listed recipients of Duterte's confidential funds in the Office of the Vice President (OVP).

text: Apisar 2024 pa nadiskubrehan ang pangalan nga ini kag iban pa nga makaduluda nga personalidad, wala gihapon nasanagan ang publiko kun sin-o ini bangud wala sang paathag nga ginhatag ang vice president.
english: Although this name and other suspicious personalities were discovered in 2024, the public is still not enlightened as to who they are because the vice president did not give an explanation.

text: “How we wish gid tani nga sa mas temprano ma-impeach siya sa lower house, agud pag-abot sa Senado, mahisayran sang banwa kun bala matuod nga tawo si Mary Grace Piattos, [kag] kun bala husto ang iya paggamit sang confidential funds,” suno kay Oso.
english: “How we wish that she would be impeached in the lower house earlier, so that when it comes to the Senate, the people will know whether Mary Grace Piattos is a real person, [and] whether she is using confidential funds properly,” Oso said.

text: Gindugang man sini ang iban pa nga kontrobersiya sa Department of Education nga ginpamunuan man anay ni Duterte sang yara pa siya sa Marcos Cabinet.
english: It also added to other controversies in the Department of Education, which Duterte also headed when he was in the Marcos Cabinet.

text: Dugang ni Msgr.
english: Msgr. added.

text: Oso: “How we wish nga ma-impeach dayon [si Sara] sa lower house, kag pag-abot sa Senate, mahublasan naton kag may yara man siya sang kinamatarong agud nga [magsabat] kay wala ya ni ginsabat eh.
english: Oso: “How we wish that [Sara] could be impeached immediately in the lower house, and when it comes to the Senate, we can expose her and she has the right to [answer] because she didn't answer.

text:
Dugay na kita nagapamangkot eh: ‘Matuod bala nga tawo si Piattos, ukon junk food lang?'”

Nagapati man si Oso nga may “kalkalanay sang baho” nga matabo kasunod sang deklarasyon ni Duterte nga magapadalagan ini sa pagka-presidente.
english:
We've been asking for a long time: 'Is Piattos a real person, or just junk food?'”

Oso also believes that there will be a “smell battle” following Duterte's declaration that he will run for president.

text: Posible man suno sa JASAC director nga temprano pa nag-anunsyo sang iya presidential bid si Duterte bilang paandam sa mga kongresista sa iya nga plano.
english: The JASAC director said it is also possible that Duterte announced his presidential bid early as a warning to congressmen of his plan.

text: Masami nga nagapanguna si Sara sa mga survey sa pagka-presidente, gani posible suno kay Oso nga pamahog man ini sa mga mamalidha nga indi pabor sa iya sa impeachment case.
english: Sara often leads in presidential polls, so Oso said it is possible that she is also a threat to lawmakers who are not in favor of her in the impeachment case.

text: Nahibaluan nga napasaka na sa Office of the House Speaker ang ikaapat nga impeachment complaint batok kay Duterte.
english: The fourth impeachment complaint against Duterte has already been filed with the Office of the House Speaker.

text: Na-impeach anay si Duterte sa Kamara sang Pebrero 5, 2025 matapos nga 215 ka mga kongresista ang nagpirma sa ikaapat man nga complaint batok sa iya.
english: Duterte was impeached by the House of Representatives on February 5, 2025 after 215 congressmen signed a fourth complaint against him.

text: Ginpasaka ang Articles of Impeachment sa Senado sang amo nga adlaw.
english: The Articles of Impeachment were filed in the Senate that day.

text: Sang Hulyo 25, gin-anunsyo naman sang Korte Suprema nga unconstitutional ang Articles of Impeachment bangud sa paglapas sa one-year bar rule sang 1987 Constitution.
english: On July 25, the Supreme Court declared the Articles of Impeachment unconstitutional for violating the one-year bar rule of the 1987 Constitution.

text: Sang Enero sini nga tuig, gin-uphold sang Supreme Court ang ila desisyon kag dalayon nga nagbasura sang motion for reconsideration nga gin-file sang Kamara.#
english: In January this year, the Supreme Court upheld its decision and immediately dismissed the motion for reconsideration filed by the House.#

text: MAY bag-o nga diskubre nga nahimo sang sini lang angot sa COVID-19 – ang balatian nga ginatuga sang SARS-CoV-2 – sang Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) sa United States sadtong Marso 2021.
english: A NEW discovery was recently made about COVID-19 – the disease caused by SARS-CoV-2 – by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) in the United States in March 2021.

text: Ini ang posibilidad nga ma-“patay” ang COVID-19 virus paagi sa ultrasound vibration mismo sa range sang “safe use” sang frequencies sa medical diagnostic imaging sa kusog nga 25 megahertz (mHz) tubtub 50 mHz.
english: This is the possibility of "killing" the COVID-19 virus through ultrasound vibration itself in the range of "safe use" of frequencies in medical diagnostic imaging at a strength of 25 megahertz (mHz) to 50 mHz.

text:
In fact, sunu kay Professor Tomasz Wierzbicki sang Massachusetts Institute of Technology, “Napamatud-an namon (gamit ang isa ka simulated model) nga ang ultrasound excitation maka-damage sang shell kag spikes sang COVID-19 virus kag sang RNA (ang genetic material nga responsable sa pag-reproduce sang virus) sa sulod sini.”

In other words, pwede “mapatay” sang ultrasound ang COVID-19 virus paagi sa damage nga mahimo sa outer cover (shell kag spikes) kag sa RNA sa sulod sini.
english:
In fact, according to Professor Tomasz Wierzbicki of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, “We have proven (using a simulated model) that ultrasound excitation can damage the shell and spikes of the COVID-19 virus and the RNA (the genetic material responsible for the reproduction of the virus) within it.”

In other words, ultrasound can “kill” the COVID-19 virus by damaging the outer cover (shell and spikes) and the RNA inside it.

text: Kon ma-confirm na ini sa aktwal nga pagtatap sa COVID-19 patient, for sure pwede na ang pagpatigayon sang ultrasound-based treatment sang na-infect sang COVID-19, labi na gid ang yara sa kritikal nga kondisyon nga nagakinahanglan sing mas mausisa kag malawak nga treatment.
english: Once this is confirmed in the actual care of the COVID-19 patient, for sure it is possible to conduct ultrasound-based treatment of those infected with COVID-19, especially those in critical condition that require more thorough and extensive treatment.

text:
***

Paagi sa ultrasound scan, mahibal-an sang mga doktor kon ano ang nagakatabo sa internal structures sang isa ka tawo.
english:
***

Through an ultrasound scan, doctors can determine what’s going on in a person’s internal structures.

text: Gamit ang transducer, gina-transmit sini ang high frequency ultrasound waves sa nagakalain-lain nga bahin sang lawas sang tawo nga indi mabatian sang ordinaryo nga dulunggan sang tawo.
english: Using a transducer, it transmits high frequency ultrasound waves to different parts of the human body that are inaudible to the ordinary human ear.

text: Maumpok (bounce) balik ining ultrasound waves agud maghimo na sang laragway sang iya nakita nga matun-an sang doktor.
english: These ultrasound waves bounce back to create a picture of what he saw that the doctor can study.

text: Lakip nga makita sa ultrasound scan ang nagakatabo sa bata (fetus) sa taguangkan sang iloy kag ang mga soft tissue structures, katulad sang gallbladder, liver, kidneys, pancreas, bladder, kag iban pa nga bahin sa sulod sang lawas sang tawo.
english: The ultrasound scan also shows what is happening to the fetus in the womb and the soft tissue structures, such as the gallbladder, liver, kidneys, pancreas, bladder, and other parts of the human body.

text: Malaragway man sini ang abdominal kag pelvic organs, muscles kag tendons, pati na ang heart kag blood vessels.
english: It also describes the abdominal and pelvic organs, muscles and tendons, as well as the heart and blood vessels.

text: Matakos man gani sini ang pagdalagan sang dugo sa mga kaugatan agud madiskubre kon bala may mga sablag (blockade) sa ugat.
english: It can even measure the blood flow in the arteries to discover if there are blockages in the arteries.

text: Conveniente nga gamiton ang ultrasound scan, base sa expersyensya sang mga doktor, tungod wala peligro ang pagpatigayon sini ikumparar sa iban nga scan.
english: Ultrasound scan is convenient to use, based on the experience of doctors, because it is safe to conduct compared to other scans.

text: Ang ultrasound scan wala nagalakip sang exposure sa radiation.
english: An ultrasound scan does not include exposure to radiation.

text: Wala man ini sing side effects kag, sa kabug-usan, wala dulot sing kasakit (painless), luas sa diutay nga discomfort.
english: It also has no side effects and, overall, is painless, except for mild discomfort.

text: In other words, wala sing problema kon ipatigayon gid man ang paggamit sang ultrasound-based treatment batok sa COVID-19 patient.
english: In other words, there is no problem if the use of ultrasound-based treatment against COVID-19 patients is implemented.

text:
***

Sa na-report ta na sang nagligad, ang COVID-19 virus wala kabuhi gani indi ini mapatay katulad sang matabo sa tawo nga may kabuhi.
english:
***

As we have reported in the past, the COVID-19 virus is not alive and therefore does not die like a living person.

text: Katulad lang ini sa hampanganan sang bata nga “mapatay” paagi sa pag-damage ukon pagbulag (dismember) sang mga bahin sini.
english: It is like a child's toy that “dies” by being damaged or dismembered.

text: Kag kon “mabuhi” ini  paagi lang sa reproduction sa toy factory.
english: And if it “survives” it is only through reproduction in the toy factory.

text: Sa kaso sang COVID-19 virus, diri ini “mabuhi” sa pagsulod na sini sa host cell kag pag-combine sang RNA strand sini sa mga genetic materials sang host cell nga daw nabuhi nga kuryente sa pagkit-anay sang negative kag positive poles agud magmuad.
english: In the case of the COVID-19 virus, it “survives” by entering the host cell and combining its RNA strand with the genetic materials of the host cell as if it were a living electricity at the meeting of the negative and positive poles to reproduce.

text: Sa paggwa sini (shedding) sa host cell, dira na ini manghalit sa mga nagakalain-lain nga bahin sang lawas sang tawo.
english: When it leaves the host cell, it can damage various parts of the human body.

text:
***

Samtang, ang aton mga siyentipiko nagapasalig sa aton nga ang COVID-19 virus “mapatay”, ukon indi maka-survive, sa sulod sang 3 ka oras sa hangin sa gwa.
english:
***

Meanwhile, our scientists assure us that the COVID-19 virus “dies”, or cannot survive, within 3 hours in outdoor air.

text: Gani, importante nga bukas ang mga bintana agud makagwa ang nakasulod nga COVID-19 virus.
english: Therefore, it is important to keep the windows open to allow the COVID-19 virus to escape.

text: Ang iban nga capabilidad sa pag-survive sangCovid-19 virus nga dapat conscious kita, sunu sa research ni Lena Ciric, Ph.D,  Associate Professor kag lecturer sa Envirnmental Engineering sa University College, London, amo ang masunod: 24 oras sa cardboard, 4 ka oras sa copper, 72 ka oras sa plastic, kag 48 oras sa steel.
english: Other survival capabilities of the Covid-19 virus that we should be aware of, according to research by Lena Ciric, Ph.D, Associate Professor and lecturer in Environmental Engineering at University College, London, are as follows: 24 hours in cardboard, 4 hours in copper, 72 hours in plastic, and 48 hours in steel.

text: Wala sing patimaan sang survival ang Covid-19 virus sa  glass, ceramic kag wood.
english: There is no sign of survival of the Covid-19 virus in glass, ceramic and wood.

text: Bagay diri ang aton pagpangamlig batok sa pagtandug sang mahigko naton nga kamot sang mga bagay, katulad sang doorknob, sa aton ilong, baba kag mata kon diin makasulod ining COVID-19 virus.
english: This includes protecting ourselves against touching our dirty hands with objects, such as doorknobs, to our nose, mouth and eyes where the COVID-19 virus can enter.

text: Kon indi makapanghugas, maggamit sang sanitizer, labi na gid sang 70% alcohol.
english: If you can't wash, use sanitizer, preferably 70% alcohol.

text: Dugang pa dira ang pagsunod sa iban nga health measures, katulad sang paggamit sang face mask kag face shield,  social distancing, kag hygienic practice, sa kabug-usan, sa sulod kag gwa sang puluy-an./PN
english: In addition, the following of other health measures, such as the use of face masks and face shields, social distancing, and hygienic practice, in general, inside and outside the home.

text: Gintumod sang Department of Education Region 6 ang rason kun ngaa may yara pa sang malapit 300 ka mga unfilled nga posisyon sa pagka- principal sa Western Visayas.
english: The Department of Education Region 6 has identified the reason why there are still nearly 300 unfilled principal positions in Western Visayas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., spokesperson sang Department of Education Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga madamo man ang qualified para sa posisyon base sa requirements sang Civil Service Commission, apang indi passers ang mga ini sang National Qualifying Exam for School Heads.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., spokesperson of the Department of Education Region 6, said that many are qualified for the position based on the requirements of the Civil Service Commission, but they are not passers of the National Qualifying Exam for School Heads.

text: Suno kay Escullar, sa 21 ka mga schools division, may vacant positions gid para sa mga school principals.
english: According to Escullar, in the 21 schools divisions, there are vacant positions for school principals.

text: Pahayag niya, sa subong, may yara lang sang nagaserbe nga officer in charge nga temporaryo nga ginatungdan ang papel sang principal.
english: He said that at present, there is only one serving officer in charge who temporarily assumes the role of principal.

text: Padayon naman nga gina-engganyo sang ahensya ang mga manunudlo nga qualified para sa posisyon nga mag-apply kag magkuha sang National Qualifying Exam for School Heads agud mapun-an ang kakulang sang principals sa bilog nga rehiyon.
english: The agency continues to encourage teachers who are qualified for the position to apply and take the National Qualifying Exam for School Heads to fill the shortage of principals across the region.

text: Gin-athag sang spokesperson sang International Criminal Court nga ang 43 alleged extrajudicial killings sa Pilipinas nga naangot sa kaso ni former President Rodrigo Duterte ang sample gid lamang, kag mas madamo nga kaso ang mahimo ipresentar sa korte.
english: The spokesperson of the International Criminal Court explained that the 43 alleged extrajudicial killings in the Philippines linked to the case of former President Rodrigo Duterte are just a sample, and more cases could be presented in court.

text: Suno kay ICC spokesperson Fadi El Abdallah, ang masunod nga tikang nga confirmation of charges hearing nga na-schedule sa September, amo ang magapadalom pa sang kaso kag kun matapos na nga pamatian ang defense, sunod nga magadesisyon kun ini nga kaso ang magadiretso sa trial ukon indi.
english: According to ICC spokesperson Fadi El Abdallah, the next step, the confirmation of charges hearing, scheduled for September, will deepen the case and after hearing the defense, will decide whether the case will go to trial or not.

text: Pahayag niya, nagakahulugan ini nga ang prosecution sarang mag- request sang dugang nga mga kaso kag mga testigo samtang padayon ang proseso.
english: He said this means that the prosecution can request additional cases and witnesses as the process continues.

text: Sang March 12 situation report sini sa Pilipinas kag kay Duterte, ginsiling sang ICC nga ang Pre-Trial Chamber I ang nag-assess sang mga materials nga ginpasa sang Prosecution kag may nakit-an sila nga reasonable grounds nga patihan nga si Duterte ang individually responsible bilang indirect co-perpetrator para sa crime against humanity of murder, nga gin-alegar nakumiter sa Pilipinas sa tunga sang November 1, 2011 kag March 16, 2019.
english: In its March 12 situation report on the Philippines and Duterte, the ICC said the Pre-Trial Chamber I assessed the materials submitted by the Prosecution and found reasonable grounds to believe that Duterte was individually responsible as an indirect co-perpetrator for the crime of murder against humanity committed against the Philippines. between November 1, 2011 and March 16, 2019.

text: Dugang sini nga ang ICC Pre-Trial Chamber ang nag-focus sa sample sang alleged incidents agud mag-facilitate sang analysis kag issuance sang arrest warrant batok sa former leader.
english: He added that the ICC Pre-Trial Chamber focused on a sample of alleged incidents to facilitate analysis and issuance of an arrest warrant against the former leader.

text: Nag-isyu ang Chinese Embassy sa Manila sang travel reminder sa mga pumuluyo sini nga nagapadulong sa Pilipinas.
english: The Chinese Embassy in Manila has issued a travel reminder to its citizens traveling to the Philippines.

text: Nagpaandam ang embassy sa Chinese citizens kag mga negosyo angot sa nagataas nga risgo sa ginlaragway sini ng “deteriorating public security situation” sa pungsod.
english: The embassy warned Chinese citizens and businesses of the increasing risk of what it described as a “deteriorating public security situation” in the country.

text: Gintumod man ang security concerns bangud sa recent political rallies sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: Security concerns were also cited due to recent political rallies across the country.

text: Gin-engganyo sang embahada ang mga tawo nga may plano nga magbisita sa Pilipinas nga magpatigayon sang maid-id nga risk assessments kag mahinalungon nga i- consider ang ila travel plans.
english: The embassy urged people planning to visit the Philippines to conduct thorough risk assessments and carefully consider their travel plans.

text: Ginapahanda ni Armed Forces of the Philippine chief General Romeo Brawner Jr.
english: Armed Forces of the Philippines chief General Romeo Brawner Jr.

text: ang mga suldado sang Pilipinas sa tion nga atakehon sang China ang Taiwan.
english: the Philippine military in case China attacks Taiwan.

text: Kasunod ini sang military exercises sang China sa palibot sang Taiwan nga ila ginaangkon.
english: This follows China's military exercises around Taiwan, which they claim.

text: Sa iya speech sa anibersaryo sang Northern Luzon Command (Nolcom), ginpahayag ni Brawner nga ginalauman ang amo nga command nga manguna sa operasyon sa pagsalbar sa may 250,000 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) nga yara sa Taiwan.
english: In his speech on the anniversary of the Northern Luzon Command (Nolcom), Brawner said the command is expected to lead the operation to rescue the 250,000 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) in Taiwan.

text: Kahapon sang ginsiling sang militar sang China nga ginpadala sini ang ila nga army, navy, air kag rocket forces para palibutan ang Taiwan para sa paghanas agud balabagan ang isla nga indi magpasakop sa China.
english: Yesterday, the Chinese military said it had sent its army, navy, air and rocket forces to surround Taiwan for training to prevent the island from surrendering to China.

text: Ginapamilit sang komunista nga Beijing nga kabahin sang ila nga teritoryo ang demokratiko nga isla sang Taiwan.
english: Communist Beijing insists that the democratic island of Taiwan is part of its territory.

text: Makapila ka bebes na nga nagpamahog ang China nga handa sila nga maggamit sang puwersa agud sakupon nila ang Taipei.
english: China has repeatedly threatened to use force to occupy Taipei.

text: Ginsulit sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) nga ang political demonstration nga naangot sa kampanya para suportahan si former president Rodrigo Duterte amo ang rason kun ngaa may mga Pinoy nga gindakop kag gin-detain sa Qatar.
english: The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) reiterated that the political demonstration linked to the campaign to support former president Rodrigo Duterte is the reason why some Filipinos were arrested and detained in Qatar.

text: Ini kasunod sang ginapalapta nga impormasyon sang iban nga pro-Duterte social media pages nga wala sila gindakop bangud sa protesta kundi bangud sa isyu sa visa nga wala nagatugot sa ila nga magtinir sang legal sa Qatar.
english: This follows information spread by some pro-Duterte social media pages that they were not arrested because of the protest but because of the visa issue that does not allow them to stay legally in Qatar.

text: “They were arrested because they participated in a political demonstration….
english: “They were arrested because they participated in a political demonstration….

text: We know they were just indicating their support for the former president.
english: We know they were just indicating their support for the former president.

text: And they were, I think they were harmless.
english: And they were, I think they were harmless.

text: It was more like a picnic gathering.
english: It was more like a picnic gathering.

text: However, they had on T-shirts and placards and that is the reason why they were arrested,” suno kay DFA Undersecretary Eduardo De Vega.
english: However, they had on T-shirts and placards and that is the reason why they were arrested,” said DFA Undersecretary Eduardo De Vega.

text: “Hindi sila inaresto dahil walang visa.
english: “They were not arrested because they did not have a visa.

text:
Wala.”

Naka-detain pa gihapon tubtub subong ang 16 ka mga Pinoy kag nakaguwa naman ang tatlo ka teenagers.
english:
Nothing."

Sixteen Filipinos are still detained and three teenagers have been released.

text: Pahayag pa ni Vega, padayon ang pagtrabaho sang Philippine embassy agud makumbinse ang otoridad nga buy-an ang mga Pilipino kag naganegosyar man nga penalidad lang nga kuwarta sa baylo nga kaso criminal.
english: Vega said the Philippine embassy is continuing to work to convince the authorities to release the Filipinos and is also negotiating a monetary penalty instead of a criminal case.

text: Nahibaluan nga istrikto ang polisa sang Qatar sa public gatherings sa Gulf state, kag pananglitan magdayon gid ang kaso, mahimo sila mapreso sang tubtub sa tatlo ka tuig.
english: Qatar has a strict policy on public gatherings in the Gulf state, and if the case goes ahead, they could face up to three years in prison.

text: Nagpasiguro naman ang Malacañang nga indi pagpabay-an ang mga Pilipino nga nadakpan sa Qatar.
english: Malacañang assured that the Filipinos arrested in Qatar will not be neglected.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Usec.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Usec.

text: Claire Castro, obligasyon sang gobyerno nga buligan ang mga Pinoy bisan anuman nga duag ang ila ginasuportahan.
english: Claire Castro, it is the government's obligation to help Filipinos regardless of the color they support.

text: Nasapwan nga nagahalamyangon kag wala na sang kabuhi ang 22 ka mga lamharon nga tawo nga ginabanta naga-edad 18-20 anyos sa sulod sang nightclub sa East London, South Africa.
english: Twenty-two young men, believed to be aged 18-20, were found dead inside a nightclub in East London, South Africa.

text: Indi pa maathag kun ano ang rason sang kamatayon apang sandig sa inisyal nga pahayag sang Department of Community Safety in Eastern Cape Province, posible nga may natabo nga stampede sa overcrowded club.
english: The cause of death is still unclear but according to the initial statement of the Department of Community Safety in Eastern Cape Province, there may have been a stampede at the overcrowded club.

text: Sa pahayag naman sang police minister, wala sang makit-an nga indikasyon nga may natabo nga stampede, bangud wala sang mga pilas ang lawas sang mga biktima.
english: The police minister said there was no indication of a stampede, as the victims had no injuries.

text: Ginalikawan ang espekulasyon sa likod sang insidente rason nga gindala sa pungsod ang top police forensic team.
english: Speculation behind the incident is being avoided, which is why a top police forensic team has been brought to the country.

text: Ipatigayon ang toxicology tests agud mahibaluan kun ginpanghiluan ang mga biktima.
english: Toxicology tests will be conducted to determine if the victims were poisoned.

text: Natabo ini kadungan man sang end of school year celebrations nga masami ginapatigayon sang mga teenagers.
english: This happened during the end of school year celebrations that are often held by teenagers.

text: Misteryo ini subong sa bilog nga syudad, bangud kun basehan ang paglaragway sang local media, nakit-an nga nagahamyangon ang mga biktima nga daw nag-collapse lang sa salog samtang nagasaot ukon nagaistoryahanay.
english: This is now a mystery throughout the city, because based on the description of local media, the victims were found lying on the floor as if they had collapsed while dancing or talking.

text: Itinuturong isa sa dahilan ng Department of Agriculture (DA) sa paglala pa ng pinsala sa sektor ng agrikultura sa bansa tuwing may tumatamang kalamidad ang hindi epektibo na ilang flood control projects.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) points out that one of the reasons for the worsening damage to the agricultural sector in the country whenever there is a disaster is the ineffectiveness of some flood control projects.

text: Ayon kay Agriculture spokesperson ASec.
english: According to Agriculture spokesperson ASec.

text: Arnel de Mesa, kung epektibo lamang ang flood control projects ay mas kakaunti ang pinsala sa sektor ng agrikultura.
english: Arnel de Mesa, if only the flood control projects are effective, the damage to the agricultural sector will be less.

text: Iniulat ng opisyal na pumapalo sa 500,000 hanggang 600,000 metrikong tonelada ang natatamong danyos sa agrikultura kada taon dahil sa matitinding pagbaha, na karamihang nasasalanta ay ang mga palay.
english: The official reported that 500,000 to 600,000 metric tons of agricultural damage is caused each year due to severe flooding, mostly affecting rice.

text: Paliwanag ni Asec.
english: Asec explained.

text: de Mesa na kung madali lamang humupa ang mga baha, mabilis lang din sana ang pag-rekober ng palay dahil pinapatubigan naman talaga ito subalit hindi nito kakayanin kung matagal na nakababad sa tubig-baha.
english: de Mesa said that if the floods subsided easily, the rice would recover quickly because it is really irrigated but it cannot cope if it is soaked in flood waters for a long time.

text: Maliban pa sa palay at crops, sinabi din ng DA official na maaaring humantong ang mga pagbaha sa pagkamatay ng livestocks at pinsala sa mga pasilidad para sa irigasyon at agricultural infrastructure.
english: Aside from rice and crops, the DA official also said that floods can lead to the death of livestocks and damage to irrigation facilities and agricultural infrastructure.

text: Matatandaan, noong Hulyo, iniulat ng DA na papalo sa P3.53 billion ang pinagsamang halaga ng pinsala sa pananalasa ng magkakasunod na bagyong Crising, Dante at Emong at hanging habagat.
english: It can be recalled that in July, the DA reported that the combined value of the damage caused by the consecutive typhoons Crising, Dante and Emong and southwest winds reached P3.53 billion.

text: Kaugnay nito, sa halip aniya na pondohan ang flood control projects na napatunayan ng hindi epektibo, maigi aniyang gamitin na lamang ang mga pondo para sa irrigation facilities na magbebenepisyo sa mga magsasaka at sa output ng agrikultura sa bansa.
english: In this regard, instead of funding flood control projects that have proven ineffective, he can use the funds for irrigation facilities that will benefit farmers and agricultural output in the country.

text: Sa pamamagitan aniya ng dagdag na pondo para sa irrigation projects, makakatulong ito para makapagpatayo ang DA at National Irrigation Administration (NIA) ng mas maraming drainage at water impounding projects gaya ng mga dam, na magiimbak ng mga tubig-baha at gagamitin para sa irigasyon.
english: Through additional funds for irrigation projects, he said, it will help the DA and National Irrigation Administration (NIA) to build more drainage and water impounding projects such as dams, which will store floodwater and use it for irrigation.

text: Nasapwan nga duguon kag wala na sang kabuhi ang isa ka security guard sa ginabantayan sini nga eskwelahan sa Barangay Mamala 1, Sariaya, Quezon.
english: A security guard was found bleeding and dead at the school he was guarding in Barangay Mamala 1, Sariaya, Quezon.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas “Ito”, 50-anyos, residente sang amo nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as alias “Ito”, 50 years old, resident of the said barangay.

text: Mismo ang janitor sang eskwelahan ang nakakita sa biktima sa guard house.
english: The school janitor himself saw the victim in the guard house.

text: May nakit-an nga igo ang bala sa ulo kag lawas sini nga amo ang rason sang iya kamatayon.
english: He was found with multiple gunshot wounds to the head and body which led to his death.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon angot sa insidente.
english: Investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: 𝗨𝗦𝗔 — Legal nga nag-ilis sang pangalan sa Literally Anybody Else ang isa ka lalaki sa Texas agud mag-aplay para sa isa ka partikular apang mabudlay makuha nga trabaho: Presidente sang Estados Unidos.
english: 𝗨𝗦𝗔 — A Texas man legally changed his name to Literally Anybody Else to apply for a specific but hard-to-get job: President of the United States.

text:
Ang 35-anyos nga beterano sang militar kag manunudlo sang matematika sa isa ka middle school nga kilala anay sa pangalan nga Dustin Ebey, ang nagdesisyon nga magapadalagan sa pagkapresidente sang Estados Unidos agod magprotesta sa mga kandidato sang mayor nga partido karon nga amo si Presidente Joe Biden sang Democratic Party kag si anay Presidente Donald Trump sang Republican Party kag ipakita ang iya pagkadisgusto para sa isa ka sistema nga ang iya website nagasiling nga “masami nga gina-una ang mga inaway sang mga partido sangsa matuod nga mga solusyon.”

Si Else ang nagpadalagan sang isa ka write-in campaihg sa Texas, sa diin wala niya makuha ang kinahanglanon nga 113,000 ka mga pirma agud makasulod sa balota, apang nagapaabot nga makita ang ngalan sa balota sang Tennessee, kon sa diin nagsiling siya nga nakuha niya ang kinahanglanon nga kantidad sang mga pirma.
english:
The 35-year-old military veteran and middle school math teacher formerly known as Dustin Ebey, decided to run for the presidency of the United States to protest the current major party candidates President Joe Biden of the Democratic Party and former President Donald Trump of the Republican Party and show his dislike for a system website says that “partisan battles are often prioritized over real solutions.”

Else ran a write-in campaihg in Texas, where he did not get the required 113,000 signatures to get on the ballot, but expects to see the name on the Tennessee ballot, where he said he got the required amount of signatures.

text: Gin-athag an ni Else nga indi kinahanglan nga parte sa pagkuha sang atensyon ang iya mga reklamo, kundi parte sa paghatag sang lugar para sa bisan sin-o nga nagapaambit sining mga reklamo nga magtingob sa isa ka sentro nga punto.
english: Else made it clear that her complaints weren’t necessarily about getting attention, but about making room for anyone who shares these complaints to come together around a focal point.

text: Proud naman nga gin-anunsyo ni Else nga si Neal David Sutz, isa ka citizen sa New York nga nagapuyo subong sa Switzerland, ang iya mangin kaupod kag ka-tandem sa pagdalagan bilang presidente sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Else proudly announced that Neal David Sutz, a citizen of New York who now lives in Switzerland, will be her running mate for president of the United States of America.

text: Sa maulanon nga panahon, masami nga naga-eksperyensya kita sang brownout sa diin ang kandila ang isa sa nagahatag sang kasanag sa sulod sang aton puluy-an.
english: During the rainy season, we often experience brownouts where candles are one of the sources of light inside our homes.

text: Apang suno sa eksperto, mas paborable sa ikaayong-lawas ang paggamit sang scented candles bangud indi lamang ini remedyo para sa brownout, kundi mangin para sa masangkad nga mental health nga labing importante sa tunga sang nagapadayon nga pandemya.
english: However, according to experts, the use of scented candles is more favorable to health because it is not only a remedy for brownout, but also for mental health which is very important in the midst of the ongoing pandemic.

text: Suno kay Chryssa Chalkia, psychotherapist kag cognitive behavioral therapist, ang scented candles ang scientifically proven nga may importante nga katungdanan sa physiological effects sang mood, stress, working capacity, kag overall mental health sang isa ka indibidwal.
english: According to Chryssa Chalkia, psychotherapist and cognitive behavioral therapist, scented candles are scientifically proven to play an important role in the physiological effects of an individual’s mood, stress, working capacity, and overall mental health.

text: Pahayag ni Chalkia, dako man ang mabulig sang scented candles sa pagpanubo sang anxiety sa diin, kun makasimhot ang isa ka indibidwal sang mahamot kag relaxing nga aroma, nagarelease ang lawas sang serotonin kag dopamine nga nagabulig sa pagregulate sang mood.
english: Chalkia said scented candles can also help reduce anxiety where, when an individual smells a fragrant and relaxing aroma, the body releases serotonin and dopamine that help regulate mood.

text: Dugang pa sang therapist, ang mga aroma kaangay sang geranium, lavender, kag peppermint, ang epektibo man agud bulngon ang pila ka psychological kag physiological disorders.
english: The therapist added that aromas such as geranium, lavender, and peppermint, are also effective to treat some psychological and physiological disorders.

text: Agud malikawan ang anxiety, epektibo suno sa therapist ang mga scent kaangay sang rosemary, lemon, chamomile, kag geranium.
english: To avoid anxiety, scents such as rosemary, lemon, chamomile, and geranium are effective, according to the therapist.

text: Panugyan sang eksperto sa mga indibidwal nga nabudlayan sa pag-maintain sang positibo nga panan-awan sa tunga COVID-19 pandemic, epektibo ang pagsindi sang citrus-scented candles, nga nagapa-boost sang enerhiya kag naga-create sang warm environment.
english: Experts advise individuals who are struggling to maintain a positive outlook amid the COVID-19 pandemic to light citrus-scented candles, which boost energy and create a warm environment.

text: DAPAT malipay sadtong Labor Day, Mayo 1, ang tanan nga mga trabador sa adlaw nga ini.
english: All workers should be happy on Labor Day, May 1.

text: Apang ang aton abyan nga minimm wage earner, nga luyag lang tawgon sa hayu nga Pedro, wala gid nalipay.
english: But our minimm wage earner friend, who prefers to be called Pedro, is not happy.

text: Wala gid siya nalipay sa pasalig ni Presidente Duterte nga protejeran sini ang “security of tenure” kag iban pa nga kinamatarong sang mga trabador.
english: He was not happy with President Duterte's assurance that he would protect the “security of tenure” and other rights of workers.

text: Wala man siya nalipay sa ginpahayag ni Presidente nga “employment recovery plan” sang gobyerno agud masabat ang “adverse effect” sang COVID-19.
english: He was also unhappy with the President's announced employment recovery plan to address the adverse effect of COVID-19.

text: Wala man gani siya nalipay sa pagpirma ni Presidente sang executive order para sa pagpasanyog sang National Employment Recovery Strategy (NERS) 2021-2022, agud maka-generate sang trabaho para sa mga trabador.
english: He was not even happy with the President's signing of an executive order for the promotion of the National Employment Recovery Strategy (NERS) 2021-2022, to generate jobs for workers.

text: “Sus a!
english: “On!

text: Paano ka sina kakita trabaho kay pirme lang lockdown,” siling niya.
english: How can you find a job because there is always a lockdown,” he said.

text:
“Maayo pa seguro kita na lang mismo ang magbulig sa katulad naton nga pigado.”

“Ha?
english:
“It's better for us to help the poor ourselves.”

“Huh?

text: Kulang gani ang ginakita naton sunu sa imo, ti paano ta pa mabuligan ang iban?” saligbat ko.
english: If we don't earn enough, how can we help others?” I replied.

text: Pwede seguro kon gulpiyade ka mag-manggaranon, “katulad abe kon magdaug ka sa lotto,” dugang ko nga may lamod sing lahog.
english: Maybe if you suddenly become rich, “like winning the lotto,” I added with a smile.

text: “Pare, indi ka gani maglahog sing subong sina.
english: “Dude, don’t even talk like that.

text:
Indi mo bala nahibal-an nga sa isa ka nagadaug sing milyon, minilyon man ang magutman tungod sa napierde nila nga taya?”

Akig man si Pedro sa pagpabatyag sang gobyerno nga daw pirme lang ang mga imol nga daw nagapakilimos.
english:
Don't you know that for one who wins a million, millions will go hungry because of the lost bet?”

Pedro is also angry that the government makes it seem like the poor are always begging.

text: “Sa mga programa sang gobyerno ginapagwa pirme nga makaluluoy ang mga imol.
english: “Government programs always make the poor look miserable.

text: Talabangan pirme.
english: Always help.

text: Ayudahan pirme.
english: Always help.

text: Kag daw mga nagapakilimos pirme,” silinng niya.
english: And they always seem to be beggars,” he said.

text: “Indi ko luyag sinang paglarawan sa aton nga mga imol – nga pirme lang kita magsalig sa ila kag tubtub lang kita sa ila ayuda.
english: “I don't like that portrayal of us poor people – that we are always dependent on them and dependent on their help.

text: Amo ina sadto ang pagpalakat sang pangbuhi sang imol sa panahon ni Stalin agud magtener siya sa poder,” daw naugot pa nga pabutyag niya.
english: That's how the poor lived during Stalin's time so that he could stay in power,” he said, sounding angry.

text:
“Ti ano ang maayo para maluas kita sa sining siling mo nga masubo naton nga kahimtangan?”

Nagpaathag siya:  “Kon mahimo naton nga maghatag sang  amot sang aton kubos nga kita sa simbahan, ngaa abe indi naton himuon ini sa aton maamot para sa aton kaayuhan agud may mabugal man kita nga mabuligan man gali naton ang aton kaugalingon.”

“Paano abe ina?” pangutana ko.
english:
“So what is good for us to get out of this sad situation you say we are in?”

He explained: “If we can give a contribution of our poor income to the church, why don't we do it with what we can contribute for our own good so that we can be proud that we can help ourselves.”

“How is that?” I asked.

text:
Siling niya dapat magbayad man kita nga mga low-income earners sing buwis, katulad abe sang 10 porsyento sang aton bulanon nga kita para sa isa ka Workers’ Assistance Fund, “nga kita ang magdesisyon kon diin gamiton para sa aton kaayuhan luas sa makuha man sang gobyerno sa mga manggaran.”

“Aba, daku ini nga poorman’s tax a!” ang natugda ko gani.
english:
He said we low-income earners should also pay taxes, such as 10 percent of our monthly income for a Workers' Assistance Fund, “which we decide where to use for our own benefit in addition to what the government takes from the rich.”

"Oh, that's a big poorman's tax!" I even suggested.

text: Gintilawan ta nga gin-matikmatik.
english: We tried to do the math.

text: Kon 50% sang aton populasyon ang low-income wage earner, kag ang buhis nga ini mga P50 kada isa (with P500 monthly pay) mga P2.5 bilyon ina kada bulan halin sa 50 ka milyon nga pumuluyo.
english: If 50% of our population is a low-income wage earner, and the tax is about P50 each (with P500 monthly pay) that's about P2.5 billion per month from 50 million people.

text: “Sa sulod sang isa ka tuig, mga P60 ka bilyon ina!” matonog ko nga pautwas.
english: “In a year, that’s about P60 billion!” I exclaimed loudly.

text: Daku matuod nga bulig ina sa aton nga mga kubos kon diin mapabugal naton sa pagsiling nga ining buwis halin mismo sa mga imol.
english: That is a great help to us poor people where we can be proud to say that this tax comes from the poor themselves.

text: “Problema ugaling, pre.
english: “Problem though, pre.

text: Anad na ang mga pumuluyo nga gina-libre pirme sa madamo nga bagay.
english: Citizens are used to being given a lot of things for free all the time.

text: Lakip na ang tax exemption kag ang padayon nga bulig sang gobyerno halin sa direkta nga buwis lang sang mga manggaranon,” siling ko.
english: Including the tax exemption and the continued government assistance from direct taxes only of the rich,” I said.

text: Mabudlay liwaton ang naandan nga pamatasan, kag daw nalipay naman gani ang aton mga kubos nga pumuluyo sa sining karon nga patakaran, dugang nga paathag ko sa iya.
english: It is difficult to repeat the usual behavior, and it seems that our poor people are happy with this current policy, I further explained to him.

text: “Isa pa, sin-o nga pulitiko ang ma-sponsor sining imo ideya, pre?
english: “Besides, which politician will sponsor this idea of ​​yours, pre?

text:
Mas gusto sang mga pulitiko pagwaon nga ang daku nga bulig mahalin gid sa mga manggaran kag bululigan lang ang mga imol.”

“Kalimtan ta na lang ining imo ideya, Pedro.
english:
Politicians prefer to pretend that the big help comes from the rich and only help the poor.”

“Let’s just forget this idea of ​​yours, Peter.

text:
Tutal makatibawas man kita seguro sa aton kapigahuhon kon mapa-eskwela  naton ang aton mga kabataan sing husto.”

Ginpaathag ko man sa iya nga ang kon sin-o ang dapat ma-mayor sa pangabuhi indi lang debate ini sa tunga sang manggaran nga mga kapitalista kag mga trabador.
english:
After all, we can survive our poverty if we can educate our children properly.”

I also explained to him that who should be the mayor in life is not just a debate between the rich capitalists and the workers.

text: “Yara ang mga professional (educators, engineers, doctors, economists, scientists, etc.) nga amo gid ang matuod nga nagaduso sa kauswagan sang aton sosyedad, kag bunga ini sila sang edukasyon sang mga kabataan.
english: “There are the professionals (educators, engineers, doctors, economists, scientists, etc.) who are the real drivers of the development of our society, and they are the fruit of children's education.

text: Okey?” pahingapos ko sa iya./PN
english: Okay?” I'll end with him./PN

text: Yara na sa phase 2 ang pila ka mga ginatukod nga cisterns sang Iloilo City Government.
english: Some of the cisterns being built by the Iloilo City Government are already in phase 2.

text: Ini ang nagaserbe bilang ‘reservoir’ sang tubig sang syudad kon tag-ilinit.
english: It serves as the city's water reservoir during the summer.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Niel Ravena, head sang General Services Office (GSO), iya ginpahayag nga ang La Paz cistern ang operational subong, kon sa diin, isa sa ginakuhaan sang talatapan agud nga gamiton sa pagpamunyag sang mga tanom sa syudad.
english: Niel Ravena, head of the General Services Office (GSO), said the La Paz cistern is now operational, where it is one of the sources of the office to be used for watering plants in the city.

text: Nagaserbe man ini nga mitigating measure sa pagbaha-baha nga ma-eksperyensya sang amo nga Distrito.
english: It also serves as a mitigating measure for flooding experienced by the District.

text: Suno kay Ravena, ang tanan nga mga merkado sa syudad ang may cistern agud mas mapreparahan ang drought nga dala sang El Niño.
english: According to Ravena, all markets in the city have cisterns to better prepare for the drought caused by El Niño.

text: Lakip sa mga padayon nga ginaubra amo ang cistern sa Jaro Plaza, Molo Plaza, kag Arevalo Plaza.
english: Among the ones under construction are the cisterns in Jaro Plaza, Molo Plaza, and Arevalo Plaza.

text: Samtang ang sa Plaza Libertad ang ginalauman nga mangin operational subong nga bulan .
english: Meanwhile, the one in Plaza Libertad is expected to be operational this month.

text: Una na nga ginmando ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga magtanom sang dugang nga mga puno agud nga mas mapanubo ang temperatura kon summer kag mas mabuhinan ang pagbaha sa syudad.
english: Earlier, Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ordered the planting of more trees to lower the summer temperature and reduce flooding in the city.

text: Nagmandu ang Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (Caap) nga indi anay pagpalupadon ang iban nga aircraft sang flying school nga amo ang naga-operate sang isa ka Cessna plane nga nagtibusok sa Lingayen, Pangasinan nga ginkamatay sang piloto kag iya student pilot.
english: The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (Caap) has ordered that other aircraft of the flying school operating a Cessna plane that crashed in Lingayen, Pangasinan, killing the pilot and his student pilot, not be allowed to fly.

text: Ang Cessna training aircraft nga may registration number RP-C8595 ang gina-operate sang Pilipinas Space Aviation Academy Inc.
english: The Cessna training aircraft with registration number RP-C8595 is operated by the Philippine Space Aviation Academy Inc.

text: Nag-crash ini kahapon sang aga kun sa diin gilayon pa nga gindala sa ospital ang mga sakay sini, apang ginbawian gid sang kabuhi.
english: It crashed yesterday morning and the passengers were rushed to the hospital, but died.

text: Suno sa CAAP, naglunsar na sang pormal nga imbestigasyon ang otoridad kun ano ang rason sang insidente; kag samtang pending ang resulta, grounded anay ang flying school.
english: According to CAAP, the authorities have launched a formal investigation into the cause of the incident; and while the results are pending, the flying school is grounded.

text: “Authorities have initiated a formal investigation to determine the cause of the incident.
english: “Authorities have initiated a formal investigation to determine the cause of the incident.

text: Meanwhile, the flying school is grounded pending the results of the ongoing investigation,” suno sa aviation authority.
english: Meanwhile, the flying school is grounded pending the results of the ongoing investigation,” the aviation authority said.

text: Ginhawiran man ang mga pangalan sang biktima kag gin-una nga ipahibalo sa ila na mga pamilya, apang sa inisyal nga impormasyon, naga-edad sang 32-anyos nga piloto kag 25-anyos naman ang estudyante kag pareho nga lalaki.
english: The names of the victims were also withheld and their families were notified first, but according to initial information, the 32-year-old pilot and the 25-year-old student were both men.

text: Naluwas sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) ang 12 ka crew members sang isa ka cargo vessel nga nasunog samtang yara sa tunga sang dagat nga sakop sang Limbones Island, Nasugbu, Batangas.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) has rescued 12 crew members of a cargo vessel that caught fire while in the middle of the sea in Limbones Island, Nasugbu, Batangas.

text: Ang involved nga barko amo ang MV CASTPILL XV.
english: The involved ship is the MV CASTPILL XV.

text: Una nga na-resue ang pito ka crew lakip ang kapitan nga may minor injuries, kag sunod amo ang dugang nga lima ka kaupdanan nila nga gilayon man ginhatagan sang nagakaigo nga atensyon-medikal.
english: Seven crew members, including the captain, were first rescued with minor injuries, followed by five other companions who were immediately given proper medical attention.

text: Gindala ang crew sa Pier 15, South Harbor, Manila kag gintugyan sa Coast Guard Medical Dispensary para sa dugang nga medical evaluation.
english: The crew was taken to Pier 15, South Harbor, Manila and handed over to the Coast Guard Medical Dispensary for further medical evaluation.

text: “At approximately 7:59 AM, BRP Boracay safely arrived at Pier 15, South Harbor, Manila, where the rescued crew members were turned over to the Coast Guard Medical Dispensary for further medical evaluation,” suno sa press release sang Coast Guard.
english: “At approximately 7:59 AM, BRP Boracay safely arrived at Pier 15, South Harbor, Manila, where the rescued crew members were turned over to the Coast Guard Medical Dispensary for further medical evaluation,” according to a Coast Guard press release.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa ginhalinan sang sunog.
english: The cause of the fire is still under investigation.

text: “The PCG has initiated an investigation to identify the cause of the fire incident.
english: “The PCG has initiated an investigation to identify the cause of the fire incident.

text: The DOTr Secretary Vince Dizon assures the public of his commitment to ensure maritime safety thru all agencies under his department especially the PCG.
english: The DOTr Secretary Vince Dizon assures the public of his commitment to ensure maritime safety through all agencies under his department especially the PCG.

text: The PCG also reaffirms its commitment to ensuring maritime safety and responding promptly to emergencies at sea,” dugang sa statement.#
english: The PCG also reaffirms its commitment to ensuring maritime safety and responding promptly to emergencies at sea,” the statement added.#

text: Naga-selebrar ang Filipino Muslims subong nga adlaw, Marso 31, sang Eid’l Fitr ukon ang Festival of Breaking the Fast nga amo ang adlaw nga nagamarka sang pagtakop sang balaan nga bulan sang Ramadan.
english: Filipino Muslims celebrate today, March 31, Eid'l Fitr or the Festival of Breaking the Fast which marks the end of the holy month of Ramadan.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini ni Bangsamoro Grand Mufti Sheikh Abdulrauf Guialani matapos ginpatigayon sang assigned groups ang moon sighting sa pungsod.
english: This was announced by Bangsamoro Grand Mufti Sheikh Abdulrauf Guialani after assigned groups conducted moon sighting in the country.

text: Importante para sa mga Muslim nga makit-an ang mooncrescent antes tumuron kun san-o ang Eid’l Fitr bangud amo ini ang nagamarka sang panugod sang bag-o nga lunar month sang Shawwal nga amo ang ika-napulo nga bulan sa Islamic lunar calendar.
english: It is important for Muslims to see the mooncrescent before Eid'l Fitr because it marks the beginning of the new lunar month of Shawwal which is the tenth month in the Islamic lunar calendar.

text: Ang Eid’l Fitr nga isa ka Islamic festivity ang tradisyonal nga ginselebrar sa sulod sang tatlo ka adlaw nga gina-umpisahan sang pagpangamuyo sa mosque sa kaagahon, pagtilipon sang magpamilya kag mag-abyan, kag pagkaon kag pagbayluhanay sang mga regalo.
english: Eid'l Fitr, an Islamic festivity, is traditionally celebrated for three days, marked by morning prayers in the mosque, gatherings of family and friends, and meals and the exchange of gifts.

text: “In spirit, the Festival of Breaking the Fast is more than a celebration; it is a testament to our desire for shared humanity, strengthening bonds of family and friendship, as well as unity among our peers… Beyond the values that Ramadan emphasized, let us continue to be inspired to extend our hands in service, uplift those in need, and help find joy in those who seek it,” kabahin sang mensahe ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: “In spirit, the Festival of Breaking the Fast is more than a celebration; it is a testament to our desire for shared humanity, strengthening bonds of family and friendship, as well as unity among our peers… Beyond the values that Ramadan emphasized, let us continue to be inspired to extend our hands in service, uplift need, and help those in need,” he said. of the message of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: bilang pag-upod sang selebrasyon sang Muslim community.
english: in conjunction with the celebration of the Muslim community.

text: Kun matandaan, nauna na nga gindeklarar sang Malacañang ang Abril 1 ukon buwas, Martes, bilang holiday kaangot sa obserbasyon sang Eid’l Fitr.
english: Malacañang had earlier declared April 1 or tomorrow, Tuesday, as a holiday in connection with the observance of Eid'l Fitr.

text: Sa Saudi Arabia nga amo ang heartland sang Islam, gin-umpisahan ang selebrasyon sang Eid’l Fitr kahapon.
english: In Saudi Arabia which is the heartland of Islam, Eid’l Fitr celebrations were started yesterday.

text: Nagpati ang pila ka mga Uniteam supporters ukon ang nagsuporta sa kandidatura nanday President Ferdinand “Bong-bong” Marcos Jr.
english: Some Uniteam supporters or those who supported the candidacy of President Ferdinand “Bong-bong” Marcos Jr.

text: kag Vice Pres.
english: and Vice Pres.

text: Sara Duterte nga ‘very technical’ ang impeachment complaint ni VP Sara Duterte.
english: Sara Duterte that VP Sara Duterte's impeachment complaint is 'very technical'.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alyas Joe, teaching staff sa isa ka unibersidad, iya ginpahayag nga kon matigayon gidman ang impeachment, kinahanglan nga nakahibalo kag incompetent ang mga senators judges.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joe, a teaching staff at a university, said that if impeachment is to be achieved, the senators and judges must be knowledgeable and incompetent.

text: Suno kay Joe, tuman ka dugay ang proseso sang impeachment process sa pungsod antes matigayon nga matapos.
english: According to Joe, the impeachment process in the country is taking too long to be completed.

text: Wala naman nga nag-ekspektar ang natungdan nga magbulagay ang Uniteam nga iya ginsuportahan bangud una na nga nagpati siya nga professional si VP Sara bangud isa ini ka abogado.
english: He said he did not expect the Uniteam he supported to split because he already believed that VP Sara was professional because he was a lawyer.

text: Gintuad man sini nga wala natuman ni Duterte ang expectations sang minilyon nga mga nagboto sa iya.
english: He also admitted that Duterte did not meet the expectations of millions of voters.

text: Nagalaum man ang natungdan nga matutokan kag mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga pagtamod ang kaso nga ginapangatubang sang bise presidente nga iya anay sadto ginsuportahan.
english: He also hopes that the case facing the vice president, whom he once supported, will be given due attention.

text: Pabor naman ang pila ka mga Uniteam supporters nga i-impeach si Vice Pres.
english: Some Uniteam supporters are in favor of impeaching Vice Pres.

text: Sara Duterte.
english: Sara Duterte.

text: Suno kay Alyas Ma’am Red, indi politically motivated ang impeachment complaint batok kay Vice Pres.
english: According to Alyas Ma’am Red, the impeachment complaint against Vice Pres.

text: Duterte.
english: Duterte.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga sa subong, magapabilin siya nga magasuporta kay President Ferdinand “Bong-bong” Marcos Jr., apisar nga nagbulag na ang Uniteam .
english: He also said that for now, he will continue to support President Ferdinand “Bong-bong” Marcos Jr., despite the fact that the Uniteam has split.

text: Nagpanindugan man ang natungdan nga indi na niya pagbotohon liwat si Vice President Duterte kon magpadalagan man sa 2028 Presidential Elections.
english: He also insisted that he will not vote for Vice President Duterte again if he runs in the 2028 Presidential Elections.

text: Para naman sa mga supporters ni Former Vice Pres.
english: For the supporters of Former Vice Pres.

text: Leni Robredo nga politically motivated ang ginahimo subong sang administrasyon ni Pres.
english: Leni Robredo said the administration of Pres.

text: Ferdinnad Bong-bong Marcos Jr.
english: Ferdinnad Bong-bong Marcos Jr.

text: bangud matunog man nga magapadalagan si Duterte sa pagka-presidente.
english: because Duterte will run for president.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Herbert Lim, stall owner sa Iloilo Central Market, iya ginpahayag nga dapat atubangon ni VP Sara Duterte ang mga alegasyon nga ginahaboy sa iya kon wala siya gidman sang sala.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Herbert Lim, stall owner at the Iloilo Central Market, said VP Sara Duterte should face the allegations against her if she is innocent.

text: Suno kay Lim, lunsay pamulitika tanan ang ginahimo sang administrasyon ni Pres.
english: According to Lim, everything the administration of Pres.

text: Marcos Jr.,ilabi na nga may plano si Inday Sara nga magpapili sa Presidential Elections.
english: Marcos Jr., especially that Inday Sara has plans to run in the Presidential Elections.

text: Indi man matumod sang natungdan kon magadaog si Inday Sara kon magapadalagan ini gidman sa pagka-presidente.
english: He cannot say whether Inday Sara will win if she runs for president.

text: Nagalaum man si Lim nga maimbestigaran sang maayo ang mga alegasyon batok kay Duterte agud nga mapasabat ang mga may kapaltahan.
english: Lim also hoped that the allegations against Duterte would be thoroughly investigated so that those responsible could be held accountable.

text: Ginpangsirado ang mga eskwelahan kag ginpa-untat ang non-essential government services sa Sri Lanka agud nga matipid ang ginakulang na nga suplay sang gatong.
english: Schools have been closed and non-essential government services have been suspended in Sri Lanka to save on already scarce fuel supplies.

text: Skeleton staff lang ang ginpatrabaho sa state offices bilang kabahin sang plano sang gobyerno nga buhinan ang pag-commute sang mga tawo kag matipid ang petrol kag diesel.
english: Only skeleton staff have been employed in state offices as part of the government's plan to reduce people's commute and save petrol and diesel.

text: Nagapadayon naman ang operasyon sang mga ospital kag seaport sa Colombo, kapital sang pungsod.
english: Hospitals and the seaport in Colombo, the country's capital, continue to operate.

text: Ginatos naman tubtub linibo ka mga motorista ang nagpila agud magpatughong sang salakyan apisar nga nag-anunsyo ang energy ministry nga may suplay pa sang gatong tubtub sa tatlo ka adlaw.
english: Hundreds to thousands of motorists queued up to refuel despite the energy ministry's announcement that there is still a supply of fuel for up to three days.

text: Ini ang gintawag pinakamalala nga economic crisis sa pungsod matapos nga nawad-an sang dollars agud nga ma-finance pati ang pinaka-importante nga imports lakip na ang fuel.
english: It was called the worst economic crisis in the country after it lost dollars to finance even the most important imports including fuel.

text: Sang Abril, napaslawan ang Sri Lanka nga bayaran ang $51 billion ukon ang P2.7 trillion nga utang sa iban nga mga pungsod.
english: In April, Sri Lanka failed to pay the $51 billion or the P2.7 trillion in foreign debt.

text: Sa subong, na-umpisahan naman sang pungsod ang pagpakig-istorya sa International Monetary Fund para sa bailout request ukon ang paghatag sang financial assistance sa isa ka ekonomiya agud nga maluwas ini gikan sa pag-collapse.
english: Meanwhile, the country has begun talks with the International Monetary Fund for a bailout request or the provision of financial assistance to an economy to save it from collapse.

text: Duha ang patay matapos nagtibusok ang isa ka Cessna Plane sa Libsong East, Lingayen Pangasinan subong nga aga.
english: Two people were killed after a Cessna plane crashed in Libsong East, Lingayen Pangasinan this morning.

text: Suno sa Lingayen Police Station, ang napatay amo ang piloto kag isa ka student-pilot.
english: According to the Lingayen Police Station, the deceased were the pilot and a student-pilot.

text: Padayon naman nga ginahibalo sang mga otoridad ang gintunaan sang insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the cause of the incident.

text: Wala naman sang naapektuhan nga mga residente sa pagtibusok sang eroplano.
english: No residents were affected by the crash.

text: Ginpa-activate na sang Task Force on Morals and Values Formation ang mga personnel sini kaupod ang mga volunteer groups sa mga barangay may kaangtanan sa nagahilapit nga selebrasyon sang Valentine’s Day.
english: The Task Force on Morals and Values ​​Formation has already activated its personnel along with volunteer groups in the barangays in connection with the upcoming celebration of Valentine's Day.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Nestor Canong, head sang Task Force, iya ginpahayag nga nagatutok sila sa pagpahanumdom sa mga accommodation establishments nga istriktuhon gid ang pagdumili sa mga menor de edad nga magsulod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Nestor Canong, head of the Task Force, said they are focusing on reminding accommodation establishments to strictly prohibit minors from entering.

text: Suno kay Canong, ginapahangop sa management sang sini nga mga establishments ang Regulation Ordinance ‎2015-447.
english: According to Canong, the management of these establishments is subject to Regulation Ordinance ‎2015-447.

text: Ini nga ordinansa naga- regulate sa operasyon sang hotels, motels, apartelles, lodging houses, pension houses, inns, kag kaangay nga establishments kag nagaplastar sang penalidad sa ano man nga violation.
english: This ordinance regulates the operation of hotels, motels, apartelles, lodging houses, pension houses, inns, and similar establishments and lays down penalties for any violation.

text: Kun may yara naman sang menor de edad nga magpamilit nga magsulod, sila ang iga- rescue kag dal-on sa City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO).
english: If there are minors who insist on entering, they will be rescued and taken to the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO).

text: Ang mga establishments naman nga maga-tolerate sa ila ang magapangatubang sang sanctions.
english: Establishments that tolerate them will face sanctions.

text: Naghatag ang United Arab Emirates sang royal pardons sa 115 ka mga Filipino convict antes ang selebrasyon sang Eid’l Fitr nga amo ang nagamarka sang pagtapos sang balaan nga bulan sang Ramadan.
english: The United Arab Emirates has granted royal pardons to 115 Filipino convicts ahead of the Eid’l Fitr celebration that marks the end of the holy month of Ramadan.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: This was confirmed by President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: sa isa ka press release kun sa diin ginpasalamatan man sini si UAE President His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan.
english: in a press release where he also thanked UAE President His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan.

text: Ginbalikan man sini ang amo man nga inisyatibo sang UAE sang 2024 kun sa diin 143 man ka mga Pinoy ang gin-pardon sang Eid-Al-Adha kag 220 naman kadungan sang ila okasyon sang National Day.
english: He also recalled the same initiative of the UAE in 2024 where 143 Filipinos were pardoned during Eid-Al-Adha and 220 during their National Day occasion.

text: Ini suno kay Marcos ang nagapakita lang sang espesyal nga partnership sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod.
english: Marcos said this only shows the special partnership between the two countries.

text: Pamatuod man diri ang malapit isa ka milyon nga mga Pilipino nga yara sa Emirates, kag ang mainit nga pag-abyanay kag respeto sini kay Sheikh Mohamed nga lider sang Emiratis.
english: This is also evidenced by the nearly one million Filipinos in the Emirates, and its warm friendship and respect for Sheikh Mohamed, the leader of the Emiratis.

text: “This act of generosity and compassion exemplifies the true spirit of mercy during the sacred occasion of Ramadan and the values of unity and goodwill,’ suno sa Philippine Embassy sa UAE.
english: “This act of generosity and compassion exemplifies the true spirit of mercy during the sacred occasion of Ramadan and the values ​​of unity and goodwill,” the Philippine Embassy in the UAE said.

text: “The UAE’s steadfast dedication to humanitarian principles and its continued support for the Filipino community in the country are deeply valued.”
english: “The UAE’s steadfast dedication to humanitarian principles and its continued support for the Filipino community in the country are deeply valued.”

text: Nagaplano ang mga mamalidha halin sa Makabayan bloc nga magsulat sa mga miyembro sang Dutch parliament agud nga pamatukan ang request ni former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque para sa asylum sa Netherlands.
english: Lawmakers from the Makabayan bloc plan to write to members of the Dutch parliament to oppose former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque's request for asylum in the Netherlands.

text: Suno kay ACT Teachers party-list Rep.
english: According to ACT Teachers party-list Rep.

text: France Castro, plano nila nga mag-collaborate sa House of Representatives sa pagpadala sang official communication kaangot sa asylum bid ni Roque.
english: France Castro, they plan to collaborate with the House of Representatives to send an official communication regarding Roque's asylum bid.

text: Magluwas pa ini sa signature drive nga ginlunsar sang Philippine-born Dutch citizen kag writer nga si Joel Vega nga nagapamatok man sa application ni Roque bangud sa argumento nga indi man ini biktima sang political persecution diri sa Pilipinas.
english: This is in addition to the signature drive launched by Philippine-born Dutch citizen and writer Joel Vega who also opposes Roque's application on the grounds that he is not a victim of political persecution in the Philippines.

text: Ginpakamalaot naman ni Lean Jimenez sang Bayan-Europe ang tikang ni Roque, ginsiling nga nagapalagyo ini sa accountability, kag wala nagasabat sa mga alegasyon nga involved siya sa POGO operations kag sa human trafficking.
english: Lean Jimenez of Bayan-Europe condemned Roque's move, saying he was running away from accountability, and not responding to allegations that he was involved in POGO operations and human trafficking.

text: Matandaan nga una na ginkumpirma ni Roque nga isa na siya ka bonafide asylum seeker sa Netherlands nga buot silingon suno sa iya, indi na siya ma-deport pabalik sa Pilipinas samtang padayon ang proseso.
english: Roque earlier confirmed that he is a bonafide asylum seeker in the Netherlands which means that he will not be deported back to the Philippines while the process is ongoing.

text: Malipayon si Roque sang gin-share sini nga indi na siya kinahanglan magpanago kaangay sa iya ginahimo sa nagligad nga anum ka bulan.
english: Roque was happy when he shared that he doesn't have to hide like he has been doing for the past six months.

text: Matandaan nga nangindulaan ang former Palace official kag nabalahuba nga yara na sa luwas sang pungsod matapos nga nag-isyu na ang Kamara sang arrest order kag gin-cite siya for contempt bangud wala sini nahatag ang mga dokumento nga makapamatuod kun ngaa gulpyada nagdamo ang iya manggad.
