english: The former Palace official disappeared and was found abroad after the House of Representatives issued an arrest order and cited him for contempt for failing to provide documents to prove why his wealth suddenly increased.

text: Una siya nga nakit-an liwat sa publiko sang Marso 14 kaupod kanday Vice President Sara Duterte kag Sen.
english: He was first seen in public again on March 14 with Vice President Sara Duterte and Sen.

text: Robin Padilla sa guwa sang International Criminal Court (ICC) premises, apang sang ulihi, ginkumpirma sang bise-presidente nga indi man parte si Roque sang legal counsel ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Robin Padilla outside the International Criminal Court (ICC) premises, but later, the vice-president confirmed that Roque was not part of former President Rodrigo Duterte's legal counsel.

text: Nakuha na subong sang Pilipinas ang No.1 spot sa “Miss Eco People’s Choice” ranking sa Miss Eco International pageant kun sa diin tiglawas sang pungsod ang Ilongga nga si Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks.
english: The Philippines has now secured the No.1 spot in the “Miss Eco People’s Choice” ranking in the Miss Eco International pageant where the country is represented by Ilongga Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks.

text: Nagapangaduha naman ang Ukraine matapos nalapawan ang USA kag United Kingdom.
english: Ukraine is in second place after surpassing the USA and the United Kingdom.

text: Nagapangatlo naman ang Taiwan.
english: Taiwan is in third place.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang magadaug nga may highest voting points ang hatagan sang award nga “Miss Eco People’s Choice” title kag automatic nga malakip bilang isa sa Top 10 finalists.
english: The winner with the highest voting points will be awarded the “Miss Eco People’s Choice” title and will automatically be included as one of the Top 10 finalists.

text: Ang voting kutob lamang sa Abril 19.
english: Voting is until April 19.

text: Si Brooks nga tumandok sang Leon ang una na man nalakip sa top 10 sang Best Resort Wear kag 1st runner up naman ini sa Talent competition.
english: Brooks, a native of Leon, was also in the top 10 of Best Resort Wear and 1st runner up in the Talent competition.

text: Ano ang imo routine para malab-ot ang imo ideal weight?
english: What is your routine to reach your ideal weight?

text: Masami nga nagaka-inspire gid kita sa weight-loss journey sang iban nga tawo kag ang disiplina nila sa kaugalingon agud nga mangin fit ukon mabuhinan ang kabug-aton sang lawas.
english: We are often inspired by the weight-loss journey of other people and their self-discipline in order to be fit or lose weight.

text: Sa Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, China, may isa ka babaye ang agaw-atensyon gid bangud man sa content sini nga ginapakita para man mapabilin ang iya bug-at ukon mas magmag-an pa gid gani.
english: In Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, China, a woman is attracting attention because of the content she shows to maintain her weight or even lose weight.

text: Ini amo si Ting Zi Baobao ukon mas kilala nga si Baby Tingzi.
english: This is Ting Zi Baobao or better known as Baby Tingzi.

text: Amo lang ina ugaling… madamo gid ang nagamuno sa iya bangud sa edad nga beintehon na kag may kataason nga five feet kag two inches, yara lamang sa 25 kilos ang iya bug-at.
english: That's all... many people criticize him because at the age of twenty and five feet and two inches tall, he weighs only 25 kilos.

text: Tuman ini kalayo sa ideal weight bangud kun basehan ang body mass index calculation, ang ideal kuntani nga bug-at para sa iya kataason amo ang 44.9 to 54.9 kilos.
english: This is far from the ideal weight because based on the body mass index calculation, the ideal weight for his height is 44.9 to 54.9 kilos.

text: Masami pa nga nagasaot si Tingzi sa iya videos kag masami man nagasuksok sang revealing nga mga bayo.
english: Tingzi often dances in her videos and often wears revealing clothes.

text: Makit-an gid kun ano ka niwang ang mga tiil sini kag kamot.
english: You can see how thin his legs and arms are.

text: Nakibot pa gid ang iya viewers sang ginsiling ni Tingzi nga gusto pa gid sini nga mabuhinan ang iya bug-at.
english: Her viewers were even more surprised when Tingzi said she wanted to lose more weight.

text: Apisar may mga nagakadlaw sa iya, may yara naman sang nagpahayag sang ila concern kag nagtugda nga dapat magpangayo na si Tingzi sang urgent medical help bangud basi kun may yara ini sang anorexia nervosa.
english: Although some people laughed at her, others expressed their concern and suggested that Tingzi should seek urgent medical help because she might have anorexia nervosa.

text: Ang anorexia amo ang eating disorder kun sa diin ang tawo nga may amo sini nga condition ang nahadlok gid nga magtambok.
english: Anorexia is an eating disorder in which a person with this condition is very afraid of gaining weight.

text: Kadam-an sang may mga amo sini nga kondisyon ang sobra-sobra gid kun mag-ehersisyo kag todo ang pag-limit sa ila pagkaon para indi madugangan ang ila bug-at sa lawas.
english: Most people with this condition exercise too much and limit their food intake to avoid gaining weight.

text: Sa tunga sang hugot nga mga pagsulundan kadungan sang COVID-19 pandemic, maka-angkon ka pa bala sang maayo nga tulog?
english: Amid the strict rules in conjunction with the COVID-19 pandemic, can you still get a good night’s sleep?

text: Nahibaluan nga ang pagpanibin bag-o magtulog ang isa sa bantog nga sleep remedy.
english: It is known that sweating before going to bed is one of the most famous sleep remedies.

text: Apang ano ang preffered time agud magpanibin bag-o magtulog?
english: But what is the preferred time to take a shower before bed?

text: Suno kay Dr. Stacy Sampson family medicine physician sa Iowa, ang best time agud magpanibin amo ang isa tubtob duha ka-oras antes ang pagtulog.
english: According to Dr. Stacy Sampson family medicine physician in Iowa, the best time to brush your teeth is one to two hours before bedtime.

text: Pinaagi sini, pahayag ni Dr. Sampson, naga-improve ang blood circulation sang core sang lawas halin sa mga kamot hasta sa mga tiil.
english: Through this, Dr. Sampson, improves blood circulation in the core of the body from hands to feet.

text: Dugang pa sang doktor, ang pagpanibin gamit ang maalabaab nga tubig ang nagapasangkad sang “temperature circadian rhythm,” nga nagabulig sa isa ka indibidwal nga matulugan sang madasig kag nagapataas sang kalidad sang pagtulog.
english: The doctor added that bathing with warm water increases the “temperature circadian rhythm,” which helps an individual fall asleep faster and increases sleep quality.

text: Naghugpa na sa Dubai International Airport ang Gulfstream G550 jet nga ginasakyan ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The Gulfstream G550 jet carrying former President Rodrigo Duterte has landed at Dubai International Airport.

text: Santo sa flightradar24.com, 8:04 subong nga aga, yara sa Dubai ang anay presidente.
english: According to flightradar24.com, 8:04 this morning, the former president is in Dubai.

text: Matapos ang stopover sa Dubai, magapadulong ang eroplano sa Rotterdam Airport sa The Netherlands, sa diin magaatubang si Duterte sa International Criminal Court sa kaso sini nga crimes against humanity.
english: After a stopover in Dubai, the plane will head to Rotterdam Airport in The Netherlands, where Duterte will face the International Criminal Court on charges of crimes against humanity.

text: Ini ang naangot sa maduguon sini nga war on drugs sang tion sang iya administrasyon sa diin linibo ang nabiktima sang extrajudicial killings.
english: This is linked to his bloody war on drugs during his administration where thousands were victims of extrajudicial killings.

text: Susunod na makakaharap ni Eala si Valentina Ryser ang ranked 230 mula sa Switzerland.
english: Eala will next face Valentina Ryser, ranked 230 from Switzerland.

text: Sulod na sa ikaduha nha round sang Ikley Open si Pinay tennis star Alex Eala.
english: Pinay tennis star Alex Eala has entered the second round of the Ikley Open.

text: Ini matapos ginpyerde ang Filipino Australian nga si Lizette Cabrera sa score nga 7(7)-6, 6-3.
english: This after defeating Filipino Australian Lizette Cabrera with a score of 7(7)-6, 6-3.

text: Nagtapos ang hampang isa ka oras kag 46 minutes sa torneo nga ginhiwat sa Northern England.
english: The match ended one hour and 46 minutes into the tournament held in Northern England.

text: Ini ang una nga kompetisyon ni Eala matapos ang kapaslawan sa Birmingham Classic.
english: It was Eala’s first competition after the disappointment at the Birmingham Classic.

text: Si Eala ang ranked 77 samtang si Cabarera ang yara sa ranked 206.
english: Eala is ranked 77 while Cabarera is ranked 206.

text: NAHISUGTAN sang United Nations ang “peaceful co-existence” sa tunga sang mga nasyon regardless kon ano man ang ideolohiya (ideology) ukon klase sang pagpalakat sang pangabuhi sang kada isa.
english: THE United Nations has agreed to “peaceful co-existence” among nations regardless of their ideology or way of life.

text: Kon may problema sa ila kaugalingon nga pungsod, gina-respeto man nga maresolbar nila ini nga indi pag-entrahan sang iban, kag kon may conflicto man ang duha ukon pila ka pungsod nga mapatung-an ini sang United Nations.
english: If there is a problem in their own country, it is also respected that they can resolve it without the involvement of others, and if there is a conflict between two or more countries, the United Nations can mediate.

text: Tungod sini wala naman sing dapat mangin problema sa ila relaciones, samtang gapabilin ang kinamatarong sang kada isa sa ila national interest para sa bagay nga pag-regulate sang ila pagpakig-relasyon.
english: Therefore, there should be no problems in their relations, while the right of each of them to their national interest to regulate their relations remains.

text: Sa negosyo man, cultural kag educational exchange, mutual defense, kag iban pa.
english: Also in trade, cultural and educational exchange, mutual defense, and so on.

text: Gani, sa pamangkot kon ano ang tindug naton sa donasyon (libre nga bulig), sang pila ka doses sang Sinovac vaccine sang China sa aton, wala man diri dapat may problema.
english: So, on the question of what our position is on the donation (free aid), of some doses of Sinovac vaccine from China to us, there should be no problem here.

text: Kabahin lang ina sang pagbinuligay sang mga myembro sang United Nations, kon diin ang Filipinas kag China mga myembro.
english: That's just part of the cooperation between the members of the United Nations, of which the Philippines and China are members.

text: Makatugda kita ugaling sa pagpasalamat ni Presidente Duterte sa gin-donar sang China nga Sinovac vaccine.
english: However, we can conclude from President Duterte's gratitude for China's donation of the Sinovac vaccine.

text: Ginakulbaan kita sa sining pagpasalamat ni Presidente nga kinahanglan pa niya magbisita kay Chinese President Xi Jinping agud personal nga magpasalamat diri.
english: We are nervous about this President's thanks that he has to visit Chinese President Xi Jinping to personally thank him.

text: Basi bala sa ining ila pagkit-anay may upod na ini sing dugang pa nga pabor sa China nga mas makaupang sa aton pagpasanyog sang aton soberanya sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Perhaps this meeting will bring more favor to China that will further hinder our enhancement of our sovereignty in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Nagaluntad diri ang aton 200-nautical mile nga Exclusive Economic Zone nga ginpat-ud na sang Hague Tribunal sa pagdaug naton sang aton kaso batok sa China sadtong 2016.
english: Our 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone exists here, which was determined by the Hague Tribunal when we won our case against China in 2016.

text: Lain ang pagpasalmat sa sugilanon lang, lain man kon personal na ang paghatag sing amistades, kon diin ang kahirup sa personal nga pagkit-anay pwede makapasanyog sang pagbayluhanay sing interes nga labi pa makaupang sang aton interes sa West Philippine Sea.
english: It is one thing to express gratitude in conversation, it is another to give personal friendships, where the closeness of personal meetings can promote an exchange of interests that further hinders our interest in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Nga daan sadto pa ginpasugtan ni Presidente Duterte ang China nga mangisda sa sulod sang aton EEZ.
english: That President Duterte has already allowed China to fish inside our EEZ.

text: Wala man sini napunggan ang pagpangagaw sang China sang pila ka isla sa sulod sang aton EEZ.
english: It has also not stopped China from seizing several islands within our EEZ.

text: Wala man nahimo ang gobyerno ni Presidente Duterte agud matapna ang ilegal kag makahalalit nga pagpanguha nila sang mga endangered species sa aton kadagatan.
english: President Duterte's government has done nothing to stop the illegal and harmful harvesting of endangered species in our waters.

text: Etcetera, etcetera!
english: Etc., etc.!

text: Pero, ngaa bala sobra gid ka-importante sa aton ang donasyon sang China sang pila ka doses sang Sinovac vaccine?
english: But, why is China's donation of several doses of the Sinovac vaccine so important to us?

text: Napilitan lang kita sa pagbaton sining Sinovac vaccine tungod wala gid kita makuha sing vaccine sa global market kay ginauna sang iban nga mga pungsod ang ila mga pumuluyo kag kulang pa gani ang ma-producir nila sini para sa ila mga pumuluyo.
english: We are forced to accept this Sinovac vaccine because we never get a vaccine from the global market because other countries put their people first and they can't even produce enough for their people.

text: Una naka-producir ang China sang vaccine kay sa China mismo nagsugod ang COVID-19.
english: China was the first to produce a vaccine because COVID-19 started in China.

text: Natural lang nga mauna man ini sa paghatag sang vaccine sa iya pumuluyo, nga ang sobra pwede na ini ma-donar ukon manegosyohan sa gwa.
english: Naturally, it will also take the lead in providing vaccines to its people, with the surplus being donated or traded abroad.

text: Tungod sini wala na kita nagpamalibad pa sa pagbaton sining Sinovac vaccine bisan manubo ang “efficacy” (50 porsyento lang) sini ikumparar sa vaccine sang iban nga pungsod, kon diin ang “efficacy” nagalab-ut gani sa 95 porsyento.
english: Therefore, we have not refused to accept this Sinovac vaccine even though its efficacy is low (only 50 percent) compared to the vaccines of other countries, where the efficacy reaches 95 percent.

text: Sunu sa mga siyentipiko ugaling, ang Sinovac, bisan sa manubo sini nga “efficacy”, makabulig na sa paglikaw sang aton mga pumuluyo sa makamamatay sini nga igu, nga kon maigu gid man sang COVID-19 ang pasyente “mild”lang.
english: According to scientists, however, Sinovac, even with its low efficacy, can help protect our people from this deadly disease, which if the patient is infected with COVID-19 is only “mild”.

text: Pero, dapat bala kita maghatag gid sing daku nga pagpasalamat kag kabalaslan sa China tungod sining pag-donate sini sang Sinovac vaccine?
english: But, should we really give a lot of gratitude and thanks to China for this donation of the Sinovac vaccine?

text: Sa matuod lang, bisan katiting wala kita sing kabalaslan sa China tungod sa gin-donar sini nga vaccine, luas lang sa pagpasalamat, bisan pakulahaw lang, sa sining “strange gesture” sang China sa pagpakita nga luyag sini makig-abyan gihapon samtang sige man ang pag-“bully” sini sa aton.
english: In fact, we have nothing to say to China for donating this vaccine, except to thank, even if it's just a joke, for this “strange gesture” of China to show that it still wants to be friends while it continues to “bully” us.

text: Ang tuod-tuod nga kabalaslan ginahatag ina sa may bunayag (pure) nga tuyu sa pagbulig.
english: True reward is given to those who have a pure intention to help.

text: Indi kay sa kon sin-o nga may malimbungon nga tinutuyu sa aton soberanya sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Not to anyone who has deceptive intentions in our sovereignty in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Sa ginhimu sang China sa West Philippine Sea, wala kita matuod kilalahon nga kabalaslan sa China.
english: For what China has done in the West Philippine Sea, we are not really recognized as a reward for China.

text: Kulang pa gani ibayad ang gin-donar sini nga mga vaccine sa sige pagtampalas sini sa aton soberanya sa West Philippine Sea.
english: It is not enough to pay for the donated vaccines for its constant violation of our sovereignty in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Dapat may utang pa gani ini nga balayran sa Filipinas tungod sa sining padayon nga “bullying” kag panghalit sa aton sa sulod mismo sang aton EEZ sa West Philippine Sea.
english: It should even owe the Philippines a fee for this continuous bullying and harm to us within our EEZ in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Indi bala?/PN
english: Isn't it?/PN

text: Ginalauman kag balantayan ang mas madinuagon nga 52nd Iloilo-Guimaras Paraw Regatta Festival subong nga tuig.
english: The 52nd Iloilo-Guimaras Paraw Regatta Festival is expected and looked forward to this year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Roberto Somosa, Chairman sang Sailing Events sa Paraw Regatta, iya ginpahayag nga nagpakig-angot na sila sa pila ka safety authorities kaangay sang Philippine Coast Guard agud maghatag sang impormasyon sa coastal communities kaangot sa gamiton nga race route.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Roberto Somosa, Chairman of Sailing Events at the Paraw Regatta, said they have already contacted several safety authorities such as the Philippine Coast Guard to provide information to coastal communities regarding the race route to be used.

text: Suno kay Somosa, ang aktibidad ang magapakita sang pinasahi nga sailing event, kon sa diin, maga-traverse ang mga tagpumalasakop sa ginabanta 30 kilometros halin sa Villa Beach padulong sa Guimaras kag pabalik.
english: According to Somosa, the activity will feature a unique sailing event, where participants will traverse approximately 30 kilometers from Villa Beach to Guimaras and back.

text: Ginhatagan man sini sang importansya ang “layag”, nga amo ang may duag sang nagkalain-lain nga pinta nga nagapakita man sang laragway kag sang artistry sang mga Ilonggo.
english: He also gave importance to the “sail”, which is the color of various paints that also show the picture and the artistry of the Ilonggos.

text: Ginlaragway man sini nga ang mga Paraw ang ang daw kaangay sang “alibangbang sa tunga sang dagat” nga nagapakita sang mainuswagon nga maritime history.
english: He also described the Paraw as being like a “butterfly in the middle of the sea” that shows a prosperous maritime history.

text: May bag-o man nga aktibidad ang balantayan, kag ini amo ang Slalom Race nga mahimo mangin isa ka kompetisyon kon malab-ot ang numero sang mga magapasakop.
english: The park also has a new activity, and it is the Slalom Race which can become a competition if the number of participants is reached.

text: Indi kuntento si Senator Imee Marcos sa mga impormasyon nga iya natipon sa una nga inquiry sang upper chamber kaangot sa pag-aresto kay former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte.
english: Senator Imee Marcos is not satisfied with the information she gathered in the first inquiry of the upper chamber regarding the arrest of former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte.

text: Suno sa presidential sister, magapawatag siya liwat sang ikaduha nga public hearing sa Huwebes sa masunod nga semana, Abril 3.
english: The presidential sister said she will hold a second public hearing on Thursday next week, April 3.

text: Natalana man nga isapubliko sang Senate committee on foreign affairs kun sanday sin-o nga mga personalidad ang magakadto sa ikaduha nga hugnat sang inquiry.
english: The Senate committee on foreign affairs is also scheduled to announce which personalities will attend the second phase of the inquiry.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, lakip sa nagpungko sa Senado amo sanday CIDG chief Major General Nicolas Torre III, General Rommel Marbil sang Philippine National Police (PNP), Sec.
english: Last week, among those who took their seats in the Senate were CIDG chief Major General Nicolas Torre III, General Rommel Marbil of the Philippine National Police (PNP), Sec.

text: Gibo Teodoro sang Department of National Defense (DND), Sec.
english: Gibo Teodoro of the Department of National Defense (DND), Sec.

text: Boying Remulla sang Justice Department, kag iban pa nga mga miyembro sang Gabinete.
english: Boying Remulla of the Justice Department, and other Cabinet members.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Imee nga may kumprehensibo nga plano ang gobyerno sa pagdakop kay Duterte kag sa pagkooperar sa International Criminal Court (ICC) apisar sang mga pamangkot sa soberanya kag mga maathag nga paglapas sa kinamatarong sang former president.
english: Earlier, Imee said the government has a comprehensive plan to arrest Duterte and to cooperate with the International Criminal Court (ICC) despite questions of sovereignty and clear violations of the former president's rights.

text: Ginsiling man anay ni Imee nga nakit-an sang Senate foreign relations committee investigation nga may kakulangan sa due process sa pag-turn over kay Duterte sa The Hague kasunod sang iya drug war-related crimes against humanity case.
english: Imee also said that the Senate foreign relations committee investigation found that there were shortcomings in the due process of turning over Duterte to The Hague following his drug war-related crimes against humanity case.

text: Antes sang naka-schedule nga ikaduha nga public hearing sang iya committee, matandaan nga nagbiya na si Imee sa senatorial lineup nga Alyansa para sa Bagong Pilipinas nga gina-endorso sang iya utod nga si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.#
english: Before the scheduled second public hearing of her committee, it can be recalled that Imee left the senatorial lineup of the Alliance for a New Philippines endorsed by her brother President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.#

text: Ginpamatud-an liwat ni U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth ang “ironclad” nga promisa sang Washington sa isa ka defence treaty upod sa Pilipinas, kon sa diin nagpangako nga magbutang sang advanced capabilities sa iya kaupod sa pagpabakod sang pagpugong batok sa mga pamahog, lakip ang “agresyon” sang China.
english: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reaffirmed Washington’s “ironclad” promise in a defense treaty with the Philippines, where it pledged to deploy advanced capabilities to its partner to strengthen deterrence against threats, including Chinese “aggression.”

text: Nakigkita si Hegseth sa iya katupong nga si Gilberto Teodoro kag kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Hegseth met with his counterpart Gilberto Teodoro and President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: kag gintumod nila ang padayon nga mabaskog nga pagbinuligay sa tunga sang nagadaku nga mga pamahog gikan sa China, nga nagapadaku sang commitment sa kalinong sa Indo-Pacific Region kag sa West Philipiine Sea, sa diin gina-akusahan sang Manila ang Beijing sang sulit-sulit nga mga agresyon.
english: and they referred to continued strong cooperation amid growing threats from China, underscoring commitment to peace in the Indo-Pacific Region and the West Philipiine Sea, where Manila accuses Beijing of repeated aggressions.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga wala nagapangita sang inaway ang Estados Unidos kag ginlaragway niya si Presidente Donald Trump bilang isa ka peacemaker.
english: He also made it clear that the United States is not looking for war and described President Donald Trump as a peacemaker.

text: Ang Pilipinas amo ang first stop ni Hegseth sa isa ka trip sa Asya.
english: The Philippines was Hegseth’s first stop on a trip to Asia.

text: Si Hegseth nagsiling nga ang Estados Unidos magadeploy sang dugang nga mga advanced capabilities sa Pilipinas nga magalakip sang NMESIS anti ship missile system kag unmanned surface vehicles nga iya ginlaragway nga “highly capable”.
english: Hegseth said the United States will deploy more advanced capabilities in the Philippines that will include the NMESIS anti ship missile system and unmanned surface vehicles which he described as “highly capable”.

text: Suno sa iya, nagkasugtan man sila nga magpatigayon sang bilateral special forces training operations sa na-aminhan nga isla sang Pilipinas nga Batanes, malapit sa Taiwan.
english: He said they also agreed to conduct bilateral special forces training operations on the northern Philippine island of Batanes, near Taiwan.

text: Si Marcos ang nagpromisa man nga magtrabaho sang suod upod sa Washington sa pag-amlig sang regional stability kag nagsiling nga ang pagbisita ni Hegseth, isa ka tanda sang suporta sang Estados Unidos para sa iya kaalyado sa kasugtanan.
english: Marcos also pledged to work closely with Washington to safeguard regional stability and said Hegseth's visit, was a sign of US support for its ally in the agreement.

text: Ang pagsinapol ginhiwat sa likod sang tensyon sa tunga sang Pilipinas kag sang nagadugang nga aktwasyon sang China sa ginaawayan nga mga isla sa West Philippine Sea, sa diin ang duha ka pungsod masami may maritime run-in.
english: The meeting was held against the backdrop of tensions between the Philippines and China’s escalating actions on disputed islands in the West Philippine Sea, where the two countries often have maritime run-ins.

text: Plano sang Marcos administration nga maghulam sang ₱735 billion sa second quarter sang 2025.
english: The Marcos administration plans to borrow ₱735 billion in the second quarter of 2025.

text: Ini ang 17 percent increase sa plano nga ₱629 billion sang first quarter, base sa data sang Bureau of the Treasury (BTr).
english: This is a 17 percent increase over the planned ₱629 billion of the first quarter, based on data from the Bureau of the Treasury (BTr).

text: Humalin sa Abril tubtob Hunyo, plano sang gobyerno nga maghulam sang ₱325 billion sa Treasury bills (T-bills), mas mataas sang 23% ukon ₱61 billion sa ₱264 billion sa first quarter.
english: From April to June, the government plans to borrow ₱325 billion in Treasury bills (T-bills), up 23% or ₱61 billion from ₱264 billion in the first quarter.

text: Sang 2024, ang gross borrowings sang Marcos administration ang nagtimbuok sa ₱2.56 trillion nga mas mataas sang ₱370 billion ukon malapit sa 17 percent nga increase halin sa ₱2.19 trillion sang 2023.
english: By 2024, the gross borrowings of the Marcos administration will total ₱2.56 trillion, higher than ₱370 billion or close to a 17 percent increase from ₱2.19 trillion in 2023.

text: Nakarekord na ang Iloilo Province sang apat ka mga indibidwal nga napatay bangud sa dengue.
english: Iloilo Province has recorded four individual deaths due to dengue.

text: Sa Morbidity Week 5 sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office humalin sang Enero 1, 2025 tubtob Pebrero 1, 2025, kabug-usan nga 385 ka mga kaso sang dengue ang narekord.
english: In Morbidity Week 5 of the Iloilo Provincial Health Office from January 1, 2025 to February 1, 2025, a total of 385 dengue cases were recorded.

text: Sa data sang PHO, lakip sa apat ka mga napatay amo ang 67-anyos nga taga Pototan; anum ka tuig nga bata nga taga Pototan; 71-anyos nga taga Carles kag 11 months nga lapsag nga taga Oton.
english: According to PHO data, the four dead were identified as a 67-year-old resident of Pototan; a six-year-old boy from Pototan; 71-year-old from Carles and 11 months old baby from Oton.

text: Sa 43 ka mga Local Government Units sa Iloilo, ang Bingawan lang ang wala sang may na-record nga dengue cases.
english: Of the 43 Local Government Units in Iloilo, only Bingawan has no recorded dengue cases.

text: Panawagan sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office sa publiko nga magbulig sa pagkampanya batuk sa dengue kasunod sang nagataas ang kaso sa probinsya.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Health Office is calling on the public to help campaign against dengue following the increase in cases in the province.

text:
Sundon gid ang 5S strategy batuk sa dengue kaangay sang mga masunod;

-search and destroy mosquito breeding sites-self-protection through proper clothing and repellents-seek early consultation for symptoms-support fogging, spraying, and misting in hotspot areas-sustain hydration to combat dehydration from fever
english:
Strictly follow the 5S strategy against dengue such as the following;

-search and destroy mosquito breeding sites-self-protection through proper clothing and repellents-seek early consultation for symptoms-support fogging, spraying, and misting in hotspot areas-sustain hydration to combat dehydration from fever

text: Ginarespeto sang House lead prosecutor ang panindugan ni Senate President Francis Escudero nga indi mahimo pagdayunon ang impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte samtang wala pa nakabalik sa sesyon ang Kongreso.
english: The House lead prosecutor respects the position of Senate President Francis Escudero that the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte cannot be continued while Congress has not returned to session.

text: Apang ginsiling sang prosecution nga bukas ini sa posibilidad sa pagdangop sa korte suprema para magpangita sang legal nga mga remedyo.
english: But the prosecution said it was open to the possibility of approaching the supreme court to seek legal remedies.

text: Suno kay lead prosecutor Rep.
english: According to lead prosecutor Rep.

text: Marcelino Libanan,para sa interes sang transparency kag due process, hulaton nila ang formal written communication sa House panel agud mabinag-binag ang legal remedies kalakip na ang pag- file sang motion for reconsideration ukon idangop sa Supreme Court para sa constitutional clarification.
english: Marcelino Libanan, in the interest of transparency and due process, they will wait for the formal written communication to the House panel to consider legal remedies including filing a motion for reconsideration or approach the Supreme Court for constitutional clarification.

text: Dugang niya, ini isa ka maragtason nga pagtakos sa mga institusyon kag sa commitment sa kasuguan.
english: He added that this is a historical measure of institutions and the commitment to the law.

text: Una na ginbasura ni Escudero ang mosyon sang kamara para sa Senado nga imando sa Vice President nga sabton ang impeachment charges, kag ginsiling nga ang ginaduso ang imposible nga matabo samtang naka-break ang kamara.
english: Escudero earlier rejected the House's motion for the Senate to order the Vice President to answer the impeachment charges, saying the proposal is impossible to happen while the House is in recess.

text: Matandaan nga gin-impeach sang House of Representatives ang Vice President sang Pebrero 5 bangud sa akusasyon naangot sa betrayal of public trust, culpable violation of the constitution, graft and corruption kag iban nga high crimes.
english: The House of Representatives impeached the Vice President on February 5 on charges related to betrayal of public trust, culpable violation of the constitution, graft and corruption and other high crimes.

text: Nag-file man si Sara Duterte sang petition for certiorari and prohibition with urgent application of temporary restraining order and/or writ of preliminary injunction sa Supreme Court, kag nagsiling nga ang iya impeachment ang wala nagsunod sa due process kag makabig nga illegal.
english: Sara Duterte also filed a petition for certiorari and prohibition with urgent application of temporary restraining order and/or writ of preliminary injunction in the Supreme Court, saying that her impeachment did not follow due process and would be considered illegal.

text: Nalumos ang kapin 16,000 ka mga karnero matapos nga naglugdang ang ginkargahan nga barko sa Red Sea sa Sudan.
english: More than 16,000 sheep drowned after a loaded ship sank in the Red Sea in Sudan.

text: 15,800 ka mga karnero ang nakarga sa amo nga livestock vessel kag natalana kuntani nga i-export ang mga sapat halin sa Sudan pa-Saudi Arabia.
english: 15,800 sheep were loaded on the livestock vessel and were scheduled to export the animals from Sudan to Saudi Arabia.

text: Ginapahayag nga na-overload ang vessel bangud nga 9,000 lang kuntani ka mga karnero ang masarangan sini nga ikarga.
english: The vessel was reportedly overloaded because it was supposed to carry only 9,000 sheep.

text: Na-rescue naman ang tanan nga crew sa amo nga vessel.
english: All crew members of the vessel were rescued.

text: Kasunod sini, ginakahangaw-an ang matuga nga economic kag environmental impact sang amo nga insidente.
english: Subsequently, there are concerns about the economic and environmental impact of the incident.

text: Ginakahangaw-an nga makaapekto sa operasyon sang puerto ang paglugdang sang barko samtang malain naman ang mangin epekto sini sa dagat bangud linibo ka sapat ang napatay.
english: It is feared that the sinking of the ship will affect the operation of the port while it will have a negative impact on the sea as thousands of animals have died.

text: Sa 15,800 ka mga karnero, 700 lang ang nasalbar apang lunsay na maluya kag wala na ginalauman nga mabuhi pa sang malawig.
english: Of the 15,800 sheep, only 700 were saved but all were weak and not expected to live much longer.

text: Yara sa 14 million Saudi riyals ang balor sang nahalitan nga livestock ukon katumbas sang masobra P199 million.
english: The value of the damaged livestock is estimated at 14 million Saudi riyals or equivalent to more than P199 million.

text: Ginaimbestigaran na subong sang tul-id ang amo nga insidente.
english: The incident is now being investigated.

text: Nag-appoint ang North Korea sang labing-una nga babayi nga foreign minister.
english: North Korea has appointed its first female foreign minister.

text: Ini amo ang veteran diplomat nga si Choe Son-hui nga nakapangalagad na anay bilang vice foreign minister.
english: This is veteran diplomat Choe Son-hui who has previously served as vice foreign minister.

text: Ginbuslan sini si Ri Son Gwon, isa ka hardline former military official nga amo anay ang nagpanguna agud nga makaistoryahanay ang North kag South Korea.
english: He replaced Ri Son Gwon, a hardline former military official who had previously taken the lead in getting North and South Korea to talk.

text: Si Choe ang makabig isa ka career diplomat nga maka-communicate sang fluent English.
english: Choe is considered a career diplomat who can communicate fluent English.

text: Nagserbe man ini bilang close aide ni North Korean leader Kim Jung On ilabi na sang tion nga may nuclear talks sa United States.
english: He also served as a close aide to North Korean leader Kim Jung On especially during nuclear talks with the United States.

text: Ginaupdan sini ang North Korean leader sa summits upod kay former US president Donald Trump.
english: It accompanies the North Korean leader to summits with former US president Donald Trump.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong nga tuig, makapila ka beses nga nagpatigayon ang North Korea sang weapon tests, lakip na ang pagpalupad sang intercontinental ballistic missile sa full range sa labing-una nga tion halin sang 2017.
english: This year, North Korea has conducted several weapon tests, including the launch of an intercontinental ballistic missile at full range for the first time since 2017.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam ang US kag South Korean officials nga posible nga naga-preparar ang North sang ika-pito nga nuclear test — isa ka tikang nga suno sa Estados Unidos, posible nagakinahanglan sang “madasig kag mapag-on” nga balos.
english: US and South Korean officials have previously warned that the North may be preparing a seventh nuclear test — a move that the United States says is likely to require a “swift and decisive” response.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Nabaton na sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office ang notice halin sa United States Agency for International Development (USAID) may kaangtanan sa temporary suspension sang tanan nila nga funded activities kasunod sang nangin direktiba ni US President Donald Trump.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The Iloilo Provincial Health Office has received a notice from the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) regarding the temporary suspension of all their funded activities following the directive of US President Donald Trump.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Maria Socorro Quiñon, Head sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office, iya ginpahayag nga on hold sa subong ang mga key initiatives sa idalom sang Support for Wide-scale Interventions to Find TB Project lakip na ang pag-hire sang dugang nga health personnel, pag-deploy sang mobile x-ray services kag pag-engage sa community Tuberculosis stakeholders.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Maria Socorro Quiñon, Head of the Iloilo Provincial Health Office, said key initiatives under the Support for Wide-scale Interventions to Find TB Project are currently on hold including the hiring of additional health personnel, deployment of mobile x-ray services and engagement with community tuberculosis stakeholders.

text: Apang sa pihak sini, ginpasigurado ni Dr. Quiñon nga uninterrupted ang Tuberculosis program sa Iloilo bangud nangin kabahin na ini sa regular health programs sang Provincial Office kag mga local government units.
english: However, despite this, Dr. Quiñon said the Tuberculosis program in Iloilo is uninterrupted because it has become part of the regular health programs of the Provincial Office and local government units.

text: Suno sa iya, nagahatag man sang free mobile x-ray screenings ang Philippine Business for Social Progress (PBSP), sila man ang naga-train sa Tuberculosis service providers kag nagasuporta sa high quality Tuberculosis data reporting.
english: He said the Philippine Business for Social Progress (PBSP) also provides free mobile x-ray screenings, they also train tuberculosis service providers and support high quality tuberculosis data reporting.

text: Nagpasalig man sang padayon nga bulig ang Philippine Coalition Against Tuberculosis kag ang Department of Health.
english: The Philippine Coalition Against Tuberculosis and the Department of Health also pledged continued assistance.

text: Pahayag sang natungdan, dako ang nangin kontribusyon sang USAID sa ikaayong lawas kag well-being sang Ilonggos ilabi na sa Universal Health Care, Family Planning kag Adolescent Health and Development pinaagi sa ReachHealth Project nga nag-umpisa sang 2023.
english: He said USAID has made a great contribution to the health and well-being of Ilonggos especially in Universal Health Care, Family Planning and Adolescent Health and Development through the ReachHealth Project which started in 2023.

text: Nagalaum si Dr. Quiñon nga makonsidera sang US government kag mapahanugutan nga mapadayon ang pagpatuman sang mga life-saving projects sa Iloilo.
english: Dr. hopes Quiñon urged the US government to consider and allow the implementation of life-saving projects in Iloilo to continue.

text: -𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗟𝘆𝗻𝗱-𝗖 𝗝𝗼𝘆 𝗕𝗮𝗱𝗲
english: -Advanced 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗟𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗵 𝗝𝗼𝘆 𝗕𝗮𝗱𝗲

text: ANG experyensya sang Maginhawa Community Pantry kag sang iya sang aktres nga si Angel Locsin sa pag-selebrar sang iya birthday nagapakita nga mabudlay ipatuman ang mga ini para sa kaayuhan sang dapat buligan.
english: THE experience of the Maginhawa Community Pantry and that of actress Angel Locsin in celebrating her birthday shows that it is difficult to implement these for the benefit of those who need help.

text: In fact, ang indi ma-kontrol nga pag-abot kag pagdinaguso sang mga tawo ginkabangdan pa sang kamatayon sang isa ka senior citizen sa community pantry ni Angel Locsin.
english: In fact, the uncontrollable influx of people even caused the death of a senior citizen at Angel Locsin's community pantry.

text: Isa pa, indi man naton maseguro dira kon sin-o gid ang bagay nga buligan sang bisan pang-kusina lang nila nga kinahanglanon.
english: Furthermore, we cannot be sure who is right to help with even their kitchen needs.

text: Sa madamo nga okasyon gani, sa pagbulig sa mga nahalitan sang kalamidad, ang madamo sa matuod nga bululigan ang indi pa makabaton sing bulig kay una pa sa linya sang pila ang indi kinahanglan buligan.
english: On many occasions, however, in helping those affected by disasters, many of the truly helped have not yet received help because they are still in line for those who do not need help.

text: Well, indi gid man seguro naton mapunggan ang padayon nga pagtuhaw sang mga community pantry, labi na gid sa panahon nga ini sang pandemic.
english: Well, we probably can't stop the continued emergence of community pantries, especially during this time of pandemic.

text: Amlig lang kita agud masunod gid ang health protocol sa padayon ta nga away sa COVID-19.
english: Let's just be careful to follow the health protocol in our ongoing fight against COVID-19.

text: Luyag man kita magpahanumdum sa aton mga organizer nga medyosan gid nila nga ang makabaton bulig amo gid ang may kinahanglan sini.
english: We would also like to remind our organizers to make sure that those who receive assistance are those who need it.

text: Katulad abe sa luyag ta man buligan, dungan ukon sunod sa sining community pantry, ang mga kabataan nga indi mapakaon sing husto sang ila kubos sa pangabuhi nga mga ginikanan.
english: Similarly, we want to help, along with or after this community pantry, the children who are not fed properly by their poor parents.

text: Ang aton pobre nga mga tigulang luyag man seguro magpangape-kape sa kaagahon upod ang pandesal nga amo lang ang pamahaw sang iban.
english: Our poor elderly people probably want to have coffee in the morning with pandesal which is the only breakfast of others.

text: Sa nahibal-an naton, may mga eskwelahan publiko sa elementarya nga nagahatag sing “full breakfast” ukon bisan “snack” lang sa sining kabataan sang kubos nga panimalay.
english: As far as we know, there are public elementary schools that provide “full breakfast” or even “snack” to these children from poor families.

text: Wala ugaling sang kasubong nga proyekto ang aton gobyerno sa mga kabataan nga wala pa nagasulod sa buluthuan.
english: However, our government does not have such a project for pre-school children.

text: Diri, pwede seguro magbulos-bulos sponsor ang mga pribado nga indibidwal ukon grupo nga may ikasarang agud magtukod sang “soup kitchen” nga makabulig hatag sang masustansya nga pamahaw sa sining mga kabataan, bisan kis-a lang kada semana.
english: Here, private individuals or groups with the means can take turns sponsoring a soup kitchen that can help provide a nutritious breakfast to these children, even once a week.

text: Ang ining mga kabataan sang kubos nga mga panimalay,  ang masami indi matagaan sing husto nga pagkaon nga nagaapekto sa ila ikaayong lawas kag husto nga pagdaku.
english: These children from poor families are often not given proper nutrition which affects their health and proper development.

text: Por ejemplo, sunu sa 7th National Nutrition Survey sangFood andNutrition Researh Institute (FNRI) sang Dept.
english: For example, according to the 7th National Nutrition Survey of the Food and Nutrition Research Institute (FNRI) of the Dept.

text: of Science and Technology (DOST), 3 sa 10 sa mga kabataan may edad 5 ka tuig panubo kulang sa kataason, nga patimaan sang ila kakulang sang protina sa ila pagkaon.
english: of Science and Technology (DOST), 3 out of 10 children under the age of 5 are underweight, a sign of their lack of protein in their diet.

text: Sunu sa FNRI, 38 ka gramo sang kumpleto nga protina ang kinahanglan sining mga kabataan, nga makuha sa itlog,  manok, baka, baboy kag isda, lakip na ang munggo kag mani, nga pwede madugang  sa pagkaon nila sa masustansya nga sopas kag tinapay, katulad sang e-nutrition buns sang gobyerno, nga mahatag sa ila sa “soup kitchen”.
english: According to the FNRI, these children need 38 grams of complete protein, which can be obtained from eggs, chicken, beef, pork and fish, including munggo and peanuts, which can be added to their diet in nutritious soups and breads, such as the government's e-nutrition buns, which will be given to them in the soup kitchen.

text: Walo man sa 10 sang mga Filipino ang kulang sa  Vitamin A nga nagapasinaw sang panan-aw, maayo nga pagdaku kag pang-away sa balatian sang mga kabataan, kag bisan pa gani sang mga may edad na.
english: Eight out of 10 Filipinos are also deficient in Vitamin A, which improves vision, healthy growth and fights disease in children, and even in the elderly.

text: Makuha ining Vitamin A, sunu sa FNRI, sa kalabasa,carrots, pula nga itlog, berde kag madahon nga mga utan kag VitaminA-fortfied nga gatas, nga madugang man sa sining “soup kitchen” nga pwede ma-sponsoran sang pribado nga mga indibidwal ukon grupo.
english: This Vitamin A, according to the FNRI, can be obtained from pumpkins, carrots, red eggs, green and leafy vegetables and VitaminA-fortfied milk, which can also be added to this “soup kitchen” that can be sponsored by private individuals or groups.

text: Pwede ini hiwaton sa gym sang barangay.
english: It can be held in the barangay gym.

text: Malipay man seguro ang aton pobre nga mga senior citizen nga mainitan ang ila tiyan kon matagaan sang isa ka tasa nga kape kag pandesal kada aga bag-o ang lubos nga pamahaw.
english: Our poor senior citizens will probably be happy to be given a cup of coffee and pandesal every morning before breakfast.

english:

By the way, it is an experience in the countryside to eat during the dry season from June to August in Western Visayas.

text: Sa lugar nga tatlo ka beses magkaon sa isa ka adlaw, kaduha na lang – painit-init lang anay sing sara-sara (sinanlag nga bugas) nga ga-serbi kape kag mamahaw ugaling dala panyaga sa mga a las 10 sa aga, kag panyapon sa pag-abot sang a las 5 sang hapon.
english: In a place where you eat three meals a day, only twice – just warm up a sara-sara (roasted rice) that serves coffee and breakfast but bring lunch at about 10 am, and dinner at 5 pm.

text: Sa masami, ang ginakaon nla sa sining panahon bilang kan-on amo ang ginabugas nga mais, nga mabakal sa siyudad, nga maka sustener sing madugay tungod kay madugay ini matunaw.
english: Usually, what they eat during this time as food is rice corn, which can be bought in the city, which can sustain for a long time because it takes a long time to digest.

text: Para sa mga taga-uma sa Guimaras, okey lang sa ila ang ining klase sang pag-antos.
english: For the farmers in Guimaras, this kind of suffering is okay.

text: Gabawi lang sa pag-abot sang maayo nga panahon.
english: Just recover when the good weather comes.

text: Take it from me kon indi kamo magpati sa sugid sang iban./PN
english: Take it from me if you don't believe what others say./PN

text: Patuloy ang pag-angat ng remittances mula sa overseas Filipinos matapos iulat ng Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas ang halos 4% na pagtaas noong Hunyo.
english: Remittances from overseas Filipinos continue to rise after the Central Bank of the Philippines reported a nearly 4% increase in June.

text: Batay sa datos, umabot sa $2.99 billion ang kabuuang cash remittances, mas mataas kumpara sa $2.88 billion sa kaparehong buwan noong nakaraang taon.
english: According to the data, total cash remittances reached $2.99 ​​billion, up from $2.88 billion in the same month last year.

text: Pinangunahan ng land-based OFWs ang pagtaas na may $2.43 billion o mahigit 81 porsyento ng kabuuang remittances, habang $555 million naman ang mula sa sea-based workers.
english: Land-based OFWs led the increase with $2.43 billion or more than 81 percent of total remittances, while $555 million came from sea-based workers.

text: Mula Enero hanggang Hunyo, nakapagtala na ng $16.75 billion na cash remittances, tumaas ng 3.1% kumpara noong unang kalahati ng 2024.
english: From January to June, it recorded $16.75 billion in cash remittances, up 3.1% from the first half of 2024.

text: Nanatiling pangunahing pinagmumulan ang Estados Unidos na may 40 porsyento, kasunod ang Singapore, Saudi Arabia, at Japan.
english: The United States remained the main source with 40 percent, followed by Singapore, Saudi Arabia, and Japan.

text: Personal remittances, kabilang ang cash at in-kind transfers, tumaas din ng 3.7% sa $3.33 billion para sa buwan ng Hunyo.
english: Personal remittances, including cash and in-kind transfers, also rose 3.7% to $3.33 billion for the month of June.

text: Gin-isa-isa ni senator Robin Padilla ang rason kun ngaa bukas ini nga magpadalagan sa pagka-bise presidente sa masunod nga eleksyon.
english: Senator Robin Padilla outlined the reasons why he is open to running for vice president in the next election.

text: Ang pinakadako sini nga rason amo nga kun itulod ini ni former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte.
english: The biggest reason for this is that if former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte pushes it.

text: Suno sa iya indi gid sini pagpamalibadan ang anay presidente.
english: He said he will never refuse the former president.

text: Suno kay Padilla, si Duterte lamang ang maka-engganyo sa iya nga sudlan ang posisyon sang pagka bise-presidente kaangay sang ginpangabay man ini sang una nga magsulod sa politika kag magpadalagan bilang senador.
english: According to Padilla, only Duterte can encourage him to enter the position of vice president as he was asked earlier to enter politics and run as a senator.

text: Sang ginpamangkot ini kun handa ini sa mas mataas nga posisyon, suno kay Padilla, ginhanda man siya nga handa sa tanan.
english: When asked if he was ready for a higher position, Padilla said he was prepared to be ready for everything.

text: Suno pa sa Senador, indi man amo gid kabudlay ang obra sang vice president bangud nakatutok lang sa advocacy work ang gina-obra sini.
english: The senator said the vice president's job is not that difficult because he is focused on advocacy work.

text: Dugang pa niya, daw kaangay nga ”spare tire” lang ini kag masarangan gid sini ang nasambit nga posisyon.
english: He added that it is like a spare tire and he can handle the position.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni Padilla nga apisar may ara sang ”hierarchy” ukon pila nga mas nauna sa iya nga mga politiko sa kampo ni Dutertekaangay ni Imee Marcos, Alan Peter Cayetano, Bong Go, Ronald dela Rosa, suno sa iya, batunon sini ang bisan ano nga kritisismo kun magpadayon ini sa pagdalagan.
english: Padilla said that although there is a hierarchy or some politicians ahead of him in Duterte's camp such as Imee Marcos, Alan Peter Cayetano, Bong Go, Ronald dela Rosa, he said he will accept any criticism if he continues to run.

text: Ginklaro man sini nga 100% ini nga magasuporta sa kampanya sang Duterte sa 2028.
english: He also clarified that he will 100% support Duterte's 2028 campaign.

text: Bumuo ang mga awtoridad ng isang special investigation team upang imbestigahan at linawin ang mga pangyayari sa likod ng pagkamatay ng bise-alkalde ng Dueñas, Iloilo na sinasabing dulot ng aksidenteng pagputok ng baril.
english: Authorities have formed a special investigation team to investigate and clarify the circumstances behind the death of the vice-mayor of Dueñas, Iloilo, allegedly caused by accidental gunfire.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo sa Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) Director na si Police Colonel Kim Legada, sinabi niyang siya mismo ang mangunguna sa naturang investigation team.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) Director Police Colonel Kim Legada said he will personally lead the investigation team.

text: May mga support unit na tutulong sa imbestigasyon tulad ng Regional Forensic Unit, Regional Civil Security Unit, Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG), at La Paz Police Station.
english: There are support units to assist in the investigation such as the Regional Forensic Unit, Regional Civil Security Unit, Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG), and La Paz Police Station.

text: Ayon kay Legada, bagama’t sinasabing aksidenteng pagputok ng baril ang nangyari kay Vice Mayor Aimee Paz Lamasan, masusi pa rin itong iimbestigahan ng mga awtoridad.
english: According to Legada, although the alleged accidental shooting of Vice Mayor Aimee Paz Lamasan, the authorities are still investigating.

text: Dagdag pa niya, kung may makitang ebidensiya na may naganap na foul play, sisiguruhin ng pulisya na may maisasampang kaso.
english: He added that if there is evidence of foul play, the police will ensure that a case is filed.

text: Nauna nang iniulat na naganap ang insidente sa isang residential village sa Barangay Tabuc Suba, La Paz, Iloilo City noong Disyembre 30.
english: The incident occurred in a residential village in Barangay Tabuc Suba, La Paz, Iloilo City on December 30.

text: Batay sa mga paunang report, naghahanda umano ng kanyang mga gamit ang bise-alkalde nang aksidente niyang nakalabit ang gatilyo ng kanyang baril, dahilan upang siya ay tamaan sa kanang bahagi ng kanyang tiyan.
english: According to preliminary reports, the vice-mayor was preparing his belongings when he accidentally pulled the trigger of his gun, causing him to be hit in the right part of his stomach.

text: Isinailalim pa sa operasyon si Lamasan, subalit binawian siya ng buhay noong Bisperas ng Bagong Taon habang patuloy na ginagamot sa ospital.
english: Lamasan was still undergoing surgery, but died on New Year's Eve while undergoing treatment at the hospital.

english: (Photo: Aimee Paz Lamasan/FB)

text: Nakapauli nqa sa Pilipinas ang 176 ka mga Pilipino nga ginpasalig nga maka-obra sa Thailand apang natuntuhan gali kag sa baylo, gin-traffick, gin-scam, kag gin-torture pa sa Myanmar.
english: The 176 Filipinos who were promised to work in Thailand but were trafficked, scammed, and tortured in Myanmar have returned to the Philippines.

text: May ginpatigayon ang gobyerno nga chartered flight sakay ang Philippine officials kag nagkadto sa Thailand agud sugaton ang na-rescue nga mga biktima nga halin sa scam hubs sa amo nga pungsod.

Bangud nga gin-smuggle lamang sila, ang ila katapusan nga passport stamp ang halin pa sa Thailand gani nga nagguwa nga nangin overstaying visitors pa sila, apang nagpasugot man ang Thai authorities nga makabiya sila gilayon paagi sa chartered flight pabalik sa Manila.
english: Because they were smuggled, their last passport stamp was from Thailand so it turned out that they were still overstaying visitors, but the Thai authorities also agreed that they could leave immediately via chartered flight back to Manila.

text: Base sa istorya sang isa ka Pinay, siya kag ang iya bana ang na-rescruit paagi lamang sa messaging app kag ginpasalig nga maga-obra sila bilang call center agents sa Thailand.
english: According to a Filipina, she and her husband were recruited through a messaging app and assured that they would work as call center agents in Thailand.

text: Ginhugpa sila una sa Hong Kong, gindala sa Bangkok, apang wala sila didto nagtinir bangud ginkarga sila sa sakayang pandagat kag gindala sa Myanmar.
english: They were landed first in Hong Kong, taken to Bangkok, but did not stay there as they were loaded onto a sea vessel and taken to Myanmar.

text: Didto suno sa natungdan gin-torture sila kag wala ginpakaon sa halos isa ka semana bisan pa nga nagabusong ang Pinay.
english: There, he said, they were tortured and not fed for almost a week even though the Filipina was pregnant.

text: Makapila ka beses man sila nga ginbaligya sang ila Chinese employer kag ginsunog pa ang passport sang bana.
english: They were also sold several times by their Chinese employer and the husband's passport was burned.

text: Ginpaathag naman ni Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) Undersecretary Eduardo De Vega nga nakapauli lamang sila sa Pilipinas bangud nagsira na ang scam factories.
english: DFA Undersecretary Eduardo De Vega explained that they were only able to return to the Philippines because the scam factories were closed.

text: Ginpatigayon man ang pagpauli paagi sa trilateral cooperation sang Myanmar, Thailand, kag Pilipinas.
english: The repatriation was also facilitated through trilateral cooperation of Myanmar, Thailand, and the Philippines.

text: Apang ginbuyagyag man ni De Vega nga madamo pa nga Pinoy ang na-trap gihapon sa scam hubs sa Myanmar, Cambodia, kag Laos, kag kadam-an sa ila ang gina-traffick halin sa Thailand.
english: But De Vega also revealed that many more Filipinos are still trapped in scam hubs in Myanmar, Cambodia, and Laos, and most of them are trafficked from Thailand.

text: Sa ila pagbalik sa Pilipinas, nagpirma ang mga biktima sang sworn statements para makabulig nga mapasaka ang kaso batok sa recruiters.
english: Upon their return to the Philippines, the victims signed sworn statements to help file a case against the recruiters.

text: Ginhatagan man sila sang kuwarta kag iban pa nga assistance halin sa gobyerno.
english: They were also given money and other assistance from the government.

text: “Each victim also received Php 50,000 in financial assistance from the DMW’s AKSYON Fund and Php 10,000 from OWWA, aside from the immediate medical and psychosocial services from the Department of Health (DoH) and Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).
english: “Each victim also received Php 50,000 in financial assistance from the DMW’s AKSYON Fund and Php 10,000 from OWWA, aside from the immediate medical and psychosocial services from the Department of Health (DoH) and Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).

text: The DMW will also provide legal assistance to the victims in addition to the reintegration support and upskilling trainings through the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA),” suno sa press statement sang DMW.#
english: The DMW will also provide legal assistance to the victims in addition to the reintegration support and upskilling trainings through the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA),” DMW said in a press statement.#

text: Nagapati ang anay legal adviser ni former President Rodrigo Duterte nga si Atty. Salvador Panelo nga isa ka ‘political game’ ang ginahimo sang mga mamalidha sang House of Representatives batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Former legal adviser to former President Rodrigo Duterte, Atty. Salvador Panelo said the lawmakers of the House of Representatives are playing a political game against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Panelo, iya ginpahayag nga para sa iya, wala sang iregularidad sa mga nahimo ni VP Sara Duterte kaangot sa mga alegasyon nga korapsyon sa pagpamuno sini sa Department of Education (DEPED) kag sa Office of the Vice President (OVP).
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Panelo, he said that for him, there are no irregularities in the actions of VP Sara Duterte regarding the allegations of corruption in her leadership in the Department of Education (DEPED) and the Office of the Vice President (OVP).

text: Suno kay Panelo, tuyo lamang nga gub-an sang administrasyon ni President Ferdinand “Bong-bong” Marcos si Inday Sara ilabi na nga siya ang ginalantaw nga mangin mainit nga kasumpong ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: According to Panelo, the administration of President Ferdinand “Bong-bong” Marcos is only trying to destroy Inday Sara especially since she is expected to be a hot opponent of House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Ika-duha, ang impeachment ang agud i-disqualify si Duterte bangud siya ang mabaskog nga kandidato para sa 2028 Presidential Elections.
english: Second, the impeachment is to disqualify Duterte because he is a strong candidate for the 2028 Presidential Elections.

text: Ginalantaw man sini nga planado na ini tanan antes paman nagbinotohay sa Kamara ang mga mamalidha.
english: He also believes that all this was planned before the lawmakers voted in the House.

text: Ginhatagan man pagtamod ni Panelo ang kahandaan sang kampo ni Vice President Sara Duterte sa pag-atubang sa impeachment trial batuk sa iya.
english: Panelo also noted the readiness of Vice President Sara Duterte's camp to face the impeachment trial against her.

text: Suno kay Panelo, preparado ang legal team ni VP Sara sa magamo nga hearing, kag sigurado nga atubangon niya ini nga may yuhum, kaisog, kag bastante nga ikasarang.
english: According to Panelo, VP Sara's legal team is prepared for the chaotic hearing, and she will surely face it with a smile, courage, and enough skills.

text: Kadungan sini, ginpakalain man sang former spokesperson ni anay Pres.
english: Meanwhile, the former spokesperson of former Pres.

text: Duterte nga wala ginarespeto sang mga mamalidha ang tingog sang pumuluyo kag ang hingyo ni Pres.
english: Duterte that lawmakers do not respect the voice of the people and the request of Pres.

text: Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga untaton ang amo nga lihok bangud magatuga lamang ini sang pagbinahin-bahin kag indi makabenepisyo sa mga Pilipino.
english: to stop such action because it will only create division and will not benefit the Filipinos.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ginalauman na nga pulihan si VP Sara kag indi na ini bag-o ang pagdali-dali sa proseso bangud may yara sang bastante nga numero ang ginapahayag ‘anti-forces’.
english: He also said that VP Sara is expected to be replaced and it is not new to rush the process because there are enough numbers of alleged 'anti-forces'

text: Duha ang kumpirmado nga patay matapos nagtibusok ang isa ka private plane sa Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur subong nga hapon.
english: Two people were confirmed dead after a private plane crashed in Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur this afternoon.

text: Ang duha ka lawas ginlaragway nga nagasuksok sang duag red kag blue nga panapton.
english: Both bodies were described as wearing red and blue clothing.

text: Isa man ka karabaw ang nasamaran kag halos napihak gid ang baba sang maigo sang eroplano.
english: A buffalo was also injured and almost broke its mouth when it was hit by the plane.

text: Arestado ang anum na naman ka Chinese nationals kag isa ka Pinoy sa isa ka pribado nga isla sa Zambales bangud sa ginaalegar nga pagpatigayon sang surveillance activities malapit sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Six Chinese nationals and a Filipino were arrested on a private island in Zambales for allegedly conducting surveillance activities near the West Philippine Sea.

text: Marso 9 sang nadakpan ang mga suspek sa hot-pursuit operation sa Grande Island nga nahamtang sa sulod sang Subic Bay Freeport Zone.
english: The suspects were arrested on March 9 in a hot-pursuit operation on Grande Island located within the Subic Bay Freeport Zone.

text: Ginpatigayon ang operasyon kasunod sang impormasyon nga nakuha sang mga opisyal sang militar kaangot sa posible nga “covert intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance operations” nga ginahimo sang “affiliated members” sang Chinese Communist Party-United Front Work.
english: The operation was conducted following information received by military officials regarding possible “covert intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance operations” conducted by “affiliated members” of the Chinese Communist Party-United Front Work.

text: Sang ginpresentar na sila sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) sa publiko, ginhingadlan sila nga si He Peng, Xu Xining, Ye Tianwu, Ye Xiaocan, Dick Ang kag Su Anlong.
english: Once the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) presented them to the public, they were named as He Peng, Xu Xining, Ye Tianwu, Ye Xiaocan, Dick Ang and Su Anlong.

text: Kaupod nila nga gindakop ang Pilipino nga si Melvin Aguillon nga amo ang nagserbe nga bodyguard.
english: They also arrested Filipino Melvin Aguillon, who served as a bodyguard.

text: Nagapanindugan ini nga wala sila sang ginhimo nga covert activities kundi nagapangisda lamang.
english: He insisted that they did not do any covert activities but were just fishing.

text: Pahayag ni Van Homer Angluben, director sang NBI Cybercrime Division, nagpakuno-kuno pa ang mga Chinese bilang mga manugpangisda nga nagapaliwa-liwa lamang, apang sang tion sang ila surveillance, nagpalupad na sila sang drone kun may maglabay nga barko.
english: Van Homer Angluben, director of the NBI Cybercrime Division, said the Chinese pretended to be recreational fishermen, but during their surveillance, they flew drones when a ship passed by.

text: Nakumpiskar sa ila ang gadgets nga may unod nga mga laragway kag videos sang Philippine kag American naval assets, mga dokumento nga naka-lista sang mga oras kag petsa sang paghalin kag pag-abot sang naval fleet sa Port of Subic, kag mga peke nga tax documents.
english: Seized from them were gadgets containing images and videos of Philippine and American naval assets, documents listing the times and dates of departure and arrival of the naval fleet at the Port of Subic, and fake tax documents.

text: Ginpaidalom ang mga suspek sa inquest proceedings sa Bataan, nagapangatubang sang kaso nga espionage, falsification of documents kag concealment sang ila matuod nga mga pangalan.
english: The suspects were subjected to inquest proceedings in Bataan, facing charges of espionage, falsification of documents and concealment of their real names.

text: Ang Pinoy naman nga kahimbon ang mangatubang man sang kaso nga paglapas sa Omnibus Election Code bangud sa iligal nga armas nga iya ginahuptan.
english: The Filipino candidate will also face charges of violating the Omnibus Election Code for possession of illegal firearms.

text: Ginpahayag man sang otoridad nga isa ka “strategic vantage point” ang Grande Island bangud makit-an halin sa area ang klaro nga view sang key sea lanes sa West Philippine Sea lakip na ang Panatag (Scarborough) Shoal.
english: The authorities also said that Grande Island is a “strategic vantage point” because it offers a clear view of key sea lanes in the West Philippine Sea including the Panatag (Scarborough) Shoal.

text: Patay ang masobra 20 ka tawo sa masaker sa Democratic Republic of Congo.
english: More than 20 people have been killed in a massacre in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

text: Ginasuspetsuhan nga ang notorious nga Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) ang may kahimuan sa amo nga atake sa eastern province sang Ituri sa amo nga pungsod.
english: The notorious Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) are suspected of being involved in the attack in the eastern province of Ituri in the country.

text: Kun basehan ang data sang Red Cross sa Irumu, 36 tanan ka mga bangkay ang naisip sang mga volunteers sa lugar kun sa diin natabo ang massacre.
english: Based on data from the Red Cross in Irumu, a total of 36 bodies were counted by volunteers in the area where the massacre took place.

text: Antes sini, naga-eksperyensya na ang Ituri kag ang kaiping sini nga North Kivu province sang mga pagpang-atake halin sa armado nga mga grupo.
english: Previously, Ituri and neighboring North Kivu province had been experiencing attacks from armed groups.

text: Pareho nga ginpaidalom sa state of siege ang duha ka probinsya halin pa sang 2021 — isa ka measure kun sa diin ginahatagan sang otoridad ang pinuno sang militar nga pabaskugon pa ang tikang batok sa armado nga mga grupo.
english: Both provinces have been under a state of siege since 2021 — a measure that authorizes the military chief to intensify measures against armed groups.

text: Antes sini, sang Sabado, 27 man ka tawo ang patay sa Beu-Manyama, isa ka lugar sa Beni sa North Kivu — isa man ka pagpang-atake nga ginatudlo gihapon nga kahimuan sang ADF.
english: Earlier, on Saturday, 27 people were also killed in Beu-Manyama, an area of ​​Beni in North Kivu — another attack still blamed on the ADF.

text: Sang Marso, 30 man ka tawo ang patay sa North Kivu kag masobra 50 ka tawo ang patay sa duha ka adlaw nga pagpang-atake sa Irumu.
english: In March, 30 people were also killed in North Kivu and more than 50 people were killed in two days of attacks in Irumu.

text: Ang ADF ang ginakabig nga affiliate sang grupo nga Islamic State.
english: The ADF is considered an affiliate of the Islamic State group.

text: Nag-ugat ang ADF bilang isa ka rebel coalition halin sa Uganda.
english: The ADF took root as a rebel coalition from Uganda.

text: Ang pinakadako nga grupo sini ang ginalakipan sang mga Muslim nga nagapamatok kay President Yoweri Museveni, isa ka Ugandan politician kag retired senior military officer.
english: Its largest group includes Muslims opposed to President Yoweri Museveni, a Ugandan politician and retired senior military officer.

text: 40 ka tawo ang patay kag masobra 450 ang napilasan matapos ang chemical explosion sa isa ka shipping container depot sa Bangladesh.
english: 40 people have been killed and more than 450 injured after a chemical explosion at a shipping container depot in Bangladesh.

text: Lima sa mga natumod nga patay amo ang mga bombero nga nagresponde sa sunog.
english: Five of the identified dead were firefighters who responded to the fire.

text: Ginakahangaw-an nga madugangan pa ang numero sang mga patay bangud malala ang kondisyon sang mga injured.
english: The death toll is feared to rise as the injured are in critical condition.

text: Ginpahayag man sang mga volunteers nga madamo pa ang nabilin sa amo nga depot.
english: The volunteers also said there are still many people left at the depot.

text: 4,000 ka containers ang sulod sang depot kag kalabanan sa garments ang ipadala kuntani sa Western retailers.
english: The depot holds 4,000 containers and most of the garments were supposed to be sent to Western retailers.

text: Ginabanta nga 600 ka mga tawo ang nagatrabaho sa amo nga pasilidad.
english: An estimated 600 people work at that facility.

text: Ginahibalo pa subong kun ano ang rason sang nagluntad nga sunog.
english: The cause of the fire is still being investigated.

text: Ginpuhag sang panibag-o kag magkasunod nga mass shooting incidents ang duha ka estado sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: New and consecutive mass shooting incidents have rocked two states in the United States of America.

text: Duha ka lalaki kag isa ka babayi ang patay matapos nga nagpangluthang ang pila ka mga suspek sa South Street entertainment district sa Philadelphia — sa area kun sa diin madamo sang mga bars kag restaurants.
english: Two men and a woman are dead after several suspects opened fire in the South Street entertainment district in Philadelphia — an area where many bars and restaurants are located.

text: 12 man ang pilason sa amo nga insidente.
english: 12 were also injured in the incident.

text: Sa isa ka separado nga shooting incident, tatlo ka tawo ang patay kag 14 ang pilason sa bar sa Chattanooga sa Tennessee.
english: In a separate shooting incident, three people were killed and 14 injured at the bar in Chattanooga in Tennessee.

text: Suno sa local authorities, duha sa napatay ang tuga sang pagkaigu sang bala kag ang isa nabungguan sang salakyan sang buot ini nga magpalagyo gikan sa lugar kun sa diin natabo ang pagpangluthang.
english: According to local authorities, two of the dead were shot and one was hit by a vehicle while trying to flee the scene of the shooting.

text: Ini nga mga insidente ang kasunod man sang pagpatay sang isa ka gunman sa apat ka mga persona sa isa ka ospital sa Tulsa, Oklahoma.
english: The incidents also follow a gunman who killed four people at a hospital in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

text: Sang nagligad lang nga semana, 21 man ang patay sang ginsulod sang suspek ang isa ka eskwelahan sa Texas.
english: Just last week, 21 people were also killed when a suspect broke into a school in Texas.

text: Antes pa gid sini, may isa man ka 18-anyos nga lalaki nga nagluthang-patay man sa 10 ka Black people sa racist attack sa isa ka supermarket sa Buffalo, New York.
english: Earlier, an 18-year-old man also shot dead 10 Black people in a racist attack at a supermarket in Buffalo, New York.

text: Sa rekord sang Gun Violence Archive, isa ka nonprofit research group, ginapahayag nga may 240 na ka mass shootings ang natabo sa Estados Unidos subong nga tuig.
english: According to the Gun Violence Archive, a nonprofit research group, there have been 240 mass shootings in the United States this year.

text: Yari ang apelar ni US President Joe Biden — hingyo sa mga mamalidha sa pungsod nga aktuhan na ang nagalala nga gun violence sa Estados Unidos nga rason sang kamatayon sang madamo nga mga tawo sa nagakatabo nga masaker sa nanuhay-tuhay nga mga estado.
english: Here is the appeal of US President Joe Biden — a request to the country's lawmakers to act on the worsening gun violence in the United States that has caused the deaths of many people in the ongoing massacres in various states.

text: Nangin mabinungahon ang ginpatigayon nga community forum kaangot sa pagatukuron nga Waste to Energy project sa bag-o nga Sanitary Landfill sa Brgy.
english: The community forum regarding the construction of the Waste to Energy project at the new Sanitary Landfill in Brgy.

text: Ingore, La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: Ingore, La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Ini kasunod man sa pagpabutyag sang pumuluyo sang nasambit nga lugar batok sa nasambit nga pasilidad.
english: This follows the expression of the residents of the said area against the said facility.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Charlie Capiral, residente sang nasambit nga barangay, iya ginpahayag nga kontani matuman ang tanan nga mga ginpromisa sa ila, kaangay sang pag-control sang basura agud nga indi maglapta kag magbaho.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Charlie Capiral, a resident of the said barangay, said he hopes that all the promises made to them will be fulfilled, such as the control of garbage so that it does not spread and smell.

text: Suno kay Capiral, mas makapamaayo sa ila kon direkta nga i-process ang basura agud nga indi na magtambak.
english: According to Capiral, it would be better for them if the garbage is directly processed so that it does not pile up.

text: Gin-highlight man sa aktibidad ang kinalain sang Calajunan Sanitary Landfill sa Mandurriao.
english: The activity also highlighted the differences between the Calajunan Sanitary Landfill in Mandurriao.

text: Nagalaum man ang natungdan nga makabulig sa ila ang mga benepisyo nga mahatag sang pasilidad.
english: He also hopes that the benefits provided by the facility will help them.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa sa mga concern ang ginpabutyag sa forum amo ang ikaayong lawas sang mga residente ilabi na ang paguwa-sulod sang mga truck nga nagahakot sang basura.
english: One of the concerns expressed at the forum was the health of the residents especially the entry and exit of garbage trucks.

text: Nabalaka ang mga nagapamasura sa sanitary landfill sa Calajunan, Mandurriao sa tion nga ipauntat na ang operasyon sini.
english: Garbage collectors at the sanitary landfill in Calajunan, Mandurriao are worried about the time when its operation will be stopped.

text: Ini may kaangtanan sa 10-year operational period sang landfill nga magatakop na sa 2026 matapos ang 10 ka tuig humalin sang ginbuksan ini sang 2016.
english: This is in connection with the 10-year operational period of the landfill which will end in 2026 after 10 years since it was opened in 2016.

text: Buslan ini sang tukuron nga pinakauna nga waste to energy project sa Ingore, La Paz.
english: It will be replaced by the first waste to energy project in Ingore, La Paz.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lilia Animas, kun mag-untat gid ang operasyon sang landfill, mapilitan na lang ini nga mag-untat man sang pagpamasura.
Dako naman ang pasalamat sini nga paagi sa pagpamasura, napatapos niya sa pagtuon ang iya kabataan gani nasiguro man sini nga saguron siya sang iya kabataan kun wala na siya sang obra.
english: She is very grateful that by collecting garbage, she was able to finish her children's studies and she is also sure that her children will take care of her when she loses her job.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Barangay Kagawad Efrain Tagaytayan, iya ginpahayagan nga nakasugilanon sila kay General Services Office head Neil Ravena sa kun ano ang matabo sa mga pumuluyo nga nagapangbasura.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Barangay Kagawad Efrain Tagaytayan said they have discussed with General Services Office head Neil Ravena what will happen to the residents who litter.

text: Suno kay Tagaytayan, nagpasalig man si Ravena nga indi pagpabay-an ang maapektuhan nga mga pumuluyo.
english: According to Tagaytayan, Ravena also assured that the affected residents will not be neglected.

text: Nahibaluan nga kapin sa 200 ka mga pumuluyo sa Calajunan ang nagapamasura bilang palangitan-an.
english: It is known that more than 200 residents in Calajunan are garbage collectors.

text: Sa tion nga matapos ang proyekto sa Ingore, makasarang ini magproseso sang 475 tons sang solid waste per day.
english: Once the Ingore project is completed, it will be able to process 475 tons of solid waste per day.

text: Ini maka- produce sang tubtob 3.5 megawatts sang power agud mag- augment sa 10 megawatts para sa tukuron nga desalination plant nga sarang naman mag-produce sang water supply sa mas manubo nga cost para sa consumers.
english: It will produce up to 3.5 megawatts of power to augment to 10 megawatts for the construction of a desalination plant that can produce water supply at a lower cost for consumers.

text: Nadugangan sang 436 ka panibag-o nga kaso sang COVID-19 ang Western Visayas.
english: Western Visayas has an additional 436 new cases of COVID-19.

text: Sa sini nga new cases, 125 ang halin sa Aklan, 2 sa Guimaras, 143 sa Iloilo Province, 78 sa Negros Occidental, 28 sa Bacolod City, kag 60 sa Iloilo City.
english: Of these new cases, 125 are from Aklan, 2 from Guimaras, 143 from Iloilo Province, 78 from Negros Occidental, 28 from Bacolod City, and 60 from Iloilo City.

text: As of July 19, nagsaka na sa 77,880 ang reported nga kabug-usan nga nagpositibo sa COVID-19 sa Rehiyon VI.
english: As of July 19, the reported total number of COVID-19 positives in Region VI has risen to 77,880.

text: 11,140 sa sini ang active cases.
english: 11,140 of these are active cases.

text: 438 naman ang reported nga bag-o nga naka-recover gani nga nagsaka na sa 64,936 ang kabug-usan nga nag-ayo sa balatian sa rehiyon.
english: 438 new recoveries were reported, bringing the total number of recoveries in the region to 64,9

english: The death toll rose to 1,783 with 17 new deaths.
