text: Patay ang 8 ka mga indibidwal lakip na ang isa ka 8 ka tuig nga Fil-Am, matapos ang mass shooting sa isa ka birthday party sa sulod sang isa ka banquet hall sa Stockton, California sang Sabado sang gab-i Nobyembre 30.
english: Eight individuals, including an 8-year-old Fil-Am, are dead after a mass shooting at a birthday party inside a banquet hall in Stockton, California on Saturday night November 30th.

text: Nahibaluan nga Kapin isa ka gatos ka mga tawo nga nagatambong sa selebrasyon sang nagsugod ang pagpaniro, na ginalakipan sang 8 ka tuig, 9,14 kag 21 ka-anyos ang napatay sa nasambit nga brutal nga krimen.
english: It was learned that more than 100 people who were attending the celebration when the shooting began, including 8 years old, 9, 14 and 21 years old were killed in the said brutal crime.

text: Ginlaragway sang mga otoridad ang insidente bilang isa ka “targeted attack” nga posible ginpatigayon sang madamo nga gunman.
english: Authorities described the incident as a “targeted attack” likely carried out by multiple gunmen.

text: Nagapanawagan ang FBI kag San Joaquin County Sheriff’s Office sang bulig gikan sa publiko para matultulan ang mga responsible sa likod sang nasambit nga krimen.
english: The FBI and San Joaquin County Sheriff's Office are calling for the public's help to identify those responsible behind the crime.

text: Gin-athag ni anay Vice President Leni Robredo kag subong Naga City Mayor nga indi pagdal-on ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Former Vice President Leni Robredo and current Naga City Mayor clarified that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang istorya-pulitika sa iya pagbisita subong nga adlaw sa Naga.
english: the political story during his visit today to Naga.

text: Ginalauman nga magakit-anay ang duha subong nga weekend para sa implementasyon sang Oplan Kontra Baha sa Naga City, Camarines Sur.
english: The two are expected to meet this weekend for the implementation of Oplan Kontra Baha in Naga City, Camarines Sur.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagtuhaw ang possible nga alyansa sa tunga ni Marcos kag Robredo halin sang gin-anunsyo ang ila nga meeting subong nga adlaw.
english: It is known that a possible alliance between Marcos and Robredo has emerged since their meeting was announced today.

text: Suno naman kay Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, ang naka-schedule nga pagbisita ni Marcos sa Naga City subong nga adlaw sang Sabado, Pebrero 21, may kaangtanan sa mga tikang sang gobyerno batok sa pagbaha.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, Marcos' scheduled visit to Naga City today, Saturday, February 21, is related to the government's measures against flooding.

text: Suno pa kay Castro, indi pamulitika kag tuman pa kalayo ang eleksyon.
english: Castro said the election is not political and is still far away.

text: Nagpanawagan man ang Malacañang sa publiko nga untatan na ang magahod nga mga ekspekulasyon sa politika bangud naga-focus ang mga opisyal sa ila tagsa ka mga trabaho agud indi ang mga ini ma-distract sa tagsa nila ka mga obligasyon.
english: Malacañang also called on the public to stop noisy political speculations as officials focus on their respective jobs so that they are not distracted from their respective obligations.

text: Gin-athag man ni Robredo nga malayo pa sa iya nga pinsar ang pulitika bangud nga nagatutok siya subong sa mga problema sang iya syudad.
english: Robredo also explained that politics is far from his mind because he is now focused on the problems of his city.

text: Ini nga statement ni Robredo ang kasunod man sang mga espekulasyon nga siya ang makasumpong ni Vice President Sara Duterte sa presidential elections sa 2028.
english: Robredo's statement also follows speculation that she will challenge Vice President Sara Duterte in the 2028 presidential elections.

text: Pahayag sini, tuman pa ka layo ang eleksyon, kag wala pa gani siya naka-isa ka tuig sa iya posisyon subong kag sa iya obligasyon sa iya nag syudad.
english: He said the election is still far away, and he has not even been in his current position for a year and in his obligations to his city.

text: Sang Myerkules sang gindeklarar ni Duterte ang iya presidential bid.
english: On Wednesday, Duterte declared his presidential bid.

text: ILOILO CITY- Kalabanan sa aton ang nagainom sang kape agud indi pagtuyhon kun kita ang nagatuon para sa exam.
english: ILOILO CITY- Most of us drink coffee to avoid being distracted when we are studying for exams.

text: Apang sa China,may pinasahi nga pamaagi nga ginhimo ang isa ka bata agud batuan ang iya katuyo.
english: But in China, there is a special way that a child has done to resist his purpose.

text: Sa Xi-an province sa China, may yara sang bata nga lalaki ang nangin kontrobersiyal matapos nga nakahimo ini sang tumalagsahon kag wala ginalauman nga pamaagi tuga sang pagka- desperado niya nga indi makabatyag sang katuyo.
english: In China's Xi-an province, a boy became controversial after he performed a strange and unexpected procedure out of desperation.

text: Ang iya ginhimo, nangita siya sang dagum, kag gintuslok niya ini sa iya kinatawo.
english: What he did was, he found a needle, and he stuck it in his vagina.

text: Natigayon nga makabugtaw ang bata sang malawig nga inoras para makatuon apang sang nagbatyag na ini sang kasakit sa sulod sang iya kinatawo,diri na kag iya ini gin-ako sa iya iloy.
english: The child managed to stay awake for a long time to study but when he felt pain inside his vagina, he admitted it to his mother.

text: Gilayon nga gindala sa ospital ang bata kag nakuha ang 10 cm kalaba nga dagum sang iya lola.
english: The child was rushed to the hospital and his grandmother's 10 cm long needle was recovered.

text: Madamo naman ang nagduda nga ang ginhimo sang bata ang indi bangud nga gusto niya solusyunan ang iya katuyo.
english: Many suspected that the boy's actions were not because he wanted to solve his problem.

text: Madamo ang nagapati nga pamaagi lang ini sang bata sa pag-explore sang iya sekswalidad kag lawas apang wala lang nagmadinalag-on.
english: Many believed it was just a child’s way of exploring her sexuality and body but it just didn’t work.

text: May yara sa gihapon sang pondo ang P20 per kilo rice program sang gobyerno sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The government's P20 per kilo rice program still has funds next year.

text: Suno kay Budget Secretary Amenah Pangandaman nga nalakip sagihapon ang nasambit nga programa sa proposed nga pondo para sa 2026.
english: Budget Secretary Amenah Pangandaman said the program is still included in the proposed fund for 2026.

text: Suno diri, ini ang may budget nga masobra sa P10 billion kag napaidalom sa rice for all program sang Department of Agriculture.
english: He said it has a budget of more than P10 billion and is under the rice for all program of the Department of Agriculture.

text: Tinutuyo man sang budget nga padamuon ang mga posible magbakal sang masarangan nga presyo sang bugas.
english: The budget also aims to increase the number of potential buyers of affordable rice.

text: Sa subong, nalakip naman ang mga mangunguma sa mahimo makabakal sang P20/kilo nga bugas matapos magsugod na nga magbaligya ang 18 warehouses sang National Food Authority sa Central kag Northern Luzon.
english: Meanwhile, farmers are among those who can buy P20/kilo rice after 18 warehouses of the National Food Authority in Central and Northern Luzon started selling.

text: Pangunahan sang Archdiocese of Jaro ang pagpangamuyo kag prusisyon kadungan sang ika-40 nga anibersaryo sang EDSA People Power Revolution subong nga adlaw, Pebrero 25.
english: The Archdiocese of Jaro will lead a prayer and procession in conjunction with the 40th anniversary of the EDSA People Power Revolution today, February 25.

text: Isa ini sa 86 ka mga diocese kag archdiocese nga magahiwat sang kaangay sini nga aktibidad sa lain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: It is one of 86 dioceses and archdioceses that will hold similar activities in different parts of the country.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Msgr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC), iya ginpahayag nga diri sa Iloilo, gin-organisar ini sa pagpanguna sang Commission on Laity nga ginabuylugan sang nagkalain-lain nga religious organizations kag mandated organizations.
english: Meliton Oso, director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC), said that here in Iloilo, it was organized under the leadership of the Commission on Laity with the participation of various religious organizations and mandated organizations.

text: Sandig sa schedule sang simbahan, alas dos karon sa hapon, magatipon ang mga katapo sang Commission on Laity kag nagkalain-lain nga mga parokya para sa Novena sa St.
english: According to the church schedule, at 2 pm today, members of the Commission on Laity and various parishes will gather for a Novena at St.

text: Clement’s Church.
english: Clement’s Church.

text: Halin sa amo nga simbahan, patigayunon ang prusisyon padulong sa Jaro Cathedral kaupod ang imahen sang Mahal nga Birhen sang Guadalupe kag imahen sang Mahal nga Birhen sang Fatima.
english: From the church, the procession will be held to the Jaro Cathedral with the image of the Blessed Virgin of Guadalupe and the image of the Blessed Virgin of Fatima.

text: Samtang padayon ang prusisyon, maga-pangamuyo ang tanan sang Santos nga Rosaryo.
english: As the procession continues, everyone will pray the Holy Rosary.

text: Alas kwatro sa hapon naman ang Santos nga Misa sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral nga pangunahan ni Jaro Archbishop Most Reverend Midyphil B. Billones, D.D. kaupod ang iban nga kaparian.
english: At 4 pm, the Holy Mass will be celebrated at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral presided over by Jaro Archbishop Most Reverend Midyphil B. Billones, D.D. along with other priests.

text: Pagkatapos sang misa, may patigayunon nga candle-lighting nga amo ang pagtakop sang mobilisasyon sa amo nga adlaw.
english: After the mass, a candle-lighting will be held to conclude the mobilization for the day.

text: Matandaan nga may duha na ka hugnat sang Trillion Peso March nga natabo sang Septyembre 21 kag Nobyembre 30, 2025, apang ini nga mobilisasyon suno kay Msgr.
english: It can be recalled that there are already two phases of the Trillion Peso March that took place on September 21 and November 30, 2025, but this mobilization according to Msgr.

text: Oso amo ang “very prayerful” nga akto nga may yara sang misa kag prusisyon sa baylo sang nakaandan nga martsa.
english: Oso is a “very prayerful” act with a mass and procession instead of the usual march.

text: Ginapangabay man sang Archdiocese of Jaro sa mga maga-upod sa prusisyon nga magsuksok sang puti nga panapton sa amo nga adlaw.
english: The Archdiocese of Jaro also requests those who will join the procession to wear white clothes on the day.

text:
PANAWAGAN BATOK SA POLITICAL DYNASTY

Ipanawagan man sang Simbahan Katolika kadungan sang mobilisasyon angpagtapna sa political dynasties sa Pilipinas.
english:
CALL AGAINST POLITICAL DYNASTY

The Catholic Church will also call for the end of political dynasties in the Philippines.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Msgr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Msgr.

text: Oso, iya ginpahayag nga ini nga dinastiya amo man ang ugat sang kurapsyon.
english: Oso, he stated that this dynasty is also the root of corruption.

text: Ipangamuyo kag ipanawagan sang Simbahan nga mangin sinsero kag seryoso man ang Kongreso sa pagpasar sang mga hagna batok sa nakaandan nga pagpasa-pasa sang gahum sa magpamilya sa pulitika.
english: The Church prays and calls that Congress will also be sincere and serious in passing bills against the usual transfer of power to political families.

text: Ginbalikan sang JASAC Director ang statement nga gin-isyu sang Catholic Bishops Conference of the Philippines-Episcopal Commission on Catholic Education, Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines, kag iban pa nga nagapanawagan sa paglakip sang pila ka mga probisyon sa anti-political dynasty bills nga pareho nga pending sa Kamara kag Senado.
english: The JASAC Director reiterated the statement issued by the Catholic Bishops Conference of the Philippines-Episcopal Commission on Catholic Education, Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines, and others calling for the inclusion of certain provisions in the anti-political dynasty bills both pending in the House and Senate.

text: Sandig sa ginaduso sang church-based groups, limitahan lamang sa “maximum of two relatives per family” ang makauyat sang elective position nga isa sa local office kag isa sa national position kag indi dapat mag-overlap ang jurisdiction.
english: According to the proposal of church-based groups, only a maximum of two relatives per family can hold elective positions, one in the local office and one in the national position, and there should be no overlap in jurisdiction.

text: Ginsuhestyon man nga indi pagpasugtan ang mga maghimata tubtub sa fourth civil degree of consanguinity ukon affinity nga dungan nga makapungko sa elective positions.
english: It was also suggested that relatives up to the fourth civil degree of consanguinity or affinity should not be allowed to sit simultaneously in elective positions.

text: Pahayag ni Oso, nagalaum ang Social Action Network sang Simbahan nga indi pakulahaw kag indi lunsay lip-service lang ang ginaproponer nga mga hagna.
english: Oso said the Social Action Network of the Church hopes that the proposed bills are not just lip-service.

text: Matandaan nga nagmandu si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: It can be recalled that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa Kongreso nga hatagan sang prayoridad ang legislation nga amo ang magadumili sang political dynasties.
english: to Congress to give priority to legislation that would ban political dynasties.

text: Kabug-usan nga 24 ka anti-political dynasty bills ang na-file subong sa Kamara kag Senado lakip na ang House Bill 6771 nga ginduso nanday Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy kag presidential son kag House Majority Leader Ferdinand Alexander Marcos.#
english: A total of 24 anti-political dynasty bills are currently filed in the House and Senate including House Bill 6771 proposed by Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy and presidential son and House Majority Leader Ferdinand Alexander Marcos.

text: Balantayan 8:00 subong nga aga oras sa Pilipinas ang Game 2 sa National Basketball Association (NBA) Finals sa tunga sang Oklahoma City Thunder kag Indiana Pacers.
english: Watch Game 2 of the National Basketball Association (NBA) Finals between the Oklahoma City Thunder and Indiana Pacers at 8:00 this morning Philippine time.

text: Patigayunon ini gihapon sa Paycom Center nga home court sang Thunder.
english: It will still be held at the Paycom Center, the home court of the Thunder.

text: Matapos ang upset nga nahimo sa Game 1, tuyo ni Tyrese Haliburton kag Pacers nga pasagunsunan ini subong nga adlaw kag makuha ang 2-0 series lead antes dal-on ang finals sa Indianapolis sa state sang Indiana.
english: After the upset in Game 1, Tyrese Haliburton and the Pacers intend to turn it around today and take a 2-0 series lead before taking the finals to Indianapolis in the state of Indiana.

text: Sang Byernes (PST), napanas sang Pacers ang 15-puntos nga abanse sang Thunder sa fourth quarter.
english: On Friday (PST), the Pacers erased a 15-point Thunder lead in the fourth quarter.

text: Nangin highlight naman ang game-winning shot ni Haliburton sang 0.3 seconds ang nabilin sa hampang nga amo ang nagpadaog sa Indiana, 111-110.
english: Haliburton's game-winning shot with 0.3 seconds left in the game was the highlight, giving Indiana a 111-110 win.

text: Determinado naman ang Oklahoma sa pagpanguna sang star point guard kag newly crowned Most Valuable Player (MVP) nga si Shai Gilgeous-Alexander nga makabawi matapos nakalusot ang Indiana sa Game 1.
english: Oklahoma, led by star point guard and newly crowned Most Valuable Player (MVP) Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, is determined to recover after Indiana slipped in Game 1.

text: Sa una nga hampang, nakahimo si SGA sang 38 puntos, five rebounds, three assists kag three steals.
english: In the first game, SGA tallied 38 points, five rebounds, three assists and three steals.

text: Ini nga 38 puntos amo ang ikatatlo sa pinakamataas nga na-skor sa NBA finals debut sang isa ka player kasunod sang nahimo nanday Allen Iverson nga may 48 points kag George Mikan nga may 42 points.
english: These 38 points are the third-highest scored in an NBA finals debut by a player behind what Allen Iverson did with 48 points and George Mikan with 42 points.

text: OKEY ining community pantry, nga isa ka version sang Bayanihan sa pagbinuligay.
english: OKEY this community pantry, which is a version of Bayanihan in cooperation.

text: In fact, duna gani ini nga pamatasan pang-komunidad sang mga Filipino.
english: In fact, there is even a community behavior among Filipinos.

text: Diri ginabaton ang mga bulig sang may ikasarang para sa isigkapareho nga nagakinahanglan sing dayon nga bulig sunu sa ila pagkinahanglan sa ila panimalay sa amo nga tion.
english: Here the donations of the able are received for their fellowmen in need of permanent assistance according to their needs in their homes at that time.

text: Indi katingalahan nga nag-popular dayon ining community pantry nga ginsuguran sang Maginhawa Community Pantry sa Quezon City.
english: Not surprisingly, this community pantry, which was started by the Maginhawa Community Pantry in Quezon City, immediately became popular.

text: In fact, sugod sadtong pagtukod sini sadtong Abril 19, madasig na nga nag-ululhot ang mga ini sa iban nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: In fact, since its establishment on April 19, they have quickly spread to other parts of the country.

text: Pati ang mga media outlets nag-ulupod na.
english: Even media outlets have joined forces.

text: Natural man lang nga mag-popular ini.
english: Naturally, it will become popular.

text: Madale mag-popular ang isa ka bagay nga bag-o, ukon madugay na nga nalipatan apang liwat nagtuhaw, nga nagapakita dayon sing pagka-mapuslanon sa mga tawo, labi na gid kon makabulig dayon katulad sa ini nga panahon sang pandemic (COVID-19), kon diin madamo ang wala sing trabaho ukon nagakita sing kulang sa ila kinahanglanon.
english: It is easy for something new, or long forgotten but reappearing, to become popular, which immediately shows its usefulness to people, especially if it can help immediately as in this time of pandemic (COVID-19), where many are unemployed or earn less than they need.

text: Sa nasiling ta na gani, duna na nga binatasan sang mga Filipino ang pagbinuligay sang magkasilingan, labi na gid sa mga kubos nga panimalay, sang pwede nila mahulam, ukon mapangayo, nga pila ka bagay nga nawad-an sila kag kinahanglan dayon.
english: As we have already said, Filipinos have a habit of helping their neighbors, especially the poor, when they can borrow, or ask for, some things that they have lost and need immediately.

text: Sa ini nga binatasan, nagahulamay ukon nagapangayuay ang magkasilingan sing asin, kalamay, panimpla sa tinola nga katumbal, sibuyas, patis kag bisan pa gani bugas nga tilig-angon, ukon ano pa.
english: In this custom, neighbors borrow or ask each other for salt, sugar, spices, onions, patis and even rice, or something else.

text: In fact, kon basehan mo ini sa ining pamatasan sang pagbinuligay sang magkasilingan, ang community pantry wala sing kinalis sa sining duna nga pamatasan.
english: In fact, if you base it on this behavior of neighborly cooperation, the community pantry is no different from this inherent behavior.

text: Ginpalapad lang ining magkasilingan nga pagbinuligay sang community pantry.
english: This neighborhood collaboration was just extended by the community pantry.

text: Sa lugar nga magpalapit ka sa pihak balay sang imo dayon nga kinahanglanon, may kadtuan ka na nga pwesto kon diin madamo na ang makahatag kag makapangayo sang kinahanglanon.
english: Instead of going to the other side of the house for your immediate need, you have a place where many people can give and ask for what they need.

text: In other words indi bag-o nga ideya ining community pantry.
english: In other words, this community pantry is not a new idea.

text: Daan na ini nga ideya sang pagbinuligay sang magkasilingan nga ginpalapad lang ang gahatag bulig kag ang maka-benepisyo agud matawag na nga community pantry.
english: This is an old idea of ​​neighborhood cooperation that has just expanded the donor and the beneficiary to be called a community pantry.

Ang problema ugaling kay nangin kontrobersyal ini tungod sa palpak nga approach sang kapulisan.
english:

The problem, however, is that it became controversial due to the police's failed approach.

text: Sala ang ila priority approach, kon diin naggwa pa nga sablag sila sa kaayuhan nga dulot sining community pantry sa mga pumuluyo.
english: Their priority approach is wrong, where it turns out that they are an obstacle to the benefits that this community pantry brings to the people.

text: Amo gani nga ang matag-as nga pamunuan sang kapulisan nagsaway na sa mga pulis sa indi nila tani ginhimo.
english: That's why the top police leadership has reprimanded the police for what they should not have done.

text: Si President Duterte, paagi sa iya spokesperson nga si Harry Roque, nagsaway man gani sa sining mga kapulisan agud pabay-an lang ang community pantry kon indi man lang ginagamit ini sa pagpakalain sa gobyerno sang mga progresibo nga mga grupo.
english: President Duterte, through his spokesperson Harry Roque, even reprimanded these policemen for neglecting the community pantry if it is not being used to criticize the government by progressive groups.

text: Ang report nagsiling nga ginakuhaan sang kapulisan sing ngalan ang mga organizer, kon ano ang ila organisasyon kag kon sin-o ang mga nagahatag sang mga produkto nga ginapanghatag, kag iban pa nga impormasyon.
english: The report said that the police are taking the names of the organizers, what their organization is and who are the suppliers of the products being distributed, among other information.

text: Suno sa mga abogado indi dapat ini ginhimo sang kapulisan tungod sa ila kinamatarong sa “privacy”, ukon pang-kaugalingon nga impormasyon.
english: The lawyers said the police should not have done this because of their right to privacy.

text: Sala gid man ining ginhimo sang kapulisan.
english: What the police did was wrong.

text: Nag-focus ang kapulisan sa ila suspetso nga may malain nga agenda ang pila ka organizer – nga posible ini mga supporter sang “communist terrorists”, kag ang ila proyekto nga community pantry isa lang ka paagi sa pagpakalain sa gobyerno.
english: The police focused on their suspicion that some of the organizers had an evil agenda – that they were possibly supporters of “communist terrorists”, and that their community pantry project was just a way to criticize the government.

text: Siling ugaling sang kapulisan nga wala man sila sang malain nga tuyu sa ila mga ginapamangkot kundi agud maamligan mismo ang interes sang mga pumuluyo.
english: However, the police said they have no malicious intent in their questions but to protect the interests of the residents.

text: Nakamuno ugaling ang iban kon paano ini masiling sang kapulisan kay wala man gani ining nagapatigayon sang community pantry sing dala nga mga  propaganda materials ukon pabutyag nga kontra sa gobyerno.
english: However, some wondered how the police could say this because the community pantry operator did not even carry propaganda materials or anti-government statements.

text: Ang husto tani ng approach amo ang una nga pag-focus sa mas importante naton nga problema batok sa COVID-19 – kon bala nagasunod ini sila sa minimum health protocol katulad sa paggamit sa face mask, ace shield, kag physical distancing, kag kon bala may permit ini, kon kinahanglan gid.
english: The right approach should be to focus on our more important problem against COVID-19 – whether they are following minimum health protocols such as the use of face masks, ace shields, and physical distancing, and whether they have a permit, if necessary.

text: Ulihi na lang ang mga suspetso.
english: It's too late for the suspects.

text: May tion dira.
english: There is time there.

text: Anyway kon wala man lang sila nagadala sang propaganda kontra gobyerno upod sa ila community pantry, wala man seguro sing malain da.
english: Anyway, if they don't bring anti-government propaganda with their community pantry, there's probably nothing wrong with that.

text: Sigeha lang ya ang inyo surveillance kag intelligence work.
english: Keep up your surveillance and intelligence work.

text: Makahulat ina.
english: That can wait.

text: Pero indi ang aton problema sa COVID-19.
english: But not our problem with COVID-19.

english: The Philippines and the United States also have a VFA that was launched in 1999 and now serves as the legal framework for US forces to temporarily visit Manila for military exercises and to provide humanitarian and disaster-response assistance.

text:
Gin-evacuate ang mga personnel sang Office of the Vice President (OVP) kaina sang hapon matapos nakabaton ang isa sa ila sang text message nga ginaalegar nagaunod sang “bomb threat.”

english:
Personnel of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) were evacuated yesterday afternoon after one of them received a text message allegedly containing a “bomb threat.”

text: Nahibaluan nga ginsundan ni Sara ang iya amay matapos ini gindala sa The Hague agud atubangon ang charges nga crimes against humanity sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Sara followed her father after he was brought to The Hague to face charges of crimes against humanity at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Nangin positibo ang reaksyon sang pila ka mga negosyante nga nagabaligya sang bugas sa Iloilo Terminal Market kasunod sang pagdeklarar sang Department of Agriculture (DA) sang Food Security Emergency sa bugas.
english: Some traders selling rice in the Iloilo Terminal Market have reacted positively following the Department of Agriculture (DA)'s declaration of a Food Security Emergency on rice.

text: Ini kasunod sang indi mapunggan nga pagtaas sang presyo sang bugas sa merkado.
english: This follows the unstoppable rise in rice prices in the market.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Edward Boco, manogbaligya sang bugas, iya ginpahayag nga maayo ang tikang nga ginpatuman sang gobyerno bangud posible nga makabulig ini sa kadam-an ilabi na sa mga pigado.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Edward Boco, a rice seller, said the government's initiative is good because it is likely to help the public especially the poor.

text: Nagalaum man ang natungdan nga magadamo ang iya mga customers kasunod sang pagdeklarar sang Food Security Emergency sa bugas.
english: He also hopes that his customers will increase following the declaration of Food Security Emergency on rice.

text: Suno kay Boco, nagasalig siya nga magnubo man ang presyo sang bugas nga iya ginabul-an agud nga ibaligya.
english: According to Boco, he hopes that the price of rice he harvests will also drop.

text: Nagapati man ini nga bisan papaano makakaon na ang mga imol nga nagapanghakroy sa presyo sang bugas.
english: He also believes that somehow the poor who are struggling with the price of rice will be able to eat.

text: Subong, ginabaligya sini ang iya imported rice sa balor nga P58 per kilo, samtang P54 tubtob P50 per kilo naman ang local rice.
english: Currently, he sells his imported rice at P58 per kilo, while local rice is P54 to P50 per kilo.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginbasehan sang National Price Coordinating Council (NPCC) ang data sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) kun sa diin naglab-ot ang rice inflation sa 17.9 percent sang September 2023.
english: The National Price Coordinating Council (NPCC) based on data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) showed that rice inflation reached 17.9 percent in September 2023.

text: Lapaw ini sa upper band sang target sang gobyerno nga 4 percent para sa food inflation
english: This is above the upper band of the government’s target of 4 percent for food inflation

text: Ginsaway sang Malacañang ang mga sentimento nga nagakumparar kay president Rodrigo Duterte kay anay senador Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino Jr.
english: Malacañang condemned sentiments comparing President Rodrigo Duterte to former senator Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino Jr.

text: Suno kay Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, wala sang basehan para sa ginapahayag nga pamahog sa kabuhi ni Duterte.
english: According to Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, there is no basis for the alleged threat to Duterte's life.

text: Kasunod ini sang ginpahayag nga ginhambalan ni Vice President Sara Duterte ang iya amay nga posible ini nga mangin si Ninoy nga gin-assassinate sa iya pagbalik sa Manila matapos ini gin-exile.
english: This follows reports that Vice President Sara Duterte told her father that he might be Ninoy who was assassinated on his return to Manila after his exile.

text: Si former president Duterte ang yara sa kustodiya sang International Criminal Court (ICC) sa The Hague sa The Netherlands.
english: Former president Duterte is in the custody of the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague in The Netherlands.

text: Ginpahayag ni Castro nga wala ini sang kamatuoran kag natingala ini kun sa diin naghalin ang ginaalegar nga threat kay Duterte.
english: Castro said this is not true and he wondered where the alleged threat to Duterte came from.

text: Suno kay Castro, indi dapat pagkumparar si former president Duterte kay late senator Aquino bangud wala gid sila sang pagkapareho ilabi na sa isyu nga naangot sa ila.
english: Castro said former president Duterte should not be compared to late senator Aquino because they have nothing in common especially on issues related to them.

text: Pahayag ni Castro, si Ninoy Aquino ang wala sang ano man nga record sang mass murder ukon crimes against humanity.
english: Castro said Ninoy Aquino has no record of mass murder or crimes against humanity.

text: Dugang niya, si Duterte ang nagkumparar sa iya kaugalingon sa late dictator nga si Adolf Hitler bangud sa pagmasaker sa minilyon nga mga Jews.
english: He added that Duterte compared himself to late dictator Adolf Hitler for massacring millions of Jews.

text: Nagplastar na sang timeline ang Pre-Trial Chamber I sang International Criminal Court (ICC) agud makapasa sang mga ebidensya ang prosecution kag ang kampo ni former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte.
english: The Pre-Trial Chamber I of the International Criminal Court (ICC) has set a timeline for the prosecution and the camp of former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte to submit evidence.

text: Sa order nga napetsahan sang Marso 21, ginsiling sang chamber nga dapat nga ipahibalo sang prosecution kag defense kun ano ka damo kag kun ano nga mga ebidensya ang ila ginaplano nga ipresentar.
english: In an order dated March 21, the chamber said the prosecution and defense must disclose how much and what evidence they plan to present.

text: Sa Abril 4, dapat nga napasa na sang prosecution ang information sa kabug-usan nga numero sang nakasulat nga mga ebidensya, kun tuyo bala nila nga maggamit sang iban nga non-written nga documentary evidence, kag kun pila ka mga testigo kag witness statements ang ila nga ihatag.
english: By April 4, the prosecution should have submitted information on the total number of written evidence, whether they intend to use other non-written documentary evidence, and how many witnesses and witness statements they will provide.

text: Ginmanduan man ang prosecution nga magpresentar kun paano ini mag-request sang protective measures para sa potential witnesses, kun magapadayon ini sa imbestigasyon kay Duterte, kag kun paano sini maapektuhan ang disclosure process.
english: The prosecution was also ordered to present how it will request protective measures for potential witnesses, whether it will continue to investigate Duterte, and how it will affect the disclosure process.

text: Para naman sa defense, ginhatagan ang kampo sang tubtub sa Abril 11 agud nga magpasa sang ila nga obserbasyon sa information nga i-sumite sang prosecution.
english: For the defense, the camp was given until April 11 to submit its observations on the information to be submitted by the prosecution.

text: Sabton man nila kun magapresentar sila sang ebidensya kag magapatawag bala sila sang kaugalingon nga witnesses kadungan sang confirmation hearing.
english: They will also answer whether they will present evidence and whether they will call their own witnesses during the confirmation hearing.

text: Kaangot naman sa partisipasyon sang mga biktima, naghatag ang ICC sang tubtub April 2, 2025 agud maka-file sang observations kaangot sa applications for participation sang mga biktima lakip na ang admission process, ang proof of identity documents, kag ang legal representation sa proceedings.
english: Regarding the participation of the victims, the ICC has given until April 2, 2025 to file observations regarding the applications for participation of the victims including the admission process, the proof of identity documents, and the legal representation in the proceedings.

text: Ang duha ka kampo ang hatagan naman sang tubtub sa April 11, 2025 agud nga makasabat.
english: Both camps will be given until April 11, 2025 to respond.

text: Una na nga gin-anunsyo sang Pre-Trial Chamber presiding judge nga gin-schedule sini sa Septyembre 23, 2025 ang confirmation of charges kay Duterte sa ginapangatubang sini nga kaso nga crimes against humanity nga nag-ugat sa kontrobersyal sini nga drug war campaign.
english: Earlier, the Pre-Trial Chamber presiding judge announced that he has scheduled for September 23, 2025 the confirmation of charges against Duterte in the case he is facing crimes against humanity stemming from his controversial drug war campaign.

text: Marso 11 sang gindakop ang former president sang nag-abot ini sa NAIA halin sa Hong Kong.#
english: The former president was arrested on March 11 when he arrived at NAIA from Hong Kong.

text: ILOILO CITY- Sin-o bala ang indi pagkiligon kun adlaw-adlaw ikaw nga ginatimplahan sang kape sang imo kahagugma,bana ukon asawa.
english: ILOILO CITY- Who doesn't like it when your lover, husband or wife makes you coffee every day.

text: Indi bala sa pamatyagan mo espesyal ka?
english: Don't you feel special?

text: Apang paano kun ang ini nga kape nga nagapakilig sa imo amo man gali ang rason sang imo mangin kamatayon.
english: But what if this coffee that makes you excited is actually the cause of your death.

text: Didto sa Michigan, may isa ka lalaki nga ginsilutan sang mamag-an nga sentensiya matapos mapamatud-an nga guilty sa pagbutang sa kape sang iya asawa sang high doses sang sleeping pills adlaw-adlaw.
english: In Michigan, a man was given a light sentence after being found guilty of putting high doses of sleeping pills in his wife's coffee every day.

text: Si Therese Kozlowski ang nagfile sang divorce gikan sa iya bana nga si Brian, sang June sang 2018 pa apang nagpadayon sila nga nagaistar sa isa lang ka balay.
english: Therese Kozlowski filed for divorce from her husband, Brian, back in June of 2018 but they continued to live in the same house.

text: Si Brian pa gani ang nagatimpla sang kape para sa iya adlaw-adlaw apang gin-gamit gali ini sang bana nga oportunidad agud paimnun siya sang delikado nga doses sang diphenhydramine, isa ka antihistamine nga ginagamit sa pagbulong sa allergies kag insomnia.
english: Brian even made coffee for her every day but her husband used this as an opportunity to give her dangerous doses of diphenhydramine, an antihistamine used to treat allergies and insomnia.

text: Sang may nabatyagan si Therese kag nagduda sa iya bana, didto kag nag install siya sang hidden cameras aud hibaluon ang ginahimo sang bana.
english: When Therese felt something and suspected her husband, she installed hidden cameras to find out what he was doing.

text: Kag didto natukiban nga sa indi na maisip nga kahigayunan nga kaangay nga ginahiluan na siya sang iya bana.
english: And there it was discovered that on countless occasions it was as if her husband had been poisoning her.

text: Matapos ginkasuhan, napamatud-an nga guilty si Brian kag ginpamatbatan sang lima ka tuig nga probation kag 60 ka adlaw sa presuhan nga iya pa serbehan kun weekend lang.
english: After being charged, Brian was found guilty and sentenced to five years probation and 60 days in jail to serve only on weekends.

text: Ginkadismaya naman sang asawa ang mamag-an nga sentensya sa iya bana.
english: The wife was disappointed with the light sentence given to her husband.

text: Nagapadayon nga hari sang floor exercise si Carlos Yulo matapos liwat nga magdaog sang bulawan sa amo nga event sa subong nga tuig sang Asian Gymnastics Championships nga ginhiwat sa South Korea.
english: Carlos Yulo continues to be the king of the floor exercise after winning gold again in the same event at this year's Asian Gymnastics Championships held in South Korea.

text: Ang duha ka beses nga Olympic gold medalist nga si Yulo ang nangin una sa walo ka finalists, nga may score nga 14.600, kag ginpasulabi ang tanan sa finals.
english: Two-time Olympic gold medalist Yulo finished first among the eight finalists, with a score of 14.600, putting everyone ahead in the finals.

text: Nagpangaduha nga lugar si Milad Karimi sang Kazakhstan nga may score nga 14.400, samtang nagtapos sa ikatatlo si Moon Geonyoung sang South Korea nga may 14.033.
english: Milad Karimi of Kazakhstan placed second with a score of 14.400, while Moon Geonyoung of South Korea finished third with a score of 14.033.

text: Ini na ang ika-apat nga sunod-sunod nga tuig nga nagdaog si Yulo sang bulawan sa floor exercise, sang una man siya nagdaog sa 2022, 2023, kag 2024 editions.
english: This is the fourth consecutive year that Yulo has won gold in the floor exercise, having previously won the 2022, 2023, and 2024 editions.

text: Amo man ini ang ikaduha niya nga medalya sa subong nga kompetisyon matapos siya nagkuha sang bronze sa individual all-around sang Huwebes.
english: It was also her second medal in the current competition after she took bronze in the individual all-around on Thursday.

text: Sa Paris Olympics sang nagligad nga tuig, nakuha man ni Yulo ang bulawan sa floor exercise.
english: At the Paris Olympics last year, Yulo also won gold in the floor exercise.

text: Nag-compete man si Yulo sa finals sang still rings, apang nagtapos siya sa ikapito nga lugar nga may score nga 13.233.
english: Yulo also competed in the still rings finals, but finished in seventh place with a score of 13.233.

text: Ang “Golden Boy” sang Pilipinas sa gymnastics maga-kompetensya pa sa finals sang vault, horizontal bar, kag parallel bars subong nga Domingo.
english: The “Golden Boy” of the Philippines in gymnastics will still compete in the finals of the vault, horizontal bar, and parallel bars this Sunday.

text: May promising data nga nakit-an ang mga eksperto sa antiviral properties sang tawa-tawa bilang potential treatment sa mild tubtob moderate nga mga kaso sang COVID-19.
english: Experts have found promising data on the antiviral properties of tawa-tawa as a potential treatment for mild to moderate cases of COVID-19.

text: Ang project team sa amo nga clinical trial ang ginapangunahan ni Dr. Philip Ian Padilla, vice chancellor for academic affairs sang University of the Philippines (UP) Visayas kag isa ka public health expert.
english: The project team for the clinical trial is led by Dr. Philip Ian Padilla, vice chancellor for academic affairs of the University of the Philippines (UP) Visayas and a public health expert.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Padilla, iya ginpahayag nga yara na subong sa Phase 2 ang ginapatigayon nga clinical trial sa nasambit nga herbal medicine.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Padilla said the clinical trial on the herbal medicine is now in Phase 2.

text: 68 ka mga pasyente ang na-recruit na nga magpartisipar sa randomized controlled clinical trial sa efficacy kag safety sang tawa-tawa extract.
english: 68 patients have been recruited to participate in the randomized controlled clinical trial on the efficacy and safety of tawa-tawa extract.

text: Suno kay Padilla, sa Bacolod City kag Negros Occidental naghalin ang mga volunteers para sa amo nga pagtuon.
english: According to Padilla, the volunteers for the study came from Bacolod City and Negros Occidental.

text: Target sang 11-month study nga makatipon sang 280 participants gani nga nagapadayon pa subong ang pagpangita sang mga volunteers ukon mga pasyente nga may mild tubtob moderate nga COVID-19 cases.
english: The 11-month study targets to recruit 280 participants so the search for volunteers or patients with mild to moderate COVID-19 cases is still ongoing.

text: Ginalauman nga Septyembre subong nga tuig matapos ang amo nga pagtuon.
english: The study is expected to be completed by September this year.

text: Una na nga gin-aprubahan ang tawa-tawa bilang health supplement para sa Dengue.
english: Tawa-tawa was previously approved as a health supplement for Dengue.

text: Funded sang Department of Science and Technology (DOST) ang research kag development agud nga makilala kag maaprubahan ang tawa-tawa bilang potential treatment sa COVID-19.
english: The Department of Science and Technology (DOST) funded the research and development to identify and approve tawa-tawa as a potential treatment for COVID-19.

text: Magapaindis-indis ang nagkalain-lain nga mga candidates para sa Mr. & Ms. IFJPIA 2025.
english: Various candidates will compete for Mr. & Ms. IFJPIA ​​2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jeremiah Keziah Balmori, Vice President for Non-Academics sang Iloilo Federation of Junior Philippine Institute of Accountants (IFJPIA), iya ginpahayag nga ang nasambit nga pageant ang pasakupan sang nagkalain-lain nga mga Accounting students halin sa mga kolehiyo kag unibersidad sa Iloilo.
english: Jeremiah Keziah Balmori, Vice President for Non-Academics of the Iloilo Federation of Junior Philippine Institute of Accountants (IFJPIA), said the pageant will be attended by various accounting students from colleges and universities in Iloilo.

text: Ini ang ginalakipan sang Central Philippine University, St.
english: These include the Central Philippine University, St.

text: Vincent College, Hua Siong College of Iloilo, Phinma University of Iloilo, kag University of San Agustin.
english: Vincent College, Hua Siong College of Iloilo, Phinma University of Iloilo, and University of San Agustin.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga ang kahiwatan ang indi lang beauty pageant, kundi ini ang pagpakita man sang talento kag paghugpong sang mga kabataan nga nagahanda agud mangin professional sa patag sang Accounting.
english: He said the event is not only a beauty pageant, but also a showcase of talent and unity of children who are preparing to become professionals in the field of Accounting.

text: Patigayunon naman ang coronation sa Hua Siong College of Iloilo – Ledesco Campus sa Mayo 3.
english: The coronation will be held at Hua Siong College of Iloilo – Ledesco Campus on May 3.
