text: Nangin mahilway ang pagsaulog sang bag-ong tuig sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: The New Year celebration in Iloilo City was free.

text: Suno kay Police Major Shiela Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office, wala sang daku nga insidente nga na-record ukon ginrespondehan ang mga kapulisan.
english: According to Police Major Shiela Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office, no major incidents were recorded or responded to by the police.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga daku nga bulig sa kalinong ang pagkumpiska sang ginadumilian nga palupok.
english: He said the confiscation of illegal fireworks is a big help to peace.

text: May yara naman san kabug-usan nga 843 ka mga ilegal nga palupok, kag 47 nga boga nga ginabanta nagabalor P34,900 pesos, ang nakuha sang pulisya sa siyudad.
english: A total of 843 illegal fireworks, and 47 boga worth P34,900 pesos, were seized by the police in the city.

text: Nagpasalig ang ICPO nga magapadayon ang ila operasyon sa pagmentenar sang kalinong, ilabi na sa nagahilapit nga Dinagyang Festival kag ASEAN Summit 2026.
english: The ICPO assured that it will continue its operations to maintain peace, especially during the upcoming Dinagyang Festival and ASEAN Summit 2026.

text: NAGAATUBANG sa karon si Iloilo City Councilor Jojo Javellana, nga anay barangay captain man, sang akusasyon nga kuno may “illegal connection” ang water-refilling station nila sa Barangay Loboc.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Jojo Javellana, a former barangay captain, is currently facing accusations that his water-refilling station in Barangay Loboc has an “illegal connection”.

text: Ang ining water-refilling ginapanag-iyahan niya kag sang iya asawa nga si Mary Tracy Javellana nga karon barangay kapitan sa Barangay Loboc, Bo.
english: This water-refilling is owned by him and his wife Mary Tracy Javellana who is now barangay captain in Barangay Loboc, Bo.

text: Obrero.
english: Worker.

text: Mabug-at ini nga akusasyon.
english: This is a serious charge.

text: Sunu sa Republic Act 7832 (Anti-Pilferage of Electricity and Theft of Electric Tranmission Lines/Materials Act of 1994), ang penalidad sa mga violators galakip sang prision mayor (six months and one day to six years), ukon ang multa (fine) nga P10,000 tubtub P20,000.
english: According to Republic Act 7832 (Anti-Pilferage of Electricity and Theft of Electricity Transmission Lines/Materials Act of 1994), the penalty for violators includes imprisonment (six months and one day to six years), or a fine of P10,000 to P20,000.

text: ukon duha gid sini, sa discretion sang korte.
english: or actually both, at the discretion of the court.

text: Kalakip ini nga akusasyon kay konsehal sa mga 3,000 nga kuno “illegal connections” man nga nadiskubrihan, nga nagaulamid man gani sang pila pa ka barangay officials.
english: This accusation against the councilor is among the 3,000 alleged “illegal connections” that were also discovered, which even involved several barangay officials.

text:
***

Admittedly, wala gid naton matagaan anay sing atensyon ang ining reklamo batok sa kay Councilor Javellana tungod sang madamo nga mga isyu sa nasyonal nga level, labi na gid ang parti sa pandemic kag sang conflicto sang China kag Filipinas sa West Philippine Sea, nga importante man sa aton mga pumuluyo diri sa rehiyon.
english:
***

Admittedly, we never paid attention to this complaint against Councilor Javellana because of the many issues at the national level, especially the pandemic and the conflict between China and the Philippines in the West Philippine Sea, which is also important to our people here in the region.

text: Tutal ginatutokan naman ining isyu sang mga kaupdanan naton sa lokal nga media nga wala naman kita sing daw madugang pa.
english: Since our colleagues in the local media are focusing on this issue, we have nothing to add.

text: Ugaling kay may nag-ungkat gid sining isyu nga luyag gid makahibalo sang aton panghuna-huna parti sini.
english: But since someone has raised this issue who really wants to know our thoughts on it.

text: Imposible kuno nga mahimo ini ni Kap, sunu sa iya.
english: It is impossible for Kap to do this, he said.

text: Una, tungod limpyo kuno ang record ni Kap sa madugay na niya nga pagserbisyo bilang isa man anay ka barangay captain.
english: First, because Kap's record is clean in his long service as a former barangay captain.

text: Hayag man, siling pa niya, halin sadto pa ang pagpangabuhi ni Kap kag sang iya asawa, lakip ang ining ila negosyo, nga indi man malikom  pa sa mga pumuluyo.
english: It is also clear, he said, that Kap and his wife have been living since then, including their business, which is not hidden from the people.

text: Ikaduha, may outstanding ini nga application para sa isa ka electric meter sa MORE Power sa ila water-refilling nga negosyo.
english: Second, it has an outstanding application for an electric meter to MORE Power in its water-refilling business.

text: Ikatatlo, wala man kinahanglan magdiskarte pa, kon posible himuon gid man ini, kay may submeter man ang mag-asawa nga gintugtan ipaangot sa mother meter sang isa ka abyan nga nagabayad tingub sini sa MORE Power.
english: Third, there is no need to strategize, if possible, do it, because the couple has a submeter that is allowed to be connected to the mother meter of a friend who pays together with MORE Power.

text: Ikaapat, dugay naman gani kuno nga wala naga-operate ang ila water-refilling station tubtub sining ulihi, ti paano nga maggamit pa sang kuryente ang ining ila negosyo, labi na gid kon sa ilegal nga paagi.
english: Fourth, their water-refilling station has not been operating for a long time until recently, so how can their business use electricity, especially if it is illegal.

text: In other words, wala gid sila matuod sing rason agud mag-angot, ukon magpaangot, sang “illegal connection” sa linya sang MORE Power.
english: In other words, they really have no reason to establish, or have established, an “illegal connection” to the MORE Power line.

text: Pero, ano atong nadiskubrihan kuno sang tinawo sang MORE Power nga electricity connection sa linya sang MORE Power nga wala nagaagi sa electric meter?
english: But, what did the MORE Power employee discover that the electricity connection on the MORE Power line does not go through the electric meter?

text: “Ambot kon sin-o ang nag-angot ukon nagpaangot sadto,” sabat sang nag-ungkat sa aton sining isyu.
english: “I don't know who linked it or linked it then,” replied the one who raised this issue.

text:
“Natural indi sila, kay wala naman sila kinahanglan magkuha sang kuryente sa kon diin pa luas paagi sa submeter nga ginabayaran sang ila abyan sing tingub sa MORE Power.”

“Sin-o ayhan ang nag-angot, ukon nagpaangot, sadto?” pamangkot ko.
english:
“Of course they don't, because they don't have to get electricity from anywhere else except through the submeter that their friend pays for together with MORE Power.”

“Who would have connected, or connected, then?” I asked.

text: “May suspetso ka?” dugang ko.
english: “You have a suspicion?” I added.

text: Pulitiko si Jojo kag si Mrs. Posible nga may luyag gid mag-sabotahe sa ila, labi na gid kay malapit na ang eleksyon sa Mayo 2022, paathag niya.
english: Jojo and Mrs. It is possible that someone would really want to sabotage them, especially since the May 2022 elections are around the corner, he explained.

text: Isa pa, dugang niya, pwede man makwartahan ina nga isyu.
english: Besides, he added, that issue could also be monetized.

text: Nga daan may ginahatag ang MORE Power sing premyo (mga P10,000 kuno) sa kon sin-o ang makatudlo sang nagapang-“illegal connection”.
english: MORE Power is already offering a reward (about P10,000) to anyone who can point out the illegal connection.

text: Daku ina nga kwarta nga makatentar sang isa ka tawo agud saskuhan ang kapareho, labi na gid ang may gut-gut sa ila nga mag-asawa.
english: That's a lot of money that can tempt a person to cheat on a partner, especially one who has a gut-gut in their marriage.

text: Kon indi sila ang nag-angot sang “illegal connection”,ukon nagsugo sini,  sin-o matuod?
english: If they didn't make the illegal connection, or order it, who did?

text: Malayo seguro sa aton pamensaron, apang, for the sake of curiosity lang, indi ayhan ang tinawo pa sang MORE ang nagdiskarte sini nga kasosyo ang nagmaneho sining “illegal connection” agud partehon nila ang premyo?
english: It's probably far from our minds, but, just for the sake of curiosity, isn't it the MORE employee who strategized this partner who drove this “illegal connection” so that they could share the prize?

text: Basi pang-sabotahe lang ini matuod agud mamansahan ang limpyo nga ngalan sang mag-asawa sa malain nga plano sang iban batok sa ila, labi na gid kay mabudlay ini sila bungguon sa palaabuton nga eleksyon sa Mayo 2022.
english: Maybe this is just a sabotage to tarnish the clean name of the couple in the evil plans of others against them, especially since they will be difficult to defeat in the upcoming elections in May 2022.

text: Meantime, may sabat na gid man seguro ang abogado ni Kap sa akusasyon sang MORE Power./PN
english: Meantime, Kap's lawyer must have an answer to MORE Power's accusation./PN

text: Ginpaguwa ni House Deputy Majority Leader Francisco Paolo Ortega V ang lain na naman nga set sang mga makaduluda nga pangalan nga ginlista ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga nakabaton sang iya nga confidential funds sang siya ang nagpungko bilang tiglikom sang Department of Education (DepEd).
english: House Deputy Majority Leader Francisco Paolo Ortega V released another set of suspicious names listed by Vice President Sara Duterte who received her confidential funds when she took office as secretary of the Department of Education (DepEd).

text: “Sa patuloy na pagsusuri ng Kongreso sa listahan ng mga nakatanggap ng confidential funds sa DepEd, may bagong grupo na naman—ang tinatawag nating ‘Team Amoy Asim,” suno kay Ortega.
english: “As Congress continues to review the list of recipients of confidential funds from DepEd, there is a new group—what we call 'Team Amoy Asim,” Ortega said.

text:
Lakip sa ginatumod sang mamalidha amo ang “Amoy Liu,” “Fernan Amuy,” kag “Joug De Asim.”

Pahayag sang kongresista, ginpasa ini sang DepEd kag Office of the Vice President (OVP) sa Commission on Audit (CoA), apang kaangay sa iban nga ginwaragwag nga pangalan, wala man ini sang birth, marriage, ukon death records sa database sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).
english:
Among those referred to by the lawmaker are “Amoy Liu,” “Fernan Amuy,” and “Joug De Asim.”

The congressman said the DepEd and the Office of the Vice President (OVP) submitted it to the Commission on Audit (CoA), but like the other names, it does not have birth, marriage, or death records in the database of the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).

text: Ginkwestyon pa ni Ortega nga kun ang mga pangalan gani daw maaslom na, ano pa gid ayhan ang natabo nga mga transaksyon.
english: Ortega questioned that if the names are sour, what else happened to the transactions.

text: “Una, may chichirya, may cellphone, at may prutas.
english: “First, there is a chichirya, there is a cellphone, and there is fruit.

text:
Sumunod ang ‘Dodong Gang.’ Ngayon naman, nandito na ang ‘Team Amoy Asim.’ Kung sa listahan pa lang ay maasim na ang dating ng pekeng mga pangalan, paano pa kaya sa mga transaksyon mismo?”

Antes sini nga mga pangalan, may recipients man nga kapangalan sang chichirya, may brand sang cellphone, may prutas, may Kamote, kag may Dodong Gang.
english:
Next came the 'Dodong Gang.' Now, here's 'Team Amoy Asim.' If the list of fake names is sour, what about the transactions themselves?”

Before these names, there are also recipients named chichirya, there is a brand of cellphone, there is fruit, there is sweet potato, and there is Dodong Gang.

text: Lakip sini nga signatories ang Mary Grace Piattos, Jay Kamote, Miggy Mango, Dodong Alcala, Dodong Bina, Dodong Bunal, Dodong Darong, kag Dodong S. Barok.
english: These signatories include Mary Grace Piattos, Jay Kamote, Miggy Mango, Dodong Alcala, Dodong Bina, Dodong Bunal, Dodong Darong, and Dodong S. Barok.

text: Kun matandaan, ginsiling man sang Kamara nga ang DepEd sa idalom anay ni Sara kag ang OVP ang nagpasa sang mga dokumento nga ginaalegar may sala nga mga petsa, may mga pirma nga wala man sang signatories, kag may indi mabasahan nga mga pangalan sang gin-justify sini ang disbursement sang ila confidential funds sang 2022 kag 2023.
english: The House also said that the DepEd under Sara and the OVP submitted documents that allegedly had wrong dates, signatures without signatories, and illegible names when justifying the disbursement of their confidential funds in 2022 and 2023.

text: Nakit-an sang General Services Office (GSO) nga hagan-hagan na nga nagbuhin ang paglapta sang mga basura sa Sunset Boulevard sa Iloilo Circumferential Road.
english: The General Services Office (GSO) has found that the spread of garbage on Sunset Boulevard on Iloilo Circumferential Road has gradually decreased.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Niel Ravena, head sang General Services Office, iya ginpahayag nga nag-deploy na ang talatapan sang 19 ka mga waste bin kag anom ka mga portalets sa nagkalain-lain nga area sang lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Niel Ravena, head of the General Services Office, said the office has already deployed 19 waste bins and six portalets in different areas of the area.

text: Suno kay Ravena, ang basurahan ang nakaplastar every 200 meters sang Sunset Boulevard.
english: According to Ravena, the garbage dump is located every 200 meters of Sunset Boulevard.

text: Nagpreparar man ang GSO sang dugang nga mga 10 ka concrete bins nga makaamodar sang mas madamo nga basura.
english: The GSO also prepared about 10 additional concrete bins that can accommodate more garbage.

text: Ang concrete bins ang human sa daan nga flowerpots nga naghalin sa Calle Real.
english: The concrete bins are made of old flowerpots from Calle Real.

text: Mas ginpili man sang talatapan ang amo nga basurahan bangud mas budlay ini matumba kag makawat.
english: The office also preferred the garbage can because it is more difficult to knock over and steal.

text: May ginpadala nga sulat kay may ginlunsar nga online petition sa tuyo nga balabagan ang pag-apply ni former Presidential spokesperson Harry Roque sang asylum sa Netherlands.
english: A letter was sent after an online petition was launched to block former Presidential spokesperson Harry Roque's application for asylum in the Netherlands.

text: Ang Philippine-born kag Dutch citizen nga si Joel Vega amo ang nagkumpirma sa iya Facebook page nga nagpasa siya sang sulat sa Immigration and Naturalization Service para pamatukan ang tikang ni Roque.
english: Philippine-born and Dutch citizen Joel Vega confirmed on his Facebook page that he submitted a letter to the Immigration and Naturalization Service to oppose Roque's move.

text: May online petition man ini nga gin-umpisahan nga ginatawag nga “Block Harry Roque’s Asylum Move to The Netherlands” kun sa diin mahimo makapirma ang “concerned Filipino citizens”.
english: He also launched an online petition called “Block Harry Roque’s Asylum Move to The Netherlands” where concerned Filipino citizens can sign.

text: As of press time, nakatipon na ini sang malapit 3,000 ka mga pirma.
english: As of press time, it has collected close to 3,000 signatures.

text: Sa sulat ni Vega, ginsiling sini nga wala sang basehan ang mga pahayag ni Roque kaangot sa political persecution sa iya diri sa Pilipinas.
english: In Vega's letter, he said Roque's statements regarding political persecution against him in the Philippines are baseless.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno kay Vega, suod si Roque sa mga Duterte nga dominante gihapon ukon gamhanan kag may daku nga impluwensya sa pulitika diri sa Pilipinas.
english: In fact, Vega said, Roque is close to the Dutertes who are still dominant or powerful and have great influence in politics here in the Philippines.

text: Ginplastar man sini nga ang tuyo ni Roque nga magpangayo sang asylum amo nga likawan ang mga imbestigasyon nga nagaangot sa iya sa POGO.
english: He also laid out that Roque's intention in seeking asylum was to avoid investigations linking him to POGO.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Roque nga kun mabaton ang iya aplikasyon para sa international protection, may kinamatarong siya sa non-refoulement, buot silingon suno sa iya, indi siya ma-deport tubtub nga maka-desisyon ang Dutch government sa iya aplikasyon.
english: Earlier, Roque said that if his application for international protection is accepted, he has the right to non-refoulement, which means that he will not be deported until the Dutch government decides on his application.

text: Bisan madugay siya nga nangindulaan sa Pilipinas, nagpanginwala man ini nga pugante siya, kag nanindugan nga ginalikawan lamang sini ang subpoena halin sa House of Representatives kag indi arrest warrant halin sa korte.
english: Although he disappeared from the Philippines for a long time, he also denied that he was a fugitive, and insisted that he was only avoiding a subpoena from the House of Representatives and not an arrest warrant from the court.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga wala siya subong sa The Hague samtang nga ginahulat ang interview sa iya application.
english: He also said he is not currently in The Hague while waiting for an interview on his application.

text: Ginkilala sa Japan ang isa ka Pinoy matapos ang dalayawon nga pagsalbar sini sa isa ka Japanese national nga nagtuyo kuntani nga maghikog.
english: A Filipino has been recognized in Japan after his commendable rescue of a Japanese national who was about to commit suicide.

text: Ang Pinoy amo si Emil Reboja Vega, 32, residente sang Albuera, Leyte, kag naga-trabaho bilang plumber sa Asaka City, Saitama Prefecture sa Japan.
english: The Filipino is Emil Reboja Vega, 32, a resident of Albuera, Leyte, and works as a plumber in Asaka City, Saitama Prefecture in Japan.

text: Sang Abril 24, samtang nagapauli halin sa trabaho si Vega, naagyan sini ang isa ka babayi nga nagahana nga maglumpat sa taytay.
english: On April 24, while Vega was returning home from work, he passed a woman who was about to jump off the bridge.

text: Wala na nagduha-duha si Vega kag nanaog sa iya nga motorsiklo, gin-uyatan ang kamot sang babayi, nagpangayo sang bulig, kag sang ulihi, nagtawag sang pulis.
english: Vega did not hesitate and got off his motorcycle, grabbed the woman's hand, asked for help, and finally, called the police.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma direkta sa Japan, bangud sa ginhimo sang Pinoy, naghatag sang award si Asaka City Police Commissioner Chief Police Inspector Makoto Sato.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma directly in Japan, because of the Filipino's actions, Asaka City Police Commissioner Chief Police Inspector Makoto Sato gave the award.

text: Nagbaton si Vega sang certificate sa isa ka seremonya nga ginpatigayon sang local authorities.
english: Vega received the certificate at a ceremony conducted by local authorities.

text: Nakaguwa na si former executive secretary Salvador Medialdea sa ospital sa Netherlands.
english: Former executive secretary Salvador Medialdea has been discharged from a hospital in the Netherlands.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Senador Bong Go matapos pila ka adlaw man nga na-confine ang abogado.
english: Senator Bong Go confirmed this after the lawyer was also confined for several days.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini suno sa senador sa tanan nga nagpangamuyo para sa iya.
english: The senator also thanked everyone who prayed for him.

text:
Yari ang statement sa Facebook page sang senador:

“Masayang ibinabalita ni Senator Bong Go ngayong Sabado na nakalabas na ng ospital si dating Executive Secretary Salvador “Bingbong” Medialdea na ilang araw ring na-confine sa hospital sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english:
Here’s the statement on the senator’s Facebook page:

“Senator Bong Go is pleased to announce this Saturday that former Executive Secretary Salvador “Bingbong” Medialdea who was confined to the hospital in The Hague, Netherlands for several days has been discharged from the hospital.

text: Successful ang naging medical heart procedure na ginawa kay Atty. Medialdea, ngunit kailangan muna niyang manatili doon ng anim na linggo dahil hindi pa siya pwedeng bumyahe.
english: The medical heart procedure performed on Atty. Medialdea, but he had to stay there for six weeks because he couldn't travel.

text:
Nagpapasalamat rin siya sa mga kababayan nating nagdasal at patuloy na nagdarasal para sa kalusugan ni Atty. Medialdea.”

Matandaan nga sang Marso 18, samtang nagabisita si Medialdea kay former President Rodrigo Duterte sa The Hague Penitentiary Institution, nagguwa ini nga sakay na sa stretcher kag ginkarga sa ambulance.
english:
He also thanked our fellow citizens who prayed and continue to pray for the health of Atty. Medialdea.”

It can be recalled that on March 18, while Medialdea was visiting former President Rodrigo Duterte at The Hague Penitentiary Institution, he came out on a stretcher and was loaded into an ambulance.

text: Siya ang nag-upod kay Duterte sang ginlupad ini halin sa Pilipinas kag gindala sa The Hague sang Marso 11 agud atubangon ang charges sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: He accompanied Duterte when he was flown from the Philippines and brought to The Hague on March 11 to face charges at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Base kay Vice President Sara Duterte, bisan nga si Medialdea ang nagpungko bilang legal counsel ni Duterte sa una sini nga pag-atubang sa international tribunal, indi na siya kabahin sang defense team sa masunod nga proceedings amo man si presidential spokesperson Harry Roque.
english: According to Vice President Sara Duterte, although Medialdea sat as Duterte's legal counsel in his first appearance before the international tribunal, he will no longer be part of the defense team in the next proceedings as will presidential spokesperson Harry Roque.

text: Sa post sa FB Page ni Go, naghingyo man ini sang padayon nga pagpangamuyo para sa former president: “Patuloy na nanawagan si Senator Bong Go na ipanalangin ang kaligtasan, kalusugan, at kalayaan ni dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte.”##
english: In a post on Go's FB Page, he also asked for continued prayers for the former president: “Senator Bong Go continues to call for prayers for the safety, health, and freedom of former President Rodrigo Duterte.”##

text: Pampa-good vibes anay sa inyo nga adlaw!
english: Send good vibes to your day!

text: Daw indi mahubsan sang similarities ini nga identical twins didto sa California.
english: The similarities between these identical twins in California seem inexhaustible.

text: Ini matapos dungan man sila nga nagbun-ag sa ila baby boys didto sa Kaiser Permanente hospital sa Anaheim.
english: This is after they gave birth to their baby boys at the same time at Kaiser Permanente hospital in Anaheim.

text: Ang ginatumod nga kapid amo sanday Jill Justiniani kag Erin Cheplak.
english: The twins in question are Jill Justiniani and Erin Cheplak.

text: Ang ila naman anak ang ginpangalanan nga sanday Oliver kag Silas.Ang ila ginbun-ag nga baby boys ang pareho man nga naga-measure sang 20 inches long.
english: Their children were named Oliver and Silas. Their baby boys were both 20 inches long.

text: Suno sa kapid, naka-schedule kuntani si Jill para sa C-section sang Mayo 5, apang sang amo nga tion, naglupok man ang panubigon ni Erin apisar nga 10 days pa kuntani antes ang iya nga due date.
english: According to the twin, Jill was scheduled for a C-section on May 5, but at that time, Erin's water also burst even though it was 10 days before her due date.

text: Gin-share man sang mag-utod nga very special nga dungan sila nga nagbusong bangud ginasuportahan nila ang isa kag isa kag pareho sila sang ginaagyan nga proseso.
english: The sisters also shared that it was very special that they got pregnant at the same time because they supported each other and were going through the same process.

text: Ginakalipay ni Rev.
english: Rev. Fr.

text: Fr.
english: Fr.

text: Angelo Colada ang pag-appoint ni Pope Francis kay His Excellency Most Rev.
english: Angelo Colada the appointment of Pope Francis to His Excellency Most Rev.

text: Midyphil B. Billones, bilang bag-o nga Archbishop sang Jaro.
english: Midyphil B. Billones, as the new Archbishop of Jaro.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Colada, Director sang Social Communication, Archdiocese of Jaro, iya ginpahayag nga madamo na nga beses nga sila ang nakaupdanay ni Archbishop Billones lakip na sa gatherings, recollections, kag bisan sa panahon nga indi pa obispo si Father Billones.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Colada, Director of Social Communication, Archdiocese of Jaro, said they have been with Archbishop Billones many times including in gatherings, recollections, and even when Father Billones was not a bishop.

text: Suno kay Colada, bisan papaano, ang ila nga ekspeyensya ang nakabulig man sa mga significant nga natabo sa kabuhi ni Archbishop Billones.
english: According to Colada, somehow, their experience also helped in the significant events that happened in the life of Archbishop Billones.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga magabalik sa Cebu si Archbishop Billones agud i-settle ang mga nabilin niya nga responsibilidad.
english: He also said that Archbishop Billones will return to Cebu to settle his remaining responsibilities.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Archbishop Billones ang nagserbe man nga Auxiliary Bishop sang Cebu.
english: Archbishop Billones also served as the Auxiliary Bishop of Cebu.

text: Si Billones nga naga-edad 55-anyos amo na ang mangin ika-14 nga archbishop sang Jaro nga nagasakop sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo amo man sa probinsya sang Guimaras.
english: Billones, 55, will be the 14th archbishop of Jaro, which covers the city and province of Iloilo as well as the province of Guimaras.

text: Nabun-ag siya sa Panay, Capiz.
english: He was born in Panay, Capiz.

text: Nagtuon siya sang Philosophy sa St.
english: He studied Philosophy at St.

text: Vincent Ferrer Seminary sa Iloilo City kag Theology sa Loyola School of Theology sa Quezon City kun sa diin nakuha sini ang master’s degree sa amo man nga program.
english: Vincent Ferrer Seminary in Iloilo City and Theology at Loyola School of Theology in Quezon City where he obtained his master’s degree in the same program.

text: Na-ordenahan siya bilang pari sa Archdiocese of Jaro sang Oktubre 2, 1995 ukon halos tatlo ka dekada na ang nagligad.
english: He was ordained a priest in the Archdiocese of Jaro on October 2, 1995 or almost three decades ago.

text: Si Arsobispo Billones amo ang magabulos kay retired Archbishop Most Reverend Jose Romeo O. Lazo, D.D.
english: Archbishop Billones will succeed retired Archbishop Most Reverend Jose Romeo O. Lazo, D.D.

text: Suportahan ni Vice President Sara Duterte bilang abyan si Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa kun ano man ang mangin desisyon sini pananglitan siya ang masunod nga dagdagan sang arrest warrant halin sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Vice President Sara Duterte will support Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa as a friend whatever his decision is if he is the next to be issued an arrest warrant from the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Suno kay Sara, indi man siya abogado ni Bato kag indi man siya parte sang grupo nga nagahatag sang advise sa senador, gani magahatag na lang siya sang suporta bilang isa ka abyan kun sa diin malipayon kag kumportable si Bato.
english: According to Sara, she is not Bato's lawyer and she is not part of the group that gives advice to the senator, so she will just give support as a friend where Bato is happy and comfortable.

text: “Kung ano yung decision niya at saan siya masaya [at] comfortable doon sa kanyang mga decisions, susuporta lang ako as a friend.
english: “Whatever decision he makes and where he is happy [and] comfortable with his decisions, I will just support him as a friend.

text: Hindi naman niya ako abogado.
english: I'm not his lawyer.

text: Hindi naman ako kaparte ng kanyang grupo sa mga nag-a-advise sa kanya,” suno sa bise sa ambush interview sa The Hague.
english: I am not part of his group of those who advise him,” the vice said in an ambush interview in The Hague.

text: Kaangot ini sa pahayag ni Bato nga sikreto anay subong kun sa diin ang iya lokasyon, kag pananglitan yara ang na ang arrest warrant, ginakonsiderar sini ang pagpanago.
english: This is in connection with Bato's statement that his location is now a secret, and if there is already an arrest warrant, he is considering hiding.

text: “Hindi ako lalabas sa aking comfort zone.
english: “I don't go out of my comfort zone.

text: My comfort zone sa Philippines.
english: My comfort zone sa Philippines.

text: Bakit ako pupunta sa ibang bansa?
english: Why am I going abroad?

text: Dito ako sa Pilipinas.
english: I'm here in the Philippines.

text: Dito ako pinanganak.
english: I was born here.

text: Dito ako mamamatay sa bansa kong sinilangan,” kabahin sang latest statement sini.
english: I will die here in my eastern country,” part of his latest statement.

text: Si Bato amo ang chief sang Philippine National Police (PNP) sang gin-umpisahan sang Duterte administration ang kontrobersyal kag maduguon nga war on drugs sang 2016.
english: Bato was the chief of the Philippine National Police (PNP) when the Duterte administration launched its controversial and bloody war on drugs in 2016.

text: Sa ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga tion, wala na naman ginmensyonar ni President Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos Jr.
english: For the second time in a row, President Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos Jr.

text: ang iya utod nga si Senador Imee Marcos samtang nagapangampanya para sa Alyansa Para Sa Bagong Pilipinas sa Laguna.
english: his sister Senator Imee Marcos while campaigning for the Alliance for a New Philippines in Laguna.

text: Sa baylo nga 12 ka mga kandidato sang Alyansa, 11 lang ang ginhinambit ni Marcos sa iya nga speech.
english: Instead of 12 Alliance candidates, Marcos mentioned only 11 in his speech.

text: Sa iya endorsement speech sa Cavite sang Marso 21, ginlaktawan man sini ang pangalan sang iya magulang.
english: In his endorsement speech in Cavite on March 21, he also skipped the name of his brother.

text: Ini ang nagagatong sa espekulasyon kun wala na bala si Imee sa slate sang Alyansa, apang wala pa man sang ginhatag nga opisyal nga klaripikasyon kun may gindula na sa ila nga senatorial lineup.
english: This is fueling speculation as to whether Imee is no longer on the Alliance's slate, but no official clarification has been given as to whether anyone has been eliminated from their senatorial lineup.

text: “Kaya po magkaisa po tayo.
english: “That's why we're together.

text: Magkaisa po tayo sa ating Alyansa.
english: Let's be united in our Alliance.

text: At huwag nating gawing alyansa lamang nitong sampu, eleven na tao, eleven na kandidato na tumatakbo bilang senador na kasama sa Alyansa.
english: And let's not just make an alliance of these ten, eleven people, eleven candidates running as senators who are in the Alliance.

text: Samahan niyo po kami.
english: Please join us.

text: Samahan niyo po kami at magka-alyansa rin tayo.
english: Please join us and we will also be an alliance.

text: Magkapit-bisig po tayo at sama-sama po natin pagandahin ang buhay ng bawat Pilipino.
english: Let's hold hands and together improve the lives of every Filipino.

text: Magsama-sama po tayo.
english: Let's be together.

text: Magtulungan po tayo.
english: Let's help each other.

text: Mag-alyansa po tayo muli upang labanan ang kahirapan, upang labanan ang krimen, upang labanan ang mga drug lord na pumapasok dito sa Pilipinas.
english: Let's join forces again to fight poverty, to fight crime, to fight drug lords who are entering the Philippines.

text: Ito po, hinaharap ko po sa inyo ang ating Alyansa na siyang gagawa at siyang magtatrabaho upang pabalikin ang kapayapaan dito sa ating minamahal na Pilipinas,” kabahin sang speech sang presidente sa Laguna rally.
english: This, I present to you our Alliance that he will create and he will work to restore peace here in our beloved Philippines,” part of the president's speech at the Laguna rally.

text: Nauna na nga si Imee mismo ang wala nagsipot sa rally sang Alyansa sa Tacloban amo man sa Cavite bangud ginakontra sini ang pag-aresto kay former President Rodrigo Duterte kag pagdala sa iya sa The Hague.
english: Earlier, Imee herself did not attend the Alliance rally in Tacloban as well as in Cavite because she opposed the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte and his extradition to The Hague.

text: Siya man ang nagpanguna sa Senate hearing sang Huwebes nga naangot sa Duterte arrest kag nagkwestyon sa mga tikang kag desisyon sang Cabinet secretaries sa pagdakop sa former president.#
english: He also led the Senate hearing on Thursday related to the Duterte arrest and questioned the steps and decisions of the Cabinet secretaries in arresting the former president.

text: Mangin sa red carpet premiere sang prestihiyoso nga Cannes Film Festival, nangagaw sang atensyon ang krisis nga nagakatabo sa Ukraine.
english: Even at the red carpet premiere of the prestigious Cannes Film Festival, the crisis in Ukraine caught the attention.

text: Ini matapos nagdalagan sa red carpet ang isa ka hublas nga babayi.
english: This was after a naked woman ran down the red carpet.

text: Napintahan sang blue kag yellow ang lawas sang protester — duag nga nagapakita sang hayahay sang Ukraine.
english: The protester's body was painted blue and yellow — colors that symbolize Ukrainian sovereignty.

text: Wala ginhingadlan ang amo nga babayi.Gin-uba sini ang iya nga gown kag gin-reveal ang Ukrainian flag colors.
english: The woman was not named. She took off her gown and revealed the Ukrainian flag colors.

text: Mabasagan ang mga tinaga nga “STOP RAPING US” sa iya nga tiyan kag may nakabutang man nga marka sang mga kamot nga duag pula sa iya nga likod.Nagsinggit ang babayi kag madasig naman ang security officials sa pagputos sang iya lawas gamit ang jacket.
english: The words “STOP RAPING US” were written on her stomach and red handprints were written on her back. The woman screamed and the security officials quickly wrapped her body in a jacket.

text: Ginkuha ini gikan sa red carpet, kag nagpadayon man sa pagtokar ang film festival music.
english: It was taken from the red carpet, and film festival music continued to play as well.

text: Nagahingyo ang grupo sang exporters sang mas mabaskog nga suporta gikan sa gobyerno para nga mapadala ang mga produkto sang Pilipinas sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: The exporters' group is calling for stronger support from the government to export Philippine products.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Philippine Exporters Confederation Inc.
english: This was revealed by the Philippine Exporters Confederation Inc.

text: (Philexport) president Sergio Ortiz-Luis Jr.
english: (Philexport) president Sergio Ortiz-Luis Jr.

text: bangud sa kahangawa nga indi malab-ot sang export performance ang ila nga target subong nga tuig.
english: due to concerns that export performance will not meet their target this year.

text: Suno kay Ortiz-Luiz, ang $110-billion projection ang mas manubo sa export target nga $113.42 billion sa idalom sang Philippine Development Plan kag sa $163.6-billion nga target sa idalom naman sang Philippine Export Development Plan para sa 2025.
english: According to Ortiz-Luiz, the $110-billion projection is lower than the export target of $113.42 billion under the Philippine Development Plan and the $163.6-billion target under the Philippine Export Development Plan for 2025.

text: Magluwas na kulang ang budget para sa export ilabi na sa promotion, may mga domestic and external risks man sila nga ginapangatubang suno sa natungdan lakip na ang malain nga tyempo, ang mga kalamidad, ang acute and protracted global economic slowdown sa major economies, ang nagapadayon nga geopolitical tensions and conflicts, trade wars kag protectionist trade policies ilabi na sa Estados Unidos.
english: Besides the lack of budget for exports especially in promotion, they also face domestic and external risks including bad weather, disasters, acute and protracted global economic slowdown in major economies, ongoing geopolitical tensions and conflicts, trade wars and protectionist trade policies especially in the United States.

text: Nagalaum ang natungdan nga matigayon ang mga free trade agreements (FTA) kaupod sa iban nga pungsod subong nga tuig agud nga mas mapaayo kuntani ang ila performance sa pag-export sang goods, services kag investments.
english: He hopes to reach free trade agreements (FTAs) with other countries this year to improve their performance in exporting goods, services and investments.

text: Ginpakita ni eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao ang iya pagdayaw kag respeto sa nagtaliwan nga American boxing legend nga si George Foreman.
english: Eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao has expressed his admiration and respect for the late American boxing legend George Foreman.

text: Kahapon sang gin-anunsyo sang pamilya nga nagtaliwan na ang 76-anyos nga boxing great nga duha ka beses nga nag-hari sa heavyweight division.
english: The family announced yesterday that the 76-year-old boxing great who twice reigned in the heavyweight division has passed away.

text: Suno naman sa Pinoy boxing legend, tuman ka dalayawon ang karera ni Foreman kag ang iya nga kabakod sa ring ang naghatag inspirasyon sa madamo nga mga boksidor lakip na sa iya.
english: According to the Filipino boxing legend, Foreman's career is very commendable and his strength in the ring has inspired many boxers including him.

text: Gindugang sini nga padayon gid nga dumdumon ang legasiya nga ginbilin ni Foreman bilang matuod nga kampyon.
english: He added that the legacy left by Foreman as a true champion will always be remembered.

text: “My heartfelt condolences go out to his family, friends, and all those whose lives he touched both in and out of the boxing world.
english: “My heartfelt condolences go out to his family, friends, and all those whose lives he touched both in and out of the boxing world.

text: Rest in peace, George.
english: Rest in peace, George.

text: You will always be an icon,” kabahin sang pahayag ni Pacquiao, Marso 22.
english: You will always be an icon,” Pacquiao said in a statement on March 22.

text: Wala pa nabun-ag si Pacquiao sang naghari si Foreman sa heavyweight ranks, apang pila ka beses naman sila nga nagkitaay sang nasambit nga 1968 Mexico City Olympics gold medalist ilabi na sa United States.
english: Pacquiao was not yet born when Foreman ruled the heavyweight ranks, but they met several times with the 1968 Mexico City Olympics gold medalist, especially in the United States.

text: Kilala man si Foreman sa “The Rumble in the Jungle” kaupod kay Muhammad Ali sang 1975, paglutos sini kanday Joe Frazier kag Ken Norton sang 1970s, kag ang epic one-punch knockout kay Michael Moorer nga amo ang naghimo sa iya bilang oldest heavyweight champion sa edad nga halos 46-anyos sang 1994.
english: Foreman is also known for “The Rumble in the Jungle” alongside Muhammad Ali in 1975, his defeats to Joe Frazier and Ken Norton in the 1970s, and the epic one-punch knockout of Michael Moorer that made him the oldest heavyweight champion at nearly 469-years-old in 1974.

text: Siya anay ang nagbayaw sa kamot ni Pacquiao kadungan sang promotional tour para sa sambuwa batok kay Brandon Rios sa Macau sang 2013.
english: He previously raised Pacquiao's hand during the promotional tour for the fight against Brandon Rios in Macau in 2013.

text: Magluwas nga isa ka boksidor, nangin kilala man si Foreman bilang humanitarian kag isa ka businessman.
english: In addition to being a boxer, Foreman also became known as a humanitarian and a businessman.

text: Madalagan liwat si Filipino boxing legend Senator Manny Pacquiao.
english: Filipino boxing legend Senator Manny Pacquiao will run again.

text: Sini nga tion, indi sa patag sang pulitika kundi sa charity marathon event sa Japan.
english: This time, not in the political sphere but at the charity marathon event in Japan.

text: Kahapon, Mayo 20, sang nag-abot si Pacquaio sa Tokyo kag mainit nga ginsugata kag gin-abi abi sang iya nga mga fans.
english: Yesterday, May 20, Pacquaio arrived in Tokyo and was warmly welcomed by his fans.

text: Patigayunon ang marathon event sa City Football Station sa Tochigi City Iwafune Sports Park buwas, Mayo 22.
english: The marathon event will be held at the City Football Station at Tochigi City Iwafune Sports Park tomorrow, May 22.

text: Ang matipon nga pondo halin sa amo nga event ang gamiton agud magpatindog sang libre nga mga eskwelahan sa Pilipinas kag pagpatukod liwat sang mga imprastraktura nga ginguba sang Bagyo Odette.
english: The funds raised from the event will be used to build free schools in the Philippines and rebuild infrastructure destroyed by Typhoon Odette.

text: Ang Manny Pacquiao Foundation charity marathon event amo ang isa sa una nga mga aktibidad ni Pacquiao matapos nga napierde ini sa May 2022 elections matapos nga nagpangatlo lang sa presidential race.
english: The Manny Pacquiao Foundation charity marathon event was one of Pacquiao's first activities after he lost the May 2022 elections after finishing third in the presidential race.

text: Ginalauman nga maga-perform sa event ang mga myembro sang all-female song kag dance group nga MNL48 kaupod ang ila “sisters” halin sa AKB48, isa man ka Japanese all-female group.
english: Members of the all-female song and dance group MNL48 are expected to perform at the event along with their sisters from AKB48, also a Japanese all-female group.

text: Lakip sa myembro sang MNL48 nga maga-perform sa marathon event amo sanday Amy, Coleen, Jan kag Sheki.
english: Among the members of MNL48 who will perform in the marathon event are Amy, Coleen, Jan and Sheki.

text: Nabatian na naman ang national anthem nga “Lupang Hinirang” kag napasaka na naman sang hayahay sang Pilipinas sa 2025 Artistic Gymnastics Asian Championships sa South Korea.
english: The national anthem “Lupang Hinirang” was heard again and the Philippines was raised again in the 2025 Artistic Gymnastics Asian Championships in South Korea.

text: Ini matapos nagpangibabaw ang Filipino superstar gymnast nga si Carlos Edriel Yulo sa floor exercise finals — ang iya pet event kun sa diin nagdaog man siya anay sang gold medal sa Paris Olympics sang 2024.
english: This comes after Filipino superstar gymnast Carlos Edriel Yulo dominated the floor exercise finals — his pet event where he also won a gold medal at the Paris Olympics in 2024.

text: Naka-skor si Yulo sang 14.600 points.
english: Yulo scored 14.600 points.

text: Ginsundan siya ni Milad Karimi sang Kazakhstan nga may 14.400 points kag Moon Geonyoung sang South Korea nga may 14.033.
english: He was followed by Kazakhstan’s Milad Karimi with 14.400 points and South Korea’s Moon Geonyoung with 14.033.

text: Ini na ang ikaapat nga sunod-sunod nga tuig nga gold medalist si Yulo sa floor exercise matapos nga nagpangibabaw man sa 2022, 2023, kag 2024 editions.
english: This is the fourth consecutive year that Yulo is a gold medalist in the floor exercise after also dominating the 2022, 2023, and 2024 editions.

text: Antes sini, matandaan nga na-secure sang Filipino gymnast ang bronze medal sa men’s all-around event sa amo man nga tournament sang nagligad nga adlaw.
english: Earlier, the Filipino gymnast secured the bronze medal in the men's all-around event at the same tournament the previous day.

text: Sa still rings finals nga ginpatigayon subong adlaw, nag-compete man si Yulo apang nagpang-pito lamang nga may 13.233 points.
english: In the still rings finals held today, Yulo also competed but only finished seventh with 13.233 points.

text: Kuwalipikado man ang Filipino golden boy sa vault, horizontal bar, kag parallel bars finals nga balantayan buwas, Hunyo 8.
english: The Filipino golden boy also qualified for the vault, horizontal bar, and parallel bars finals tomorrow, June 8.

text: GINAPAUNA naton ang pagpangamuyo, upod sa aton kauturan nga mga Filipino, ang kadalag-an ni Miss Rabiya sa Miss Universe Pageant nga hiwaton sa Mayo 16.
english: WE are praying, together with our Filipino brothers and sisters, for Miss Rabiya's victory in the Miss Universe Pageant to be held on May 16.

text: Tani indi kita malugaw-an katulad sang luyag matabo sang pila ka sup-sup bangongon nga naga-enjoy sang ila kademonyohan batok kay Miss Rabiya.
english: May we not be disappointed like what some sup-sup Bangon who are enjoying their demonism against Miss Rabiya want to happen.

text: Mas importante sa karon ang kadalag-an sang Demokrasya sangsa aton personal nga sentimiento.
english: The victory of Democracy is more important today than our personal sentiments.

text: Labi na gid kay ginaukudan ta pa ang pagpasanyog sang Demokrasya nga gindaug naton batok sa kamot nga salsalon sang martial law ni anay Presidente Marcos.
english: Especially since we are still trying to promote democracy that we won against the iron hand of former President Marcos' martial law.

text: Tungod sini, sikwali ang gawi nga diniktador sang iban sa aton nga indi makabaton sing kritisismo kag daw luyag pa nila busalan ang  pagpautwas sang iban sang ila baba paagi sang masakit nga sugilanon kag pamahog agud mapahipos sila.
english: Therefore, reject the dictatorial behavior of some of us who do not accept criticism and seem to want to silence the expression of others with painful stories and threats to silence them.

text: Sa aton Demokrasya, nga gindaug naton sugod sadtong 1986, kinamatarong ina, por ejemplo, ni Presidente Duterte ang magpati nga “unfit” ang isa ka babaye agud magpangulo sang pungsod.
english: In our democracy, which we have won since 1986, it is the right of, for example, President Duterte to believe that a woman is “unfit” to lead the country.

text: Pero kinamatarong man ina sang mga kababaenhan, katulad ni Miss Rabiya nga aton Miss Universe Philippines, kag bisan pa sang madamo man nga kalalakehan, sa pagpati nga may igual ng kinamatarong kag ikasarang man ang mga babaye agud mag-uyat sing mataas nga posisyon sa sosyedad lakip na sang iya sang presidente.
english: But it is also the right of women, like Miss Rabiya, our Miss Universe Philippines, and even many men, to believe that women have equal rights and abilities to hold high positions in society, including that of the president.

text: Indi kay pakamalauton si Miss Rabiya sang pila ka chochowa ni Presidente kag himu-himuan sing malaw-ay nga istorya nga makapanubo sang iya personalidad samtang nagahimos ini sa pagpasimpalad, sa ngalan sang mga Filipino, sa Miss Universe Pageant sa palaabuton nga Mayo 16.
english: Not that Miss Rabiya will be condemned by some of the President's chochowa and made up with ugly stories that will lower her personality as she prepares to compete, on behalf of the Filipinos, in the Miss Universe Pageant on May 16.

text: Pwede ina iya masabat ni Presidente ang kritisismo sa iya pagpati sa matarong nga paagi nga indi kinahanglan pakamalauton pa si Miss Rabiya.
english: The President can respond to criticism of his beliefs in a fair way without having to condemn Miss Rabiya.

text: Salamat lang kay wala ini makalingkang sa “peace of mind” ni Miss Rabiya kag ginaatubang lang ining mga paglibak sa iya sing may kaugdang kag taas-noo.
english: Thankfully, this did not disturb Miss Rabiya's “peace of mind” and only faced these criticisms with dignity and high-noo.

text: In fact, ginadayaw naton ang kaisug ni Rabiya sa iya pagsupak sa pagpati ni Presidente Duterte nga “unfit” mangin presidente ang isa ka babaye.
english: In fact, we admire Rabiya's courage in opposing President Duterte's belief that a woman is “unfit” to be president.

text: Indi lang tungod kapanahunan na ini sang “Women Power”, kundi tungod sa pagpakita man sang iya personal nga karakter sa pagpanguna sing may kaisug ang maayo nga mga kawsa katulad sang iya sang mga kababaehan.
english: Not only because it is the era of “Women Power”, but also because of her personal character in leading with courage good causes such as those of women.

text: Ini nga personalidad nagapamatuod pa gani nga bagay siya mangin Miss Universe 2021 (kon palaron) nga dala ang tatak sang maisug nga panindugan pabor sa mga kababaehan nga katulad niya.

In fact, sa panahon karon, mas kinahanglanon naton ang liderato nga maki-iloy nga may balatyagon samtang wala naman gina-spoil ang binatasan sang iya mga anak, ukon liderato nga “firm but kind”, sa pagdala sang panimalay sang pungsod.
english: In fact, in today's world, we need more leadership that is motherly with feelings while not spoiling the behavior of her children, or leadership that is “firm but kind”, in carrying the nation's household.

text: Indi ang kapintas kag wala balatyagon nga liderato, nga ginakangil-aran naton mabasahan sa mga pinanid sang  kasaysayan sang kalibutan.
english: Not the cruel and callous leadership, which we hate to read about in the pages of world history.

text: Katulad sang liderato sang mga mapintas kag wala kaluoy nga liderato ni Hitler sang Gemany,  Joseph Stalin sang Rusya, Idi Amin sang Uganda, Augusto Pinochet sang Chile, kag iban pa.
english: Like the leadership of the brutal and ruthless leadership of Hitler of Germany, Joseph Stalin of Russia, Idi Amin of Uganda, Augusto Pinochet of Chile, and others.

text: Samtang isa lang ang nahibal-an ko nga mapintas kag wala kaluoy nga lider nga babaye – si Queen “Bloody” Mary sang England nga ginpugutan sang ulo sang mahusgaran na ang iya kalain.
english: While I know of only one cruel and ruthless female leader – Queen “Bloody” Mary of England who was beheaded when her evil was judged.

text: Syempre indi ta man dapat kalimtan si Presidente Cory Aquino nga nagpanguna sa pagtumba sang mapintas nga martial law regime ni Marcos.
english: Of course, we should not forget President Cory Aquino who led the overthrow of Marcos' brutal martial law regime.

text: Lakip na dira ang pagpatigayon sang bag-o nga Konstitusyon nga nagpabalik sang Demokrasya sa pungsod, comprehsnive land reform, reforma sa military establishment, kag madamo pa.
english: This includes the implementation of a new Constitution that restored Democracy in the country, comprehsnive land reform, reform of the military establishment, and many more.

text: Indi ta man dapat kalimtan si President Gloria Arroyo, ang iloy sang Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps) sa Filipinas nga nagahatag sing paglaum sa madamo nga pigado naton nga mga pumuluyo.
english: We should not forget President Gloria Arroyo, the mother of the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps) in the Philippines who gives hope to many of our poor people.

text: Gintawag nga illegal ni Veronica ‘Kitty’ Duterte ang pag-aresto sa iya amay nga si former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Veronica 'Kitty' Duterte called the arrest of her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, illegal.

text: Ini ang gin-post mismo sang anay presidential daughter sa iya Instagram.
english: This was posted by the former presidential daughter herself on her Instagram.

text: “Illegal detention.
english: “Illegal detention.

text: No warrant of arrest,” post ni Kitty.
english: No warrant of arrest,” posted Kitty.

text: Una na nga ginkumpirma sang Malacañang ang pag-aresto sa anay presidente matapos gindagdagan sang warrant of arrest bangud sa crimes against humanity sang International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Malacañang earlier confirmed the arrest of the former president after the International Criminal Court (ICC) added a warrant of arrest for crimes against humanity.

text: Kun magluto kita sang adobo, ang iban sa aton, pat-od nga nagapulula ang mga tudlo sa kamot bangod sang pagkumos sang liso sang achiote ukon istiwitis agud ilakot sa aton nga sud-an.
english: When we cook adobo, some of us, surely our fingers turn red because of rubbing the seeds of achiote or istiwitis to add to our food.

text: Ang istiwitis ukon ang annatto amo ang sahi sang food coloring nga himo nagikan sa mga liso sang achiote.
english: Annatto is a type of food coloring made from achiote seeds.

text: Magluwas sa culinary uses sang istiwitis, madugay naman ini nga ginagamit para sa art sa South kag Central America kag ginagamit man agud bulngon ang pila ka mga medical condition.
english: In addition to the culinary uses of istiwitis, it has long been used for art in South and Central America and is also used to treat some medical conditions.

text: Suno kay Ryan Raman, isa ka registered dietician sa Auckland, New Zealand, natukiban sa test-tube studies nga ang extracts sang istiwitis ang nagabulig suppress ukon pugong sang cancer cell growth kag nagapatay sang mga cells nga nagatuga sang cancer sa prostate, pancreas, atay kag panit.
english: According to Ryan Raman, a registered dietician in Auckland, New Zealand, test-tube studies have shown that istiwitis extracts help suppress cancer cell growth and kill cancer-causing cells in the prostate, pancreas, liver and skin.

text:
Pahayag ni Raman, ini bangud manggaranon ang istiwitis sa anticancer properties kaangay sang carotenoids bixin kag norbixin, antioxidants kag tocotrienols nga isa ka sahi sang vitamin E.

Ang nasambit nga vitamin E compound nga yara sa istiwitis ang nagabulig man sa age-related heart issues.
english:
Raman said this is because istiwitis is rich in anticancer properties such as carotenoids bixin and norbixin, antioxidants and tocotrienols which is a type of vitamin E.

The vitamin E compound found in istiwitis also helps with age-related heart issues.

text: Magluwas diri, ang mataas nga carotenoids sang istiwitis ang nagapromote man sang eye health.
english: In addition, the high carotenoids of istiwitis also promote eye health.

text: Ipanawagan man sang Simbahan Katolika kadungan sang mobilisasyon sa ika-40 nga anibersaryo sang EDSA People Power Revolution ang pagtapna sa political dynasties sa Pilipinas.
english: The Catholic Church also called for the end of political dynasties in the Philippines during the mobilization on the 40th anniversary of the EDSA People Power Revolution.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Msgr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC), iya ginpahayag nga ini nga dinastiya amo man ang ugat sang kurapsyon.
english: Meliton Oso, director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC), said this dynasty is also the root of corruption.

text: Suno kay Oso, kadungan sang prusisyon kag prayer rally sa Pebrero 25, ipangamuyo kag ipanawagan sang Simbahan nga mangin sinsero kag seryoso man ang Kongreso sa pagpasar sang mga hagna batok sa nakaandan nga pagpasa-pasa sang gahum sa magpamilya sa pulitika.
english: Oso said that during the procession and prayer rally on February 25, the Church will pray and call on Congress to be sincere and serious in passing bills against the usual transfer of power to political families.

text: Ginbalikan sang JASAC Director ang statement nga gin-isyu sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines-Episcopal Commission on Catholic Education, Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines, Simbahang Lingkod ng Bayan, kag Caritas Philippines nga nagapanawagan sa paglakip sang pila ka mga probisyon sa anti-political dynasty bills nga pareho nga pending sa Kamara kag Senado.
english: The JASAC Director reiterated the statement issued by the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines-Episcopal Commission on Catholic Education, Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines, Simbahang Lingkod ng Bayan, and Caritas Philippines calling for the inclusion of several provisions in the anti-political bill such as the pending bill and Senate.

text: Sandig sa ginaduso sang church-based groups, limitahan lamang sa “maximum of two relatives per family” ang makauyat sang elective position nga isa sa local office kag isa sa national position kag indi dapat mag-overlap ang jurisdiction.
english: According to the proposal of church-based groups, only a maximum of two relatives per family can hold elective positions, one in the local office and one in the national position, and there should be no overlap in jurisdiction.

text: Ginsuhestyon man nga indi pagpasugtan ang mga maghimata tubtub sa fourth civil degree of consanguinity ukon affinity nga dungan nga makapungko sa elective positions.
english: It was also suggested that relatives up to the fourth civil degree of consanguinity or affinity should not be allowed to sit simultaneously in elective positions.

text: Pahayag ni Oso, nagalaum ang Social Action Network sang Simbahan nga indi pakulahaw kag indi lunsay lip-service lang ang ginaproponer nga mga hagna.
english: Oso said the Social Action Network of the Church hopes that the proposed bills are not just lip-service.

text: Matandaan nga nagmandu si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: It can be recalled that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa Kongreso nga hatagan sang prayoridad ang legislation nga amo ang magadumili sang political dynasties.
english: to Congress to give priority to legislation that would ban political dynasties.

text: Kabug-usan nga 24 ka anti-political dynasty bills ang na-file subong sa Kamara kag Senado lakip na ang House Bill 6771 nga ginduso nanday Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy kag presidential son kag House Majority Leader Ferdinand Alexander Marcos.#
english: A total of 24 anti-political dynasty bills are currently filed in the House and Senate including House Bill 6771 proposed by Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy and presidential son and House Majority Leader Ferdinand Alexander Marcos.

text: Nagabululigay ang mga overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) ilabi na ang mga naka-base sa pungsod Greece nga ipalab-ot ang impormasyon kaangot sa isa ka ginapahayag Ilonggo seaman nga na-confine sa ospital sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) especially those based in Greece are working together to provide information regarding an alleged Ilonggo seaman who is confined to a hospital in that country.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon base sa Facebook post sang OFW nga si Tess Cariño, ginapahayag nga ang pangalan sang seaman amo si Harold Nicolas kag admitted subong sa Rhodes General Hospital sa sulod na sang duha ka semana.
english: According to initial information based on a Facebook post by OFW Tess Cariño, the seaman's name is Harold Nicolas and he has been admitted to Rhodes General Hospital for two weeks.

text: Ginapahayag nga indi na ini maayo makahambal apang nakapanugid nga taga-Iloilo siya.
english: He is said to be unable to speak well but was able to tell that he is from Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Conrado Rivera, isa ka OFW nga naga-trabaho man sa Greece, iya ginpahayag nga sandig sa dugang nga impormasyon nga ginsugid ni Cariño, wala gid sang may nagatatap sa pasyente kag indi na sini mahulag ang pihak nga lawas bangud sa stroke.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Conrado Rivera, an OFW who is also working in Greece, said that based on additional information provided by Cariño, no one is taking care of the patient and he cannot move his other body due to the stroke.

text: Indi man makumpirma dugang ang mga detalye sa iya bangud wala ini sang passport kag wala man sang identification card nga nakit-an.
english: Further details could not be confirmed as he did not have a passport and no identification card was found.

text: Natabuan lang nga yara si Cariño sa amo nga ospital bangud nga na-ospital man ang iya nga amo.
english: Cariño happened to be in the hospital because his employer was also hospitalized.

text: Nagmato-mato man si Cariño nga limpyuhan ang amo nga seaman.
english: Cariño also threatened to clean up the seaman.

text: Indi maathag kun sin-o ang nakadala sa seaman sa ospital, apang sandig sa impormasyon halin sa isa man ka pasyente, may nakabisita anay sa iya sa ospital apang wala na nakabalik.
english: It is not clear who brought the seaman to the hospital, but based on information from another patient, someone visited him at the hospital but did not return.

text: Sunod man nga nagbululigay ang mga OFWs sa amo nga lugar.
english: The OFWs in the area also helped each other.

text: Sa Facebook, ang katapusan nga post sang amo nga seaman ang napetsahan pa sang Abril 18.
english: On Facebook, the seaman's last post was dated April 18.

text: Kaupod sini ang ‘Sailor’s Group Overseas Chapter’.
english: Along with this is the ‘Sailor’s Group Overseas Chapter’.

text: ILOILO – Tuman nga nagakabalaka ang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sa nangin desisyon sang Korte Suprema nga nagapahanugot sa commercial fishing vessels nga makasulod sa municipal waters.
english: ILOILO – The Sangguniang Panlalawigan is deeply concerned about the Supreme Court's decision to allow commercial fishing vessels to enter municipal waters.

text: Sa subong, tatlo na ka mga resolution ang gin-file kag gin-approve sa provincial board nga nagapahayag sang concern sa mga manugpangisda sa Iloilo.
english: So far, three resolutions have been filed and approved by the provincial board expressing concern for the fishermen in Iloilo.

text: Una nga gin-file amo ang resolution ni 5th District Board Member Binky April Tupas nga may tigulo “Resolution Supporting the Petitions and Position Papers of different fisherfolks associations in the Province of Iloilo, and the intervention that the Provincial Government of Iloilo intends to file relative to the Supreme Court’s Resolution in G.R.
