text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Dr. Ildefonso Toledo, Head sang Provincial Agriculture Office, nga ginatipon na sang Provincial Government ang mga petition kag position papers sang mga asosasyon sang manugpangisda agud ipadala sa Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources.
english: Earlier, Dr. Ildefonso Toledo, Head of the Provincial Agriculture Office, said the Provincial Government is already collecting the petitions and position papers of the fishermen's associations to be sent to the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources.

text: Naghabiya na sa The Hague, Netherlands si anay presidential spokesperson Harry Roque samtang nagkatalana nga sugoran ang iya proseso sa asylum.
english: Former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque has left The Hague, Netherlands as he is scheduled to begin his asylum process.

text: Suno kay Roque, ginahulat niya ang iya una nga interview sa syudad nga masobra apat ka oras ang kalayuon halin sa The Hague.
english: Roque said he was looking forward to his first interview in the city, which is more than four hours from The Hague.

text: Nagsiling siya nga pagkatapos sang una nga interview, hilway na siya nga magbalik sa The Hague.
english: He said that after the first interview, he was free to return to The Hague.

text: Ginpaathag niya nga ang proseso sang asylum may pila ka mga tikang, lakip ang inisyal nga pagparehistro, fingerprinting, interview sa pulis, medical examination, kag una nga interview.
english: He explained that the asylum process has several steps, including initial registration, fingerprinting, police interview, medical examination, and initial interview.

text: Pagkatapos sini, mahimo na siya maghalin kag maghulat na lang sang abiso para sa katapusan nga interview.
english: After that, he can leave and just wait for the notification for the final interview.

text: Ginpanindugan man ni Roque nga bilang isa ka asylum seeker, may yara siya sang kinamatarung sa nonrefoulement ukon proteksyon batok sa deportation pabalik sa Pilipinas nga iya gintawag nga pungsod nga nagapamulitika sa iya.
english: Roque also insisted that as an asylum seeker, he has the right to nonrefoulement or protection against deportation back to the Philippines which he called a country that politicizes him.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga indi na siya mapabalik sa Pilipinas bangud sa political persecution.
english: He said he will not be able to return to the Philippines because of political persecution.

text: Samtang, ginklaro man sini nga wala siya gin-detain kag hilway na nga makahulag.
english: Meanwhile, he clarified that he was not detained and is free to move.

text: Madumduman nga nagbiya sa pungsod si Roque matapos gin-issue sang Kongreso sang arrest warrant may kaangtanan sa ginaalegar kahilabtanan sini sa iligal nga operasyon sang Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) sa pungsod.
english: Roque left the country after Congress issued an arrest warrant in connection with his alleged involvement in the illegal operation of the Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) in the country.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sa publiko nga magmartsa sa EDSA agud suportahan si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: He also called on the public to march on EDSA to support former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Apang sa baylo nga magsuporta, daw baliskad ini kag madamo ang nagyaguta sa iya online, nga nagasiling nga dapat magbalik na lang siya sa Pilipinas kag pangunahan ang ginaduso nga protesta.
english: But instead of being supportive, it appeared to be the opposite and many mocked him online, saying he should just return to the Philippines and lead the proposed protest.

text: Nakibot kag nadismaya ang Department of Justice (DOJ) sa desisyon sang Timor-Leste Court of Appeal nga balibadan ang extradition request sang Pilipinas para mapapauli diri sa pungsod si anay Negros Oriental Representative Arnolfo “Arnie” Teves Jr.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) is shocked and disappointed by the decision of the Timor-Leste Court of Appeal to reject the extradition request of the Philippines to repatriate former Negros Oriental Representative Arnolfo “Arnie” Teves Jr.

text: Nagapangatubang si Teves sang multiple murder cases lakip na ang kaso sa pagsalakay sa balay kag pagpatay kay former Negros Oriental governor Roel Degamo kag iban pa sadtong 2023.
english: Teves is facing multiple murder cases including the house invasion and killing of former Negros Oriental governor Roel Degamo and others in 2023.

text: Suno sa justice department, nasorpresa sila sa desisyon bangud duha ka beses na nga nagpabor ang korte sang Timor Leste sa Philippine Government bag-o nagliso ang desisyon kag ginpaboran naman ang apelar ni Teves.
english: According to the justice department, they were surprised by the decision because the court of Timor Leste had twice favored the Philippine Government before the decision was reversed and favored Teves' appeal.

text: “It is peculiar that after having twice decided in favor of extradition—first in June 2024 and again in December 2024—the Timor-Leste Court of Appeal has now reversed its stance, taking a complete 180-degree turn to reject the Philippines’ extradition request,” suno sa DOJ.
english: “It is peculiar that after having twice decided in favor of extradition—first in June 2024 and again in December 2024—the Timor-Leste Court of Appeal has now reversed its stance, taking a complete 180-degree turn to reject the Philippines’ extradition request,” the DOJ said.

text: Una nga gin-aprubahan sang korte ang extradition request sang June 2024, apang ginkwestyon sang kampo ni Teves ang proseso gani nga nagpatigayon liwat sang hearing.
english: The court initially approved the extradition request in June 2024, but Teves' camp questioned the process and rescheduled the hearing.

text: Disyembre sang amo man nga tuig, ginpaguwa liwat ang desisyon pabor gihapon sa pagpapauli sa former congressman diri sa Pilipinas, apang nag-apelar naman ang kampo sini.
english: In December of the same year, the decision was again issued in favor of the former congressman's repatriation to the Philippines, but his camp appealed.

text: Pahayag pa sang DOJ, may seryoso nga concerns sa hinali nga paglain sang desisyon subong, kag magapangayo sang klaripikasyon ang Pilipinas kun ano ang nangin basehan sang amo nga desisyon.
english: The DOJ said there are serious concerns about the sudden change in the decision, and the Philippines will seek clarification on the basis of the decision.

text: “Allowing him to evade justice would be the height of injustice, not only to the victims and their families but to the integrity of the rule of law,” suno sa DOJ.
english: “Allowing him to evade justice would be the height of injustice, not only to the victims and their families but to the integrity of the rule of law,” according to the DOJ.

text: Nagpasalig man sang ahensya sa publiko nga himuon sang gobyerno ang tanan nga legal remedies para mabalik sa Pilipinas si Teves.
english: The agency also assured the public that the government will take all legal remedies to bring Teves back to the Philippines.

text:
Sa pihak nga bahin, nalipay naman ang kampo ni Teves kag gintawag pa ini sang iya legal counsel bilang “triumph of the rule of law.”

“The decision… denying the request for extradition of Rep.
english:
Meanwhile, Teves' camp was happy and his legal counsel called it a “triumph of the rule of law.”

“The decision… denying the request for extradition of Rep.

text: Arnolfo Teves to the Philippines to face trumped up charges fabricated by the oppressive and dictatorial Marcos government, is a triumph of the rule of law, and an indictment of the kind of government we currently have,” base sa statement sang former lawmaker.
english: Arnolfo Teves to the Philippines to face trumped up charges fabricated by the oppressive and dictatorial Marcos government, is a triumph of the rule of law, and an indictment of the kind of government we currently have,” based on the statement of the former lawmaker.

text: “A government who ignores the Constitution and the laws of the Republic in the brazen desire to silence political dissent and destroy the legitimate political opposition,” dugang sini.
english: “A government who ignores the Constitution and the laws of the Republic in the brazen desire to silence political dissent and destroy the legitimate political opposition,” it added.

text: 10 ka counts sang murder, 14 counts sang frustrated murder, kag apat ka counts sang attempted murder sa idalom sang Revised Penal Code ang ginaatubang ni Teves.
english: 10 counts of murder, 14 counts of frustrated murder, and four counts of attempted murder under the Revised Penal Code are facing Teves.

text: Ginpanginwala naman sang anay mamalidha ini nga mga alegasyon batok sa iya.
english: The former lawmaker has denied these allegations against him.

text: Gindesignar man siya anay bilang terorista sa idalom sang Anti-Terrorism Council bangud sang gina-alegar nga mga pagpamatay sa Negros Oriental.
english: He was also designated as a terrorist under the Anti-Terrorism Council for alleged killings in Negros Oriental.

text: Gin-appoint ang anay presidente kag chief executive officer sang Union Digital Bank nga si Henry Rhoel Aguda bilang bag-o nga secretary sang Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT).
english: Former Union Digital Bank president and chief executive officer Henry Rhoel Aguda has been appointed as the new secretary of the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT).

text: Ginpili ni President Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos Jr.

text: si Aguda para islan si anay secretary Ivan John Uy nga naghalin sa pwesto sang Marso subong nga tuig.
english: Aguda to replace former secretary Ivan John Uy who stepped down in March this year.

text: Si Aguda ang anay parte sang Digital Infrastructure Lead ni Marcos sa Private Sector Advisory Council kag siya man ang may eksperyensya sa mga sector sang banking kag teknolohiya.
english: Aguda was previously part of Marcos’ Digital Infrastructure Lead on the Private Sector Advisory Council and he also has experience in the banking and technology sectors.

text: Nag-serbe man si Aguda bilang chairman sang board sang City Savings sa UBX Philippines, director sang Insular Health Care, BancNet, Metaverse Ventures and Platforms, sa Philippine Clearing House Corp.
english: Aguda also served as chairman of the board of City Savings at UBX Philippines, director of Insular Health Care, BancNet, Metaverse Ventures and Platforms, at Philippine Clearing House Corp.

text: Magluwas diri, nangin parte man siya sang software development services sa WeServ Systems International, nag-serbe bilang assistant vice president sa Bayantel Communication Holdings.
english: Besides, he has also been part of software development services at WeServ Systems International, served as assistant vice president at Bayantel Communication Holdings.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakuha ni Aguda ang iya degree sa mathematics halin sa University of the Philippines Diliman sang 1989 kag ang Juris Doctor halin sa UP Law sang 2008 — pareho nga cum laude.
english: Aguda obtained his degree in mathematics from the University of the Philippines Diliman in 1989 and the Juris Doctor from UP Law in 2008 — both cum laude.

text: Nakapasakop man siya sa Strategic Alliance Program sa Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania kag nagakuha sang master’s degree in Applied Business Economics sa University of Asia and the Pacific.
english: He has also participated in the Strategic Alliance Program at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania and is pursuing a master’s degree in Applied Business Economics at the University of Asia and the Pacific.

text: (Article: Bombo Mae Joy Amora)
english: (Article: Bombo Mae Joy Amora)

text: Ginatudlo ni Senator Imee Marcos nga ang Interpol diffusion request ang wala sang “prior consultations” sa gobyerno sang Pilipinas kag nagapahanugot ini nga sundon ang mandu nga dakpon si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Senator Imee Marcos points out that the Interpol diffusion request did not have “prior consultations” with the Philippine government and allows it to follow the order to arrest former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Gintumod ni Sen.
english: He pointed out that Sen.

text: Marcos nga ang dokumento partikular nga nagapanawagan para sa mga panikasog sa pagpangita kag pagdakop nga may tuyo nga extradition, kag nagalakip sang mga probisyon para sa provisional arrest suno sa national laws kag/ukon applicable sa bilateral and multilateral treaties.
english: Marcos said the document specifically calls for search and arrest efforts with extradition in mind, and includes provisions for provisional arrest in accordance with national laws and/or applicable bilateral and multilateral treaties.

text: Suno naman kay Justice Secretary Boying Remulla, ginpili sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas nga isungka si Duterte sa Interpol.
english: Justice Secretary Boying Remulla said the Philippine government chose to extradite Duterte to Interpol.

text: Dugang ni Marcos, dapat ang publiko ang mangin hukom kon bala ginhatagan sang due process si anay presidente Rodrigo Duterte sang gindakop ini halin sa isa ka biyahe sa Hong Kong kag ginpalupad pakadto sa The Hague, Netherlands bangud sa iya ginaalegar crime against humanity.
english: Marcos said the public should be the judge of whether former President Rodrigo Duterte was given due process when he was arrested from a trip to Hong Kong and flown to The Hague, Netherlands for his alleged crime against humanity.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Senator Marcos, chair sang Senate Committee on Foreign Relations, ang nagpanguna sa hearing sang Senado sa pagdakop sa anay presidente sang Marso 11.
english: Senator Marcos, chairman of the Senate Committee on Foreign Relations, led the Senate hearing on the arrest of the former president on March 11.

text: Sa hearing sang Senate foreign relations committee sa pag-aresto kay Duterte, ginpresentar ni Marcos ang serye sang mga video clip halin sang ginserbe ang warrant of arrest sa anay presidente sang ini ang nagpauli sa Pilipinas halin sa Hong Kong, tubtob sang ginpalupad ini sa Netherlands.
english: At the hearing of the Senate foreign relations committee on Duterte's arrest, Marcos presented a series of video clips from the time the warrant of arrest was served on the former president when he returned to the Philippines from Hong Kong, until he was flown to the Netherlands.

text: Kon mapamatud-an nga may mga sala sa pagdakop kay Duterte, ginpahayag ni Marcos nga magabutang sila sang mga safeguards agud indi na ini matabo liwat.
english: If it is proven that there were wrongdoings in Duterte's arrest, Marcos said they will put in place safeguards to prevent this from happening again.

text: Nagpabutyag naman si Palace Press Officer Usec.
english: Palace Press Officer Usec.

text: Claire Castro nga indi sini luyag nga mangin probinsya sang The Hague ukon China ukon bisan ano nga pungsod ang Pilipinas kasunod sang ginapatuman layi batok kay former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Claire Castro said she does not want the Philippines to become a province of The Hague or China or any other country following the law against former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Suno kay Castro, nakahibalo si Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: According to Castro, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa imbestigasyon sang Senado nga ginapangunahan sang iya utod nga si Sen.
english: in the Senate investigation led by his brother, Sen.

text: Imee Marcos.
english: Imee Marcos.

text: Si Castro nagsiling nga ang Palasyo indi magpamatok sa imbestigasyon agud ipakita nga ang gobyerno nagasunod sa mga kasuguan sang Pilipinas kag wala sang ginatago sa pagdakop kay Duterte.
english: Castro said the Palace will not oppose the investigation to show that the government is following Philippine laws and has nothing to hide in arresting Duterte.

text: Suno kay Castro, naka-istorya na si Marcos kay Solicitor General Menardo Guevarra matapos ang pagbalibad ni Guevarra sa pagdepensa sa gobyerno sa habeas corpus petitions nga ginpasaka sang mga kabataan ni Duterte.
english: Castro said Marcos has already spoken to Solicitor General Menardo Guevarra after Guevarra refused to defend the government in habeas corpus petitions filed by Duterte's children.

text: Ginpahayag ni Castro nga wala nadula ang pagsalig ni Marcos kay Guevarra.
english: Castro said Marcos has not lost confidence in Guevarra.

text: Sa una nga war crimes trial halin sang gin-atake sang Russia ang Ukraine, nag-atubang kag nag-ako ang 21-anyos nga Russian soldier sa pagpatay sa isa ka 62-anyos nga sibilyan.
english: In the first war crimes trial since Russia invaded Ukraine, a 21-year-old Russian soldier has come forward and pleaded guilty to the murder of a 62-year-old civilian.

text: Ang non-commissioned officer amo si Vadim Shishimarin, myembro sang Russian tank unit, kag posible silutan sang bilog nga kabuhi nga pagkabilanggo.
english: Ang non-commissioned officer amo si Vadim Shishimarin, myembro sang Russian tank unit, kag posible silutan sang bilog nga kabuhi nga pagkabilanggo.

text: Gin-ako sini ang pagluthang sa 62 anyos nga indi armado nga Ukrainian sa northeastern Sumy region sang bag-o pa lang nag-umpisa ang Russian invasion.
english: He admitted to shooting a 62-year-old unarmed Ukrainian in the northeastern Sumy region just before the Russian invasion began.

text: Sang nag-plead guilty si Shishimarin sa amo nga krimen, yara mismo ang asawa sang sibilyan nga iya ginpatay.
english: When Shishimarin pleaded guilty to the crime, the wife of the civilian he killed was present.

text: Gin-prosecute si Shishimarin sa idalom sang section sang Ukrainian criminal code nga naga-address sang laws and customs sang gyera.
english: Shishimarin was prosecuted under a section of the Ukrainian criminal code that addresses the laws and customs of war.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Ukrainian Prosecutor General Iryna Venediktova nga ginahanda na ang war crimes cases batok sa 41 Russian soldiers sa sala nga nagalakip sang pagpamomba sa mga civilian infrastructure, pagpatay sa mga sibilyan, pagpang-rape, kag pagpangawat.
english: Earlier, Ukrainian Prosecutor General Iryna Venediktova said war crimes cases were being prepared against 41 Russian soldiers for crimes including bombing civilian infrastructure, killing civilians, rape, and theft.

text: Indi pa subong maathag kun pila na sa mga Russian soldiers ang nadakpan.
english: It is not yet clear how many of the Russian soldiers have been captured.

text: Ginasundan ang kaso ni Shishimarin bangud nagakolekta ang mga imbestigador sang ebidensya sang ginapahayag natabo nga war crimes agud madala mismo sa International Criminal Court sa The Hague.
english: Shishimarin's case is being followed as investigators are collecting evidence of alleged war crimes to be brought to the International Criminal Court in The Hague.

text: Ginapahayag nga 10,700 potential war crimes ang ginasundan kag masobra 600 ang suspects lakip na ang Russian soldiers kag government officials.
english: It is reported that 10,700 potential war crimes are being investigated and more than 600 are suspects including Russian soldiers and government officials.

text: Magahiwat ang Department of Energy (DOE) sang One-Stop-Shop sa probinsya sang Palawan halin Agosto 11 tubtob 15, 2025, agud mapadasig ang proseso sang pagkuha sang License to Operate (LTO) kag Certificate of Compliance (COC) para sa mga negosyante nga sakop sang industriya sang LPG.
english: The Department of Energy (DOE) will hold a One-Stop-Shop in Palawan province from August 11 to 15, 2025, to expedite the process of obtaining License to Operate (LTO) and Certificate of Compliance (COC) for entrepreneurs in the LPG industry.

text: Ginpa-athag sang DOE nga ini nga inisyatibo kabahin sang direktiba ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The DOE explained that this initiative is part of the directive of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga mapadasig ang serbisyo sang gobyerno sa mga malayo nga lugar, labi na sa mga MSMEs.
english: to accelerate government services in remote areas, especially to MSMEs.

text: Ginapunto man sang ahensya nga pinaagi sa One-Stop-Shop, mahimo na nga makuha sa pareho nga adlaw ang LTO kag COC basta kumpleto ang ginpresentar nga mga dokumento sang aplikante.
english: The agency also points out that through the One-Stop-Shop, the LTO and COC can be obtained on the same day as long as the documents presented by the applicant are complete.

text: Ini magabulig nga makaminus sang gastos kag oras sa pagproseso kag makalikaw sa tuman ka delay.
english: This will help minimize processing costs and time and avoid excessive delay.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga One-Stop-Shop nga ginpatigayon sang DOE sa Palawan, kasunod sang ginhiwat sa Puerto Princesa sang 2023.
english: This is the second One-Stop-Shop conducted by the DOE in Palawan, following the one held in Puerto Princesa in 2023.

text: Plano man sang ahensya nga i-extend pa ini nga programa sa iban pa nga mga isla kag malayo nga probinsya sa pungsod.
english: The agency also plans to extend the program to other islands and remote provinces in the country.

text: ILOILO CITY- Importante nga leksyon gid ang natun-an sang isa ka lalaki sa United Kingdom nga nakahiligan ang pagkaon sang French fries, potato chips, processed meat kag white bread sa sulod sang pila ka tuig.
english: ILOILO CITY – A man in the United Kingdom who has been eating French fries, potato chips, processed meat and white bread for several years has learned an important lesson.

text: Gin-report sang mga doctor sa UK ang shocking case sang teenager nga naguba ang mata tubtob naglab-ot sa punto nga nabulag ini bangud sa poor diet tuga sang pagkaon sang french fries, potato chips, processed meat kag white bread.
english: Doctors in the UK reported the shocking case of a teenager who lost his eyesight to the point of blindness due to a poor diet caused by eating french fries, potato chips, processed meat and white bread.

text: Ang Bristol-based teenager, nga nagpahinago sang pangalan, ang ginlaragway sang iya pamilya nga wala gid natolerar ang sabor kag texture sang utan kag prutas.
english: The Bristol-based teenager, who asked to remain anonymous, was described by her family as never tolerating the taste and texture of vegetables and fruit.

text: Una siya nga nagpakonsulta sa doctor sang siya ang 14, bangud nagabatyag siya sang kakapoy kag paglain sang pamatyag kag na- diagnosed nga may severe vitamin deficiency.
english: She first consulted a doctor when she was 14, because she was feeling tired and unwell and was diagnosed with severe vitamin deficiency.

text: Siya ang ginpatumar sang supplements kag gin- abisuhan nga bag-uhon ang diet, apang wala niya ini gintuman, kag matapos ang tatlo ka tuig, siya ang na- diagnose nga may progressive sight loss bangud sa undernourishment.
english: He was prescribed supplements and advised to change his diet, but he did not comply, and after three years, he was diagnosed with progressive sight loss due to undernourishment.

text: Suno sa mga doktor, ini nga condition ang mabulong kuntani kun na- diagnose sang temprano apang sa kaso sang lalaki, ini ang nangin irreversible.
english: According to doctors, this condition could have been cured if diagnosed early but in the case of the man, it became irreversible.

text: Bangud sini,siya ang nag-untat gid sa pag- eskwela gani tubtob subong, ginahinulsulan ang pagkahilig sa mga pagkaon nga indi masustansiya.
english: Because of this, he dropped out of school and to this day, he regrets his fondness for junk food.

text: Nagapangayo si Pavia Mayor Laurence Gorriceta sang klaro kag insakto nga imbestigasyon halin sa kapulisan may kaangtanan sa duha ka magsunod nga insidente nga natabo sang nagligad nga gab-i Pebrero 23 sa banwa sang Pavia.
english: Pavia Mayor Laurence Gorriceta is demanding a clear and proper investigation from the police in connection with two consecutive incidents that occurred last night February 23 in Pavia town.

text: Ini matapos nga wala nagasanto ang mga statement kag imbestigasyon nga ginpagwa sang Pavia Municipal Police Station, Criminal Investigation and Detection Group(CIDG) Iloilo kag Police Regional Office (PRO) 6.
english: This is after the statements and investigations issued by the Pavia Municipal Police Station, Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) Iloilo and Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 do not match.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Pavia Mayor Laurence Gorriceta, iya ginapahayag nga nagapanawagan ini nga kuntani hatagan sang atensyon ni PRO 6 Director PBGen.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Pavia Mayor Laurence Gorriceta said he is calling for the attention of PRO 6 Director PBGen.

text: Josefino Ligan kag Provincial Director PCol.
english: Josefino Ligan and Provincial Director PCol.

text: Bayani Razalan ang nasambit nga mga insidente agud nga mahatagan ini sang insakto kag klaro nga imbestigasyon.
english: Bayani Razalan the said incidents so that they can be given a proper and clear investigation.

text: Pahayag pa niya, tuman ini ka dismayado sa natabo nga imbestigasyon sang Pavia Municipal Police Station.
english: He said he was very disappointed with the investigation of the Pavia Municipal Police Station.

text: Dugang pa ni Mayor Gorriceta, magahulat ini sang lihuk nga pagaubrahon sang mga otoridad kag dapat pasabton ang mga dapat manabat sa natbo nga insidente.
english: Mayor Gorriceta said he will wait for the action of the authorities and those responsible for the incident should be held accountable.

text: Sa kaangot nga balita, dismayado man si Mayor Luigi Gorriceta sa performance ni Police Captain Ritz Presquito sa pag-imbestigar sa gina-alegar nga abduction incidents nga natabo sa ila banwa.
english: In related news, Mayor Luigi Gorriceta is also disappointed with the performance of Police Captain Ritz Presquito in investigating the alleged abduction incidents that occurred in their town.

text: Pahayag pa sang alcalde nga kun indi mahatagan sang solusyon maga-request ini sang replacement ni PCapt.
english: The mayor said that if a solution is not provided, he will request the replacement of PCapt.

text: Presquito.
english: Presquito.

text: Dugang pa sang alcalde nga indi man ini satisfied sa trabaho sang Pavia Municipal Police Station.
english: The mayor added that he is not satisfied with the work of the Pavia Municipal Police Station.

text: Sa matandaan nga sa idalom man ni Pcapt.
english: It can be recalled that under Pcapt.

text: Presquito natbo ang pagsulod sang Termite gang sa isa ka jewelry shop sang Pamilya Gorriceta sa nasambit nga banwa.
english: Presquito said the Termite gang entered a jewelry shop of the Gorriceta family in the said town.

text: Suportado ng Philippine National Police (PNP) ang planong pagpapalabas ng reward money para sa agarang pagkaaresto kay dating AKO Bicol Partylist Representatives Zaldy Co.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) supports the planned release of reward money for the immediate arrest of former AKO Bicol Partylist Representatives Zaldy Co.

text: Ayon kay acting PNP chief Lt.
english: According to acting PNP chief Lt.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.
english: Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.

text: patuloy ang kanilang pakikipag-ugnayan sila sa mga iba’t-ibang ahensiya gaya ng Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) at Office of the President para sa pagsasaayos sa pag-aresto kay Go.
english: they continue to liaise with various agencies such as the Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) and Office of the President to arrange for the arrest of Go.

text: Dagdag pa nito na gagawa muna sila ng pormal na rekomendasyon sa reward scheme at nakatuon sila sa pag-aresto kay Co.
english: He added that they will make a formal recommendation on the reward scheme and they are focused on the arrest of Co.

text: Ang nasabing reward ay makakatulong sa komunidad para ituro ang kinaroroonan ni Co.
english: The said reward will help the community to point out the legacy of Co.

text: GOOD to hear halin sa regional office sang Department of Health (DOH-6) nga wala sing na-detect nga “variant” sang COVID-19 diri sa Western Visayas.
english: GOOD to hear from the regional office of the Department of Health (DOH-6) that no “variant” of COVID-19 has been detected here in Western Visayas.

text: Sunu kay Dr. Mary Jane Roches Juanico,  head sang DOH-6 Infectious Disease Cluster, wala sa mga specimens nga ginpadala nila sa Phiipine Genome Center ang nangin positive sa bisan ano nga variant sang COVID-19.
english: According to Dr. Mary Jane Roches Juanico, head of the DOH-6 Infectious Disease Cluster, said none of the specimens they sent to the Phiipine Genome Center tested positive for any variant of COVID-19.

text: Mga 45 ka specimen ang ila ginpadala sa Philippine Genome Center, siling niya.
english: They sent about 45 specimens to the Philippine Genome Center, he said.

text: “Meaning zero new variant for Region 6,” pamat-ud niya.
english: “Meaning zero new variant for Region 6,” he concluded.

text: Apang ngaa “good to hear” nga wala sing na-detect nga variant ang COVID-19 sa Region 6?
english: But why is it “good to hear” that no variant of COVID-19 has been detected in Region 6?

text: Ngaa may dapat bala kita kabalak-an kon may yara na sini diri sa aton?
english: Why should we have anything to worry about if we already have it here?

text: Indi man ini mas makamamatay sangsa orihinal nga COVID-19, sunu gani sa kadam-an nga mga scientist.
english: It is also no more deadly than the original COVID-19, according to most scientists.

text: Kon may pila ka scientist ang nakasiling nga posible mas makamamatay ini, wala man sila ugaling mapat-ud nga ebidensya nga mas makamamatay gid man ini.
english: While some scientists have suggested that it may be more deadly, they have not found conclusive evidence that it is actually more deadly.

text: Kon may kabalak-an kita ugaling, ina amo ang ginpakita sini nga kadasig sang paglapta sing pagpanglaton sini.
english: If there is any concern, however, it is the speed with which it has spread.

text: Mas madasig kuno ini manglaton sing mga 70 ka porsyento, sunu sa nadiskubrihan sa United Kingdom.
english: It is said to spread about 70 percent faster, according to discoveries in the United Kingdom.

text: Kag diri sini kita seguro dapat magkalangkag kay basi indi na naton maarapalan ang pagtatap sang mga pasyente sa kadamuon nga matupa sa mga ospital kon amo man sini ang klase sang variant sang COVID-19 ang magtuhaw diri sa aton.
english: And this is where we should probably be concerned because we may not be able to cope with the care of patients in the number of hospitals if the same kind of variant of COVID-19 appears here in our country.

text: Nga daan malawig na ang linya sa madamo nga ospital sa Metro Manila tungod sa padayon nga mga kaso sang orihinal nga COVID-19.
english: That there are already long lines in many hospitals in Metro Manila due to the continuous cases of the original COVID-19.

text: Wala man nagadugang ang kadamuon sang mga doktor, nars kag iban pa nga health workers, labi na gid kay madamo sa ila ang nagpaamulya na sa pagtrabaho sa gwa sang pungsod tungod sa kaiwat sang pangabuhi diri sa Filipinas.
english: The number of doctors, nurses and other health workers is not increasing, especially since many of them have already decided to work abroad due to the poor living conditions here in the Philippines.

text:
***

Ano gid bala ang isa ka variant sang COVID-19?
english:
***

What exactly is a variant of COVID-19?

text: Ang bisan ano nga virus, katulad sang COVID-19 virus, masami nga naga-replicate, ukon nagahimo sing kopya sang iy kaugalingon nga may dugang sang bisan diutay lang nga kapinasahe agud magpakita sang bag-o nga kinaiya kag epekto sa mabiktima sini.
english: Any virus, such as the COVID-19 virus, often replicates, or makes a copy of itself with the addition of even a little bit of functionality to show new characteristics and effects on its victims.

text: Ining pagkopya sang kinaiya, sa pag-explicar sang mga scientist, ginatawag nga “mutation”.
english: This replication of the trait, to explain scientists, is called “mutation”.

text: Samtang ang virus nga may isa ukon dugang pa nga “mutation” ginatawag nga “variant”.
english: While a virus with one or more mutations is called a variant.

text: Na-detect ang isa ka variant sang COVID-19 sadtong bulan sang Disyembre 2020 sa southestern England.
english: A variant of COVID-19 was detected in December 2020 in southeastern England.

text: Ini ang B.1.1.7 variant.
english: It is the B.1.1.7 variant.

text: Halin sadto nakita na ini sa iban nga pungsod lakip ang United States, South Africa, Brazil kag Japan.
english: It has since been spotted in other countries including the United States, South Africa, Brazil and Japan.

text: May na-detect na gani diri sa Filipinas nga dala sang mga nagapanglugayawan (traveller), partikular sa Central Visayas (Cebu kag kaiping nga mga isla) kag sa Metro Manila.
english: Some have even been detected in the Philippines brought by travelers, particularly in Central Visayas (Cebu and neighboring islands) and Metro Manila.

text: Pero wala pa ini sa Western Visayas, sunu gani sa report sang DOH-6 sang sini lang.
english: But it is not yet in Western Visayas, according to a recent DOH-6 report.

text: Ang una nga na-identify sa Central Visayas amo ang variant nga na-derive sa Brazilian B.1.1.28 strain nga mahalintulad sa P.1 variant nga na-detect sa Manaus sang Enero 2021.
english: The first identified in Central Visayas is a variant derived from the Brazilian B.1.1.28 strain which is similar to the P.1 variant detected in Manaus in January 2021.

text: May amo-amo ini nga characteristics nga unique sa Filipinas.
english: It has certain characteristics that are unique to the Philippines.

text:
***

May mga una nga pagpati nga basi ining mga variant may abilidad sa paglikaw sa mga antibodies agud libre makapanghalit sa ila biktima.
english:
***

There were initial beliefs that perhaps these variants had the ability to evade antibodies to freely harm their prey.

text: May findings ugaling nga ma-neutralize man ang madasig sini nga paglapta, sunu sa nadiskurihan sa Brazil.
english: There are findings, however, that it can also neutralize its rapid spread, according to discoveries in Brazil.

text: Sang Enero 2021 mismo, isa ka variant ang na-detect sa Brazil sa isa ka traveller nga nagpadulong sa Japan.
english: In January 2021 itself, a variant was detected in Brazil in a traveler bound for Japan.

text: Sang sumunod nga bulan, nakita na ini sa United States.
english: The following month, it was seen in the United States.

text: Tani malibre kita diri sa WesternVisayas sining variant sang COVID-19 agud indi na maglala pa ang mga kaso diri sang COVID-19 sa iya orihinal nga kinaiya kag halin man sa kon ano pa nga “variant” sini nga magtuhaw diri sa aton sa Filipinas.
english: Hopefully we will be free here in Western Visayas from this variant of COVID-19 so that the cases of COVID-19 will not get worse in its original form and from any other “variant” that will appear here in the Philippines.

text: Kag kon makalab-ut man ini sa aton diri, tani mangin mas mangin mas maamligon pa gid kita batok sini sa pagsunod religiously sa minimum health protocols nga ginapatuman sang aton gobyerno kag mga health authorities./PN
english: And if it reaches us here, hopefully we will be more protected against it by following religiously the minimum health protocols implemented by our government and health authorities./PN

text: Wala subong nakahibalo ang National Police Commission (Napolcom) kun sa diin na ang pulis nga nagpamahog sa International Criminal Court (ICC) kag sa Interpol kaangot sa pagkaaresto kay former President Rodrigo Duterte sang Marso 11.
english: The National Police Commission (Napolcom) does not know the whereabouts of the policeman who threatened the International Criminal Court (ICC) and Interpol in connection with the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte on March 11.

text: Ini amo si Patrolman Francis Steve Fontillas nga kilala man bilang si Fonts Stv Vlogs sa iya Facebook account.
english: This is Patrolman Francis Steve Fontillas also known as Fonts Stv Vlogs on his Facebook account.

text:
Temprano nga bahin sang Marso sang nagpaguwa siya sang threat sa Interpol kag sa international tribunal paagi sa pagsiling nga may gyera nga matabo kun tandugon ang former president nga iya ginatawag nga “Tatay Digong.”

Suno kay Napolcom Commissioner Ralph Calinisan, at large subong ang amo nga patrolman, wala sa Quezon City Police District (QCPD), kag padayon pa nga ginapangita.
english:
In early March, he issued a threat to Interpol and the international tribunal by saying that there would be war if he touched the former president whom he called “Tatay Digong.”

According to Napolcom Commissioner Ralph Calinisan, the patrolman is now at large, not in the Quezon City Police District (QCPD), and is still being sought.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sang Napolcom nga sang Pebrero, nag-request ang superior sang pulis nga magpaidalom ini sa mental health check sa regional office, apang wala ini nagsipot kag nagpamalibad nga magpa-test sa medical team sang Philippine National Police (PNP).
english: Napolcom also revealed that in February, the police superior requested that he undergo a mental health check at the regional office, but he did not hesitate and refused to be tested by the medical team of the Philippine National Police (PNP).

text: Nag-file naman ang Napolcom sang panumbungon nga grave misconduct kag conduct unbecoming of a police officer batok kay Fontillas kasunod sang ila ginpatigayon nga kaugalingon nga imbestigasyon.
english: Napolcom filed charges of grave misconduct and conduct unbecoming of a police officer against Fontillas following their own investigation.

text: Magluwas sa administrative cases halin sa Napolcom, una naman nag-file ang PNP sang “inciting to sedition” criminal case batok sa patrolman sa Quezon City Prosecutor’s Office.
english: Aside from the administrative cases from Napolcom, the PNP also filed an “inciting to sedition” criminal case against the patrolman at the Quezon City Prosecutor’s Office.

text: Posible suno kay Calinisan nga madagdagan sang penalidad si Fontillas kaangay sang suspension, iga-demote (bisan nga patrolman na ini ukon ang lowest ranking nga police officer) ukon kakasan gid sang badge ukon pahalinon sa serbisyo.
english: Calinisan said it is possible that Fontillas will face additional penalties such as suspension, demotion (even if he is a patrolman or the lowest ranking police officer) or be stripped of his badge or dismissed from service.

text: Sa latest post ni Fontillas, ginsuyaan pa sini ang PNP kag nagsiling nga indi siya magsunod sa mga order sang organisasyon.
english: In Fontillas' latest post, he criticized the PNP and said he would not follow the orders of the organization.

text: Indi na mangin kabahin sang defense team ni former president Rodrigo Duterte sa iya kaso sa International Criminal Court (ICC) sanday former executive secretary Salvador Medialdea kag former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque.
english: Former executive secretary Salvador Medialdea and former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque will no longer be part of former president Rodrigo Duterte's defense team in his case at the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Ini base sa pahayag ni Vice President Sara Duterte kasunod sang iya pagbisita sa iya amay sa ICC detention facility.
english: This is based on the statement of Vice President Sara Duterte following her visit to her father at the ICC detention facility.

text: Suno kay VP Sara, ang legal team ang pangunahan ni Atty. Nicholas Kaufman kag may iban pa nga abogado siya nga istoryahon.
english: According to VP Sara, the legal team will be led by Atty. Nicholas Kaufman and he has other lawyers to talk to.

text: May yara man sang maabot nga isa ka abogado nga iya ipaidalom anay sa interview para mag-upod sa team.
english: There will also be a lawyer who will be interviewed to join the team.

text: Suno sa bise presidente,sa tion nga mahuman na ang team para sa ICC, maga-withdraw si Atty. Medialdea bangud may yara lang sang limited nga mga slots para sa mga abogado kag luyag nila nga may eksperyensya sa ICC ang tanan nga magabug-os sang legal team.
english: According to the vice president, once the team for the ICC is completed, Atty. Medialdea because there are only limited slots for lawyers and they want everyone who will make up the legal team to have ICC experience.

text: S Medialdea ang nag-atubang sa ICC Pre-Trial chamber sang naghimo sang iya una nga appearance via videolink si former president Duterte sang Marso 14.
english: S Medialdea appeared in the ICC Pre-Trial chamber when former president Duterte made his first appearance via videolink on March 14.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, ginsiling ni Sara nga ang British-Israeli lawyer nga si Kaufman ang mangin lead counsel kauposd sanday Roque kag Medialdea bilang supporting lawyers.
english: Last week, Sara said British-Israeli lawyer Kaufman will be lead counsel with Roque and Medialdea as supporting lawyers.

text: Sang Lunes, gin-anunsyo ni Roque, ang iya plano nga mag- apply para sa asylum sa Netherlands, apang wala ini na-nominate nga mangin parte sang defense team as well.
english: On Monday, Roque announced his plan to apply for asylum in the Netherlands, but he was not nominated to be part of the defense team as well.

text: Suno kay VP Sara, wala pa na-establish kun ano ang basehan sang pagtinir ni Roque sa Netherlands kag indi niya luyag sang komplikado nga sitwasyon.
english: According to VP Sara, it has not been established what the basis of Roque's stay in the Netherlands is and he does not want a complicated situation.

text: Sa bahin naman ni Kaufman, siya ang officially appointed bilang lead counsel sang Marso 17 kag nabisitahan naman niya si former President Duterte sa detention.
english: Kaufman was officially appointed as lead counsel on March 17 and visited former President Duterte in detention.

text: Suno kay Kaufman, dako ang pagsalig niya nga may mapag-on nga depensa si Duterte kalakip na ang kwestiyonable nga pag- aresto sa iya.
english: Kaufman said he is confident that Duterte has a strong defense including his questionable arrest.

text: Dugang ni Kaufman, may isa ka semana sila agud mahuman ang ila defense team.
english: Kaufman added that they have a week to complete their defense team.

text: Gina-monitor sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) ang 20 ka vloggers nga ginaakusaran nga nagapinalapta sang fake news sa social media.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) is monitoring 20 vloggers accused of spreading fake news on social media.

text: Sa 20 nga ini, duha na ang may yara sang arrest warrants.
english: Of the 20, two already have arrest warrants.

text: Mismo si NBI Director Jaime Santiago ang nagkumpirma nga may lista sila sang vloggers kag sa ila pinakaulihi nga online posts.
english: NBI Director Jaime Santiago himself confirmed that they have a list of vloggers and their latest online posts.

text: uno kay Santiago, may isa pa ka vlogger nga didto nakabase sa United States.
english: uno Santiago, there is another vlogger who is based in the United States.

text: Gina-assess sang bureau ang posible ikaso sa sini nga mga indibidwal bangud ginpahayag nga sulod ini sa cyber libel kag sulod man sa inciting to sedition.
english: The bureau is assessing possible charges against these individuals as they are allegedly involved in cyber libel and also involved in inciting to sedition.

text: “Papasok sa cyber libel, papasok sa inciting to sedition.
english: “It will be charged with cyber libel, it will be charged with inciting to sedition.

text: Yung mga mamamayan natin, ginagawa nilang biro-biro yan no?
english: Our citizens, they make jokes about it, right?

text: Sinasabi nila, meron tayong freedom of speech, freedom of expression.
english: They say, we have freedom of speech, freedom of expression.

text: Pero lagi po nating sinasabi, that is not absolute.
english: But we always say, that is not absolute.

text: Merong limitation yan.
english: There is a limitation.

text: Pagka lumalampas ka na sa parameter ng batas, nakaka-commit ka na ng krimen, e kailangan masawata natin yan,” suno sa director sang bureau.
english: When you go beyond the parameters of the law, you have committed a crime, we don't have to tolerate that,” said the director of the bureau.

text:
MALACAÑANG

Nagapakig-angot na ang Malacañang sa NBI kaangot sa nagalinapta nga fake news online nga mahimo maangot sa pagkaaresto kay former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english:
MALACAÑANG

Malacañang is already in contact with the NBI regarding the spread of fake news online that may be linked to the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Gin-cite pa mismo ni Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary Claire Castro ang nangin statement ni former Executive Secretary Salvador Medialdea nga wala sa detention facility si Duterte.
english: Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Undersecretary Claire Castro even quoted former Executive Secretary Salvador Medialdea's statement that Duterte is not in the detention facility.

text: Sang amo nga tion, madasig naman nga nagpaguwa sang statement ang International Criminal Court (ICC) agud balion ang nagalapta nga impormasyon nga missing ang former president.
english: Meanwhile, the International Criminal Court (ICC) quickly issued a statement to quash rumors that the former president was missing.

text: Nagapakig-angot man ang Palasyo sa National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) kag sa Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) agud nga madagdagan sang penalidad ang fake news peddlers.
english: The Palace is also working with the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) and the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) to increase penalties for fake news peddlers.

text: “Kapag po nandoon na po iyong elemento ng inciting to sedition, which is of course without any tumultuous uprising but they are encouraging people to sow hatred for the government, for the President, then we have to step up,” suno kay Castro.
english: “When you have the element of inciting to sedition, which is of course without any tumultuous uprising but they are encouraging people to sow hatred for the government, for the President, then we have to step up,” Castro said.

text: Ginsulit sang Malacañang nga bisan wala man nagapalingkang sa kritisismo si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr., dapat mahangpan sang publiko nga may limitasyon ang freedom of expression.
english: Malacañang reiterated that although President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. does not shy away from criticism, the public should understand that there are limits to freedom of expression.

text: Base sa recent Social Weather Stations survey, 62% sang mga Pilipino ang nagapati nga seryoso nga problema ang fake news, kag natukiban man sa amo nga survey nga madamo nga respondents ang nabudlayan sa paghibalo kun ano ang fake news.#
english: Based on the recent Social Weather Stations survey, 62% of Filipinos believe that fake news is a serious problem, and the survey also found that many respondents have difficulty knowing what fake news is.

text: Nagpaathag si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga indi direkta nga makadto sa mga job hire sang city government ang gintanyag nga bugas sang National Food Authority (NFA).
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas explained that the rice offered by the National Food Authority (NFA) will not go directly to the job hires of the city government.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga nagpadala sang sulat ang nasambit nga talatapan agud nga ipahibalo nga may yara sang monthly allocation sang 7,500 ka bags sang bugas nga for sale.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said the office sent a letter to inform that there is a monthly allocation of 7,500 bags of rice for sale.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, pangitaan pa sang pondo agud nga mabakal sang city government ang bugas kag mabaligya sa kapareho man nga balor nga ginhatag sang NFA.
english: According to Fantilaga, the city government will have to find funds to buy the rice and sell it at the same price given by the NFA.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ginalantaw sang syudad ang volume sang bugas nga baklon bangud may mga specific pa ini nga alokasyon.
english: He also said that the city is looking at the volume of rice to be purchased because it has specific allocations.

text: Plano naman nga i-endorse sang alkalde ang tikang sa finance committee agud matumod kon may pondo nga gamiton sa pagbakal.
english: The mayor plans to endorse the measure to the finance committee to determine if there is funds to be used for the purchase.

text: Pabor ang Liga ng mga Barangay President sang Iloilo City sa extension sang termino sang mga barangay officials.
english: The League of Barangay Presidents of Iloilo City is in favor of the extension of the term of barangay officials.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Ma.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Punong Barangay Ma.

text: Irene Ong, Presidente sang Liga ng mga Barangay sa Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ang extension ang mahimo magamit sang mga opisyal agud nga matapos ang mga proyekto.
english: Irene Ong, President of the League of Barangays in Iloilo, said the extension can be used by officials to complete the projects.
